This process results in the oriented division of the cell." [GOC:ascb_2009, GOC:dph, GOC:tb]

GO:0003428.name: chondrocyte intercalation involved in growth plate cartilage morphogenesis
GO:0003428.def: "The orderly movement of a chondrocyte from one site to another that contributes to the shaping of growth plate cartilage in an endochondral bone." [GOC:ascb_2009, GOC:dph, GOC:tb]

GO:0003429.name: growth plate cartilage chondrocyte morphogenesis
GO:0003429.def: "The process in which the structures of a chondrocyte in the growth plate cartilage are generated and organized." [GOC:ascb_2009, GOC:dph, GOC:tb]

GO:0003430.name: growth plate cartilage chondrocyte growth
GO:0003430.def: "The growth of a growth plate cartilage chondrocyte, where growth contributes to the progression of the chondrocyte over time from one condition to another." [GOC:ascb_2009, GOC:dph, GOC:tb]

GO:0003431.name: growth plate cartilage chondrocyte development
GO:0003431.def: "The progression of a growth plate cartilage chondrocyte over time from after its fate commitment to the mature cell." [GOC:ascb_2009, GOC:dph, GOC:tb]

GO:0003432.name: cell growth involved in growth plate cartilage chondrocyte morphogenesis
GO:0003432.def: "The growth of a growth plate cartilage chondrocyte, where growth contributes to the shaping of the chondrocyte over time." [GOC:ascb_2009, GOC:dph, GOC:tb]

GO:0003433.name: chondrocyte development involved in endochondral bone morphogenesis
GO:0003433.def: "The progression of a chondrocyte over time from after its commitment to its mature state where the chondrocyte will contribute to the shaping of an endochondral bone." [GOC:ascb_2009, GOC:dph, GOC:tb]

GO:0003436.name: regulation of cell adhesion involved in growth plate cartilage morphogenesis
GO:0003436.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of attachment of a cell to another cell or to the extracellular matrix and contributes to the shaping of the growth plate cartilage of an endochondral bone." [GOC:ascb_2009, GOC:dph, GOC:tb]

GO:0003437.name: regulation of cell communication involved in growth plate cartilage morphogenesis
GO:0003437.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of cell communication that contributes to the shaping of the growth plate cartilage." [GOC:ascb_2009, GOC:dph, GOC:tb]

GO:0003674.name: molecular_function
GO:0003674.def: "A molecular process that can be carried out by the action of a single macromolecular machine, usually via direct physical interactions with other molecular entities. Function in this sense denotes an action, or activity, that a gene product (or a complex) performs." [GOC:pdt]

GO:0003677.name: DNA binding
GO:0003677.def: "Any molecular function by which a gene product interacts selectively and non-covalently with DNA (deoxyribonucleic acid)." [GOC:dph, GOC:jl, GOC:tb, GOC:vw]

GO:0003678.name: DNA helicase activity
GO:0003678.def: "Unwinding of a DNA helix, driven by ATP hydrolysis." [GOC:jl]

GO:0003680.name: minor groove of adenine-thymine-rich DNA binding
GO:0003680.def: "Binding to a DNA structure formed by the minor groove of adenine-thymine-rich DNA regions. Examples of proteins having this function are AT-rich interaction domain (ARID)-containing proteins." [GOC:jl, PMID:10545119, PMID:15802641, PMID:26223912, PMID:2670564]

GO:0003681.name: bent DNA binding
GO:0003681.def: "Binding to DNA in a bent conformation." [GOC:jl, PMID:12627977]

GO:0003682.name: chromatin binding
GO:0003682.def: "Binding to chromatin, the network of fibers of DNA, protein, and sometimes RNA, that make up the chromosomes of the eukaryotic nucleus during interphase." [GOC:jl, ISBN:0198506732, PMID:20404130]

GO:0003688.name: DNA replication origin binding
GO:0003688.def: "Binding to a DNA replication origin, a unique DNA sequence of a replicon at which DNA replication is initiated and proceeds bidirectionally or unidirectionally." [GOC:curators]

GO:0003689.name: DNA clamp loader activity
GO:0003689.def: "Facilitating the opening of the ring structure of the PCNA complex, or any of the related sliding clamp complexes, and their closing around the DNA duplex, driven by ATP hydrolysis." [GOC:mah, GOC:vw, PMID:16082778]

GO:0003692.name: left-handed Z-DNA binding
GO:0003692.def: "Binding to DNA in the Z form, i.e. a left-handed helix in which the phosphate backbone zigzags." [ISBN:0716720094]

GO:0003693.name: P-element binding
GO:0003693.def: "Binding to a P-element, a class of Drosophila transposon responsible for hybrid dysgenesis." [GOC:jl, PMID:9440262]

GO:0003696.name: satellite DNA binding
GO:0003696.def: "Binding to satellite DNA, the many tandem repeats (identical or related) of a short basic repeating unit; many have a base composition or other property different from the genome average that allows them to be separated from the bulk (main band) genomic DNA." [GOC:jl, SO:0000005]

GO:0003700.name: DNA-binding transcription factor activity
GO:0003700.def: "A transcription regulator activity that modulates transcription of gene sets via selective and non-covalent binding to a specific double-stranded genomic DNA sequence (sometimes referred to as a motif) within a cis-regulatory region. Regulatory regions include promoters (proximal and distal) and enhancers. Genes are transcriptional units, and include bacterial operons." [GOC:txnOH-2018]

GO:0003707.name: nuclear steroid receptor activity
GO:0003707.def: "A nuclear receptor activity regulated by steroid binding and modulating the transcription of specific gene sets transcribed by RNA polymerase II." [GOC:signaling, PMID:14708019]

GO:0003711.name: transcription elongation factor activity
GO:0003711.def: "A molecular function that stimulates the elongation properties of the RNA polymerase during the elongation phase of transcription. A subclass of transcription elongation factors enable the transition from transcription initiation to elongation, while another class rescue stalled RNA polymerases." [GOC:txnOH-2018, PMID:23878398, PMID:28892040]

GO:0003712.name: transcription coregulator activity
GO:0003712.def: "A transcription regulator activity that modulates the transcription of specific gene sets via binding to a DNA-binding transcription factor at a specific genomic locus, either on its own or as part of a complex. Coregulators often act by altering chromatin structure and modifications. For example, one class of transcription coregulators modifies chromatin structure through covalent modification of histones. A second class remodels the conformation of chromatin in an ATP-dependent fashion. A third class modulates interactions of DNA-bound DNA-binding transcription factors with other transcription coregulators." [GOC:txnOH-2018, PMID:10213677, PMID:16858867, PMID:24203923, PMID:25957681, Wikipedia:Transcription_coregulator]

GO:0003713.name: transcription coactivator activity
GO:0003713.def: "A transcription coregulator activity that activates or increases the transcription of specific gene sets via binding to a DNA-binding transcription factor at a specific genomic locus, either on its own or as part of a complex. Coactivators often act by altering chromatin structure and modifications. For example, one class of transcription coactivators modifies chromatin structure through covalent modification of histones. A second class remodels the conformation of chromatin in an ATP-dependent fashion. A third class modulates interactions of DNA-bound DNA-binding transcription factors with other transcription coregulators. A fourth class of coactivator activity is the bridging of a DNA-binding transcription factor to the general (basal) transcription machinery. The Mediator complex, which bridges sequence-specific DNA binding transcription factors and RNA polymerase, is also a transcription coactivator." [GOC:txnOH-2018, PMID:10213677, PMID:16858867]

GO:0003714.name: transcription corepressor activity
GO:0003714.def: "A transcription coregulator activity that represses or decreases the transcription of specific gene sets via binding to a DNA-binding transcription factor at a specific genomic locus, either on its own or as part of a complex. Corepressors often act by altering chromatin structure and modifications. For example, one class of transcription corepressors modifies chromatin structure through covalent modification of histones. A second class remodels the conformation of chromatin in an ATP-dependent fashion. A third class modulates interactions of DNA-bound DNA-binding transcription factors with other transcription coregulators." [GOC:txnOH-2018, PMID:10213677, PMID:16858867]

GO:0003720.name: telomerase activity
GO:0003720.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate + DNA(n) = diphosphate + DNA(n+1) using an internal RNA template that encodes the telomeric repeat sequence." [GOC:krc, PMID:11812242, PMID:28732250]

GO:0003723.name: RNA binding
GO:0003723.def: "Binding to an RNA molecule or a portion thereof." [GOC:jl, GOC:mah]

GO:0003724.name: RNA helicase activity
GO:0003724.def: "Unwinding of an RNA helix, driven by ATP hydrolysis." [GOC:jl, PMID:19158098]

GO:0003726.name: double-stranded RNA adenosine deaminase activity
GO:0003726.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine + H2O = inosine + NH3, in a double-stranded RNA molecule." [GOC:mah, RHEA:10120]

GO:0003729.name: mRNA binding
GO:0003729.def: "Binding to messenger RNA (mRNA), an intermediate molecule between DNA and protein. mRNA includes UTR and coding sequences, but does not contain introns." [GOC:kmv, GOC:pr, SO:0000234]

GO:0003730.name: mRNA 3'-UTR binding
GO:0003730.def: "Binding to a 3' untranslated region of an mRNA molecule." [GOC:mah]

GO:0003735.name: structural constituent of ribosome
GO:0003735.def: "The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of the ribosome." [GOC:mah]

GO:0003743.name: translation initiation factor activity
GO:0003743.def: "Functions in the initiation of ribosome-mediated translation of mRNA into a polypeptide." [ISBN:0198506732]

GO:0003746.name: translation elongation factor activity
GO:0003746.def: "Functions in chain elongation during polypeptide synthesis at the ribosome." [ISBN:0198506732]

GO:0003747.name: translation release factor activity
GO:0003747.def: "Involved in catalyzing the release of a nascent polypeptide chain from a ribosome." [ISBN:0198547684]

GO:0003756.name: protein disulfide isomerase activity
GO:0003756.def: "Catalysis of the rearrangement of both intrachain and interchain disulfide bonds in proteins." [EC:5.3.4.1, GOC:vw, Wikipedia:Protein_disulfide-isomerase#Function]

GO:0003774.name: cytoskeletal motor activity
GO:0003774.def: "Generation of force resulting in movement, for example along a microfilament or microtubule, or in torque resulting in membrane scission or rotation of a flagellum. The energy required is obtained either from the hydrolysis of a nucleoside triphosphate or by an electrochemical proton gradient (proton-motive force)." [GOC:mah, GOC:vw, PMID:11242086, PMID:29716949]

GO:0003777.name: microtubule motor activity
GO:0003777.def: "A motor activity that generates movement along a microtubule, driven by ATP hydrolysis." [PMID:19686686, PMID:32684327, PMID:32842864]

GO:0003779.name: actin binding
GO:0003779.def: "Binding to monomeric or multimeric forms of actin, including actin filaments." [GOC:clt]

GO:0003785.name: actin monomer binding
GO:0003785.def: "Binding to monomeric actin, also known as G-actin." [GOC:ai]

GO:0003786.name: actin lateral binding
GO:0003786.def: "Binding to an actin filament along its length." [GOC:mah]

GO:0003788.name: actin monomer sequestering activity
GO:0003788.def: "Binding to an actin monomer to prevent it from interacting with other partners or to inhibit its localization to the area of the cell or complex where it is active." [PMID:11274401, PMID:1447300]

GO:0003789.name: actin filament severing activity
GO:0003789.def: "Binding to an actin subunit and promoting its dissociation from an actin filament by a local change in actin subunit conformation and orientation, and severing of filaments." [PMID:11812157, PMID:23395798, PMID:23727096]

GO:0003796.name: lysozyme activity
GO:0003796.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the beta-(1->4) linkages between N-acetylmuramic acid and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues in a peptidoglycan." [EC:3.2.1.17, PMID:22748813]

GO:0003810.name: protein-glutamine gamma-glutamyltransferase activity
GO:0003810.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutaminyl-[protein] + L-lysyl-[protein] = [protein]-L-lysyl-N(6)-5-L-glutamyl-[protein] + NH4+. This reaction is the formation of the N6-(L-isoglutamyl)-L-lysine isopeptide, resulting in cross-linking polypeptide chains; the gamma-carboxamide groups of peptidyl-glutamine residues act as acyl donors, and the 6-amino-groups of peptidyl-lysine residues act as acceptors, to give intra- and intermolecular N6-(5-glutamyl)lysine cross-links." [EC:2.3.2.13]

GO:0003823.name: antigen binding
GO:0003823.def: "Binding to an antigen, any substance which is capable of inducing a specific immune response and of reacting with the products of that response, the specific antibody or specifically sensitized T-lymphocytes, or both. Binding may counteract the biological activity of the antigen. Antigen binding by an MHC protein complex allows the antigen to be displayed to a T cell or NK cell." [GOC:jl, ISBN:0198506732, ISBN:0721662544]

GO:0003824.name: catalytic activity
GO:0003824.def: "Catalysis of a biochemical reaction at physiological temperatures. In biologically catalyzed reactions, the reactants are known as substrates, and the catalysts are naturally occurring macromolecular substances known as enzymes. Enzymes possess specific binding sites for substrates, and are usually composed wholly or largely of protein, but RNA that has catalytic activity (ribozyme) is often also regarded as enzymatic." [GOC:vw, ISBN:0198506732]

GO:0003825.name: alpha,alpha-trehalose-phosphate synthase (UDP-forming) activity
GO:0003825.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + D-glucose-6-phosphate = UDP + alpha,alpha-trehalose-6-phosphate." [EC:2.4.1.15]

GO:0003827.name: alpha-1,3-mannosylglycoprotein 2-beta-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
GO:0003827.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 3-(alpha-D-mannosyl)-beta-D-mannosyl-R + UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine = 3-(2-[N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl]-alpha-D-mannosyl)-beta-D-mannosyl-R + H+ + UDP." [EC:2.4.1.101, RHEA:11456]

GO:0003829.name: beta-1,3-galactosyl-O-glycosyl-glycoprotein beta-1,6-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
GO:0003829.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-N-acetyl-D-galactosaminyl-R = UDP + beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-[N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-(1->6)]-N-acetyl-D-galactosaminyl-R. This reaction is the addition of N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine to the core 1 structure of O-glycans forming core 2." [EC:2.4.1.102]

GO:0003830.name: beta-1,4-mannosylglycoprotein 4-beta-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
GO:0003830.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + beta-D-mannosyl-R = UDP + 4-(N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl)-beta-D-mannosyl-R." [EC:2.4.1.144]

GO:0003831.name: beta-N-acetylglucosaminylglycopeptide beta-1,4-galactosyltransferase activity
GO:0003831.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-galactose + N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminylglycopeptide = UDP + beta-D-galactosyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminylglycopeptide." [EC:2.4.1.38]

GO:0003832.name: beta-alanyl-dopamine hydrolase activity
GO:0003832.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: beta-alanyl-dopamine + H2O = dopamine + beta-alanine." [PMID:16299587, RHEA:73467]

GO:0003833.name: beta-alanyl amine synthase activity
GO:0003833.def: "Catalysis of the synthesis of beta-alanyl amine conjugate from a precursor biogenic amine, such as dopamine or histamine." [GOC:bf, ISBN:0198506732, PMID:12900414, PMID:12957543, PMID:25229196]

GO:0003834.name: beta-carotene 15,15'-dioxygenase activity
GO:0003834.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: all-trans-beta-carotene + O2 = 2 all-trans-retinal." [RHEA:32887]

GO:0003835.name: beta-galactoside alpha-2,6-sialyltransferase activity
GO:0003835.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: CMP-N-acetylneuraminate + beta-D-galactoside = N-acetyl-alpha-neuraminyl-(2->6)-beta-D-galactosyl derivative + CMP + H+." [EC:2.4.3.1]

GO:0003837.name: beta-ureidopropionase activity
GO:0003837.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: N-carbamoyl-beta-alanine + H2O = beta-alanine + CO2 + NH3." [EC:3.5.1.6]

GO:0003838.name: sterol 24-C-methyltransferase activity
GO:0003838.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + zymosterol = fecosterol + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine." [RHEA:21128]

GO:0003839.name: gamma-glutamylcyclotransferase activity
GO:0003839.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (5-L-glutamyl)-L-amino acid = 5-oxoproline + L-amino acid." [PMID:18515354]

GO:0003841.name: 1-acylglycerol-3-phosphate O-acyltransferase activity
GO:0003841.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-CoA + 1-acyl-sn-glycerol-3-phosphate = CoA + 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol-3-phosphate." [EC:2.3.1.51, GOC:ab]

GO:0003844.name: 1,4-alpha-glucan branching enzyme activity
GO:0003844.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of a segment of a (1->4)-alpha-D-glucan chain to a primary hydroxyl group in a similar glucan chain." [EC:2.4.1.18]

GO:0003846.name: 2-acylglycerol O-acyltransferase activity
GO:0003846.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-CoA + 2-acylglycerol = CoA + diacylglycerol." [PMID:4016575, RHEA:16741]

GO:0003847.name: 1-alkyl-2-acetylglycerophosphocholine esterase activity
GO:0003847.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-O-alkyl-2-acetyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine + H2O = 1-O-alkyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine + acetate + H+." [RHEA:17777]

GO:0003848.name: 2-amino-4-hydroxy-6-hydroxymethyldihydropteridine diphosphokinase activity
GO:0003848.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 2-amino-4-hydroxy-6-hydroxymethyl-7,8-dihydropteridine + ATP = (2-amino-4-hydroxy-7,8-dihydropteridin-6-yl)methyl diphosphate + AMP + 2 H+." [EC:2.7.6.3, RHEA:11412]

GO:0003849.name: 3-deoxy-7-phosphoheptulonate synthase activity
GO:0003849.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: D-erythrose 4-phosphate + H2O + phosphoenolpyruvate = 7-phospho-2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-arabino-heptonate + phosphate." [EC:2.5.1.54, RHEA:14717]

GO:0003851.name: N-acylsphingosine galactosyltransferase activity
GO:0003851.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: N-acylsphing-4-enine + UDP-alpha-D-galactose = a beta-D-galactosyl-(1<->1')-N-acylsphing-4-enine + H+ + UDP." [EC:2.4.1.47]

GO:0003852.name: 2-isopropylmalate synthase activity
GO:0003852.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate + acetyl-CoA + H2O = (2S)-2-isopropylmalate + CoA + H+." [RHEA:21524]

GO:0003853.name: short-chain 2-methyl fatty acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
GO:0003853.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: Catalysis of the reaction: a short-chain 2-methyl fatty acyl-CoA + H+ + oxidized [electron-transfer flavoprotein] = a short-chain (2E)-2-methyl-2-enoyl-CoA + reduced [electron-transfer flavoprotein]." [PMID:10989435, PMID:6401712]

GO:0003854.name: 3-beta-hydroxy-Delta5-steroid dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
GO:0003854.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 3-beta-hydroxy-Delta(5)-steroid + NAD+ = a 3-oxo-Delta(5)-steroid + NADH + H+. Also acts on on 3-beta-hydroxypregn-5-en-20-one to form progesterone." [EC:1.1.1.145]

GO:0003857.name: (3S)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
GO:0003857.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a (3S)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA + NAD+ = a 3-oxoacyl-CoA + NADH + H+." [RHEA:22432]

GO:0003858.name: 3-hydroxybutyrate dehydrogenase activity
GO:0003858.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-3-hydroxybutanoate + NAD+ = acetoacetate + H+ + NADH." [EC:1.1.1.30, RHEA:20521]

GO:0003862.name: 3-isopropylmalate dehydrogenase activity
GO:0003862.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (2R,3S)-3-isopropylmalate + NAD+ = 4-methyl-2-oxopentanoate + CO2 + NADH." [RHEA:32271]

GO:0003863.name: branched-chain 2-oxo acid dehydrogenase activity
GO:0003863.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-[(R)-lipoyl]-L-lysyl-[dihydrolipoyllysine-residue (2-methylpropanoyl)transferase] + 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate + H+ = N(6)-[(R)-S(8)-2-methylpropanoyldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[dihydrolipoyllysine-residue (2-methylpropanoyl)transferase] + CO2. Also acts on 4-methyl-2-oxopentanoate and (S)-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoate, so that it acts on the 2-oxo acids that derive from the action of transaminases on valine, leucine and isoleucine." [EC:1.2.4.4]

GO:0003865.name: 3-oxo-5-alpha-steroid 4-dehydrogenase activity
GO:0003865.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 3-oxo-5-alpha-steroid + acceptor = a 3-oxo-delta(4)-steroid + reduced acceptor." [EC:1.3.99.5]

GO:0003866.name: 3-phosphoshikimate 1-carboxyvinyltransferase activity
GO:0003866.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 3-phosphoshikimate + phosphoenolpyruvate = 5-O-(1-carboxyvinyl)-3-phosphoshikimate + phosphate." [EC:2.5.1.19, RHEA:21256]

GO:0003868.name: 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase activity
GO:0003868.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate + O2 = homogentisate + CO2." [EC:1.13.11.27]

GO:0003870.name: 5-aminolevulinate synthase activity
GO:0003870.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: glycine + H+ + succinyl-CoA = 5-aminolevulinate + CO2 + CoA." [EC:2.3.1.37, RHEA:12921]

GO:0003871.name: 5-methyltetrahydropteroyltriglutamate-homocysteine S-methyltransferase activity
GO:0003871.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 5-methyltetrahydropteroyltri-L-glutamate + L-homocysteine = L-methionine + tetrahydropteroyltri-L-glutamate." [EC:2.1.1.14, RHEA:21196]

GO:0003872.name: 6-phosphofructokinase activity
GO:0003872.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + D-fructose-6-phosphate = ADP + D-fructose 1,6-bisphosphate." [EC:2.7.1.11]

GO:0003873.name: 6-phosphofructo-2-kinase activity
GO:0003873.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: beta-D-fructose 6-phosphate + ATP = beta-D-fructose 2,6-bisphosphate + ADP + 2 H+." [EC:2.7.1.105, RHEA:15653]

GO:0003874.name: 6-pyruvoyltetrahydropterin synthase activity
GO:0003874.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 7,8-dihydroneopterin 3'-triphosphate = 6-pyruvoyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydropterin + H+ + triphosphate." [EC:4.2.3.12, RHEA:22048]

GO:0003875.name: ADP-ribosylarginine hydrolase activity
GO:0003875.def: "Catalysis of the reactions: H2O + N(omega)-(ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-arginyl-[protein] = ADP-D-ribose + L-arginyl-[protein], and H2O + N(omega)-(ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-arginine = ADP-D-ribose + L-arginine." [EC:3.2.2.19]

GO:0003876.name: AMP deaminase activity
GO:0003876.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: AMP + H2O = IMP + NH3." [EC:3.5.4.6]

GO:0003877.name: ATP:ADP adenylyltransferase activity
GO:0003877.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ADP + ATP = phosphate + P(1),P(4)-bis(5'-adenosyl)tetraphosphate." [EC:2.7.7.53]

GO:0003878.name: ATP citrate synthase activity
GO:0003878.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + ADP + H+ + oxaloacetate + phosphate = ATP + citrate + CoA." [RHEA:21160]

GO:0003880.name: protein C-terminal carboxyl O-methyltransferase activity
GO:0003880.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of a methyl group to the oxygen atom of a carboxyl group at the C-terminal of a protein." [PMID:8428937]

GO:0003881.name: CDP-diacylglycerol-inositol 3-phosphatidyltransferase activity
GO:0003881.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: myo-inositol + CDP-diacylglycerol = 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol + CMP + H+." [EC:2.7.8.11, RHEA:11580]

GO:0003882.name: CDP-diacylglycerol-serine O-phosphatidyltransferase activity
GO:0003882.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: CDP-diacylglycerol + L-serine = CMP + O-sn-phosphatidyl-L-serine." [EC:2.7.8.8]

GO:0003883.name: CTP synthase activity
GO:0003883.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + UTP + glutamine + H20= ADP + phosphate + CTP + glutamate." [PMID:12354108, RHEA:26426]

GO:0003884.name: D-amino-acid oxidase activity
GO:0003884.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a D-alpha-amino acid + H2O + O2 = a 2-oxocarboxylate + H2O2 + NH4+." [RHEA:21816]

GO:0003885.name: D-arabinono-1,4-lactone oxidase activity
GO:0003885.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: D-arabinono-1,4-lactone + O2 = dehydro-D-arabinono-1,4-lactone + H2O2 + H+." [EC:1.1.3.37, RHEA:23756]

GO:0003886.name: DNA (cytosine-5-)-methyltransferase activity
GO:0003886.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 2'-deoxycytidine in DNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a 5-methyl-2'-deoxycytidine in DNA + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine." [RHEA:13681]

GO:0003887.name: DNA-directed DNA polymerase activity
GO:0003887.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: deoxynucleoside triphosphate + DNA(n) = diphosphate + DNA(n+1); DNA-template-directed extension of the 3'-end of a DNA strand by one nucleotide at a time." [EC:2.7.7.7, GOC:vw]

GO:0003899.name: DNA-directed RNA polymerase activity
GO:0003899.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: nucleoside triphosphate + RNA(n) = diphosphate + RNA(n+1). Utilizes a DNA template, i.e. the catalysis of DNA-template-directed extension of the 3'-end of an RNA strand by one nucleotide at a time. Can initiate a chain 'de novo'." [EC:2.7.7.6]

GO:0003904.name: deoxyribodipyrimidine photo-lyase activity
GO:0003904.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: cyclobutadipyrimidine (in DNA) = 2 pyrimidine residues (in DNA). This reaction represents the reactivation of irradiated DNA by light." [EC:4.1.99.3]

GO:0003905.name: alkylbase DNA N-glycosylase activity
GO:0003905.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: DNA with alkylated base + H2O = DNA with abasic site + alkylated base. This reaction is the hydrolysis of DNA by cleavage of the N-C1' glycosidic bond between the target damaged DNA base and the deoxyribose sugar to remove an alkylated base, leaving an apyrimidinic or apurinic site." [EC:3.2.2.21, GOC:elh, PMID:10872450, PMID:9224623]

GO:0003906.name: DNA-(apurinic or apyrimidinic site) endonuclease activity
GO:0003906.def: "Catalysis of the cleavage of the C-O-P bond in the AP site created when DNA glycosylase removes a damaged base, involved in the DNA base excision repair pathway (BER)." [Wikipedia:AP_endonuclease]

GO:0003908.name: methylated-DNA-[protein]-cysteine S-methyltransferase activity
GO:0003908.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: DNA (containing 6-O-methylguanine) + (protein)-L-cysteine = DNA (without 6-O-methylguanine) + protein S-methyl-L-cysteine." [EC:2.1.1.63]

GO:0003909.name: DNA ligase activity
GO:0003909.def: "Catalysis of the formation of a phosphodiester bond between the 3'-hydroxyl group at the end of one DNA chain and the 5'-phosphate group at the end of another. This reaction requires an energy source such as ATP or NAD+." [ISBN:0716720094]

GO:0003910.name: DNA ligase (ATP) activity
GO:0003910.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + deoxyribonucleotide(n) + deoxyribonucleotide(m) = AMP + diphosphate + deoxyribonucleotide(n+m)." [EC:6.5.1.1]

GO:0003911.name: DNA ligase (NAD+) activity
GO:0003911.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + deoxyribonucleotide(n) + deoxyribonucleotide(m) = AMP + nicotinamide nucleotide + deoxyribonucleotide(n+m)." [EC:6.5.1.2]

GO:0003912.name: DNA nucleotidylexotransferase activity
GO:0003912.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: deoxynucleoside triphosphate + DNA(n) = diphosphate + DNA(n+1); template-independent extension of the 3'-end of a DNA strand by one nucleotide at a time." [EC:2.7.7.31]

GO:0003913.name: DNA photolyase activity
GO:0003913.def: "Catalysis of the repair of a photoproduct resulting from ultraviolet irradiation of two adjacent pyrimidine residues in DNA." [GOC:mah, PMID:11124949]

GO:0003914.name: DNA (6-4) photolyase activity
GO:0003914.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: pyrimidine-pyrimidone (6-4) photoproduct (in DNA) = 2 pyrimidine residues (in DNA). Catalyzes the reactivation of ultraviolet-irradiated DNA." [GOC:mah, PMID:11124949]

GO:0003916.name: DNA topoisomerase activity
GO:0003916.def: "Catalysis of the transient cleavage and passage of individual DNA strands or double helices through one another, resulting a topological transformation in double-stranded DNA." [GOC:mah, PMID:8811192]

GO:0003917.name: DNA topoisomerase type I (single strand cut, ATP-independent) activity
GO:0003917.def: "Catalysis of a DNA topological transformation by transiently cleaving one DNA strand at a time to allow passage of another strand; changes the linking number by +1 per catalytic cycle." [PMID:8811192]

GO:0003918.name: DNA topoisomerase type II (double strand cut, ATP-hydrolyzing) activity
GO:0003918.def: "Catalysis of a DNA topological transformation by transiently cleaving a pair of complementary DNA strands to form a gate through which a second double-stranded DNA segment is passed, after which the severed strands in the first DNA segment are rejoined, driven by ATP hydrolysis. The enzyme changes the linking number in multiples of 2." [PMID:8811192]

GO:0003919.name: FMN adenylyltransferase activity
GO:0003919.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + FMN = diphosphate + FAD." [EC:2.7.7.2, RHEA:17237]

GO:0003920.name: GMP reductase activity
GO:0003920.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: IMP + NADP+ + NH4 = GMP + 2 H+ + NADPH." [EC:1.7.1.7, RHEA:17185]

GO:0003921.name: GMP synthase activity
GO:0003921.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + XMP + NH4(+) = AMP + diphosphate + GMP + 2H+." [RHEA:18301]

GO:0003922.name: GMP synthase (glutamine-hydrolyzing) activity
GO:0003922.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + XMP + L-glutamine + H2O = AMP + diphosphate + GMP + L-glutamate + 2H+." [RHEA:11680]

GO:0003923.name: GPI-anchor transamidase activity
GO:0003923.def: "Catalysis of the formation of the linkage between a protein and a glycosylphosphatidylinositol anchor. The reaction probably occurs by subjecting a peptide bond to nucleophilic attack by the amino group of ethanolamine-GPI, transferring the protein from a signal peptide to the GPI anchor." [ISBN:0471331309]

GO:0003924.name: GTPase activity
GO:0003924.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + H2O = GDP + H+ + phosphate." [PMID:26832457, PMID:27218782]

GO:0003925.name: G protein activity
GO:0003925.def: "A molecular function regulator that cycles between active GTP-bound and inactive GDP-bound states. In its active state, binds to a variety of effector proteins to regulate cellular processes. Intrinsic GTPase activity returns the G protein to its GDP-bound state. The return to the GDP-bound state can be accelerated by the action of a GTPase-activating protein (GAP)." [PMID:16923326, PMID:24470015]

GO:0003933.name: GTP cyclohydrolase activity
GO:0003933.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the imidazole ring of GTP, releasing formate. Two C-N bonds are hydrolyzed and the pentase unit is isomerized." [GOC:curators]

GO:0003934.name: GTP cyclohydrolase I activity
GO:0003934.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + H2O = 7,8-dihydroneopterin 3'-triphosphate + formate + H+." [EC:3.5.4.16]

GO:0003935.name: GTP cyclohydrolase II activity
GO:0003935.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + 4 H2O = 2,5-diamino-6-hydroxy-4-(5-phosphoribosylamino)-pyrimidine + formate + 3 H+ + 2 phosphate." [EC:3.5.4.25, RHEA:23704]

GO:0003938.name: IMP dehydrogenase activity
GO:0003938.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: inosine 5'-phosphate + NAD+ + H2O = xanthosine 5'-phosphate + NADH + H+." [EC:1.1.1.205]

GO:0003939.name: L-iditol 2-dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
GO:0003939.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-iditol + NAD+ = L-sorbose + NADH + H+. Acts on a number of sugar alcohols, including (but not limited to) L-iditol, D-glucitol, D-xylitol, and D-galactitol." [EC:1.1.1.14, PMID:13373783]

GO:0003940.name: L-iduronidase activity
GO:0003940.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of alpha-L-iduronosidic linkages in dermatan sulfate. Can also hydrolyze alpha-L-iduronosidic linkages in heparan sulfate." [EC:3.2.1.76, PMID:35011691]

GO:0003941.name: L-serine ammonia-lyase activity
GO:0003941.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-serine = pyruvate + NH3." [EC:4.3.1.17]

GO:0003942.name: N-acetyl-gamma-glutamyl-phosphate reductase activity
GO:0003942.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyl-L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde + NADP+ + phosphate = N-acetyl-5-glutamyl phosphate + NADPH + H+." [RHEA:21588]

GO:0003943.name: N-acetylgalactosamine-4-sulfatase activity
GO:0003943.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the 4-sulfate groups of the N-acetyl-D-galactosamine 4-sulfate units of chondroitin sulfate and dermatan sulfate." [EC:3.1.6.12]

GO:0003944.name: N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphodiester alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity
GO:0003944.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: glycoprotein N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-phospho-D-mannose + H2O = N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + glycoprotein phospho-D-mannose." [EC:3.1.4.45]

GO:0003945.name: N-acetyllactosamine synthase activity
GO:0003945.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-galactose + N-acetyl-D-glucosamine = UDP + N-acetyllactosamine." [EC:2.4.1.90]

GO:0003948.name: N4-(beta-N-acetylglucosaminyl)-L-asparaginase activity
GO:0003948.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: N(4)-(beta-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl)-L-asparagine + H2O = N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminylamine + L-aspartate + H+." [EC:3.5.1.26, RHEA:11544]

GO:0003951.name: NAD+ kinase activity
GO:0003951.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + NAD+ = ADP + H+ + NADP+." [RHEA:18629]

GO:0003952.name: NAD+ synthase (glutamine-hydrolyzing) activity
GO:0003952.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: deamido-NAD+ + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O = L-glutamate + AMP + diphosphate + NAD+ + H+." [RHEA:24384]

GO:0003953.name: NAD+ nucleosidase activity
GO:0003953.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + H2O = ADP-D-ribose + nicotinamide + H+." [PMID:11866528, PMID:7805847, RHEA:16301]

GO:0003954.name: NADH dehydrogenase activity
GO:0003954.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: NADH + H+ + acceptor = NAD+ + reduced acceptor." [RHEA:11356]

GO:0003955.name: NAD(P)H dehydrogenase (quinone) activity
GO:0003955.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: NAD(P)H + H+ + a quinone = NAD(P)+ + a quinol." [EC:1.6.5.2]

GO:0003957.name: NAD(P)+ transhydrogenase (Si-specific) activity
GO:0003957.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: NADPH + NAD+ = NADP+ + NADH." [RHEA:11692]

GO:0003958.name: NADPH-hemoprotein reductase activity
GO:0003958.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: NADPH + H+ + n oxidized hemoprotein = NADP+ + n reduced hemoprotein." [EC:1.6.2.4]

GO:0003959.name: NADPH dehydrogenase activity
GO:0003959.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: NADPH + H+ + acceptor = NADP+ + reduced acceptor." [RHEA:13149]

GO:0003960.name: quinone reductase (NADPH) activity
GO:0003960.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 2 a quinone + NADPH + H+ = 2 a 1,4-benzosemiquinone + NADP+." [RHEA:14269]

GO:0003961.name: O-acetylhomoserine aminocarboxypropyltransferase activity
GO:0003961.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: O-acetyl-L-homoserine + methanethiol = L-methionine + acetate. Also reacts with other thiols and H2S, producing homocysteine or thioethers." [EC:2.5.1.49]

GO:0003962.name: cystathionine gamma-synthase activity
GO:0003962.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-cysteine + O-succinyl-L-homoserine = H+ + L,L-cystathionine + succinate." [RHEA:20397]

GO:0003963.name: RNA-3'-phosphate cyclase activity
GO:0003963.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + RNA 3'-terminal-phosphate = AMP + diphosphate + RNA terminal-2',3'-cyclic-phosphate." [EC:6.5.1.4]

GO:0003964.name: RNA-directed DNA polymerase activity
GO:0003964.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate + DNA(n) = diphosphate + DNA(n+1); RNA-template-directed extension of the 3'-end of a DNA strand by one deoxynucleotide at a time." [EC:2.7.7.49]

GO:0003968.name: RNA-directed RNA polymerase activity
GO:0003968.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: nucleoside triphosphate + RNA(n) = diphosphate + RNA(n+1); uses an RNA template, i.e. the catalysis of RNA-template-directed extension of the 3'-end of an RNA strand by one nucleotide at a time." [EC:2.7.7.48, GOC:mah, GOC:pf]

GO:0003972.name: RNA ligase (ATP) activity
GO:0003972.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + (ribonucleotide)n-3'-hydroxyl + 5'-phospho-(ribonucleotide)m = (ribonucleotide)n+m + AMP + diphosphate." [EC:6.5.1.3]

GO:0003973.name: (S)-2-hydroxy-acid oxidase activity
GO:0003973.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-2-hydroxy-acid + O2 = 2-oxo acid + hydrogen peroxide." [RHEA:16789]

GO:0003975.name: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine-dolichyl-phosphate N-acetylglucosaminephosphotransferase activity
GO:0003975.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + dolichyl phosphate = UMP + N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-diphosphodolichol." [EC:2.7.8.15]

GO:0003976.name: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine-lysosomal-enzyme N-acetylglucosaminephosphotransferase activity
GO:0003976.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + lysosomal-enzyme D-mannose = UMP + lysosomal-enzyme N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-phospho-D-mannose." [EC:2.7.8.17]

GO:0003977.name: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine diphosphorylase activity
GO:0003977.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + UTP = diphosphate + UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine." [EC:2.7.7.23, RHEA:13509]

GO:0003979.name: UDP-glucose 6-dehydrogenase activity
GO:0003979.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + 2 NAD+ + UDP-alpha-D-glucose = 3 H+ + 2 NADH + UDP-alpha-D-glucuronate." [EC:1.1.1.22, RHEA:23596]

GO:0003980.name: UDP-glucose:glycoprotein glucosyltransferase activity
GO:0003980.def: "Catalysis of the addition of UDP-glucose on to asparagine-linked (N-linked) oligosaccharides of the form Man7-9GlcNAc2 on incorrectly folded glycoproteins." [GOC:al, PMID:10764828]

GO:0003983.name: UTP:glucose-1-phosphate uridylyltransferase activity
GO:0003983.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate + UTP = diphosphate + UDP-D-glucose." [EC:2.7.7.9, RHEA:19889]

GO:0003984.name: acetolactate synthase activity
GO:0003984.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + 2 pyruvate = (2S)-2-acetolactate + CO2. Can also convert 2-oxobutanoate and pyruvate to (S)-2-ethyl-2-hydroxy-3-oxobutanoate." [EC:2.2.1.6]

GO:0003985.name: acetyl-CoA C-acetyltransferase activity
GO:0003985.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 2 acetyl-CoA = CoA + acetoacetyl-CoA." [RHEA:21036]

GO:0003986.name: acetyl-CoA hydrolase activity
GO:0003986.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + H2O = acetate + CoA + H+." [EC:3.1.2.1, RHEA:20289]

GO:0003987.name: acetate-CoA ligase activity
GO:0003987.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + acetate + CoA = AMP + diphosphate + acetyl-CoA." [EC:6.2.1.1]

GO:0003988.name: acetyl-CoA C-acyltransferase activity
GO:0003988.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-CoA + acetyl-CoA = CoA + 3-oxoacyl-CoA." [RHEA:21564]

GO:0003989.name: acetyl-CoA carboxylase activity
GO:0003989.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + acetyl-CoA + HCO3- = ADP + phosphate + malonyl-CoA." [EC:6.4.1.2]

GO:0003990.name: acetylcholinesterase activity
GO:0003990.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: acetylcholine + H2O = choline + acetate." [EC:3.1.1.7]

GO:0003991.name: acetylglutamate kinase activity
GO:0003991.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + N-acetyl-L-glutamate = ADP + N-acetyl-L-glutamate-5-phosphate." [EC:2.7.2.8]

GO:0003992.name: N2-acetyl-L-ornithine:2-oxoglutarate 5-aminotransferase activity
GO:0003992.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + N(2)-acetyl-L-ornithine = N-acetyl-L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde + L-glutamate." [EC:2.6.1.11, RHEA:18049]

GO:0003993.name: acid phosphatase activity
GO:0003993.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: an orthophosphoric monoester + H2O = an alcohol + phosphate, with an acid pH optimum." [EC:3.1.3.2]

GO:0003994.name: aconitate hydratase activity
GO:0003994.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: citrate = isocitrate. The reaction occurs in two steps: (1) citrate = cis-aconitate + H2O, (2) cis-aconitate + H2O = isocitrate. This reaction is the interconversion of citrate and isocitrate via the labile, enzyme-bound intermediate cis-aconitate. Water is removed from one part of the citrate molecule and added back to a different atom to form isocitrate." [EC:4.2.1.3, GOC:pde, GOC:vw]

GO:0003995.name: acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
GO:0003995.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 2,3-saturated acyl-CoA + H+ oxidized [electron-transfer flavoprotein] = a (2E)-enoyl-CoA + reduced [electron-transfer flavoprotein]." [RHEA:44704]

GO:0003997.name: acyl-CoA oxidase activity
GO:0003997.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 2,3-saturated acyl-CoA + O2 = a (2E)-enoyl-CoA + H2O2." [RHEA:38959]

GO:0003998.name: acylphosphatase activity
GO:0003998.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: an acyl phosphate + H2O = a carboxylate + phosphate." [EC:3.6.1.7]

GO:0003999.name: adenine phosphoribosyltransferase activity
GO:0003999.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: AMP + diphosphate = adenine + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate." [RHEA:16609]

GO:0004000.name: adenosine deaminase activity
GO:0004000.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine + H2O = inosine + NH3." [RHEA:24408]

GO:0004001.name: adenosine kinase activity
GO:0004001.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + adenosine = ADP + AMP." [EC:2.7.1.20, PMID:11223943]

GO:0004013.name: adenosylhomocysteinase activity
GO:0004013.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H2O = adenosine + L-homocysteine." [RHEA:21708]

GO:0004014.name: adenosylmethionine decarboxylase activity
GO:0004014.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + H+ = S-adenosylmethioninamine + CO2." [EC:4.1.1.50, RHEA:15981]

GO:0004015.name: adenosylmethionine-8-amino-7-oxononanoate transaminase activity
GO:0004015.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 8-amino-7-oxononanoate + S-adenosyl-L-methionine(1+) = 7,8-diaminononanoate + S-adenosyl-4-methylthio-2-oxobutanoate." [EC:2.6.1.62, RHEA:16861]

GO:0004016.name: adenylate cyclase activity
GO:0004016.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP = 3',5'-cyclic AMP + diphosphate." [EC:4.6.1.1]

GO:0004017.name: AMP kinase activity
GO:0004017.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + AMP = 2 ADP." [RHEA:12973]

GO:0004018.name: N6-(1,2-dicarboxyethyl)AMP AMP-lyase (fumarate-forming) activity
GO:0004018.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: N6-(1,2-dicarboxyethyl)AMP = fumarate + AMP." [RHEA:16853]

GO:0004019.name: adenylosuccinate synthase activity
GO:0004019.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate + GTP + IMP = N(6)-(1,2-dicarboxyethyl)-AMP + GDP + 3 H+ + phosphate." [EC:6.3.4.4, RHEA:15753]

GO:0004020.name: adenylylsulfate kinase activity
GO:0004020.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + ATP = 3'-phosphoadenylyl sulfate + ADP + H+." [EC:2.7.1.25]

GO:0004021.name: L-alanine:2-oxoglutarate aminotransferase activity
GO:0004021.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + L-alanine = L-glutamate + pyruvate." [RHEA:19453]

GO:0004022.name: alcohol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
GO:0004022.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: an alcohol + NAD+ = an aldehyde or ketone + NADH + H+." [EC:1.1.1.1]

GO:0004026.name: alcohol O-acetyltransferase activity
GO:0004026.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + an alcohol = CoA + an acetyl ester." [EC:2.3.1.84]

GO:0004027.name: alcohol sulfotransferase activity
GO:0004027.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + an alcohol = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + an alkyl sulfate." [EC:2.8.2.2]

GO:0004028.name: 3-chloroallyl aldehyde dehydrogenase activity
GO:0004028.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 3-chloroallyl aldehyde + H2O = 2 H+ + 2 e- + 3-chloroacrylic acid." [GOC:curators]

GO:0004029.name: aldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
GO:0004029.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: an aldehyde + H2O + NAD+ = a carboxylate + 2 H+ + NADH." [RHEA:16185]

GO:0004030.name: aldehyde dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
GO:0004030.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: an aldehyde + NAD(P)+ + H2O = an acid + NAD(P)H + H+." [EC:1.2.1.5]

GO:0004031.name: aldehyde oxidase activity
GO:0004031.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: an aldehyde + H2O + O2 = a carboxylic acid + hydrogen peroxide." [EC:1.2.3.1]

GO:0004032.name: aldose reductase (NADPH) activity
GO:0004032.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: an alditol + NADP+ = an aldose + NADPH + H+." [EC:1.1.1.21]

GO:0004034.name: aldose 1-epimerase activity
GO:0004034.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucose = beta-D-glucose. Also acts on L-arabinose, D-xylose, D-galactose, maltose and lactose." [EC:5.1.3.3]

GO:0004035.name: alkaline phosphatase activity
GO:0004035.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a phosphate monoester + H2O = an alcohol + phosphate, with an alkaline pH optimum." [EC:3.1.3.1]

GO:0004037.name: allantoicase activity
GO:0004037.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: allantoate + H2O = (S)-ureidoglycolate + urea." [EC:3.5.3.4, RHEA:11016]

GO:0004038.name: allantoinase activity
GO:0004038.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: allantoin + H2O = allantoate." [EC:3.5.2.5]

GO:0004039.name: allophanate hydrolase activity
GO:0004039.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + 3 H+ + urea-1-carboxylate = 2 CO2 + 2 NH4." [EC:3.5.1.54, RHEA:19029]

GO:0004040.name: amidase activity
GO:0004040.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a monocarboxylic acid amide + H2O = a monocarboxylate + NH4+." [RHEA:12020]

GO:0004042.name: L-glutamate N-acetyltransferase activity
GO:0004042.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamate + acetyl-CoA = N-acetyl-L-glutamate + CoA + H+." [RHEA:24292]

GO:0004043.name: L-aminoadipate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity
GO:0004043.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-2-aminoadipate 6-semialdehyde + NADP+ + H2O = L-2-aminoadipate + NADPH + H+." [EC:1.2.1.31]

GO:0004044.name: amidophosphoribosyltransferase activity
GO:0004044.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 5-phospho-beta-D-ribosylamine + L-glutamate + diphosphate = 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + L-glutamine + H2O." [EC:2.4.2.14, RHEA:14905]

GO:0004045.name: peptidyl-tRNA hydrolase activity
GO:0004045.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: an N-acyl-L-alpha-aminoacyl-tRNA + H2O = an N-acyl-L-amino acid + a tRNA + H+." [RHEA:54448]

GO:0004046.name: aminoacylase activity
GO:0004046.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: an N-acyl-L-amino acid + H2O = a carboxylate + an L-amino acid." [EC:3.5.1.14]

GO:0004048.name: anthranilate phosphoribosyltransferase activity
GO:0004048.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: N-(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)anthranilate + diphosphate = 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + anthranilate." [EC:2.4.2.18, RHEA:11768]

GO:0004049.name: anthranilate synthase activity
GO:0004049.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: chorismate + L-glutamine = anthranilate + pyruvate + L-glutamate." [EC:4.1.3.27]

GO:0004050.name: apyrase activity
GO:0004050.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a ribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate + 2 H2O = a ribonucleoside 5'-phosphate + 2 phosphate. This reaction consists of two distinct successive phosphate-releasing steps, with NDPs as intermediates. GO:0004053.name: arginase activity

GO:0004054.name: arginine kinase activity

GO:0004057.name: arginyl-tRNA--protein transferase activity

GO:0004066.name: asparagine synthase (glutamine-hydrolyzing) activity

GO:0004068.name: aspartate 1-decarboxylase activity

GO:0004070.name: aspartate carbamoyltransferase activity

GO:0004071.name: aspartate-ammonia ligase activity

GO:0004073.name: aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity

GO:0004074.name: biliverdin reductase [NAD(P)H] activity

GO:0004075.name: biotin carboxylase activity

GO:0004076.name: biotin synthase activity

GO:0004077.name: biotin--[biotin carboxyl-carrier protein] ligase activity

GO:0004081.name: bis(5'-nucleosyl)-tetraphosphatase (asymmetrical) activity

GO:0004084.name: branched-chain-amino-acid transaminase activity

GO:0004088.name: carbamoyl-phosphate synthase (glutamine-hydrolyzing) activity

GO:0004095.name: carnitine O-palmitoyltransferase activity

GO:0004096.name: catalase activity

GO:0004097.name: catechol oxidase activity

GO:0004098.name: cerebroside-sulfatase activity

GO:0004099.name: chitin deacetylase activity

GO:0004102.name: choline O-acetyltransferase activity

GO:0004109.name: coproporphyrinogen oxidase activity
GO:0004109.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: coproporphyrinogen III + 2 H+ + O2 = 2 CO2 + 2 H2O + protoporphyrinogen IX." [EC:1.3.3.3, RHEA:18257]

GO:0004111.name: creatine kinase activity
GO:0004111.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + creatine = N-phosphocreatine + ADP + 2 H+." [EC:2.7.3.2, RHEA:17157]

GO:0004112.name: cyclic-nucleotide phosphodiesterase activity

GO:0004114.name: 3',5'-cyclic-nucleotide phosphodiesterase activity

GO:0004115.name: 3',5'-cyclic-AMP phosphodiesterase activity
GO:0004115.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 3',5'-cyclic AMP + H2O = AMP + H+." [GOC:ai, RHEA:25277]

GO:0004117.name: calmodulin-activated dual specificity 3',5'-cyclic-GMP, 3',5'-cyclic-AMP phosphodiesterase activity
GO:0004117.def: "Catalysis of the reactions: 3',5'-cyclic AMP + H2O = AMP + H+ and 3',5'-cyclic GMP + H2O = GMP + H+; this activity is activated by binding to calcium-bound calmodulin." [PMID:8557689, PMID:9419816]

GO:0004118.name: 3',5'-cGMP-stimulated cyclic-nucleotide phosphodiesterase activity

GO:0004119.name: 3',5'-cGMP-inhibited cyclic-nucleotide phosphodiesterase activity

GO:0004122.name: cystathionine beta-synthase activity

GO:0004123.name: cystathionine gamma-lyase activity

GO:0004125.name: L-seryl-tRNA(Sec) selenium transferase activity

GO:0004126.name: cytidine deaminase activity

GO:0004134.name: 4-alpha-glucanotransferase activity

GO:0004135.name: amylo-alpha-1,6-glucosidase activity
GO:0004135.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of (1->6)-alpha-D-glucosidic branch linkages in glycogen phosphorylase limit dextrin. Limit dextrin is the highly branched core that remains after exhaustive treatment of glycogen with glycogen phosphorylase. It is formed because these enzymes cannot hydrolyze the (1->6) glycosidic linkages present." [EC:3.2.1.33]

GO:0004136.name: deoxyadenosine kinase activity
GO:0004136.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 2'-deoxyadenosine + ATP = ADP + dAMP + 2 H+." [EC:2.7.1.76, RHEA:23452]

GO:0004137.name: deoxycytidine kinase activity

GO:0004142.name: diacylglycerol cholinephosphotransferase activity

GO:0004145.name: diamine N-acetyltransferase activity

GO:0004146.name: dihydrofolate reductase activity

GO:0004148.name: dihydrolipoyl dehydrogenase (NADH) activity

GO:0004149.name: dihydrolipoyllysine-residue succinyltransferase activity

GO:0004151.name: dihydroorotase activity
GO:0004151.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-dihydroorotate + H2O = N-carbamoyl-L-aspartate + H+." [EC:3.5.2.3, RHEA:24296]

GO:0004152.name: dihydroorotate dehydrogenase activity
GO:0004152.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-dihydroorotate + A = AH(2) + orotate." [RHEA:18073]

GO:0004153.name: dihydropterin deaminase activity

GO:0004154.name: dihydropterin oxidase activity
GO:0004154.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 7,8-dihydropteridine compound + O2 = an oxidized 7,8-dihydropteridine compound + H2O2. Specific substrates and their fully oxidized products include: 7,8-dihydropteridin/pterin, 7,8-dihydrobiopterin/biopterin, 7,8-dihydroxanthopterin/xanthopterin and sepiapterin/oxidized sepiapterin." [GOC:sjm, PMID:1745247, PMID:38786926, PMID:6815189]

GO:0004155.name: 6,7-dihydropteridine reductase activity

GO:0004156.name: dihydropteroate synthase activity

GO:0004159.name: dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity

GO:0004161.name: dimethylallyltranstransferase activity

GO:0004163.name: diphosphomevalonate decarboxylase activity

GO:0004164.name: diphthine synthase activity

GO:0004165.name: delta(3)-delta(2)-enoyl-CoA isomerase activity

GO:0004166.name: dolichyl-phosphate alpha-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity

GO:0004175.name: endopeptidase activity

GO:0004176.name: ATP-dependent peptidase activity
GO:0004176.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of peptide bonds, driven by ATP hydrolysis." [GOC:mah]

GO:0004177.name: aminopeptidase activity

GO:0004180.name: carboxypeptidase activity
GO:0004180.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a single C-terminal amino acid residue from a polypeptide chain." [https://www.ebi.ac.uk/merops/about/glossary.shtml#CARBOXYPEPTIDASE]

GO:0004181.name: metallocarboxypeptidase activity

[https://www.ebi.ac.uk/merops/about/glossary.shtml#CARBOXYPEPTIDASE]

GO:0004185.name: serine-type carboxypeptidase activity

[https://www.ebi.ac.uk/merops/about/glossary.shtml#CARBOXYPEPTIDASE]

GO:0004190.name: aspartic-type endopeptidase activity
GO:0004190.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of internal, alpha-peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain by a mechanism in which a water molecule bound by the side chains of aspartic residues at the active center acts as a nucleophile." [ISBN:0198506732]

GO:0004197.name: cysteine-type endopeptidase activity
GO:0004197.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of internal, alpha-peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain by a mechanism in which the sulfhydryl group of a cysteine residue at the active center acts as a nucleophile." [GOC:mah, https://www.ebi.ac.uk/merops/about/glossary.shtml#CATTYPE, https://www.ebi.ac.uk/merops/about/glossary.shtml#ENDOPEPTIDASE]

GO:0004198.name: calcium-dependent cysteine-type endopeptidase activity
GO:0004198.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of nonterminal peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain by a mechanism using a cysteine residue at the enzyme active center, and requiring the presence of calcium." [GOC:mah]

GO:0004222.name: metalloendopeptidase activity
GO:0004222.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of internal, alpha-peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain by a mechanism in which water acts as a nucleophile, one or two metal ions hold the water molecule in place, and charged amino acid side chains are ligands for the metal ions." [GOC:mah, https://www.ebi.ac.uk/merops/about/glossary.shtml#CATTYPE, https://www.ebi.ac.uk/merops/about/glossary.shtml#ENDOPEPTIDASE]

GO:0004230.name: glutamyl aminopeptidase activity
GO:0004230.def: "Catalysis of the release of a N-terminal glutamate (and to a lesser extent aspartate) from a peptide." [EC:3.4.11.7]

GO:0004239.name: initiator methionyl aminopeptidase activity
GO:0004239.def: "Catalysis of the release of N-terminal initiator methionine from peptides." [EC:3.4.11.18]

GO:0004252.name: serine-type endopeptidase activity
GO:0004252.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of internal, alpha-peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain by a catalytic mechanism that involves a catalytic triad consisting of a serine nucleophile that is activated by a proton relay involving an acidic residue (e.g. aspartate or glutamate) and a basic residue (usually histidine)." [GOC:mah, https://www.ebi.ac.uk/merops/about/glossary.shtml#CATTYPE]

GO:0004298.name: threonine-type endopeptidase activity
GO:0004298.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of internal peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain by a mechanism in which the hydroxyl group of a threonine residue at the active center acts as a nucleophile." [GOC:mah, https://www.ebi.ac.uk/merops/about/glossary.shtml#CATTYPE, https://www.ebi.ac.uk/merops/about/glossary.shtml#ENDOPEPTIDASE]

GO:0004300.name: enoyl-CoA hydratase activity
GO:0004300.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 3-hydroxy-fatty acyl-CoA = a enoyl-CoA + H2O. This reaction usually occurs in the reverse direction, leading to the reduction of the double bound of enoyl-CoA in position 2 or 3. Specific reactions catalyzed include: a 4-saturated-(3S)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA = a (3E)-enoyl-CoA + H2O and a (3S)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA = a (2E)-enoyl-CoA + H2O." [EC:4.2.1.17]

GO:0004301.name: epoxide hydrolase activity
GO:0004301.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: an epoxide + H2O = an ethanediol." [EC:3.3.2.10]

GO:0004303.name: estradiol 17-beta-dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
GO:0004303.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: estradiol-17-beta + NAD(P)+ = estrone + NAD(P)H + H+. The activity can use NAD+ or NADP+ as the acceptor." [EC:1.1.1.62]

GO:0004304.name: estrone sulfotransferase activity
GO:0004304.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + estrone = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + estrone 3-sulfate." [EC:2.8.2.4]

GO:0004305.name: ethanolamine kinase activity
GO:0004305.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + ethanolamine = ADP + 2 H+ + phosphoethanolamine." [EC:2.7.1.82, RHEA:13069]

GO:0004306.name: ethanolamine-phosphate cytidylyltransferase activity
GO:0004306.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: CTP + ethanolamine phosphate = diphosphate + CDP-ethanolamine." [EC:2.7.7.14]

GO:0004307.name: ethanolaminephosphotransferase activity
GO:0004307.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: CDP-ethanolamine + 1,2-diacylglycerol = CMP + a phosphatidylethanolamine." [EC:2.7.8.1, RHEA:32943]

GO:0004308.name: exo-alpha-sialidase activity
GO:0004308.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of alpha-(2->3)-, alpha-(2->6)-, alpha-(2->8)-glycosidic linkages of terminal sialic residues in oligosaccharides, glycoproteins, glycolipids, colominic acid and synthetic substrates." [EC:3.2.1.18]

GO:0004309.name: exopolyphosphatase activity

GO:0004311.name: geranylgeranyl diphosphate synthase activity

GO:0004312.name: fatty acid synthase activity
GO:0004312.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + n malonyl-CoA + 2n NADPH + 2n H+ = long-chain fatty acid + n+1 CoA + n CO2 + 2n NADP+." [EC:2.3.1.85]

GO:0004313.name: [acyl-carrier-protein] S-acetyltransferase activity

GO:0004314.name: [acyl-carrier-protein] S-malonyltransferase activity
GO:0004314.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: malonyl-CoA + [acyl-carrier protein] = CoA + malonyl-[acyl-carrier protein]." [EC:2.3.1.39]

GO:0004315.name: 3-oxoacyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] synthase activity

GO:0004316.name: 3-oxoacyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] reductase (NADPH) activity

GO:0004318.name: enoyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] reductase (NADH) activity

GO:0004321.name: fatty-acyl-CoA synthase activity

GO:0004322.name: ferroxidase activity

GO:0004324.name: ferredoxin-NADP+ reductase activity

GO:0004325.name: ferrochelatase activity

GO:0004326.name: tetrahydrofolylpolyglutamate synthase activity

GO:0004331.name: fructose-2,6-bisphosphate 2-phosphatase activity

GO:0004334.name: fumarylacetoacetase activity

GO:0004335.name: galactokinase activity

GO:0004336.name: galactosylceramidase activity

GO:0004338.name: glucan exo-1,3-beta-glucosidase activity

GO:0004342.name: glucosamine-6-phosphate deaminase activity

GO:0004343.name: glucosamine 6-phosphate N-acetyltransferase activity

GO:0004344.name: glucose dehydrogenase activity

GO:0004359.name: glutaminase activity

GO:0004360.name: glutamine-fructose-6-phosphate transaminase (isomerizing) activity

GO:0004361.name: glutaryl-CoA dehydrogenase activity

GO:0004365.name: glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (NAD+) (phosphorylating) activity

GO:0004366.name: glycerol-3-phosphate O-acyltransferase activity

GO:0004368.name: glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (quinone) activity

GO:0004369.name: glycerol-3-phosphate oxidase activity

GO:0004376.name: GPI mannosyltransferase activity

GO:0004378.name: GDP-Man:Man(1)GlcNAc(2)-PP-Dol alpha-1,3-mannosyltransferase activity

GO:0004379.name: glycylpeptide N-tetradecanoyltransferase activity

GO:0004382.name: GDP phosphatase activity

GO:0004383.name: guanylate cyclase activity

GO:0004400.name: histidinol-phosphate transaminase activity

GO:0004401.name: histidinol-phosphatase activity
