GO:0004419.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA = acetoacetate + acetyl-CoA." [EC:4.1.3.4, RHEA:24404]

GO:0004420.name: hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA reductase (NADPH) activity
GO:0004420.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-mevalonate + CoA + 2 NADP+ = (S)-3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA + 2 H+ + 2 NADPH." [PMID:29224355, RHEA:15989]

GO:0004421.name: hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA synthase activity
GO:0004421.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: acetoacetyl-CoA + acetyl-CoA + H2O = (S)-3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA + CoA + H+." [RHEA:10188]

GO:0004422.name: hypoxanthine phosphoribosyltransferase activity
GO:0004422.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: IMP + diphosphate = hypoxanthine + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate." [RHEA:17973]

GO:0004423.name: iduronate-2-sulfatase activity
GO:0004423.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the 2-sulfate groups of the L-iduronate 2-sulfate units of dermatan sulfate, heparan sulfate and heparin." [EC:3.1.6.13]

GO:0004424.name: imidazoleglycerol-phosphate dehydratase activity
GO:0004424.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: D-erythro-1-(imidazol-4-yl)glycerol 3-phosphate = 3-(imidazol-4-yl)-2-oxopropyl phosphate + H2O." [EC:4.2.1.19, RHEA:11040]

GO:0004427.name: inorganic diphosphate phosphatase activity
GO:0004427.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: diphosphate + H2O = H+ + 2 phosphate." [EC:3.6.1.1, RHEA:24576]

GO:0004430.name: 1-phosphatidylinositol 4-kinase activity
GO:0004430.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol + ATP = a 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate + ADP + H+." [EC:2.7.1.67, RHEA:19877]

GO:0004435.name: phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate phospholipase C activity
GO:0004435.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol-4,5-bisphosphate) + H2O = 1D-myo-inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate + a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol + H+." [RHEA:33179]

GO:0004436.name: phosphatidylinositol diacylglycerol-lyase activity
GO:0004436.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol = D-myo-inositol 1,2-cyclic phosphate + diacylglycerol." [EC:4.6.1.13]

GO:0004441.name: inositol-1,4-bisphosphate 1-phosphatase activity
GO:0004441.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 1D-myo-inositol 1,4-bisphosphate + H2O = 1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate + phosphate." [EC:3.1.3.57, GOC:hb]

GO:0004445.name: inositol-polyphosphate 5-phosphatase activity
GO:0004445.def: "Catalysis of the reactions: D-myo-inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate + H2O = myo-inositol 1,4-bisphosphate + phosphate, and 1D-myo-inositol 1,3,4,5-tetrakisphosphate + H2O = 1D-myo-inositol 1,3,4-trisphosphate + phosphate." [EC:3.1.3.56]

GO:0004446.name: inositol hexakisphosphate phosphatase activity
GO:0004446.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: myo-inositol hexakisphosphate + H2O = myo-inositol pentakisphosphate + phosphate." [GOC:curators]

GO:0004447.name: iodide peroxidase activity
GO:0004447.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: iodide + H2O2 = iodine + 2 H2O." [RHEA:23336]

GO:0004448.name: isocitrate dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
GO:0004448.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: isocitrate + NAD(P)+ = 2-oxoglutarate + CO2 + NAD(P)H." [GOC:curators]

GO:0004449.name: isocitrate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
GO:0004449.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: isocitrate + NAD+ = 2-oxoglutarate + CO2 + NADH." [RHEA:23632]

GO:0004450.name: isocitrate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
GO:0004450.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: isocitrate + NADP+ = 2-oxoglutarate + CO2 + NADPH." [RHEA:19629]

GO:0004451.name: isocitrate lyase activity
GO:0004451.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: isocitrate = glyoxylate + succinate." [EC:4.1.3.1, RHEA:13245]

GO:0004452.name: isopentenyl-diphosphate delta-isomerase activity
GO:0004452.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: isopentenyl diphosphate = dimethylallyl diphosphate." [RHEA:23284]

GO:0004453.name: juvenile-hormone esterase activity
GO:0004453.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: methyl (2E,6E)-(10R,11S)-10,11-epoxy-3,7,11-trimethyltrideca-2,6-dienoate + H2O = (2E,6E)-(10R,11S)-10,11-epoxy-3,7,11-trimethyltrideca-2,6-dienoate + methanol. A carboxylesterase that hydrolyzes the ester linkage of juvenile hormone." [PMID:11267890, RHEA:16393]

GO:0004454.name: ketohexokinase activity
GO:0004454.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + D-fructose = ADP + D-fructose 1-phosphate." [EC:2.7.1.3]

GO:0004455.name: ketol-acid reductoisomerase activity
GO:0004455.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-2,3-dihydroxy-3-methylbutanoate + NADP+ = (S)-2-hydroxy-2-methyl-3-oxobutanoate + NADPH + H+." [EC:1.1.1.86]

GO:0004457.name: lactate dehydrogenase activity
GO:0004457.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: lactate + NAD+ = H+ + NADH + pyruvate." [GOC:ai, GOC:bf]

GO:0004458.name: D-lactate dehydrogenase (cytochrome) activity
GO:0004458.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-lactate + 2 [Fe(III)cytochrome c] = 2 [Fe(II)cytochrome c] + 2 H+ + pyruvate." [RHEA:13521]

GO:0004459.name: L-lactate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
GO:0004459.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-lactate + NAD+ = pyruvate + NADH + H+." [RHEA:23444]

GO:0004460.name: L-lactate dehydrogenase (cytochrome) activity
GO:0004460.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-lactate + 2 [Fe(III)cytochrome c] = 2 [Fe(II)cytochrome c] + 2 H+ + pyruvate." [RHEA:19909]

GO:0004461.name: lactose synthase activity
GO:0004461.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-galactose + D-glucose = UDP + lactose." [EC:2.4.1.22]

GO:0004462.name: lactoylglutathione lyase activity
GO:0004462.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-S-lactoylglutathione = glutathione + methylglyoxal." [EC:4.4.1.5, RHEA:19069]

GO:0004463.name: leukotriene-A4 hydrolase activity
GO:0004463.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + leukotriene A(4) = leukotriene B(4)." [EC:3.3.2.6, RHEA:22324]

GO:0004464.name: leukotriene-C4 synthase activity
GO:0004464.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: leukotriene C(4) = glutathione + leukotriene A(4)." [EC:4.4.1.20, RHEA:17617]

GO:0004465.name: lipoprotein lipase activity
GO:0004465.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: triacylglycerol + H2O = diacylglycerol + a carboxylate, where the triacylglycerol is part of a lipoprotein. May also hydrolyze diacylglycerol and phospholipids present in lipoproteins." [EC:3.1.1.34, GOC:bf]

GO:0004466.name: long-chain fatty acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
GO:0004466.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a long-chain 2,3-saturated fatty acyl-CoA + H+ + oxidized [electron-transfer flavoprotein] = a long-chain (2E)-enoyl-CoA + reduced [electron-transfer flavoprotein]. A long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 13 to 22 carbons." [RHEA:17721]

GO:0004467.name: long-chain fatty acid-CoA ligase activity
GO:0004467.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a long-chain fatty acid + ATP + CoA = a long-chain fatty acyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate. A long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 13 to 22 carbons." [RHEA:15421]

GO:0004468.name: L-lysine N-acetyltransferase activity, acting on acetyl phosphate as donor
GO:0004468.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl phosphate + L-lysine = phosphate + N6-acetyl-L-lysine." [RHEA:14417]

GO:0004470.name: malic enzyme activity
GO:0004470.def: "Catalysis of the oxidative decarboxylation of malate with the concomitant production of pyruvate." [ISBN:0198506732]

GO:0004471.name: malate dehydrogenase (decarboxylating) (NAD+) activity
GO:0004471.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-malate + NAD+ = pyruvate + CO2 + NADH." [RHEA:12653]

GO:0004473.name: malate dehydrogenase (decarboxylating) (NADP+) activity
GO:0004473.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-malate + NADP+ = pyruvate + CO2 + NADPH." [RHEA:18253]

GO:0004474.name: malate synthase activity
GO:0004474.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + glyoxylate + H2O = (S)-malate + CoA + H+." [RHEA:18181]

GO:0004475.name: mannose-1-phosphate guanylyltransferase (GTP) activity
GO:0004475.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-mannose 1-phosphate + GTP = diphosphate + GDP-alpha-D-mannose." [RHEA:15229]

GO:0004478.name: methionine adenosyltransferase activity
GO:0004478.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-methionine + H2O = phosphate + diphosphate + S-adenosyl-L-methionine." [EC:2.5.1.6]

GO:0004479.name: methionyl-tRNA formyltransferase activity
GO:0004479.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 10-formyltetrahydrofolate + L-methionyl-tRNA + H2O = tetrahydrofolate + N-formylmethionyl-tRNA." [EC:2.1.2.9]

GO:0004481.name: methylene-fatty-acyl-phospholipid synthase activity
GO:0004481.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + phospholipid olefinic fatty acid = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + phospholipid methylene fatty acid." [EC:2.1.1.16]

GO:0004482.name: mRNA 5'-cap (guanine-N7-)-methyltransferase activity
GO:0004482.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + G(5')pppR-RNA = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + m7G(5')pppR-RNA. m7G(5')pppR-RNA is mRNA containing an N7-methylguanine cap; R may be guanosine or adenosine." [EC:2.1.1.56]

GO:0004483.name: methyltransferase cap1 activity
GO:0004483.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 5'-end (N(7)-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-ribonucleoside in mRNA or snRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a 5'-end (N(7)-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-(2'-O-methyl-ribonucleoside) in mRNA or snRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+. This activity catalyzes the methylation of the ribose on the first transcribed nucleotide of mRNAs and snRNAs." [EC:2.1.1.57]

GO:0004484.name: mRNA guanylyltransferase activity
GO:0004484.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + (5')pp-Pur-mRNA = diphosphate + G(5')ppp-Pur-mRNA; G(5')ppp-Pur-mRNA is mRNA containing a guanosine residue linked 5' through three phosphates to the 5' position of the terminal residue." [EC:2.7.7.50]

GO:0004485.name: methylcrotonoyl-CoA carboxylase activity
GO:0004485.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 3-methylbut-2-enoyl-CoA + ATP + bicarbonate = trans-3-methylglutaconyl-CoA + ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate." [EC:6.4.1.4, RHEA:13589]

GO:0004488.name: methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
GO:0004488.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate + NADP+ = 5,10-methenyltetrahydrofolate + NADPH." [EC:1.5.1.5, RHEA:22812]

GO:0004489.name: methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase [NAD(P)H] activity
GO:0004489.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 5-methyltetrahydrofolate + NAD(P)+ = 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate + NAD(P)H + H+." [EC:1.5.1.20, PMID:26872964]

GO:0004490.name: methylglutaconyl-CoA hydratase activity
GO:0004490.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA = trans-3-methylglutaconyl-CoA + H2O." [EC:4.2.1.18, RHEA:21536]

GO:0004491.name: methylmalonate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase (acylating, NAD) activity
GO:0004491.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 2-methyl-3-oxopropanoate + CoA + NAD+ = propanoyl-CoA + CO2 + NADH + H+. Can also use malonate (3-oxopropanoate) as a substrate. The reaction occurs in two steps with the decarboxylation process preceding CoA-binding. Bicarbonate rather than CO2 is released as a final product." [EC:1.2.1.27, PMID:2768248]

GO:0004492.name: methyl/ethyl malonyl-CoA decarboxylase activity
GO:0004492.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-methylmalonyl-CoA + H+ = CO2 + propanoyl-CoA or (2S)-ethylmalonyl-CoA + H+ = butanoyl-CoA + CO2." [PMID:22016388]

GO:0004496.name: mevalonate kinase activity
GO:0004496.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-mevalonate + ATP = (R)-5-phosphomevalonate + ADP + 2 H+." [EC:2.7.1.36, RHEA:17065]

GO:0004497.name: monooxygenase activity
GO:0004497.def: "Catalysis of the incorporation of one atom of molecular oxygen (O2) into the substrate and the reduction of the other atom of O2 to water." [PMID:1444267]

GO:0004498.name: calcidiol 1-monooxygenase activity
GO:0004498.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: calcidiol + H+ + NADPH + O2 = calcitriol + H2O + NADP+." [EC:1.14.15.18, RHEA:20573]

GO:0004499.name: N,N-dimethylaniline monooxygenase activity
GO:0004499.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: N,N-dimethylaniline + NADPH + H+ + O2 = N,N-dimethylaniline N-oxide + NADP+ + H2O." [RHEA:24468]

GO:0004500.name: dopamine beta-monooxygenase activity
GO:0004500.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-ascorbate + dopamine + O2 = (R)-noradrenaline + dehydroascorbate + H2O." [EC:1.14.17.1, RHEA:19117]

GO:0004501.name: ecdysone 20-monooxygenase activity
GO:0004501.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: AH(2) + ecdysone + O2 = 20-hydroxyecdysone + A + H2O." [EC:1.14.99.22, RHEA:14021]

GO:0004502.name: kynurenine 3-monooxygenase activity
GO:0004502.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-kynurenine + H+ + NADPH + O2 = 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine + H2O + NADP+." [EC:1.14.13.9, RHEA:20545]

GO:0004503.name: tyrosinase activity
GO:0004503.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-tyrosine + O2 = L-DOPAquinone + H2O. This reaction can use both monophenols (such as tyrosine) and catechols (o-diphenols) as substrates." [PMID:4965136, RHEA:18117]

GO:0004504.name: peptidylglycine monooxygenase activity
GO:0004504.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: peptidyl-glycine + ascorbate + O2 = peptidyl(2-hydroxyglycine) + dehydroascorbate + H2O." [EC:1.14.17.3]

GO:0004505.name: phenylalanine 4-monooxygenase activity
GO:0004505.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-phenylalanine + tetrahydrobiopterin + O2 = L-tyrosine + 4-alpha-hydroxytetrahydrobiopterin." [PMID:4004813, RHEA:20273]

GO:0004506.name: squalene monooxygenase activity
GO:0004506.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + NADPH + O2 + squalene = (S)-2,3-epoxysqualene + H2O + NADP+." [RHEA:25282]

GO:0004507.name: steroid 11-beta-monooxygenase activity
GO:0004507.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a steroid + reduced adrenal ferredoxin + O2 = an 11-beta-hydroxysteroid + oxidized adrenal ferredoxin + H2O." [EC:1.14.15.4]

GO:0004508.name: steroid 17-alpha-monooxygenase activity
GO:0004508.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a C21-steroid + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = a 17alpha-hydroxy-C21-steroid + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase]." [RHEA:65760]

GO:0004509.name: steroid 21-monooxygenase activity
GO:0004509.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: A C(21) steroid + [reduced NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = a 21-hydroxy-C(21)-steroid + [oxidized NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + H2O." [RHEA:65612]

GO:0004510.name: tryptophan 5-monooxygenase activity
GO:0004510.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-tryptophan + tetrahydrobiopterin + O2 = 5-hydroxy-L-tryptophan + 4-alpha-hydroxytetrahydrobiopterin + H2O." [EC:1.14.16.4]

GO:0004511.name: tyrosine 3-monooxygenase activity
GO:0004511.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-tyrosine + tetrahydrobiopterin + O2 = 3,4-dihydroxy-L-phenylalanine + 4-alpha-hydroxytetrahydrobiopterin + H2O." [EC:1.14.16.2]

GO:0004512.name: inositol-3-phosphate synthase activity
GO:0004512.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucose 6-phosphate = 1D-myo-inositol 3-phosphate. This reaction requires NAD, which dehydrogenates the CHOH group to CO at C-5 of the glucose 6-phosphate, making C-6 into an active methylene, able to condense with the aldehyde at C-1. Finally, the enzyme-bound NADH reconverts C-5 into the CHOH form." [EC:5.5.1.4, RHEA:10716]

GO:0004514.name: nicotinate-nucleotide diphosphorylase (carboxylating) activity
GO:0004514.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: CO2 + diphosphate + nicotinate D-ribonucleotide = 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + 2 H+ + quinolinate." [EC:2.4.2.19, RHEA:12733]

GO:0004515.name: nicotinate-nucleotide adenylyltransferase activity
GO:0004515.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: nicotinate beta-D-ribonucleotide + ATP + H+ = deamido-NAD+ + diphosphate." [RHEA:22860]

GO:0004516.name: nicotinate phosphoribosyltransferase activity
GO:0004516.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: nicotinate + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + ATP + H2O = nicotinate beta-D-ribonucleotide + ADP + phosphate + diphosphate." [PMID:7503993, RHEA:36163]

GO:0004517.name: nitric-oxide synthase activity
GO:0004517.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-arginine + n NADPH + n H+ + m O2 = citrulline + nitric oxide + n NADP+." [EC:1.14.13.39, RHEA:19897]

GO:0004518.name: nuclease activity
GO:0004518.def: "Catalysis of the cleavage of ester linkages within nucleic acids." [ISBN:0198547684]

GO:0004519.name: endonuclease activity
GO:0004519.def: "Catalysis of the cleavage of ester linkages within nucleic acids by creating internal breaks." [GOC:mah, ISBN:0198547684]

GO:0004520.name: DNA endonuclease activity
GO:0004520.def: "Catalysis of the cleavage of ester linkages within deoxyribonucleic acid by creating internal breaks." [GOC:mah, ISBN:0198547684]

GO:0004521.name: RNA endonuclease activity
GO:0004521.def: "Catalysis of the cleavage of ester linkages within ribonucleic acid by creating internal breaks." [GOC:mah, ISBN:0198547684]

GO:0004522.name: ribonuclease A activity
GO:0004522.def: "Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of RNA to 3'-phosphomononucleotides and 3'-phosphooligonucleotides ending in C-P or U-P with 2',3'-cyclic phosphate intermediates." [EC:4.6.1.18]

GO:0004523.name: RNA-DNA hybrid ribonuclease activity
GO:0004523.def: "Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of RNA in RNA-DNA hybrids to 5'-phosphomonoesters." [EC:3.1.26.4]

GO:0004525.name: ribonuclease III activity
GO:0004525.def: "Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of RNA with 5'-phosphomonoesters and 3'-OH termini; makes two staggered cuts in both strands of dsRNA, leaving a 3' overhang of 2 nt." [PMID:11157775, PMID:15242644]

GO:0004526.name: ribonuclease P activity
GO:0004526.def: "Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of RNA, removing 5' extra nucleotides from tRNA precursor." [EC:3.1.26.5]

GO:0004527.name: exonuclease activity
GO:0004527.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of ester linkages within nucleic acids by removing nucleotide residues from the 3' or 5' end." [GOC:mah, ISBN:0198547684]

GO:0004528.name: phosphodiesterase I activity
GO:0004528.def: "Catalysis of the sequential hydrolytic removal of 5'-nucleotides from the 3'-hydroxy termini of 3'-hydroxy-terminated oligonucleotides." [EC:3.1.4.1]

GO:0004529.name: DNA exonuclease activity
GO:0004529.def: "Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 5' or 3' terminus of a DNA molecule." [GOC:mah, ISBN:0198547684]

GO:0004530.name: deoxyribonuclease I activity
GO:0004530.def: "Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of DNA to 5'-phosphodinucleotide and 5'-phosphooligonucleotide end products." [EC:3.1.21.1]

GO:0004531.name: deoxyribonuclease II activity
GO:0004531.def: "Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of DNA to 3'-phosphodinucleotide and 3'-phosphooligonucleotide end products." [EC:3.1.22.1]

GO:0004532.name: RNA exonuclease activity
GO:0004532.def: "Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 5' or 3' terminus of an RNA molecule." [GOC:mah, ISBN:0198547684]

GO:0004533.name: exoribonuclease H activity
GO:0004533.def: "Catalysis of the exonucleolytic cleavage of RNA to 5'-phosphomonoester oligonucleotides in both 5' to 3' and 3' to 5' directions." [EC:3.1.13.2]

GO:0004534.name: 5'-3' RNA exonuclease activity
GO:0004534.def: "Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 5' terminus of an RNA molecule." [GOC:mah, ISBN:0198547684]

GO:0004535.name: poly(A)-specific ribonuclease activity
GO:0004535.def: "Catalysis of the exonucleolytic cleavage of poly(A) to 5'-AMP." [EC:3.1.13.4, ISBN:0198547684]

GO:0004536.name: DNA nuclease activity
GO:0004536.def: "Catalysis of the cleavage of ester linkages within deoxyribonucleic acid." [GOC:mah, ISBN:0198547684]

GO:0004540.name: RNA nuclease activity
GO:0004540.def: "Catalysis of the cleavage of phosphodiester bonds in chains of RNA." [GOC:mah, ISBN:0198547684]

GO:0004549.name: tRNA-specific ribonuclease activity
GO:0004549.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of phosphodiester bonds in tRNA molecules." [GOC:mah]

GO:0004550.name: nucleoside diphosphate kinase activity
GO:0004550.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + nucleoside diphosphate = ADP + nucleoside triphosphate." [EC:2.7.4.6]

GO:0004551.name: dinucleotide phosphatase activity
GO:0004551.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a dinucleotide + H2O = 2 mononucleotides." [PMID:2848456, PMID:4405504]

GO:0004552.name: octanol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
GO:0004552.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 1-octanol + NAD+ = 1-octanal + H+ + NADH." [EC:1.1.1.73, RHEA:24620]

GO:0004553.name: hydrolase activity, hydrolyzing O-glycosyl compounds
GO:0004553.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of any O-glycosyl bond." [GOC:mah]

GO:0004555.name: alpha,alpha-trehalase activity
GO:0004555.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: alpha,alpha-trehalose + H2O = 2 D-glucose." [PMID:19897915, RHEA:32675]

GO:0004556.name: alpha-amylase activity
GO:0004556.def: "Catalysis of the endohydrolysis of (1->4)-alpha-D-glucosidic linkages in polysaccharides containing three or more alpha-(1->4)-linked D-glucose units." [PMID:12527308]

GO:0004557.name: alpha-galactosidase activity
GO:0004557.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing alpha-D-galactose residues in alpha-D-galactosides, including galactose oligosaccharides, galactomannans and galactolipids." [EC:3.2.1.22]

GO:0004558.name: alpha-1,4-glucosidase activity
GO:0004558.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing alpha-(1->4)-linked alpha-D-glucose residues with release of alpha-D-glucose." [EC:3.2.1.20]

GO:0004559.name: alpha-mannosidase activity
GO:0004559.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing alpha-D-mannose residues in alpha-D-mannosides." [EC:3.2.1.24]

GO:0004560.name: alpha-L-fucosidase activity
GO:0004560.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: an alpha-L-fucoside + H2O = an alcohol + L-fucose." [EC:3.2.1.51]

GO:0004561.name: alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity

GO:0004589.name: dihydroorotate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity

GO:0004598.name: peptidylamidoglycolate lyase activity

GO:0004613.name: phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase (GTP) activity

GO:0004642.name: phosphoribosylformylglycinamidine synthase activity

[EC:2.4.1.41, ISBN:0879695595]

GO:0004661.name: protein geranylgeranyltransferase activity

GO:0004663.name: Rab geranylgeranyltransferase activity

GO:0004693.name: cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity
GO:0004693.def: "Cyclin-dependent catalysis of the reactions: ATP + protein serine = ADP + protein serine phosphate, and ATP + protein threonine = ADP + protein threonine phosphate." [GOC:pr, GOC:rn, PMID:7877684, PMID:9841670]

GO:0004694.name: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2alpha kinase activity
GO:0004694.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + [eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2 alpha subunit] = ADP + [eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2 alpha subunit] phosphate." [GOC:mah, InterPro:IPR015516]

GO:0004697.name: diacylglycerol-dependent serine/threonine kinase activity
GO:0004697.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein. This reaction requires diacylglycerol." [EC:2.7.11.13]

GO:0004698.name: calcium,diacylglycerol-dependent serine/threonine kinase activity
GO:0004698.def: "Calcium-dependent catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein. This reaction is activated in the presence of diacylglycerol and calcium." [PMID:34834162]

GO:0004699.name: diacylglycerol-dependent, calcium-independent serine/threonine kinase activity
GO:0004699.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein. This reaction is activated by diacylglycerol but not by calcium." [PMID:34834162]

GO:0004703.name: G protein-coupled receptor kinase activity
GO:0004703.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + G protein-coupled receptor = ADP + G protein-coupled receptor phosphate." [GOC:dph]

GO:0004705.name: JUN kinase activity
GO:0004705.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: JUN + ATP = JUN phosphate + ADP. This reaction is the phosphorylation and activation of members of the JUN family, a gene family that encodes nuclear transcription factors." [GOC:bf, ISBN:0198506732]

GO:0004706.name: JUN kinase kinase kinase activity
GO:0004706.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: JNKK + ATP = JNKK phosphate + ADP. This reaction is the phosphorylation and activation of JUN kinase kinases (JNKKs)." [GOC:bf]

GO:0004707.name: MAP kinase activity
GO:0004707.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: protein + ATP = protein phosphate + ADP. This reaction is the phosphorylation of proteins. Mitogen-activated protein kinase; a family of protein kinases that perform a crucial step in relaying signals from the plasma membrane to the nucleus. They are activated by a wide range of proliferation- or differentiation-inducing signals; activation is strong with agonists such as polypeptide growth factors and tumor-promoting phorbol esters, but weak (in most cell backgrounds) by stress stimuli." [GOC:ma, ISBN:0198547684]

GO:0004708.name: MAP kinase kinase activity
GO:0004708.def: "Catalysis of the concomitant phosphorylation of threonine (T) and tyrosine (Y) residues in a T-X-Y motif in the activation loop of a MAP kinase (MAPK) substrate." [PMID:12623839, PMID:38270553]

GO:0004709.name: MAP kinase kinase kinase activity
GO:0004709.def: "Catalysis of the phosphorylation and activation of a MAP kinase kinase; each MAP kinase kinase can be phosphorylated by any of several MAP kinase kinase kinases." [PMID:9561267]

GO:0004711.name: ribosomal protein S6 kinase activity
GO:0004711.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ribosomal protein S6 + ATP = ribosomal protein S6 phosphate + ATP." [GOC:mah, PMID:9822608]

GO:0004712.name: protein serine/threonine/tyrosine kinase activity
GO:0004712.def: "Catalysis of the reactions: ATP + a protein serine = ADP + protein serine phosphate; ATP + a protein threonine = ADP + protein threonine phosphate; and ATP + a protein tyrosine = ADP + protein tyrosine phosphate." [GOC:mah]

GO:0004713.name: protein tyrosine kinase activity
GO:0004713.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein tyrosine = ADP + protein tyrosine phosphate." [RHEA:10596]

GO:0004714.name: transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase activity
GO:0004714.def: "Combining with a signal and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity by catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein-L-tyrosine = ADP + a protein-L-tyrosine phosphate." [EC:2.7.10.1, GOC:mah]

GO:0004715.name: non-membrane spanning protein tyrosine kinase activity
GO:0004715.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + protein L-tyrosine = ADP + protein L-tyrosine phosphate by a non-membrane spanning protein." [EC:2.7.10.2]

GO:0004719.name: protein-L-isoaspartate (D-aspartate) O-methyltransferase activity
GO:0004719.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + protein L-beta-aspartate = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + protein L-beta-aspartate methyl ester." [EC:2.1.1.77]

GO:0004720.name: protein-lysine 6-oxidase activity
GO:0004720.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: peptidyl-L-lysyl-peptide + H2O + O2 = peptidyl-allysyl-peptide + NH3 + hydrogen peroxide." [EC:1.4.3.13]

GO:0004721.name: phosphoprotein phosphatase activity
GO:0004721.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a phosphoprotein + H2O = a protein + phosphate. Together with protein kinases, these enzymes control the state of phosphorylation of cellular proteins and thereby provide an important mechanism for regulating cellular activity." [ISBN:0198547684]

GO:0004722.name: protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity
GO:0004722.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: protein serine phosphate + H2O = protein serine + phosphate, and protein threonine phosphate + H2O = protein threonine + phosphate." [GOC:bf]

GO:0004723.name: calcium-dependent protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity
GO:0004723.def: "Catalysis of the reactions: protein serine phosphate + H2O = protein serine + phosphate; and protein threonine phosphate + H2O = protein threonine + phosphate. These reactions require the presence of calcium ions." [GOC:mah]

GO:0004725.name: protein tyrosine phosphatase activity
GO:0004725.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: protein tyrosine phosphate + H2O = protein tyrosine + phosphate." [EC:3.1.3.48]

GO:0004726.name: non-membrane spanning protein tyrosine phosphatase activity
GO:0004726.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: non-membrane spanning protein tyrosine phosphate + H2O = non-membrane spanning protein tyrosine + phosphate." [PMID:34353440]

GO:0004729.name: oxygen-dependent protoporphyrinogen oxidase activity
GO:0004729.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 3 O2 + protoporphyrinogen IX = 3 H2O2 + protoporphyrin IX." [RHEA:25576]

GO:0004730.name: pseudouridylate synthase activity
GO:0004730.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribose 5-phosphate + uracil = H2O + pseudouridine 5'-phosphate." [EC:4.2.1.70, RHEA:18337]

GO:0004731.name: purine-nucleoside phosphorylase activity
GO:0004731.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: purine nucleoside + phosphate = purine + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate." [EC:2.4.2.1]

GO:0004732.name: pyridoxal oxidase activity
GO:0004732.def: "Catalysis of the reaction:  pyridoxal + H2O + O2 = 4-pyridoxate + H+ + H2O2." [RHEA:23724]

GO:0004733.name: pyridoxamine phosphate oxidase activity
GO:0004733.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: pyridoxamine 5'-phosphate + H2O + O2 = pyridoxal 5'-phosphate + NH4+ + hydrogen peroxide. This activity can also oxidize pyridoxine 5'-phosphate to pyridoxal 5'-phosphate + hydrogen peroxide." [PMID:11786019]

GO:0004734.name: pyrimidodiazepine synthase activity
GO:0004734.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a pyrimidodiazepine + oxidized glutathione = 6-pyruvoyltetrahydropterin + 2 glutathione." [EC:1.5.4.1]

GO:0004735.name: pyrroline-5-carboxylate reductase activity
GO:0004735.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-proline + NADP+ = 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate + NADPH + H+." [EC:1.5.1.2]

GO:0004736.name: pyruvate carboxylase activity
GO:0004736.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + bicarbonate + pyruvate = ADP + 2 H+ + oxaloacetate + phosphate." [EC:6.4.1.1, RHEA:20844]

GO:0004737.name: pyruvate decarboxylase activity
GO:0004737.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 2-oxo acid = an aldehyde + CO2." [EC:4.1.1.1]

GO:0004739.name: pyruvate dehydrogenase (acetyl-transferring) activity
GO:0004739.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-[(R)-lipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + pyruvate + H+ = N(6)-[(R)-S(8)-acetyldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + CO2." [RHEA:19189]

GO:0004740.name: pyruvate dehydrogenase (acetyl-transferring) kinase activity
GO:0004740.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-seryl-[pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 alpha subunit] = ADP + H+ + O-phospho-L-seryl-[pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 alpha subunit]." [RHEA:23052]

GO:0004741.name: [pyruvate dehydrogenase (acetyl-transferring)]-phosphatase activity
GO:0004741.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: O-phospho-L-seryl-[pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 alpha subunit] + H2O = L-seryl-[pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 alpha subunit] + phosphate." [EC:3.1.3.43]

GO:0004743.name: pyruvate kinase activity
GO:0004743.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: = ADP + H+ + phosphoenolpyruvate => ATP + pyruvate." [EC:2.7.1.40, RHEA:18159]

GO:0004745.name: all-trans-retinol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
GO:0004745.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: all-trans-retinol--[retinol-binding protein] + NAD+ = all-trans-retinal--[retinol-binding protein] + H+ + NADH. Recognizes the substrate both in free form and when bound to cellular-retinol-binding-protein (CRBP1), but has higher affinity for the bound form." [RHEA:48488]

GO:0004746.name: riboflavin synthase activity
GO:0004746.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 2 6,7-dimethyl-8-(1-D-ribityl)lumazine + H+ = 5-amino-6-(D-ribitylamino)uracil + riboflavin." [EC:2.5.1.9, RHEA:20772]

GO:0004747.name: ribokinase activity
GO:0004747.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + D-ribose = ADP + D-ribose 5-phosphate." [EC:2.7.1.15]

GO:0004748.name: ribonucleoside-diphosphate reductase activity, thioredoxin disulfide as acceptor
GO:0004748.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 2'-deoxyribonucleoside diphosphate + thioredoxin disulfide + H2O = ribonucleoside diphosphate + thioredoxin. Thioredoxin disulfide is the oxidized form of thioredoxin." [EC:1.17.4.1]

GO:0004749.name: ribose phosphate diphosphokinase activity
GO:0004749.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribose 5-phosphate + ATP = 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + AMP + 2 H+." [RHEA:15609]

GO:0004750.name: D-ribulose-phosphate 3-epimerase activity
GO:0004750.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribulose 5-phosphate = D-xylulose 5-phosphate." [EC:5.1.3.1, RHEA:13677]

GO:0004753.name: saccharopine dehydrogenase activity
GO:0004753.def: "Catalysis of the cleavage of N6-(L-1,3-dicarboxypropyl)-L-lysine to release an amino acid (lysine or glutamate), with the concomitant reduction of an electron acceptor." [GOC:mah]

GO:0004754.name: saccharopine dehydrogenase (NAD+, L-lysine-forming) activity
GO:0004754.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-saccharopine + H2O + NAD+ = 2-oxoglutarate + L-lysine + H+ + NADH." [EC:1.5.1.7, RHEA:12440]

GO:0004755.name: saccharopine dehydrogenase (NADP+, L-glutamate-forming) activity
GO:0004755.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-saccharopine + H2O + NADP+ = L-allysine + L-glutamate + H+ + NADPH." [EC:1.5.1.10, RHEA:10020]

GO:0004756.name: selenide, water dikinase activity
GO:0004756.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O + hydrogen selenide = AMP + 3 H+ + phosphate + selenophosphorate." [EC:2.7.9.3, RHEA:18737]

GO:0004757.name: sepiapterin reductase (NADP+) activity
GO:0004757.def: "Catalysis of the reactions: 7,8-dihydrobiopterin + NADP+ = sepiapterin + NADPH + H+ and (6R)-L-erythro-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrobiopterin + 2 NADP+ = 6-pyruvoyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydropterin + 2 H+ + 2 NADPH." [EC:1.1.1.153]

GO:0004758.name: serine C-palmitoyltransferase activity
GO:0004758.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-serine + H+ + palmitoyl-CoA = 3-dehydrosphinganine + CO2 + CoA." [EC:2.3.1.50, RHEA:14761]

GO:0004760.name: L-serine-pyruvate transaminase activity
GO:0004760.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-serine + pyruvate = 3-hydroxypyruvate + L-alanine." [EC:2.6.1.51, RHEA:22852]

GO:0004764.name: shikimate 3-dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
GO:0004764.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: shikimate + NADP+ = 3-dehydroshikimate + NADPH + H+." [EC:1.1.1.25]

GO:0004765.name: shikimate kinase activity
GO:0004765.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + shikimate = 3-phosphoshikimate + ADP + 2 H+." [EC:2.7.1.71, RHEA:13121]

GO:0004766.name: spermidine synthase activity
GO:0004766.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosylmethioninamine + putrescine = 5'-methylthioadenosine + spermidine." [EC:2.5.1.16]

GO:0004767.name: sphingomyelin phosphodiesterase activity
GO:0004767.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + sphingomyelin = ceramide + choline phosphate + H+." [EC:3.1.4.12, RHEA:19253]

GO:0004768.name: stearoyl-CoA 9-desaturase activity
GO:0004768.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H+ + O2 + octadecanoyl-CoA = (9Z)-octadecenoyl-CoA + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H2O." [RHEA:19721]

GO:0004771.name: sterol ester esterase activity
GO:0004771.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a sterol ester + H2O = a fatty acid + a sterol + H+." [RHEA:10100]

GO:0004772.name: sterol O-acyltransferase activity
GO:0004772.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a long-chain fatty acyl-CoA + a sterol = a sterol ester + CoA." [RHEA:59816]

GO:0004774.name: succinate-CoA ligase activity
GO:0004774.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: succinate + CoA + nucleotide triphosphate = nucleotide diphosphate + phosphate + succinyl-CoA." [GOC:ai]

GO:0004775.name: succinate-CoA ligase (ADP-forming) activity
GO:0004775.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + succinate + CoA = ADP + succinyl-CoA + phosphate." [PMID:9874242, RHEA:17661]

GO:0004776.name: succinate-CoA ligase (GDP-forming) activity
GO:0004776.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + succinate + CoA = GDP + succinyl-CoA + phosphate." [RHEA:22120]

GO:0004777.name: succinate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
GO:0004777.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: succinate semialdehyde + NAD+ + H2O = succinate + NADH + H+." [RHEA:13217]

GO:0004778.name: succinyl-CoA hydrolase activity
GO:0004778.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + succinyl-CoA = CoA + H+ + succinate." [EC:3.1.2.3, RHEA:11516]

GO:0004779.name: sulfate adenylyltransferase activity
GO:0004779.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of an adenylyl group from an adenosine nucleotide (ATP or ADP) to sulfate, forming adenylylsulfate." [GOC:mah]

GO:0004780.name: sulfate adenylyltransferase (ADP) activity
GO:0004780.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ADP + H+ + sulfate = 5'-adenylyl sulfate + phosphate." [EC:2.7.7.5, RHEA:16529]

GO:0004781.name: sulfate adenylyltransferase (ATP) activity
GO:0004781.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H+ + sulfate = adenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + diphosphate." [EC:2.7.7.4]

GO:0004783.name: sulfite reductase (NADPH) activity
GO:0004783.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: hydrogen sulfide + 3 NADP+ + 3 H2O = sulfite + 3 NADPH + 3 H+." [RHEA:13801]

GO:0004784.name: superoxide dismutase activity
GO:0004784.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 2 superoxide + 2 H+ = O2 + hydrogen peroxide." [EC:1.15.1.1, GOC:vw, PMID:15064408]

GO:0004787.name: thiamine diphosphate phosphatase activity
GO:0004787.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: thiamine diphosphate + H2O = thiamine monophosphate + phosphate." [GOC:ai, RHEA:27998]

GO:0004788.name: thiamine diphosphokinase activity
GO:0004788.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + thiamine = AMP + thiamine diphosphate." [RHEA:11576]

GO:0004789.name: thiamine-phosphate diphosphorylase activity
GO:0004789.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 4-amino-2-methyl-5-diphosphomethylpyrimidine + 4-methyl-5-(2-phosphoethyl)-thiazole + H+ = diphosphate + thiamine phosphate." [EC:2.5.1.3, RHEA:22328]

GO:0004790.name: thioether S-methyltransferase activity
GO:0004790.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine(1+) + dimethyl sulfide = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + trimethylsulfonium." [EC:2.1.1.96, RHEA:19613]

GO:0004791.name: thioredoxin-disulfide reductase (NADPH) activity
GO:0004791.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: thioredoxin-dithiol + NADP+ = thioredoxin-disulfide + H+ + NADPH." [RHEA:20345]

GO:0004792.name: thiosulfate-cyanide sulfurtransferase activity
GO:0004792.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: thiosulfate + hydrogen cyanide = thiocyanate + sulfite + 2 H+." [RHEA:16881]

GO:0004793.name: threonine aldolase activity
GO:0004793.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-threonine = glycine + acetaldehyde." [EC:4.1.2.5]

GO:0004795.name: threonine synthase activity
GO:0004795.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: O-phospho-L-homoserine + H2O = L-threonine + phosphate." [EC:4.2.3.1]

GO:0004796.name: thromboxane-A synthase activity
GO:0004796.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: prostaglandin H(2) = thromboxane A(2)." [EC:5.3.99.5, RHEA:17137]

GO:0004797.name: thymidine kinase activity
GO:0004797.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + thymidine = ADP + thymidine 5'-phosphate." [EC:2.7.1.21]

GO:0004798.name: dTMP kinase activity
GO:0004798.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: dTMP + ATP = dTDP + ADP." [RHEA:13517]

GO:0004799.name: thymidylate synthase activity
GO:0004799.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate + dUMP = 7,8-dihydrofolate + thymidylate." [EC:2.1.1.45, RHEA:12104]

GO:0004800.name: thyroxine 5'-deiodinase activity
GO:0004800.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 3,3',5-triiodo-L-thyronine + iodide + acceptor + H+ = L-thyroxine + acceptor-H2." [RHEA:19745]

GO:0004801.name: transaldolase activity
GO:0004801.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: sedoheptulose 7-phosphate + D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate = D-erythrose 4-phosphate + D-fructose 6-phosphate." [PMID:7592346, RHEA:17053]

GO:0004802.name: transketolase activity
GO:0004802.def: "Catalysis of the reversible transfer of a 2-carbon ketol group (CH2OH-CO-) from a ketose phosphate donor to an aldose phosphate acceptor." [EC:2.2.1.1, GOC:fmc]

GO:0004803.name: transposase activity
GO:0004803.def: "Catalysis of the transposition of transposable elements or transposons. Transposases are involved in recombination required for transposition and are site-specific for the transposon/transposable element." [GOC:bm, ISBN:0198506732]

GO:0004805.name: trehalose-phosphatase activity
GO:0004805.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: alpha,alpha-trehalose 6-phosphate + H2O = alpha,alpha-trehalose + phosphate." [EC:3.1.3.12, RHEA:23420]

GO:0004806.name: triacylglycerol lipase activity
GO:0004806.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a triacylglycerol + H2O = a diacylglycerol + a fatty acid + H+." [RHEA:12044]

GO:0004807.name: triose-phosphate isomerase activity
GO:0004807.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate = dihydroxyacetone phosphate." [RHEA:18585]

GO:0004808.name: tRNA (5-methylaminomethyl-2-thiouridylate)(34)-methyltransferase activity
GO:0004808.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 5-aminomethyl-2-thiouridine34 in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 5-methylaminomethyl-2-thiouridine34 in tRNA + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This enzyme specifically adds the terminal methyl group of 5-[(methylamino)methyl]-2-thiouridylate." [RHEA:19569]

GO:0004810.name: CCA tRNA nucleotidyltransferase activity
GO:0004810.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a tRNA precursor + ATP + 2 CTP = a tRNA with a 3' CCA end + 3 diphosphate." [PMID:2247609, RHEA:14433]

GO:0004812.name: aminoacyl-tRNA ligase activity
GO:0004812.def: "Catalysis of the formation of aminoacyl-tRNA from ATP, amino acid, and tRNA with the release of diphosphate and AMP." [ISBN:0198506732]

GO:0004813.name: alanine-tRNA ligase activity
GO:0004813.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-alanine + tRNA(Ala) = AMP + diphosphate + L-alanyl-tRNA(Ala)." [EC:6.1.1.7]

GO:0004814.name: arginine-tRNA ligase activity
GO:0004814.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-arginine + tRNA(Arg) = AMP + diphosphate + L-arginyl-tRNA(Arg)." [EC:6.1.1.19]

GO:0004815.name: aspartate-tRNA ligase activity
GO:0004815.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-aspartate + tRNA(Asp) = AMP + diphosphate + L-aspartyl-tRNA(Asp)." [EC:6.1.1.12]

GO:0004816.name: asparagine-tRNA ligase activity
GO:0004816.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-asparagine + ATP + tRNA(Asn) = AMP + Asn-tRNA(Asn) + diphosphate + 2 H+." [EC:6.1.1.22, RHEA:11180]

GO:0004817.name: cysteine-tRNA ligase activity
GO:0004817.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-cysteine + tRNA(Cys) = AMP + diphosphate + L-cysteinyl-tRNA(Cys)." [EC:6.1.1.16]

GO:0004818.name: glutamate-tRNA ligase activity
GO:0004818.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-glutamate + tRNA(Glu) = AMP + diphosphate + L-glutamyl-tRNA(Glu)." [EC:6.1.1.17]

GO:0004819.name: glutamine-tRNA ligase activity
GO:0004819.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-glutamine + tRNA(Gln) = AMP + diphosphate + L-glutaminyl-tRNA(Gln)." [EC:6.1.1.18]

GO:0004820.name: glycine-tRNA ligase activity
GO:0004820.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + glycine + tRNA(Gly) = AMP + diphosphate + glycyl-tRNA(Gly)." [EC:6.1.1.14]

GO:0004821.name: histidine-tRNA ligase activity
GO:0004821.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-histidine + tRNA(His) = AMP + diphosphate + L-histidyl-tRNA(His)." [EC:6.1.1.21]

GO:0004822.name: isoleucine-tRNA ligase activity
GO:0004822.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-isoleucine + ATP + tRNA(Ile) = L-isoleucyl-tRNA(Ile) + AMP + diphosphate + 2 H+." [EC:6.1.1.5, RHEA:11060]

GO:0004823.name: leucine-tRNA ligase activity
GO:0004823.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: leucine + ATP + tRNA(Leu) = AMP + diphosphate + 2 H+ + Leu-tRNA(Leu)." [RHEA:11688]

GO:0004824.name: lysine-tRNA ligase activity
GO:0004824.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-lysine + tRNA(Lys) = AMP + diphosphate + L-lysyl-tRNA(Lys)." [EC:6.1.1.6]

GO:0004825.name: methionine-tRNA ligase activity
GO:0004825.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-methionine + tRNA(Met) = AMP + diphosphate + L-methionyl-tRNA(Met)." [EC:6.1.1.10]

GO:0004826.name: phenylalanine-tRNA ligase activity
GO:0004826.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-phenylalanine + tRNA(Phe) = AMP + diphosphate + L-phenylalanyl-tRNA(Phe)." [EC:6.1.1.20]

GO:0004827.name: proline-tRNA ligase activity
GO:0004827.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-proline + tRNA(Pro) = AMP + diphosphate + L-prolyl-tRNA(Pro)." [EC:6.1.1.15]

GO:0004828.name: serine-tRNA ligase activity
GO:0004828.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-serine + tRNA(Ser) = AMP + diphosphate + L-seryl-tRNA(Ser). Also catalyzes the formation of L-seryl-tRNA(Sec) from tRNA(Sec), the special tRNA for selenocysteine." [EC:6.1.1.11]

GO:0004829.name: threonine-tRNA ligase activity
GO:0004829.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-threonine + tRNA(Thr) = AMP + diphosphate + L-threonyl-tRNA(Thr)." [EC:6.1.1.3]

GO:0004830.name: tryptophan-tRNA ligase activity

GO:0005219.name: ryanodine-sensitive calcium-release channel activity
GO:0005219.def: "Enables transmembrane transfer of calcium ions from an intracellular store to the cytosol on induction by increased calcium concentration and is sensitive to the plant alkaloid ryanodine." [GOC:dph, GOC:tb, PMID:22822064]

GO:0005220.name: inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate-gated calcium channel activity
GO:0005220.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of a calcium ion by a channel that opens when inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate (IP3) has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts." [GOC:mah, GOC:signaling, PMID:28416699, PMID:8660280, Wikipedia:Inositol_trisphosphate_receptor]

GO:0005221.name: intracellularly cyclic nucleotide-activated monoatomic cation channel activity
GO:0005221.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of a monoatomic cation by a channel that opens when intracellular cyclic nucleotide has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts." [GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0005222.name: intracellularly cAMP-activated cation channel activity
GO:0005222.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of a cation by a channel that opens when intracellular cAMP has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts." [GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0005223.name: intracellularly cGMP-activated cation channel activity
GO:0005223.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of a cation by a channel that opens when intracellular cGMP has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts." [GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0005225.name: volume-sensitive anion channel activity
GO:0005225.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of a monoatomic anion by a volume-sensitive channel. A volume-sensitive channel is a channel that responds to changes in the volume of a cell." [GOC:dph, GOC:tb]

GO:0005227.name: calcium-activated cation channel activity
GO:0005227.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of an inorganic cation by a channel that opens when a calcium cation has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts." [GOC:dph, GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0005228.name: intracellular sodium-activated potassium channel activity
GO:0005228.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of potassium by a channel that opens in response to stimulus by a sodium ion or ions. Transport by a channel involves facilitated diffusion of a solute (by an energy-independent process) involving passage through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel, without evidence for a carrier-mediated mechanism. Sodium activated potassium channels have distinctive properties, including a large single channel conductance, subconductance states, and a block of single channel currents at positive potentials, similar to inward rectification." [GOC:mtg_transport, PMID:12628167]

GO:0005229.name: intracellularly calcium-gated chloride channel activity
GO:0005229.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of chloride by a channel that opens in response to stimulus by a calcium ion or ions. Transport by a channel involves catalysis of facilitated diffusion of a solute (by an energy-independent process) involving passage through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel, without evidence for a carrier-mediated mechanism." [GOC:mtg_transport, PMID:29236691]

GO:0005230.name: extracellular ligand-gated monoatomic ion channel activity
GO:0005230.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a channel that opens when a specific extracellular ligand has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005231.name: excitatory extracellular ligand-gated monoatomic ion channel activity
GO:0005231.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a channel that opens when a specific extracellular ligand has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts, where channel opening contributes to an increase in membrane potential." [GOC:mah, ISBN:0323037070]

GO:0005234.name: extracellularly glutamate-gated ion channel activity
GO:0005234.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a channel that opens when glutamate is bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts on the extracellular side of the plasma membrane." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005237.name: inhibitory extracellular ligand-gated monoatomic ion channel activity
GO:0005237.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a channel that opens when a specific extracellular inhibitory ligand has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts. Inhibitory ligands, such as GABA or glycine, open chloride-selective channels." [GOC:mah, ISBN:0323037070]

GO:0005242.name: inward rectifier potassium channel activity
GO:0005242.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of a potassium ion by an inwardly-rectifying voltage-gated channel. An inwardly rectifying current-voltage relation is one where at any given driving force the inward flow of K+ ions exceeds the outward flow for the opposite driving force. The inward-rectification is due to a voltage-dependent block of the channel pore by a specific ligand or ligands, and as a result the macroscopic conductance depends on the difference between membrane voltage and the K+ equilibrium potential rather than on membrane voltage itself." [GOC:cb, GOC:mah, PMID:14977398]

GO:0005243.name: gap junction channel activity
GO:0005243.def: "A wide pore channel activity that enables a direct cytoplasmic connection from one cell to an adjacent cell. The gap junction can pass large solutes as well as electrical signals between cells. Gap junctions consist of two gap junction hemi-channels, or connexons, one contributed by each membrane through which the gap junction passes." [GOC:dgh, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005244.name: voltage-gated monoatomic ion channel activity
GO:0005244.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a voltage-gated channel. An ion is an atom or group of atoms carrying an electric charge by virtue of having gained or lost one or more electrons. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0198506732, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005245.name: voltage-gated calcium channel activity
GO:0005245.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of a calcium ion by a voltage-gated channel. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded." [GOC:mtg_transport, GOC:tb, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005246.name: calcium channel regulator activity
GO:0005246.def: "Modulates the activity of a calcium channel." [GOC:mah]

GO:0005247.name: voltage-gated chloride channel activity
GO:0005247.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of a chloride ion by a voltage-gated channel. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005248.name: voltage-gated sodium channel activity
GO:0005248.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of a sodium ion by a voltage-gated channel. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005249.name: voltage-gated potassium channel activity
GO:0005249.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of a potassium ion by a voltage-gated channel. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005250.name: A-type (transient outward) potassium channel activity
GO:0005250.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of a potassium ion by an outwardly-rectifying voltage-gated channel that produces a transient outward current upon a step change in membrane potential." [GOC:mah, PMID:5575340]

GO:0005251.name: delayed rectifier potassium channel activity
GO:0005251.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of a potassium ion by a delayed rectifying voltage-gated channel. A delayed rectifying current-voltage relation is one where channel activation kinetics are time-dependent, and inactivation is slow." [GOC:mah, PMID:11343411, PMID:2462513]

GO:0005252.name: open rectifier potassium channel activity
GO:0005252.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of a potassium ion by an open rectifier voltage-gated channel. An open rectifier current-voltage relationship is one in which the direction of rectification depends on the external potassium ion concentration." [GOC:mah, PMID:8917578]

GO:0005253.name: monoatomic anion channel activity
GO:0005253.def: "Enables the energy-independent facilitated diffusion of a monoatomic anion through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel." [GOC:dph, GOC:mtg_transport, GOC:pr, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005254.name: chloride channel activity
GO:0005254.def: "Enables the energy-independent facilitated diffusion of a chloride ion through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel." [GOC:mtg_transport, GOC:pr, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005260.name: intracellularly ATP-gated chloride channel activity
GO:0005260.def: "Enables passage of a chloride ion through a transmembrane channel that opens when ATP is bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts on the intracellular side of the plasma membrane." [PMID:24727426, PMID:9922375]

GO:0005261.name: monoatomic cation channel activity
GO:0005261.def: "Enables the energy-independent facilitated diffusion of a monoatomic cation through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel." [GOC:def, GOC:dph, GOC:mtg_transport, GOC:pr, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005262.name: calcium channel activity
GO:0005262.def: "Enables the energy-independent facilitated diffusion of a calcium ion through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel." [GOC:mtg_transport, GOC:pr, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005267.name: potassium channel activity
GO:0005267.def: "Enables the energy-independent facilitated diffusion of a potassium ion through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel." [GOC:BHF, GOC:mtg_transport, GOC:pr, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005272.name: sodium channel activity
GO:0005272.def: "Enables the energy-independent facilitated diffusion of a sodium ion through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel." [GOC:BHF, GOC:mtg_transport, GOC:pr, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005274.name: allantoin:proton symporter activity
GO:0005274.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: allantoin(out) + H+(out) = allantoin(in) + H+(in) by secondary active transport." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729, TC:2.A.39.3.1]

GO:0005275.name: amine transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005275.def: "Enables the transfer of amines, including polyamines, from one side of a membrane to the other. Amines are organic compounds that are weakly basic in character and contain an amino (-NH2) or substituted amino group." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0198506732, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005277.name: acetylcholine transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005277.def: "Enables the transfer of acetylcholine from one side of a membrane to the other. Acetylcholine is an acetic acid ester of the organic base choline and functions as a neurotransmitter, released at the synapses of parasympathetic nerves and at neuromuscular junctions." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005278.name: acetylcholine:proton antiporter activity
GO:0005278.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: H+(out) + acetylcholine(in) = H+(in) + acetylcholine(out)." [TC:2.A.1.2.13]

GO:0005280.name: amino acid:proton symporter activity
GO:0005280.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: amino acid(out) + H+(out) = amino acid(in) + H+(in)." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005283.name: amino acid:sodium symporter activity
GO:0005283.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: amino acid(out) + Na+(out) = amino acid(in) + Na+(in)." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005287.name: high-affinity basic amino acid transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005287.def: "Enables the transfer of basic amino acids from one side of a membrane to the other. Acidic amino acids have a pH above 7. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations." [GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0005289.name: high-affinity L-arginine transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005289.def: "Enables the transfer of arginine from one side of a membrane to the other. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations." [GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0005290.name: L-histidine transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005290.def: "Enables the transfer of L-histidine from one side of a membrane to the other. L-histidine is 2-amino-3-(1H-imidazol-4-yl)propanoic acid." [GOC:ai, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005291.name: high-affinity L-histidine transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005291.def: "Enables the transfer of L-histidine from one side of a membrane to the other. L-histidine is 2-amino-3-(1H-imidazol-4-yl)propanoic acid. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations." [GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0005292.name: high-affinity lysine transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005292.def: "Enables the transfer of lysine from one side of a membrane to the other. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations." [GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0005294.name: neutral L-amino acid secondary active transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005294.def: "Enables the transfer of a neutral L-amino acid from one side of a membrane to the other, up its concentration gradient. The transporter binds the solute and undergoes a series of conformational changes. Transport works equally well in either direction and is driven by a chemiosmotic source of energy. Secondary active transporters include symporters and antiporters." [GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0005295.name: neutral L-amino acid:sodium symporter activity
GO:0005295.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: neutral L-amino acid(out) + Na+(out) = neutral L-amino acid(in) + Na+(in)." [TC:2.A.23.3.1]

GO:0005297.name: proline:proton symporter activity
GO:0005297.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: proline(out) + H+(out) = proline(in) + H+(in)." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005298.name: proline:sodium symporter activity
GO:0005298.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: proline(out) + Na+(out) = proline(in) + Na+(in)." [TC:2.A.22.2.1]

GO:0005300.name: high-affinity tryptophan transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005300.def: "Catalysis of the high-affinity transfer of L-tryptophan from one side of a membrane to the other. Tryptophan is 2-amino-3-(1H-indol-3-yl)propanoic acid. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005302.name: L-tyrosine transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005302.def: "Enables the transfer of L-tyrosine from one side of a membrane to the other. L-tyrosine is 2-amino-3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)propanoic acid." [GOC:ai, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005304.name: L-valine transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005304.def: "Enables the transfer of L-valine from one side of a membrane to the other. L-valine is 2-amino-3-methylbutanoic acid." [GOC:ai, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005307.name: choline:sodium symporter activity
GO:0005307.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: choline(out) + Na+(out) = choline(in) + Na+(in)." [TC:2.A.22.3.5]

GO:0005308.name: creatine transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005308.def: "Enables the transfer of creatine from one side of a membrane to the other. Creatine is a compound synthesized from the amino acids arginine, glycine, and methionine that occurs in muscle." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005309.name: creatine:sodium symporter activity
GO:0005309.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: creatine(out) + Na+(out) = creatine(in) + Na+(in)." [TC:2.A.22.3.4]

GO:0005310.name: dicarboxylic acid transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005310.def: "Enables the transfer of dicarboxylic acids from one side of a membrane to the other. A dicarboxylic acid is an organic acid with two COOH groups." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005313.name: L-glutamate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005313.def: "Enables the transfer of L-glutamate from one side of a membrane to the other. L-glutamate is the anion of 2-aminopentanedioic acid." [GOC:ai, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005314.name: high-affinity L-glutamate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005314.def: "Enables the transfer of glutamate from one side of a membrane to the other. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations." [TC:2.A.3.10.5]

GO:0005315.name: phosphate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005315.def: "Enables the transfer of phosphate ions from one side of a membrane to the other, up its concentration gradient. The transporter binds the solute and undergoes a series of conformational changes. Transport works equally well in either direction and is driven by a chemiosmotic source of energy. Secondary active transporters include symporters and antiporters." [GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0005316.name: high-affinity phosphate:sodium symporter activity
GO:0005316.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction:phosphate(out) + Na+(out) = phosphate(in) + Na+(in). In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations." [TC:2.A.20.2.2]

GO:0005319.name: lipid transporter activity
GO:0005319.def: "Enables the directed movement of lipids into, out of or within a cell, or between cells." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005324.name: long-chain fatty acid transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005324.def: "Enables the transfer of a long-chain fatty acid from one side of a membrane to the other. A long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 13 to 22 carbons." [ISBN:0198506732]

GO:0005326.name: neurotransmitter transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005326.def: "Enables the directed movement of a neurotransmitter into, out of or within a cell, or between cells. Neurotransmitters are any chemical substance that is capable of transmitting (or inhibiting the transmission of) a nerve impulse from a neuron to another cell." [GOC:ai, ISBN:0198506732]

GO:0005328.name: neurotransmitter:sodium symporter activity
GO:0005328.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: neurotransmitter(out) + Na+(out) = neurotransmitter(in) + Na+(in)." [TC:2.A.22.-.-]

GO:0005330.name: dopamine:sodium symporter activity
GO:0005330.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: dopamine(out) + Na+(out) + Cl-(out)= dopamine(in) + Na+(in) + Cl-(in)." [PMID:21752877, PMID:22519513, TC:2.A.22.1.3]

GO:0005332.name: gamma-aminobutyric acid:sodium:chloride symporter activity
GO:0005332.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: gamma-aminobutyric acid(out) + Na+(out) + Cl-(out) = gamma-aminobutyric acid(in) + Na+(in) + Cl(in)." [PMID:7589472, PMID:7861179]

GO:0005334.name: norepinephrine:sodium symporter activity
GO:0005334.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: norepinephrine(out) + Na+(out) + Cl-(out) = norepinephrine(in) + Na+(in) + Cl-(in)." [PMID:21752877, PMID:22519513, TC:2.A.22.1.2]

GO:0005335.name: serotonin:sodium:chloride symporter activity
GO:0005335.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: serotonin(out) + Na+(out) + Cl-(out) = serotonin(in) + Na+(in)+ Cl-(in)." [PMID:21752877, PMID:22519513]

GO:0005337.name: nucleoside transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005337.def: "Enables the transfer of a nucleoside, a nucleobase linked to either beta-D-ribofuranose (ribonucleoside) or 2-deoxy-beta-D-ribofuranose, (a deoxyribonucleotide) from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005338.name: nucleotide-sugar transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005338.def: "Enables the transfer of a nucleotide-sugar from one side of a membrane to the other. A nucleotide-sugar is any nucleotide in which the distal phosphoric residue of a nucleoside 5'-diphosphate is in glycosidic linkage with a monosaccharide or monosaccharide derivative." [GOC:ai, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729, PMID:15034926]

GO:0005340.name: nucleotide-sulfate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005340.def: "Enables the transfer of nucleotide-sulfate from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0005342.name: organic acid transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005342.def: "Enables the transfer of organic acids from one side of a membrane to the other. Organic acids are acidic compound containing carbon in covalent linkage." [ISBN:0198506732]

GO:0005343.name: organic acid:sodium symporter activity
GO:0005343.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: organic acid(out) + Na+(out) = organic acid(in) + Na+(in)." [TC:2.A.28.1.1]

GO:0005344.name: oxygen carrier activity
GO:0005344.def: "Binding to oxygen and delivering it to an acceptor molecule or a specific location." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005345.name: purine nucleobase transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005345.def: "Enables the transfer of purine nucleobases, one of the two classes of nitrogen-containing ring compounds found in DNA and RNA, from one side of a membrane to the other." [ISBN:0198506732]

GO:0005346.name: purine ribonucleotide transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005346.def: "Enables the transfer of a purine ribonucleotide, any compound consisting of a purine ribonucleoside (a purine organic base attached to a ribose sugar) esterified with (ortho)phosphate, from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005347.name: ATP transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005347.def: "Enables the transfer of ATP, adenosine triphosphate, from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005350.name: pyrimidine nucleobase transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005350.def: "Enables the transfer of pyrimidine nucleobases, one of the two classes of nitrogen-containing ring compounds found in DNA and RNA, from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005351.name: carbohydrate:proton symporter activity
GO:0005351.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: carbohydrate(out) + H+(out) = carbohydrate(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.1.1]

GO:0005352.name: alpha-glucoside:proton symporter activity
GO:0005352.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: alpha-glucoside(out) + H+(out) = alpha-glucoside(in) + H+(in). Alpha-glucosides include trehalose, maltose, turanose, isomaltose, alpha-methylglucoside, maltotriose, palatinose, trehalose and melezitose." [TC:2.A.1.1.11]

GO:0005353.name: fructose transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005353.def: "Enables the transfer of fructose from one side of a membrane to the other. Fructose exists in a open chain form or as a ring compound. D-fructose is the sweetest of the sugars and is found free in a large number of fruits and honey." [GOC:ai, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005354.name: galactose transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005354.def: "Enables the transfer of galactose from one side of a membrane to the other. D-galactose is widely distributed in combined form in plants, animals and microorganisms as a constituent of oligo- and polysaccharides; it also occurs in galactolipids and as its glucoside in lactose and melibiose." [GOC:ai, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005356.name: D-glucose:proton symporter activity
GO:0005356.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: D-glucose + H+ = D-glucose + H+. Symporter activity enables the active transport of a solute across a membrane by a mechanism whereby two or more species are transported together in the same direction in a tightly coupled process not directly linked to a form of energy other than chemiosmotic energy." [GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0005358.name: high-affinity D-glucose:proton symporter activity
GO:0005358.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: glucose + H+ = glucose + H+. This activity is constitutive and therefore always present, regardless of demand. Symporter activity enables the active transport of a solute across a membrane by a mechanism whereby two or more species are transported together in the same direction in a tightly coupled process not directly linked to a form of energy other than chemiosmotic energy. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations." [GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0005359.name: low-affinity D-glucose:proton symporter activity
GO:0005359.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: glucose(out) + H(out)+ = glucose(in) + H(in)+. In low-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute only if it is present at very high concentrations. Symporter activity enables the active transport of a solute across a membrane by a mechanism whereby two or more species are transported together in the same direction in a tightly coupled process not directly linked to a form of energy other than chemiosmotic energy." [GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0005360.name: insulin-responsive D-glucose:proton symporter activity
GO:0005360.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: glucose(out) + H(out)+ = glucose(in) + H(in)+, in response to a stimulus by insulin. Symporter activity enables the active transport of a solute across a membrane by a mechanism whereby two or more species are transported together in the same direction in a tightly coupled process not directly linked to a form of energy other than chemiosmotic energy." [GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0005362.name: low-affinity D-glucose:sodium symporter activity
GO:0005362.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: D-glucose(out) + Na+(out) = D-glucose(in) + Na+(in). In low-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute only if it is present at very high concentrations." [TC:2.A.21.3.-]

GO:0005363.name: maltose transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005363.def: "Enables the transfer of maltose from one side of a membrane to the other. Maltose is the disaccharide 4-O-alpha-D-glucopyranosyl-D-glucopyranose, an intermediate in the enzymatic breakdown of glycogen and starch." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0198506732, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005364.name: maltose:proton symporter activity
GO:0005364.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: maltose(out) + H+(out) = maltose(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.1.1.10]

GO:0005365.name: myo-inositol transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005365.def: "Enables the transfer of myo-inositol from one side of a membrane to the other. Myo-inositol is 1,2,3,4,5/4,6-cyclohexanehexol, a growth factor for animals and microorganisms." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005366.name: myo-inositol:proton symporter activity
GO:0005366.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: myo-inositol(out) + H+(out) = myo-inositol(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.1.1.8]

GO:0005367.name: myo-inositol:sodium symporter activity
GO:0005367.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: myo-inositol(out) + Na+(out) = myo-inositol(in) + Na+(in)." [TC:2.A.21.4.-]

GO:0005368.name: taurine transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005368.def: "Enables the transfer of taurine from one side of a membrane to the other. Taurine (2-aminoethanesulfonic acid) is a sulphur-containing amino acid derivative which is important in the metabolism of fats." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005369.name: taurine:sodium symporter activity
GO:0005369.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: taurine(out) + Na+(out) = taurine(in) + Na+(in)." [TC:2.A.22.3.3]

GO:0005371.name: tricarboxylate secondary active transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005371.def: "Enables the transfer of tricarboxylate from one side of a membrane to the other, up its concentration gradient. The transporter binds the solute and undergoes a series of conformational changes. Transport works equally well in either direction and is driven by a chemiosmotic source of energy. Secondary active transporters include symporters and antiporters." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005372.name: water transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005372.def: "Enables the transfer of water (H2O) from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005375.name: copper ion transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005375.def: "Enables the transfer of copper (Cu) ions from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005381.name: iron ion transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005381.def: "Enables the transfer of iron (Fe) ions from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005384.name: manganese ion transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005384.def: "Enables the transfer of manganese (Mn) ions from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:dgf]

GO:0005385.name: zinc ion transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005385.def: "Enables the transfer of zinc (Zn) ions from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:dgf]

GO:0005388.name: P-type calcium transporter activity
GO:0005388.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + Ca2+(in) = ADP + phosphate + Ca2+(out)." [RHEA:18105]

GO:0005391.name: P-type sodium:potassium-exchanging transporter activity
GO:0005391.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + Na+(in) + K+(out) = ADP + phosphate + Na+(out) + K+(in)." [EC:7.2.2.13]

GO:0005402.name: carbohydrate:monoatomic cation symporter activity
GO:0005402.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: sugar(out) + cation(out) = sugar(in) + cation(in)." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005412.name: D-glucose:sodium symporter activity
GO:0005412.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: D-glucose(out) + Na+(out) = D-glucose(in) + Na+(in)." [TC:2.A.21.3.-]

GO:0005415.name: nucleoside:sodium symporter activity
GO:0005415.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: nucleoside(out) + Na+(out) = nucleoside(in) + Na+(in)." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005416.name: amino acid:monoatomic cation symporter activity
GO:0005416.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: amino acid(out) + cation(out) = amino acid(in) + cation(in)." [GOC:ai]

GO:0005427.name: proton-dependent oligopeptide secondary active transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005427.def: "Enables the transfer of a oligopeptide from one side of a membrane to the other, up its concentration gradient. The transporter binds the solute and undergoes a series of conformational changes. Transport works equally well in either direction and is driven by proton movement." [GOC:mtg_transport, OMIM:600544]

GO:0005432.name: calcium:sodium antiporter activity
GO:0005432.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: Ca2+(in) + Na+(out) = Ca2+(out) + Na+(in)." [GOC:curators, PMID:16371597]

GO:0005436.name: sodium:phosphate symporter activity
GO:0005436.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: Na+(out) + phosphate(out) = Na+(in) + phosphate(in)." [TC:2.A.1.14.6]

GO:0005452.name: solute:inorganic anion antiporter activity
GO:0005452.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: inorganic anion(out) + solute(in) = inorganic anion (in) + solute(out)." [GOC:mah]

GO:0005456.name: CMP-N-acetylneuraminate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005456.def: "Enables the transfer of a CMP-N-acetylneuraminate from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:ai, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005457.name: GDP-fucose transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005457.def: "Enables the transfer of a GDP-fucose from one side of a membrane to the other. GDP-fucose is a substance composed of fucose in glycosidic linkage with guanosine diphosphate." [GOC:ai, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005458.name: GDP-mannose transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005458.def: "Enables the transfer of a GDP-mannose from one side of a membrane to the other. GDP-mannose is a substance composed of mannose in glycosidic linkage with guanosine diphosphate." [GOC:ai, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005459.name: UDP-galactose transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0005459.def: "Enables the transfer of a UDP-galactose from one side of a membrane to the other. UDP-galactose is a substance composed of galactose in glycosidic linkage with uridine diphosphate." [GOC:ai, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0005460.name: UDP-glucose transmembrane transporter activity
