GO:0015345.name: ferric enterobactin:proton symporter activity
GO:0015345.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ferric enterobactin(out) + H+(out) = ferric enterobactin(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.1.16.2]

GO:0015346.name: ferric triacetylfusarinine C:proton symporter activity
GO:0015346.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ferric triacetylfusarinine C(out) + H+(out) = ferric triacetylfusarinine C(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.1.16.3]

GO:0015347.name: sodium-independent organic anion transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015347.def: "Enables the transfer of organic anions from one side of a membrane to the other, in a sodium independent manner." [GOC:go_curators]

GO:0015349.name: thyroid hormone transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015349.def: "Enables the transfer of thyroid hormones from one side of a membrane to the other. Thyroid hormone are any of the compounds secreted by the thyroid gland, largely thyroxine and triiodothyronine." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015350.name: methotrexate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015350.def: "Enables the transfer of methotrexate, 4-amino-10-methylformic acid from one side of a membrane to the other. Methotrexate is a folic acid analogue and a potent competitive inhibitor of dihydrofolate reductase." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015355.name: secondary active monocarboxylate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015355.def: "Catalysis of the movement of a monocarboxylate, any compound containing a single carboxyl group (COOH or COO-), by uniport, symport or antiport across a membrane by a carrier-mediated mechanism." [GOC:bf, GOC:jl]

GO:0015360.name: acetate:proton symporter activity
GO:0015360.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: acetate(out) + H+(out) = acetate(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.44.4.1]

GO:0015361.name: low-affinity sodium:dicarboxylate symporter activity
GO:0015361.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: dicarboxylate(out) + Na+(out) = dicarboxylate(in) + Na+(in). In low-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute only if it is present at very high concentrations." [TC:2.A.47.1.1]

GO:0015362.name: high-affinity sodium:dicarboxylate symporter activity
GO:0015362.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: dicarboxylate(out) + Na+(out) = dicarboxylate(in) + Na+(in). In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations." [TC:2.A.47.1.4]

GO:0015364.name: dicarboxylate:phosphate antiporter activity
GO:0015364.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: dicarboxylate(out) + phosphate(in) = dicarboxylate(in) +  phosphate(out)." [TC:2.A.29.2.3]

GO:0015366.name: malate:proton symporter activity
GO:0015366.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: malate(out) + H+(out) = malate(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.16.2.1]

GO:0015367.name: oxoglutarate:malate antiporter activity
GO:0015367.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: oxoglutarate(out) + malate(in) = oxoglutarate(in) + malate(out)." [TC:2.A.29.2.1]

GO:0015368.name: calcium:monoatomic cation antiporter activity
GO:0015368.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: Ca2+(in) + cation(out) = Ca2+(out) + cation(in)." [TC:2.A.19.-.-]

GO:0015369.name: calcium:proton antiporter activity

GO:0015381.name: high-affinity sulfate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015381.def: "Enables the secondary active high affinity transfer of sulfate from one side of a membrane to the other. Secondary active transport is the transfer of a solute across a membrane, up its concentration gradient. The transporter binds the solute and undergoes a series of conformational changes. Transport works equally well in either direction and is driven by a chemiosmotic source of energy. Secondary active transporters include symporters and antiporters. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind thesolute even if it is only present at very low concentrations." [GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0015382.name: sodium:sulfate symporter activity
GO:0015382.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: sulfate(out) + Na+(out) = sulfate(in) + Na+(in)." [TC:2.A.47.1.2]

GO:0015385.name: sodium:proton antiporter activity

GO:0015394.name: uridine:proton symporter activity
GO:0015394.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: uridine(out) + H+(out) = uridine(in) + H+(in)." [GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0015395.name: nucleoside transmembrane transporter activity, down a concentration gradient
GO:0015395.def: "Enables the transfer of a nucleoside, from one side of a membrane to the other, down the concentration gradient." [PMID:10353709, PMID:11749958, PMID:12446811]

GO:0015399.name: primary active transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015399.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute from one side of a membrane to the other, up the solute's concentration gradient, by binding the solute and undergoing a series of conformational changes. Transport works equally well in either direction and is powered by a primary energy source. Primary energy sources known to be coupled to transport are chemical such as ATP hydrolysis, redox energy and photon energy." [GOC:mtg_transport, PMID:31613498]

GO:0015401.name: urea:sodium symporter activity
GO:0015401.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: urea(out) + Na+(out) = urea(in) + Na+(in)." [TC:2.A.21.6.1]

GO:0015407.name: ABC-type monosaccharide transporter activity
GO:0015407.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + monosaccharide(out) = ADP + phosphate + monosaccharide(in). Ribose, xylose, arabinose, galactose and methylgalactoside are imported." [MetaCyc:3.6.3.17-RXN]

GO:0015408.name: ABC-type ferric iron transporter activity
GO:0015408.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + Fe3+(out) = ADP + phosphate + Fe3+(in)." [RHEA:12332]

GO:0015410.name: ABC-type manganese transporter activity
GO:0015410.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + Mn2+(out) = ADP + phosphate + Mn2+(in)." [RHEA:17365]

GO:0015411.name: ABC-type taurine transporter transporter activity

GO:0015412.name: ABC-type molybdate transporter activity

GO:0015413.name: ABC-type nickel transporter activity

GO:0015414.name: ABC-type nitrate transporter activity

GO:0015415.name: ATPase-coupled phosphate ion transmembrane transporter activity

GO:0015416.name: ABC-type phosphonate transporter activity
GO:0015416.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + phosphonate(out) = ADP + phosphate + phosphonate(in). A phosphonate is any salt, anion, or ester of phosphonic acid (HPO(OH)2)." [RHEA:18065]

GO:0015417.name: ABC-type polyamine transporter activity
GO:0015417.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O + polyamine(out) = ADP + phosphate + polyamine(in)." [RHEA:29999]

GO:0015418.name: ABC-type quaternary ammonium compound transporting activity
GO:0015418.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O + quaternary ammonium(out) = ADP + H+ + phosphate + quaternary ammonium(in)." [GOC:pz, RHEA:11036]

GO:0015419.name: ABC-type sulfate transporter activity
GO:0015419.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + sulfate(out) = ADP + phosphate + sulfate(in)." [RHEA:10192]

GO:0015420.name: ABC-type vitamin B12 transporter activity
GO:0015420.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: vitamin B12(out) + ATP + H2O = ADP + an vitamin B12(in) + H+ + phosphate. Vitamin B12 is alkylcob(III)alamin." [GOC:pz, RHEA:17873]

GO:0015421.name: ABC-type oligopeptide transporter activity
GO:0015421.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O + oligopeptide(out) = ADP + phosphate + oligopeptide(in)." [RHEA:14429]

GO:0015422.name: ABC-type oligosaccharide transporter activity

GO:0015423.name: ABC-type maltose transporter activity

GO:0015424.name: ABC-type amino acid transporter activity
GO:0015424.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + amino acid(out/in) = ADP + phosphate + amino acid(in/out)." [GOC:ai, GOC:mah]

GO:0015425.name: ATPase-coupled nonpolar-amino acid transporter activity
GO:0015425.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + nonpolar amino acid(out) = ADP + phosphate + nonpolar amino acid(in)." [EC:7.4.2.2]

GO:0015426.name: ATPase-coupled polar amino acid-transporter activity

GO:0015430.name: ABC-type glycerol-3-phosphate transporter activity

GO:0015431.name: ABC-type glutathione S-conjugate transporter activity

GO:0015432.name: ABC-type bile acid transporter activity
GO:0015432.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: bile acid(in) + ATP + H2O -> bile acid(out) + ADP + phosphate." [RHEA:50048]

GO:0015433.name: ABC-type peptide antigen transporter activity
GO:0015433.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: peptide antigen(in) + ATP = peptide antigen(out) + ADP + phosphate." [TC:3.A.1.209.1]

GO:0015434.name: ABC-type cadmium transporter activity
GO:0015434.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + Cd (cytosol) = ADP + phosphate + Cd (vacuole)." [PMID:12455987]

GO:0015436.name: ABC-type capsular-polysaccharide transporter activity
GO:0015436.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + capsular polysaccharide(in) = ADP + phosphate + capsular polysaccharide(out)." [EC:7.6.2.12]

GO:0015437.name: lipopolysaccharide floppase activity
GO:0015437.def: "Enables the transfer of a lipopolysaccharide from the cytosolic to the exoplasmic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP." [EC:7.5.2.5]

GO:0015438.name: ABC-type teichoic acid transporter activity
GO:0015438.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + teichoic acid(in) = ADP + phosphate + teichoic acid(out)." [PMID:7565096]

GO:0015439.name: ABC-type heme transporter activity
GO:0015439.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O + heme(in) = ADP + phosphate + heme(out)." [RHEA:19261]

GO:0015440.name: ABC-type peptide transporter activity
GO:0015440.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O + peptide(in) = ADP + phosphate + peptide(out). Peptides exported include alpha-hemolysin, cyclolysin, colicin V and siderophores from Gram-negative bacteria, and bacteriocin, subtilin, competence factor and pediocin from Gram-positive bacteria." [EC:7.4.2.5]

GO:0015441.name: ABC-type beta-glucan transporter activity
GO:0015441.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + beta-glucan(in) = ADP + phosphate + beta-glucan(out)." [RHEA:18453]

GO:0015444.name: P-type magnesium transporter activity
GO:0015444.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + Mg2+(out) = ADP + phosphate + Mg2+(in)." [RHEA:10260]

GO:0015445.name: P-type silver transporter activity
GO:0015445.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + Ag+(in) = ADP + phosphate + Ag+(out)." [RHEA:14733]

GO:0015446.name: ATPase-coupled arsenite transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015446.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + arsenite(in) = ADP + phosphate + arsenite(out)." [PMID:10970874, RHEA:11348]

GO:0015450.name: protein-transporting ATPase activity
GO:0015450.def: "Primary active carrier-mediated transport of a protein across a membrane, driven by the hydrolysis of the diphosphate bond of inorganic pyrophosphate, ATP, or another nucleoside triphosphate. The transport protein may or may not be transiently phosphorylated, but the substrate is not phosphorylated." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0015451.name: decarboxylation-driven active transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015451.def: "Primary active transport of a solute across a membrane driven by decarboxylation of a cytoplasmic substrate. Primary active transport is catalysis of the transport of a solute across a membrane, up the solute's concentration gradient, by binding the solute and undergoing a series of conformational changes. Transport works equally well in either direction and is driven by a primary energy source." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729, TC:3.B.-.-.-]

GO:0015452.name: methyl transfer-driven active transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015452.def: "Primary active transport of a solute across a membrane driven by a methyl transfer reaction. Primary active transport is catalysis of the transport of a solute across a membrane, up the solute's concentration gradient, by binding the solute and undergoing a series of conformational changes. Transport works equally well in either direction and is driven by a primary energy source." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729, TC:3.C.-.-.-]

GO:0015453.name: oxidoreduction-driven active transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015453.def: "Primary active transport of a solute across a membrane, driven by exothermic flow of electrons from a reduced substrate to an oxidized substrate. Primary active transport is catalysis of the transport of a solute across a membrane, up the solute's concentration gradient, by binding the solute and undergoing a series of conformational changes. Transport works equally well in either direction and is driven by a primary energy source." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729, TC:3.D.-.-.-]

GO:0015454.name: light-driven active monoatomic ion transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015454.def: "Active transport of an ion across a membrane, driven by light." [GOC:mtg_transport, PMID:23994288, PMID:26442282]

GO:0015459.name: potassium channel regulator activity
GO:0015459.def: "Binds to and modulates the activity of a potassium channel." [GOC:dos, GOC:mah]

GO:0015462.name: ABC-type protein transporter activity
GO:0015462.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + protein(out) = ADP + phosphate + protein(in)." [GOC:jl]

GO:0015464.name: acetylcholine receptor activity
GO:0015464.def: "Combining with an acetylcholine receptor ligand and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity." [GOC:jl, GOC:signaling]

GO:0015467.name: G-protein activated inward rectifier potassium channel activity
GO:0015467.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of a potassium ion by an inwardly-rectifying voltage-gated channel, where the inward rectification is due to a voltage-dependent block of the channel pore by a G protein. An inwardly rectifying current-voltage relation is one where at any given driving force the inward flow of K+ ions exceeds the outward flow for the opposite driving force." [GOC:cb, GOC:mah]

GO:0015471.name: nucleoside-specific channel forming porin activity
GO:0015471.def: "Enables the energy independent passage of nucleoside, sized less than 1000 Da, across a membrane. The transmembrane portions of porins consist exclusively of beta-strands which form a beta-barrel. They are found in the outer membranes of Gram-negative bacteria, mitochondria, plastids and possibly acid-fast Gram-positive bacteria." [GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0015473.name: fimbrial usher porin activity
GO:0015473.def: "A porin that acts in the assembly of fimbria together with fimbrial chaperone." [TC:1.B.11.-.-]

GO:0015474.name: autotransporter activity
GO:0015474.def: "Transports a passenger protein from the periplasm to the external milieu; the passenger protein and the porin are the N- and C-terminal regions of the same protein, respectively." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729, TC:1.B.12.-.-]

GO:0015478.name: oligosaccharide transporting porin activity
GO:0015478.def: "Enables the transfer of oligosaccharide, sized less than 1000 Da, from one side of a membrane to the other. The transmembrane portions of porins consist exclusively of beta-strands which form a beta-barrel. They are found in the outer membranes of Gram-negative bacteria, mitochondria, plastids and possibly acid-fast Gram-positive bacteria." [GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0015481.name: maltose transporting porin activity
GO:0015481.def: "Enables the transfer of maltose from one side of a membrane to the other. Maltose is the disaccharide 4-O-alpha-D-glucopyranosyl-D-glucopyranose, an intermediate in the enzymatic breakdown of glycogen and starch. This transporter is a porin so enables the energy independent passage of substances, sized less than 1000 Da, across a membrane. The transmembrane portions of porins consist exclusively of beta-strands which form a beta-barrel. They are found in the outer membranes of Gram-negative bacteria, mitochondria, plastids and possibly acid-fast Gram-positive bacteria." [GOC:mtg_transport]

GO:0015483.name: long-chain fatty acid transporting porin activity
GO:0015483.def: "Enables the transfer of a long-chain fatty acid from one side of a membrane to the other. A long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 13 to 22 carbons. This transporter is a porin and so enables the energy independent passage of substances, sized less than 1000 Da, across a membrane. The transmembrane portions of porins consist exclusively of beta-strands which form a beta-barrel. They are found in the outer membranes of Gram-negative bacteria, mitochondria, plastids and possibly acid-fast Gram-positive bacteria." [GOC:mtg_transport, TC:1.B.9.1.1]

GO:0015485.name: cholesterol binding
GO:0015485.def: "Binding to cholesterol (cholest-5-en-3-beta-ol); the principal sterol of vertebrates and the precursor of many steroids, including bile acids and steroid hormones." [GOC:jl, ISBN:0198506732]

GO:0015486.name: glycoside-pentoside-hexuronide:cation symporter activity

GO:0015487.name: melibiose:monoatomic cation symporter activity

GO:0015488.name: glucuronide:cation symporter activity

GO:0015489.name: putrescine transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015489.def: "Enables the transfer of putrescine from one side of a membrane to the other. Putrescine is 1,4-diaminobutane, the polyamine formed by decarboxylation of ornithine and the metabolic precursor of spermidine and spermine." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015492.name: phenylalanine:proton symporter activity

GO:0015493.name: lysine:proton symporter activity

GO:0015494.name: aromatic amino acid:proton symporter activity
GO:0015494.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: aromatic amino acid(out) + H+(out) = aromatic amino acid(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.3.1.3]

GO:0015495.name: gamma-aminobutyric acid:proton symporter activity
GO:0015495.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: gamma-aminobutyric acid(out) + H+(out) = gamma-aminobutyric acid(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.18.5.1, TC:2.A.3.1.4, TC:2.A.3.4.2]

GO:0015498.name: pantothenate:sodium symporter activity

GO:0015499.name: formate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015499.def: "Enables the transfer of formate from one side of a membrane to the other. Formate is also known as methanoate, the anion HCOO- derived from methanoic (formic) acid." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015501.name: glutamate:sodium symporter activity
GO:0015501.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: glutamate(out) + Na+(out) = glutamate(in) + Na+(in)." [TC:2.A.27.1.1]

GO:0015503.name: glutathione-regulated potassium exporter activity
GO:0015503.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: K+(in) + H+(out) = K+(out) + H+(in), where glutathione maintains the closed state." [PMID:11053405, TC:2.A.37.1.1, TC:2.A.37.1.2]

GO:0015506.name: nucleoside:proton symporter activity

GO:0015513.name: high-affinity secondary active nitrite transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015513.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of nitrite from one side of the membrane to the other, up the solute's concentration gradient. The transporter binds the solute and undergoes a series of conformational changes. Transport works equally well in either direction and is driven by a chemiosmotic source of energy. In high affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0015514.name: nitrite efflux transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015514.def: "Enables the transfer of nitrite from the inside of the cell to the outside of the cell across a membrane." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0015515.name: citrate:succinate antiporter activity
GO:0015515.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: citrate(out) + succinate(in) = citrate(in) + succinate(out)." [TC:2.A.47.3.2]

GO:0015516.name: tartrate:succinate antiporter activity
GO:0015516.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: tartrate(out) + succinate(in) = tartrate(in) + succinate(out)." [TC:2.A.47.3.3]

GO:0015517.name: galactose:proton symporter activity
GO:0015517.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: galactose(out) + H+(out) = galactose(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.1.1.1, TC:2.A.1.1.9]

GO:0015518.name: arabinose:proton symporter activity
GO:0015518.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: arabinose(out) + H+(out) = arabinose(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.1.1.2]

GO:0015519.name: D-xylose:proton symporter activity
GO:0015519.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: D-xylose(out) + H+(out) = D-xylose(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.1.1.3]

GO:0015520.name: tetracycline:proton antiporter activity
GO:0015520.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: H+(out) + tetracycline(in) = H+(in) + tetracycline(out)." [TC:2.A.1.2.4]

GO:0015526.name: hexose-phosphate:phosphate antiporter activity
GO:0015526.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: hexose phosphate(out) + phosphate(in) = hexose phosphate(in) +  phosphate(out)." [TC:2.A.1.4.1]

GO:0015527.name: glycerol-phosphate:phosphate antiporter activity
GO:0015527.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: glycerol phosphate(out) + phosphate(in) = glycerol phosphate(in) + phosphate(out)." [TC:2.A.1.4.3]

GO:0015528.name: lactose:proton symporter activity
GO:0015528.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: lactose(out) + H+(out) = lactose(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.1.1.9, TC:2.A.1.5.1]

GO:0015529.name: raffinose:proton symporter activity
GO:0015529.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: raffinose(out) + H+(out) = raffinose(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.1.5.2]

GO:0015530.name: shikimate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015530.def: "Enables the transfer of shikimate from one side of a membrane to the other. Shikimate is an important intermediate in the biosynthesis of aromatic amino acids." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015531.name: citrate:proton symporter activity
GO:0015531.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: citrate(out) + H+(out) = citrate(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.1.6.1]

GO:0015532.name: alpha-ketoglutarate:proton symporter activity
GO:0015532.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: alpha-ketoglutarate(out) + H+(out) = alpha-ketoglutarate(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.1.6.2]

GO:0015533.name: shikimate:proton symporter activity
GO:0015533.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: shikimate(out) + H+(out) = shikimate(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.1.6.6]

GO:0015535.name: fucose:proton symporter activity
GO:0015535.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: fucose(out) + H+(out) = fucose(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.1.7.1]

GO:0015537.name: xanthosine:proton symporter activity
GO:0015537.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: xanthosine(out) + H+(out) = xanthosine(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.1.10.2]

GO:0015538.name: sialic acid:proton symporter activity
GO:0015538.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: sialate(out) + H+(out) = sialate(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.1.12.1]

GO:0015539.name: hexuronate:monoatomic cation symporter activity
GO:0015539.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: hexuronate(out) + cation(out) = hexuronate(in) + cation(in). The hexuronate may be glucuronate or galacturonate." [TC:2.A.1.14.2]

GO:0015540.name: 3-hydroxyphenyl propionate:proton symporter activity
GO:0015540.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: 3-hydroxyphenyl propionate(out) + H+(out) = 3-hydroxyphenyl propionate(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.1.15.2]

GO:0015541.name: secondary active cyanate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015541.def: "Enables the transfer of cyanate from one side of a membrane to the other." [TC:2.A.1.17.1]

GO:0015544.name: phenyl propionate uniporter activity
GO:0015544.def: "Enables the transfer of phenyl propionate from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:mtg_transport, TC:2.A.1.27.1]

GO:0015545.name: bicyclomycin transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015545.def: "Enables the transfer of bicyclomycin from one side of a membrane to the other. Bicyclomycin (or bicozamycin) is an antibacterial drug often used as a livestock feed additive." [ISBN:091191028X]

GO:0015546.name: sulfathiazole transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015546.def: "Enables the transfer of sulfathiazole from one side of a membrane to the other. Sulfathiazole is an antibacterial agent of the sulfonamide group." [GOC:curators]

GO:0015550.name: galacturonate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015550.def: "Enables the transfer of galacturonate from one side of a membrane to the other. Galacturonate is the uronic acid formally derived from galactose by oxidation of the hydroxymethylene group at C-6 to a carboxyl group." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015551.name: 3-hydroxyphenyl propanoate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015551.def: "Enables the transfer of 3-hydroxyphenyl propanoate from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015552.name: propionate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015552.def: "Enables the transfer of propionate from one side of a membrane to the other. Propionate (or propanoate) is the organic acid CH3-CH2-COOH." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015553.name: xanthosine transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015553.def: "Enables the transfer of xanthosine, xanthine riboside, from one side of a membrane to the other." [ISBN:0198506732]

GO:0015554.name: tartrate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015554.def: "Enables the transfer of tartrate from one side of a membrane to the other. Tartrate is the anion of 2,3-dihydroxybutanedioic acid, one of the aldaric acids. The L(+) enantiomer occurs widely in plants, especially in grape juice, and in fungi and bacteria." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015556.name: C4-dicarboxylate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015556.def: "Enables the transfer of C4-dicarboxylate from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:krc]

GO:0015558.name: secondary active p-aminobenzoyl-glutamate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015558.def: "Enables the transfer of p-aminobenzoyl-glutamate from one side of a membrane to the other, up its concentration gradient. The transporter binds the solute and undergoes a series of conformational changes. Transport works equally well in either direction and is driven by a chemiosmotic source of energy. Secondary active transporters include symporters and antiporters. p-aminobenzoyl-glutamate is the anion of p-aminobenzoyl-glutamic acid." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015561.name: rhamnose:proton symporter activity
GO:0015561.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: rhamnose(out) + H+(out) = rhamnose(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.7.6]

GO:0015562.name: efflux transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015562.def: "Enables the transfer of a specific substance or related group of substances from the inside of the cell to the outside of the cell across a membrane." [GOC:ai, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0015565.name: threonine efflux transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015565.def: "Enables the transfer of threonine from the inside of the cell to the outside of the cell across a membrane." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0015567.name: alkane transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015567.def: "Enables the transfer of alkanes from one side of a membrane to the other. Alkanes are saturated aliphatic hydrocarbon compounds." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015568.name: L-idonate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015568.def: "Enables the transfer of L-idonate from one side of a membrane to the other. L-idonate is an aldonic acid derived from L-idose, an aldohexose which is epimeric with D-glucose." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015571.name: N-acetylgalactosamine transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015571.def: "Enables the transfer of N-acetylgalactosamine from one side of a membrane to the other. N-acetylgalactosamine, 2-acetamido-2-deoxygalactopyranose, is the n-acetyl derivative of galactosamine." [GOC:ai, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0015572.name: N-acetylglucosamine transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015572.def: "Enables the transfer of N-acetylglucosamine from one side of a membrane to the other. The D isomer of N-acetylglucosamine is a common structural unit of glycoproteins in plants, bacteria and animals; it is often the terminal sugar of an oligosaccharide group of a glycoprotein." [GOC:ai, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0015573.name: beta-glucoside transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015573.def: "Enables the transfer of beta-glucosides from one side of a membrane to the other. Beta-glucosides are glycosides in which the sugar group is a glucose residue, and the anomeric carbon of the bond is in a beta configuration." [GOC:jl, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0198506732, ISBN:0815340729, PMID:7883710]

GO:0015574.name: trehalose transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015574.def: "Enables the transfer of trehalose from one side of a membrane to the other. Trehalose is the disaccharide alpha-D-glucopyranosyl-alpha-D-glucopyranoside that acts of a reserve carbohydrate in certain fungi, algae and lichens." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0198506732, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0015575.name: mannitol transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015575.def: "Enables the transfer of mannitol from one side of a membrane to the other. Mannitol is the alditol derived from D-mannose by reduction of the aldehyde group." [GOC:ai, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0015576.name: sorbitol transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015576.def: "Enables the transfer of sorbitol from one side of a membrane to the other. Sorbitol, also known as glucitol, is the hexitol derived by the reduction of the aldehyde group of glucose." [GOC:ai, ISBN:0198506732]

GO:0015577.name: galactitol transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015577.def: "Enables the transfer of a galactitol from one side of a membrane to the other. Galactitol is the hexitol derived by the reduction of the aldehyde group of either D- or L-galactose." [GOC:ai, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0015578.name: mannose transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015578.def: "Enables the transfer of mannose from one side of a membrane to the other. Mannose is the aldohexose manno-hexose, the C-2 epimer of glucose. The D-(+)-form is widely distributed in mannans and hemicelluloses and is of major importance in the core oligosaccharide of N-linked oligosaccharides of glycoproteins." [GOC:ai, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0015591.name: D-ribose transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015591.def: "Enables the transfer of D-ribose from one side of a membrane to the other. As beta-D-ribofuranose, D-ribose forms the glycose group of all ribonucleosides, ribonucleotides and ribonucleic acids, and also of ribose phosphates, various glycosides, some coenzymes and some forms of vitamin B12." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0198506732, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0015592.name: methylgalactoside transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015592.def: "Enables the transfer of methylgalactoside from one side of a membrane to the other. Methylgalactoside is a compound in which the H of the OH group on carbon-1 of galactose is replaced by a methyl group." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0015594.name: ABC-type putrescine transporter activity
GO:0015594.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O + putrescine(out) -> ADP + phosphate + putrescine(in)." [EC:7.6.2.11]

GO:0015599.name: ATPase-coupled L-glutamine transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015599.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + glutamine(out) -> ADP + phosphate + glutamine(in)." [RHEA:29895]

GO:0015603.name: iron chelate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015603.def: "Enables the transfer of an iron chelate from one side of a membrane to the other. An iron chelate is a heterocyclic compound having a metal ion attached by coordinate bonds to at least two nonmetal ions." [PMID:17660286]

GO:0015605.name: organophosphate ester transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015605.def: "Enables the transfer of organophosphate esters from one side of a membrane to the other. Organophosphate esters are small organic molecules containing phosphate ester bonds." [GOC:mcc]

GO:0015606.name: spermidine transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015606.def: "Enables the transfer of spermidine, N-(3-aminopropyl)-1,4-diaminobutane, from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015607.name: ABC-type fatty-acyl-CoA transporter activity
GO:0015607.def: "Catalysis of the reaction ATP + H2O + fatty acyl CoA(Side 1) = ADP + phosphate + fatty acyl CoA(Side 2). A fatty acyl CoA group is any acyl group derived from a fatty acid with a coenzyme A group attached to it." [RHEA:15181]

GO:0015608.name: carbohydrate-importing ABC transporter activity
GO:0015608.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + carbohydrate(out) -> ADP + phosphate + carbohydrate(in)." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015611.name: ABC-type D-ribose transporter activity
GO:0015611.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + D-ribose(out) = ADP + phosphate + D-ribose(in)." [RHEA:29903]

GO:0015612.name: ABC-type L-arabinose transporter activity
GO:0015612.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + L-arabinose(out) = ADP + phosphate + L-arabinose(in)." [RHEA:30007]

GO:0015614.name: ABC-type D-xylose transporter activity
GO:0015614.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + D-xylose(out) = ADP + phosphate + D-xylose(in)." [RHEA:29899]

GO:0015615.name: ABC-type D-allose transporter activity
GO:0015615.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + D-allose(out) = ADP + phosphate + D-allose(in)." [PMID:9401019, RHEA:29799]

GO:0015616.name: DNA translocase activity
GO:0015616.def: "Generation of movement along a single- or double-stranded DNA molecule, driven by ATP hydrolysis." [GOC:mah, PMID:16428451, PMID:17631491]

GO:0015620.name: ferric-enterobactin transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015620.def: "Enables the transfer of ferric-enterobactin from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015621.name: ferric triacetylfusarinine C transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015621.def: "Enables the transfer of ferric triacetylfusarinine C from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015624.name: ABC-type ferric-enterobactin transporter activity
GO:0015624.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + ferric-enterobactin(out) = ADP + phosphate + ferric-enterobactin(in)." [RHEA:58492]

GO:0015625.name: ABC-type ferric hydroxamate transporter activity
GO:0015625.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + ferric-hydroxamate(out) = ADP + phosphate + ferric-hydroxamate(in)." [PMID:1551849]

GO:0015626.name: L-diaminopimelate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015626.def: "Enables the transfer of L-diaminopimelate from one side of a membrane to the other. L-diaminopimelate is the L-enantiomer anion of 2,6-diaminoheptanedioic acid." [GOC:go_curators, GOC:jsg, GOC:mah, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0198506732, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0015627.name: type II protein secretion system complex
GO:0015627.def: "A large protein complex, containing 12-15 subunits, that spans the cell envelope of Gram-negative bacteria and mediates the movement of proteins into the extracellular environment. The complex includes a component in the cytoplasm, an inner membrane subcomplex that reaches into the periplasmic compartment and a secretion pore in the outer membrane. Proteins using the Type II pathway are transported across the cytoplasmic membrane by the Sec or Tat complex." [PMID:16448494]

GO:0015628.name: protein secretion by the type II secretion system
GO:0015628.def: "The process in which proteins are secreted across the outer membrane of Gram-negative bacteria by the type II secretion system. Proteins using this pathway are first translocated across the cytoplasmic membrane via the Sec or Tat pathways." [GOC:pamgo_curators]

GO:0015629.name: actin cytoskeleton
GO:0015629.def: "The part of the cytoskeleton (the internal framework of a cell) composed of actin and associated proteins. Includes actin cytoskeleton-associated complexes." [GOC:jl, ISBN:0395825172, ISBN:0815316194]

GO:0015630.name: microtubule cytoskeleton
GO:0015630.def: "The part of the cytoskeleton (the internal framework of a cell) composed of microtubules and associated proteins." [GOC:jl, ISBN:0395825172]

GO:0015631.name: tubulin binding
GO:0015631.def: "Binding to monomeric or multimeric forms of tubulin, including microtubules." [GOC:clt]

GO:0015633.name: ABC-type zinc transporter activity
GO:0015633.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + Zn2+(out) = ADP + phosphate + Zn2+(in)." [RHEA:29795]

GO:0015636.name: short-chain fatty acid transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015636.def: "Enables the transfer of short-chain fatty acids from one side of a membrane to the other. A short-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing fewer than 6 carbons." [GOC:mah]

GO:0015638.name: microcin transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015638.def: "Enables the transfer of a microcin from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:mah]

GO:0015640.name: peptidoglycan peptide transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015640.def: "Enables the transfer of peptidoglycan peptides from one side of a membrane to the other. Peptidoglycan peptides are the oligopeptides found in peptidoglycan networks which cross-link the polysaccharide chains." [ISBN:0198506732]

GO:0015643.name: toxic substance binding
GO:0015643.def: "Binding to a toxic substance, a poisonous substance that causes damage to biological systems." [GOC:bf, GOC:curators, GOC:jl, GOC:pr]

GO:0015645.name: fatty acid ligase activity
GO:0015645.def: "Catalysis of the ligation of a fatty acid to an acceptor, coupled to the hydrolysis of ATP." [GOC:cjk, GOC:mah]

GO:0015647.name: peptidoglycan transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015647.def: "Enables the transfer of peptidoglycans, a class of glycoconjugates found in bacterial cell walls, from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015648.name: lipid-linked peptidoglycan transporter activity
GO:0015648.def: "Enables the directed movement of lipid-linked peptidoglycans into, out of or within a cell, or between cells." [GOC:mah]

GO:0015649.name: 2-keto-3-deoxygluconate:proton symporter activity
GO:0015649.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: 2-keto-3-deoxygluconate(out) + H+(out) = 2-keto-3-deoxygluconate(in) + H+(in)." [RHEA:29943, TC:2.A.10.1.1]

GO:0015650.name: lactate:proton symporter activity
GO:0015650.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: lactate (out) + H+ (out) = lactate (in) + H+ (in)." [TC:2.A.14.1.1]

GO:0015651.name: quaternary ammonium group transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015651.def: "Enables the transfer of quaternary ammonium groups from one side of a membrane to the other. Quaternary ammonium groups are any compound that can be regarded as derived from ammonium hydroxide or an ammonium salt by replacement of all four hydrogen atoms of the NH4+ ion by organic groups." [ISBN:0198506732]

GO:0015652.name: quaternary ammonium group:proton symporter activity
GO:0015652.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: quaternary ammonium group(out) + H+(out) = quaternary ammonium group(in) + H+(in)." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015653.name: glycine betaine:proton symporter activity
GO:0015653.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: glycine betaine(out) + H+(out) = glycine betaine(in) + H+(in)." [TC:2.A.15.1.1]

GO:0015654.name: tellurite transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015654.def: "Enables the transfer of tellurite from one side of a membrane to the other. Tellurite is a salt of tellurous acid or an oxide of tellurium which occurs sparingly in tufts of white or yellowish crystals." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015655.name: alanine:sodium symporter activity
GO:0015655.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: alanine(out) + Na+(out) = alanine(in) + Na+(in)." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015657.name: branched-chain amino acid:sodium symporter activity
GO:0015657.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: branched-chain amino acid(out) + cation(out) = branched-chain amino acid(in) + cation(in)." [TC:2.A.26.1.1]

GO:0015658.name: branched-chain amino acid transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015658.def: "Enables the transfer of branched-chain amino acids from one side of a membrane to the other. Branched-chain amino acids are amino acids with a branched carbon skeleton without rings." [GOC:ai, GOC:bf, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0015660.name: formate efflux transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015660.def: "Enables the transfer of formate from the inside of the cell to the outside of the cell across a membrane." [GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0015661.name: L-lysine efflux transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015661.def: "Enables the transfer of L-lysine from the inside of the cell to the outside of the cell across a membrane." [GOC:ai, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

GO:0015662.name: P-type ion transporter activity
GO:0015662.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O = ADP + phosphate, to directly drive the transport of ions across a membrane. The reaction is characterized by the transient formation of a high-energy aspartyl-phosphoryl-enzyme intermediate." [PMID:10322420, PMID:10600683]

GO:0015663.name: nicotinamide mononucleotide transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015663.def: "Enables the directed movement of nicotinamide mononucleotide into, out of or within a cell, or between cells. Nicotinamide mononucleotide is a ribonucleotide in which the nitrogenous base, nicotinamide, is in beta-n-glycosidic linkage with the c-1 position of d-ribose. It is a constituent of NAD and NADP." [ISBN:0721662544]

GO:0015665.name: alcohol transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0015665.def: "Enables the transfer of an alcohol from one side of a membrane to the other. An alcohol is any carbon compound that contains a hydroxyl group." [ISBN:0198506732]

GO:0015666.name: restriction endodeoxyribonuclease activity
GO:0015666.def: "Catalysis of endonucleolytic cleavage of DNA in a site-specific manner, resulting in double-strand breaks." [GOC:mlg]

GO:0015667.name: site-specific DNA-methyltransferase (cytosine-N4-specific) activity
GO:0015667.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + DNA cytosine = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + DNA N4-methylcytosine." [EC:2.1.1.113]

GO:0015668.name: type III site-specific deoxyribonuclease activity
GO:0015668.def: "Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of DNA to give double-stranded fragments with terminal 5'-phosphates. ATP hydrolysis is required. Cleavage is dependent on the presence of two copies of a specific recognition sequence in an inverse orientation in the DNA. Cleavage occurs at a specific distance from one of the recognition sites." [EC:3.1.21.5, PMID:12654995]

GO:0015669.name: gas transport
GO:0015669.def: "The directed movement of substances that are gaseous in normal living conditions into, out of or within a cell, or between cells, by means of some agent such as a transporter or pore." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015670.name: carbon dioxide transport
GO:0015670.def: "The directed movement of carbon dioxide (CO2) into, out of or within a cell, or between cells, by means of some agent such as a transporter or pore." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015671.name: oxygen transport

GO:0015695.name: organic cation transport
GO:0015695.def: "The directed movement of organic cations into, out of or within a cell, or between cells, by means of some agent such as a transporter or pore. Organic cations are atoms or small molecules with a positive charge which contain carbon in covalent linkage." [GOC:ai]

GO:0015697.name: quaternary ammonium group transport
GO:0015697.def: "The directed movement into, out of or within a cell, or between cells, by means of some agent such as a transporter or pore of quaternary ammonium compounds, any compound that can be regarded as derived from ammonium hydroxide or an ammonium salt by replacement of all four hydrogen atoms of the NH4+ ion by organic groups." [GOC:ai, ISBN:0198506732]

GO:0015698.name: inorganic anion transport
GO:0015698.def: "The directed movement of inorganic anions into, out of or within a cell, or between cells, by means of some agent such as a transporter or pore. Inorganic anions are atoms or small molecules with a negative charge which do not contain carbon in covalent linkage." [GOC:krc]

GO:0015699.name: antimonite transmembrane transport
GO:0015699.def: "The directed movement of antimonite into, out of or within a cell, or between cells, by means of some agent such as a transporter or pore." [GOC:krc]

GO:0015708.name: silicic acid import across plasma membrane
GO:0015708.def: "The directed movement of silicates from outside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the cytosol. Silicates are the salts of silicic acids, and are usually composed of silicon and oxygen (Si[x]O[y]), one or more metals, and possibly hydrogen. Types of silicate include unisilicates, metasilicates and hydrous silicates." [GOC:ai, GOC:krc, PMID:16572174]

GO:0015709.name: thiosulfate transport

GO:0015712.name: hexose phosphate transport

GO:0015713.name: phosphoglycerate transmembrane transport

GO:0015716.name: organic phosphonate transport
GO:0015716.def: "The directed movement of phosphonates into, out of or within a cell, or between cells, by means of some agent such as a transporter or pore. A phosphonate is any salt, anion, or ester of phosphonic acid (HPO(OH)2)." [GOC:krc]

GO:0015717.name: triose phosphate transport
