GO:0120298.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-noradrenaline + L-glutaminyl-[protein] = 5-(R)-noradrenalinyl-L-glutamyl-[protein] + NH4(+)." [GOC:sp, PMID:22858378]

GO:0120299.name: peptide histaminyltransferase activity
GO:0120299.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: histamine + L-glutaminyl-[protein] = 5-histaminyl-L-glutamyl-[protein]." [GOC:sp, PMID:23022564, PMID:23797785]

GO:0120300.name: peptide lactyltransferase (CoA-dependent) activity
GO:0120300.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (L-lysyl-[protein] + lactoyl-CoA = CoA + H+ + N(6)-lactoyl-L-lysyl-[protein]." [GOC:sp, PMID:31645732, RHEA:61996]

GO:0120301.name: histone lactyltransferase (CoA-dependent) activity
GO:0120301.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (L-lysyl-[histone] + lactoyl-CoA = CoA + H+ + N(6)-lactoyl-L-lysyl-[histone]." [GOC:sp, PMID:31645732]

GO:0120302.name: background adaptation
GO:0120302.def: "Any process in which an organism changes its pigmentation (lightening in response to a brighter environment or darkening in response to a dimmer environment) in response to a change in light intensity." [GOC:cvs, GOC:krc, PMID:10493760, PMID:29239123, PMID:32898924]

GO:0120303.name: visually-mediated background adaptation
GO:0120303.def: "Any process in which an organism changes its pigmentation (lightening in response to a brighter environment or darkening in response to a dimmer environment) in response to a change in light intensity detected by melanopsin-expressing eye cells." [GOC:cvs, GOC:krc, PMID:29239123, PMID:32898924]

GO:0120304.name: integument-mediated background adaptation
GO:0120304.def: "Any process in which an organism changes its pigmentation (lightening in response to a brighter environment or darkening in response to a dimmer environment) in response to a change in light intensity detected by light sensitive cells in the integument." [GOC:cvs, GOC:krc, PMID:29239123, PMID:32898924]

GO:0120305.name: regulation of pigmentation
GO:0120305.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the deposition or modulates the distribution of coloring matter in an organism." [GOC:krc]

GO:0120306.name: cellular response to actin cytoskeletal stress
GO:0120306.def: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of perturbations or damage to the actin cytoskeleton." [GOC:krc, GOC:vw, PMID:32915139]

GO:0120307.name: Hechtian strand
GO:0120307.def: "An extended membranous thread which firmly connects the plasma membrane to the cell wall during plasmolysis such that the plasma membrane does not separate from the cell wall completely." [GOC:krc, PMID:32397402]

GO:0120308.name: axonemal outer doublet assembly
GO:0120308.def: "The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form an axonemal outer doublet, a part of an axoneme consisting of a doublet microtubule." [GOC:ach, GOC:krc, PMID:16278296]

GO:0120309.name: cilium attachment to cell body
GO:0120309.def: "A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the lateral attachment of the cilium to the cell body via the flagellar attachment zone in some trypanosomatid species." [GOC:ach, GOC:krc, PMID:11877446, PMID:18820079, PMID:22623724, PMID:26272611]

GO:0120310.name: amastigogenesis
GO:0120310.def: "The morphological, biochemical and genetic changes that induce the differentiation of metacyclic parasites into amastigotes in some of the Trypanosomatidae species such as Leishmania parasites and Trypanosoma cruzi. This process occurs inside the cells of the mammalian hosts, particularly in macrophages and other phagocytic cells for Leishmania parasites." [DOI:10.5772/intechopen.84639, GOC:ach, GOC:krc, PMID:12377273, PMID:13129524, PMID:26752404]

GO:0120311.name: ciliary pro-basal body maturation
GO:0120311.def: "A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the conversion of an immature and partially assembled ciliary pro-basal body into a mature basal body that is capable of nucleating a cilium." [GOC:ach, GOC:krc, PMID:26862392]

GO:0120312.name: ciliary basal body segregation
GO:0120312.def: "The process in which the duplicated basal bodies migrate in pairs to the mitotic poles of the nucleus and results in equal distribution in the daughter cells. Ciliary basal body segregation ensures inheritance of the duplicated mitochondrial DNA to the two daughter cells in the Trypanosoma parasites." [GOC:ach, GOC:krc, PMID:1876188, PMID:26272611, PMID:26862392, PMID:27252853, PMID:4055898]

GO:0120313.name: regulation of oocyte karyosome formation
GO:0120313.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of oocyte karyosome formation, the chromosome organization process in which meiotic chromosomes in the oocyte nucleus cluster together to form a compact spherical structure called the karyosome." [GOC:ha, GOC:krc, PMID:33382409]

GO:0120314.name: negative regulation of oocyte karyosome formation
GO:0120314.def: "Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of oocyte karyosome formation, the chromosome organization process in which meiotic chromosomes in the oocyte nucleus cluster together to form a compact spherical structure called the karyosome." [GOC:ha, GOC:krc, PMID:33382409]

GO:0120315.name: positive regulation of oocyte karyosome formation
GO:0120315.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of oocyte karyosome formation, the chromosome organization process in which meiotic chromosomes in the oocyte nucleus cluster together to form a compact spherical structure called the karyosome." [GOC:ha, GOC:krc, PMID:33382409]

GO:0120316.name: sperm flagellum assembly
GO:0120316.def: "The assembly and organization of the sperm flagellum, the microtubule-based axoneme and associated structures that are part of a sperm flagellum (or cilium)." [GOC:krc, PMID:32791035]

GO:0120317.name: sperm mitochondrial sheath assembly
GO:0120317.def: "The assembly and organization of the sperm mitochondrial sheath, the tightly packed helical sheath of ATP-producing mitochondria restricted to the midpiece of the sperm flagellum." [GOC:krc, PMID:32791035]

GO:0120318.name: olfactory sociosexual communication
GO:0120318.def: "The use of external chemical cues called pheromones to send social and sexual information between members of the same species, leading to specific behavioral responses. Pheromones may be detected by two olfactory sensory circuits, the main olfactory pathway and the vomeronasal system." [GOC:krc, PMID:17935991]

GO:0120319.name: long-chain fatty acid omega-1 hydroxylase activity
GO:0120319.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: an (omega-1)-ethyl long-chain fatty acid + O2 + reduced [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] = an (omega-1)-hydroxy-long-chain fatty acid + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase. A long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 13 to 22 carbons." [GOC:nhn, PMID:18577768, PMID:22772592, PMID:24242247, RHEA:60936]

GO:0120320.name: lateral pseudopodium retraction
GO:0120320.def: "The myosin-based contraction and retraction of a lateral pseudopodium." [GOC:krc, GOC:pf, PMID:12953059, PMID:15483055, PMID:17623773]

GO:0120321.name: nuclear envelope adjacent to nuclear pore complex
GO:0120321.def: "The region of the nuclear envelope situated in close proximity to a nuclear pore complex." [GOC:mah, PMID:21802294, PMID:24184107]

GO:0120322.name: lipid modification by small protein conjugation
GO:0120322.def: "A lipid modification process in which one or more groups of a small protein, such as ubiquitin or a ubiquitin-like protein, are covalently attached to a target lipid." [GOC:sp, PMID:34012115]

GO:0120323.name: lipid ubiquitination
GO:0120323.def: "The process in which one or more ubiquitin groups are added to a lipid." [GOC:sp, PMID:34012115]

GO:0120324.name: procyclogenesis
GO:0120324.def: "The morphological, biochemical and genetic changes that induce the differentiation of bloodstream form trypomastigotes into procyclic trypomastigotes in some of the Trypanosomatidae species such as Trypanosoma brucei. This process occurs inside the midgut of the tsetse fly vectors in T. brucei." [GOC:ach, PMID:10593184, PMID:1698624, PMID:17997129, PMID:3194362, PMID:3194363]

GO:0120325.name: NuRD complex binding
GO:0120325.def: "Binding to a NuRD complex." [GOC:krc, GOC:lb, PMID:25150861]

GO:0120326.name: appressorium-mediated entry into host
GO:0120326.def: "Penetration by a symbiont into a host organism via an appressorium. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [GOC:ach, GOC:krc, PMID:14731267, PMID:22589729]

GO:0120327.name: telopode
GO:0120327.def: "A telopode is a plasma membrane bounded cell projection that is present on a telocyte and is tens to hundreds of microns long. Telopodes form a labyrinthine system communicating through gap junctions." [GOC:krc, MESH:D000067617, PMID:20367664]

GO:0120328.name: ATP-dependent DNA (cytosine-5-)-methyltransferase activity
GO:0120328.def: "Catalytic activity that acts to transfer a methyl group to a DNA molecule, driven by ATP hydrolysis." [GOC:krc, PMID:31955845, PMID:32437639, RHEA:68984]

GO:0120329.name: protein localization to centriolar satellite
GO:0120329.def: "A process in which a protein is transported to, or maintained in, a location within a centriolar satellite." [PMID:34782749]

GO:0120330.name: rixosome complex
GO:0120330.def: "A conserved RNA endonuclease complex required for spreading and epigenetic inheritance of heterochromatin. The rixosome contains six unique subunits: three structural subunits (Crb3, Rix1, and Ipi1) which form the core of the complex, and three catalytic subunits (the endonuclease Las1, the polynucleotide kinase Grc3, and the AAA-type ATPase Mdn1), which are involved in the processing of ribosomal RNA precursors. All subunits are essential for viability and are conserved from yeast to mammals, including humans." [GOC:vw, PMID:32491985, PMID:35355014]

GO:0120331.name: endothelial tube formation
GO:0120331.def: "The developmental process pertaining to the initial formation of an endothelial tube." [GOC:sl, PMID:23239824]

GO:0120332.name: host-mediated modulation of oral microbiota composition
GO:0120332.def: "The biological process involved in maintaining the steady-state number of cells within a population of free-living cells, such as the bacteria, in the mouth." [PMID:31882545]

GO:0120333.name: radial spoke 1
GO:0120333.def: "The radial spoke of each group of radial spokes, whether grouped as triplets or doublets, that is most proximal to the base of the cilium. Radial spoke 1 (RS1), similarly to radial spoke 2, is comprised of four domains: 1) a very short base anchored to the A microtubule, 2) an elongaged stalk, 3) a bifurcated neck, and 4) an orthogonal head. The base of RS1 is connected to the tail of the inner dynein arm a/d." [GOC:krc, PMID:22754630]

GO:0120334.name: radial spoke 2
GO:0120334.def: "The radial spoke of each group of radial spokes, whether grouped as triplets or doublets, that is immediately distal to radial spoke 1 (RS1). Radial spoke 2 (RS2), similarly to RS1, is comprised of four domains: 1) a very short base anchored to the A microtubule, 2) an elongaged stalk, 3) a bifurcated neck, and 4) an orthogonal head. The base of RS2 is connected to the tail of the inner dynein arm c." [GOC:krc, PMID:22754630]

GO:0120335.name: radial spoke 3
GO:0120335.def: "Radial spoke 3 (RS3), when present, is the most distal of each group of radial spokes, whether grouped as triplets or doublets. RS3 has significantly different morphology and protein composition than RS1 and RS2 and also extends at a slant from the microtubule doublet, rather than perpendicularly like RS1 and RS2. In some organisms (e.g. Chlamydomonas and Sarcophaga bullata), RS3 is represented only as a stump attached to the A-microtubule lacking the rest of the stalk structure and entirely lacking the head structure." [GOC:krc, ISBN:0124325653, PMID:22754630, PMID:25694453, PMID:9450971]

GO:0120336.name: radial spoke head 1
GO:0120336.def: "The portion of the radial spoke 1 that is orthogonal to the elongated stalk and which projects towards the central pair of microtubules within the ciliary axoneme." [GOC:krc, PMID:22754630, PMID:348711799]

GO:0120337.name: radial spoke head 2
GO:0120337.def: "The portion of the radial spoke 2 that is orthogonal to the elongated stalk and which projects towards the central pair of microtubules within the ciliary axoneme." [GOC:krc, PMID:22754630, PMID:348711799]

GO:0120338.name: radial spoke head 3
GO:0120338.def: "The portion of the radial spoke 3 that is orthogonal to the elongated stalk and which projects towards the central pair of microtubules within the ciliary axoneme." [GOC:krc, PMID:22754630, PMID:348711799]

GO:0120339.name: radial spoke base
GO:0120339.def: "The short portion of the radial spoke that is directly anchored to the A microtubule of an axonemal microtubule doublet." [GOC:krc, PMID:22754630, PMID:25694453]

GO:0120340.name: radial spoke base 1
GO:0120340.def: "The short portion of the radial spoke 1 (RS1) that is directly anchored to the A microtubule of an axonemal microtubule doublet." [GOC:krc, PMID:22754630, PMID:25694453]

GO:0120341.name: radial spoke base 2
GO:0120341.def: "The short portion of the radial spoke 2 (RS2) that is directly anchored to the A microtubule of an axonemal microtubule doublet." [GOC:krc, PMID:22754630, PMID:25694453]

GO:0120342.name: radial spoke base 3
GO:0120342.def: "The short portion of the radial spoke 3 (RS3 )that is directly anchored to the A microtubule of an axonemal microtubule doublet." [GOC:krc, PMID:22754630, PMID:25694453]

GO:0120343.name: radial spoke neck
GO:0120343.def: "The radial spoke neck is a complex that connects the spoke stalk to the head." [GOC:krc, PMID:22754630]

GO:0120500.name: NAE1-UBA3 complex
GO:0120500.def: "A heterodimeric E1 complex that activates the ubiquitin-like protein NEDD8. In humans the subunits are NAE1 (also known as APPBP1) and UBA3." [PMID:12740388, PMID:21931660]

GO:0120501.name: F-actin monooxygenase activity
GO:0120501.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-methionyl-[F-actin] + NADPH + O2 + H+ = L-methionyl-(R)-S-oxide-[F-actin] + NADP+ + H2O." [RHEA:51308]

GO:0120502.name: fatty acid omega-1 hydroxylase activity
GO:0120502.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: an (omega-1)-ethyl fatty acid + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = an (omega-1)-hydroxy fatty acid + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase]." [RHEA:44548]

GO:0120503.name: medium-chain fatty acid omega-1 hydroxylase activity
GO:0120503.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: an (omega-1)-ethyl medium-chain fatty acid + O2 + reduced [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] = an (omega-1)-hydroxy-medium-chain fatty acid + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase. A medium-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 6 to 12 carbons." [PMID:35934685]

GO:0120504.name: EXT1-EXT2 complex
GO:0120504.def: "A heterodimeric complex capable of glycosyltransferase activity required for the elongation of heparan sulfate chains. In humans, the complex consists of EXT1 and EXT2. In Drosophila, the complex consists of ttv and sotv." [GOC:sjm, PMID:14998928, PMID:36402845, PMID:36593275]

GO:0120505.name: histone H3K79 monomethyltransferase activity
GO:0120505.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl79-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N6-methyl-L-lysyl79-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine." [PMID:14732680, PMID:15371351, RHEA:60332]

GO:0120506.name: histone H3K79 dimethyltransferase activity
GO:0120506.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl79-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2H+ + N6,N6-methyl-L-lysyl79-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine." [PMID:14732680, PMID:15371351]

GO:0120507.name: tRNA-guanine transglycosylase complex
GO:0120507.def: "A protein complex that catalyzes the base-exchange of a guanine residue with queuine at the wobble position of the anticodon of tRNAs. The eukaryotic tRNA-guanine transglycosylase exists as a heterodimer of a catalytic subunit (QTRT1 in humans) and an accessory subunit (QTRT2 in humans), whereas the bacterial enzyme is homodimeric." [GOC:sjm, PMID:20354154, PMID:38181786]

GO:0120508.name: GDP-mannose pyrophosphorylase complex
GO:0120508.def: "A protein complex capable of catalyzing the reaction of GTP and mannose-1-phosphate to form GDP-mannose. The complex is a homodimer in most bacteria and a heterodimer in most eukaryotes. In humans, it is composed of a catalytic beta subunit (GMPPB) and a regulatory alpha subunit (GMPPA)." [GOC:sjm, PMID:33986552]

GO:0120509.name: hydroxypyruvate reductase (NADPH) activity
GO:0120509.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-glycerate + NADP+ = 3-hydroxypyruvate + NADPH + H+." [RHEA:18657]

GO:0120510.name: mitochondrial [4Fe-4S] assembly complex
GO:0120510.def: "A protein complex capable of condensing two 2Fe-2S clusters into one 4Fe-4S center in mitochondria. In S. cerevisiae, it consists of Isa1 and Isa2. In humans it consists of ISCA1 and ISCA2. Additional proteins may be present." [PMID:25347204, PMID:29079644, PMID:33711344, PMID:34660592]

GO:0120511.name: methyl farnesoate epoxidase activity
GO:0120511.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: methyl (2E,6E)-farnesoate + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = H+ + H2O + juvenile hormone III + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase]." [PMID:23586995, PMID:38741075, RHEA:43728]

GO:0120512.name: farnesoate epoxidase activity
GO:0120512.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (2E,6E)-farnesoate + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = H+ + H2O + juvenile hormone III carboxylate + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase]." [PMID:22412378, PMID:38741075, RHEA:43724]

GO:0120513.name: 2-(3-amino-3-carboxypropyl)histidine synthase complex
GO:0120513.def: "A protein complex capable of catalysing the transfer of the 3-amino-3-carboxypropyl group from S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAM) to the histidine residue of translation elongation factor 2 (EF2), which is the first step in the biosynthesis of diphthamide. The complex is a Dph2 homodimer in archaea and a Dph1-Dph2 heterodimer in eukaryotes." [GOC:sjm, PMID:24422557, PMID:31463593]

GO:0120514.name: 2-hydroxyflavanone C-glucosyltransferase activity
GO:0120514.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 3'-hydro-2'-hydroxy-beta-oxodihydrochalcone + UDP-alpha-D-glucose = a 3'-(beta-D-glucopyranosyl)-2'-hydroxy-beta-oxodihydrochalcone + H+ + UDP." [RHEA:51504]

GO:0120515.name: fatty acid-CoA ligase activity
GO:0120515.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a fatty acid + ATP + CoA = a fatty acyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate." [RHEA:38883]

GO:0120516.name: diacylglycerol lipase activity
GO:0120516.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a diacylglycerol + H2O = a fatty acid + a monoacylglycerol + H+." [RHEA:32731]

GO:0120517.name: inositol pentakisphosphate kinase activity
GO:0120517.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: inositol pentakisphosphate + ATP = inositol hexakisphosphate + ADP + H+." [GOC:curators]

GO:0120518.name: protein N-terminal-methionine acetyltransferase activity
GO:0120518.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + N-terminal L-methionyl-[protein] = CoA + H+ + N-terminal N(alpha)-acetyl-L-methionyl-[protein]." [RHEA:75239]

GO:0120519.name: tubulin N-terminal-methionine acetyltransferase activity
GO:0120519.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + N-terminal L-methionyl-[tubulin] = CoA + H+ + N-terminal N(alpha)-acetyl-L-methionyl-[tubulin]. The N-terminus of both alpha- and beta-tubulin are acetylated." [EC:2.3.1.308, RHEA:69607]

GO:0120520.name: free fatty acid 2-hydroxylase activity
GO:0120520.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-saturated fatty acid + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H+ + O2 = a (R)-2-hydroxy fatty acid + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + H2O. Note that the substrate is a free fatty acid, not a fatty acyl chain within a sphingolipid." [GOC:sjm, RHEA:38855]

GO:0120521.name: 4-hydroxysphinganine ceramide fatty acyl 2-hydroxylase activity
GO:0120521.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: an N-(1,2 saturated acyl)-(4R)-hydroxysphinganine + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H+ + O2 = an N-(2R-hydroxyacyl)-4R-hydroxysphinganine + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + H2O." [RHEA:46520]

GO:0120522.name: short-chain fatty acyl-CoA oxidase activity
GO:0120522.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a short-chain 2,3-saturated fatty acyl-CoA + O2 = a short-chain (2E)-enoyl-CoA + H2O2." [RHEA:78859]

GO:0120523.name: medium-chain fatty acyl-CoA oxidase activity
GO:0120523.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a medium-chain 2,3-saturated fatty acyl-CoA + O2 = a medium-chain (2E)-enoyl-CoA + H2O2." [RHEA:78855]

GO:0120524.name: long-chain fatty acyl-CoA oxidase activity
GO:0120524.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a long-chain 2,3-saturated fatty acyl-CoA + O2 = a long-chain (2E)-enoyl-CoA + H2O2." [RHEA:78851]

GO:0120525.name: choline trimethylamine lyase activity
GO:0120525.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: choline = acetaldehyde + trimethylamine." [RHEA:35095]

GO:0120526.name: homomethionine N-monooxygenase activity
GO:0120526.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: an L-polyhomomethionine + 2 O2 + 2 reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = an (E)-omega-(methylsulfanyl)-alkanal oxime + CO2 + 2 H(+) + 3 H2O + 2 oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase]." [RHEA:51972]

GO:0120527.name: aliphatic desulfoglucosinolate sulfotransferase activity
GO:0120527.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenylyl sulfate + an aliphatic (Z)-desulfo-glucosinolate = a (Z)-omega-(methylsulfanyl)-N-sulfo-alkylhydroximate S-glucoside + adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + H+." [RHEA:52724]

GO:0120528.name: 2-(omega-methylthio)alkylmalate dehydratase activity
GO:0120528.def: "Catalysis of the reactions: a 2-(omega-methylsulfanyl)alkylmalate = a 2-(omega-methylsulfanyl)alkylmaleate + H2O and a 3-(omega-methylsulfanyl)alkylmalate = a 2-(omega-methylsulfanyl)alkylmaleate + H2O." [EC:4.2.1.170]

GO:0120529.name: secoisolariciresinol dehydrogenase activity
GO:0120529.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (-)-secoisolariciresinol + 2 NAD+ = (-)-matairesinol + 2 H(+) + 2 NADH." [RHEA:33887]

GO:0120530.name: UDP-alpha-D-glucose biosynthetic process
GO:0120530.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of UDP-alpha-D-glucose, a substance composed of alpha-D-glucose in glycosidic linkage with uridine diphosphate." [MetaCyc:PWY-7343]

GO:0120531.name: prenyl diphosphate synthase activity
GO:0120531.def: "Catalysis of chain elongation of prenyl diphosphate substrates via one or more condensation reactions with isopentenyl diphosphate to generate linear polymers with defined chain lengths." [PMID:12135472, PMID:26216239]

GO:0120532.name: glycosaminoglycan-protein linkage region biosynthetic process
GO:0120532.def: "The formation of a tetrasaccharide linker sequence (xylose-galactose-galactose-glucuronate) on specific serine residues of a core protein, on to which dermatan sulfate, chondroitin sulfate, heparan sulfate or heparin glycosaminoglycans may be assembled to synthesise the corresponding proteoglycan." [MetaCyc:PWY-6557]

GO:0120533.name: glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] (non-phosphorylating) activity
GO:0120533.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + NAD(P)+ + H2O = (2R)-3-phosphoglycerate + NAD(P)H + 2 H+." [EC:1.2.1.90]

GO:0120534.name: dermatan sulfotransferase activity
GO:0120534.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenylyl sulfate + dermatan = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + dermatan sulfate." [GOC:curators]

GO:0120536.name: heptaprenylglyceryl phosphate synthase activity
GO:0120536.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: sn-glycerol 1-phosphate + all-trans-heptaprenyl diphosphate = 3-heptaprenyl-sn-glycero-1-phosphate + diphosphate." [PMID:21761520, RHEA:33495]

GO:0120537.name: 3-demethylubiquinone 3-O-methyltransferase activity
GO:0120537.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 3-demethylubiquinone + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a ubiquinone + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine." [PMID:38425362, RHEA:81215]

GO:0120538.name: 2-methoxy-6-polyprenolphenol 4-hydroxylase activity
GO:0120538.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 2-methoxy-6-(all-trans-polyprenyl)phenol + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + O2 + 2 H+ = 2-methoxy-6-(all-trans-polyprenyl)benzene-1,4-diol + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + H2O." [PMID:38425362, RHEA:81183]

GO:0120539.name: 4-hydroxy-3-methoxy-5-polyprenylbenzoate decarboxylase activity
GO:0120539.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 4-hydroxy-3-methoxy-5-(all-trans-polyprenyl)benzoate + H+ = a 2-methoxy-6-(all-trans-polyprenyl)phenol + CO2." [PMID:38295803, PMID:38425362, RHEA:81179]

GO:0120542.name: ethanol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
GO:0120542.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ethanol + NAD+ = acetaldehyde + NADH + H+." [RHEA:25290]

GO:0120543.name: macromolecular conformation isomerase activity
GO:0120543.def: "Catalysis of a reaction that alters the macromolecular conformation of a molecule." [EC:5.6.-.-]

GO:0120544.name: polypeptide conformation or assembly isomerase activity
GO:0120544.def: "Catalysis of a reaction that alters the conformation or assembly of a polypeptide." [EC:5.6.1.-]

GO:0120545.name: nucleic acid conformation isomerase activity
GO:0120545.def: "Catalysis of a reaction that alters the conformation of a nucleic acid." [EC:5.6.2.-]

GO:0120546.name: oxidoreductase activity, reducing C-O-C group as acceptor
GO:0120546.def: "Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which a reducing C-O-C group acts as acceptor." [EC:1.23.-.-]

GO:0120547.name: heme A synthase activity
GO:0120547.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: Fe(II)-heme o + 2 acceptor + H2O = Fe(II)-heme a + 2 acceptor-H2. The conversion of heme o to heme a occcurs by two successive hydroxylations of the methyl group at C8 using water as the oxygen source. The first hydroxylation forms heme i, the second hydroxylation results in an unstable dihydroxymethyl group, which spontaneously dehydrates, resulting in the formyl group of heme A." [PMID:30397130, RHEA:63388]

GO:0120548.name: phosphatidylinositol phospholipase C activity
GO:0120548.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol) + H2O = 1D-myo-inositol 1-phosphate + a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol + H+." [RHEA:43484]

GO:0120549.name: limit dextrin alpha-1,6-maltotetraose-hydrolase activity
GO:0120549.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of (1->6)-alpha-D-glucosidic linkages to branches with degrees of polymerization of three or four glucose residues in limit dextrin." [EC:3.2.1.196]

GO:0120550.name: methyltransferase cap2 activity
GO:0120550.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 5'-end (N(7)-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-(2'-O-methyl-ribonucleoside)-(ribonucleotide) in mRNA or snRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a 5'-end (N(7)-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-(2'-O-methyl-ribonucleoside)-(2'-O-methyl-ribonucleotide) in mRNA or snRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+. This activity catalyzes the methylation of the ribose on the second transcribed nucleotide of mRNAs and snRNAs." [EC:2.1.1.296]

GO:0120551.name: 2-oxoglutarate decarboxylation to succinyl-CoA
GO:0120551.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of succinyl-CoA from 2-oxoglutarate.  In most organisms, this pathway is part of the TCA cycle and comprises a series of three reactions carried out by a multisubunit complex called the '2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenase complex', even though 2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenase activity describes only one of those reactions. The combination of the three reactions can be summarized as: 2-oxoglutarate + coenzyme A + NAD+ -> succinyl-CoA + CO2 + NADH." [MetaCyc:PWY-5084]

GO:0120552.name: branched-chain alpha-keto acid decarboxylation to branched-chain acyl-CoA
GO:0120552.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of a branched-chain acyl-CoA by the oxidative decarboxylation of a branched-chain alpha-keto acid derived from L-leucine, L-isoleucine or L-valine. This pathway comprises a series of three reactions carried out by a multisubunit complex called the 'branched-chain alpha-keto acid dehydrogenase complex', even though branched-chain alpha-keto acid dehydrogenase activity describes only one of those reactions. The combination of the three reactions can be summarized as: 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate + coenzyme A + NAD+ -> branched-chain acyl-CoA + CO2 + NADH. Specific substrates include 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate (a transamination product of L-valine), (S)-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoate (a transamination product of L-isoleucine) and 4-methyl-2-oxopentanoate (a transamination product of L-leucine), which generate the products 2-methylpropanoyl-CoA, 2-methylbutanoyl-CoA and 3-methylbutanoyl-CoA, respectively." [MetaCyc:PWY-5046]

GO:0120553.name: farnesal dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
GO:0120553.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (2E,6E)-farnesal + NAD+ + H2O = (2E,6E)-farnesoate + NADH + 2 H+." [PMID:23639754, RHEA:24216]

GO:0120555.name: NADH dehydrogenase (ubiquinone) (non-electrogenic) activity
GO:0120555.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a ubiquinone + NADH + H+ = a ubiquinol + NAD+." [RHEA:23152]

GO:0120556.name: polyprenyl diphosphate phosphatase activity
GO:0120556.def: "Catalysis of the dephosphorylation of polyprenyl diphosphates." [GOC:curators]

GO:0120557.name: farnesyl diphosphatase activity
GO:0120557.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate + H2O = (2E,6E)-farnesyl phosphate + phosphate + H+." [PMID:19168029, RHEA:48128]

GO:0120558.name: lysophospholipase activity
GO:0120558.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a lysophospholipid (a phospholipid missing one fatty acid), removing the remaining acyl chain to yield a glycerophospho-compound and a free fatty acid." [GOC:curators]

GO:0120559.name: phosphatidylethanolamine lysophospholipase activity
GO:0120559.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine + H2O = sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine + a fatty acid + H+." [RHEA:32967]

GO:0120560.name: phosphatidylserine lysophospholipase activity
GO:0120560.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine + H2O = sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine + a fatty acid + H+." [RHEA:32979]

GO:0120561.name: phosphatidylinositol lysophospholipase activity
GO:0120561.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol) + H2O = sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol + a fatty acid + H+." [RHEA:32987]

GO:0120562.name: GlcNAc(2)-PP-Dol mannosyltransferase activity
GO:0120562.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of a mannosyl residue to GlcNAc(2)-PP-Dol bearing 0-8 mannoses during synthesis of the N-glycan precursor." [GOC:curators]

GO:0120563.name: dol-P-Man:Man(1)GlcN-acyl-PI alpha-1,6-mannosyltransferase activity
GO:0120563.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of an alpha-D-mannosyl residue from dolichol-P-mannose to Man(1)-GlcN-acyl-PI, forming an alpha-(1->6)-D-mannosyl-D-mannose linkage. This transfers the second mannose to the GPI precursor." [PMID:15623507]

GO:0120564.name: dol-P-Man:Man(2)GlcN-acyl-PI alpha-1,2-mannosyltransferase activity
GO:0120564.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of an alpha-D-mannosyl residue from dolichol-P-mannose to Man(2)-GlcN-acyl-PI, forming an alpha-(1->2)-D-mannosyl-D-mannose linkage. This transfers the third mannose to the GPI precursor." [PMID:8861954]

GO:0120565.name: dol-P-Man:Man(3)GlcN-acyl-PI alpha-1,2-mannosyltransferase activity
GO:0120565.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of an alpha-D-mannosyl residue from dolichol-P-mannose to Man(3)-GlcN-acyl-PI, forming an alpha-(1->2)-D-mannosyl-D-mannose linkage. This transfers a fourth mannose to the GPI precursor, which is only present in some organisms/cell types." [PMID:15208306]

GO:0120566.name: menadiol geranylgeranyltransferase activity
GO:0120566.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: menadiol + (2E,6E,10E)-geranylgeranyl diphosphate = menaquinol-4 + diphosphate." [PMID:20953171, RHEA:74083]

GO:0140001.name: morula formation
GO:0140001.def: "The initial formation of a spherical embryonic mass of blastomeres formed before the blastula and resulting from cleavage of the fertilized ovum." [PMID:37935903, PMID:38386558, PMID:39361745]

GO:0140002.name: histone H3K4me3 reader activity
GO:0140002.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H3 trimethylated at lysine 4." [PMID:15647753, PMID:23318260]

GO:0140003.name: histone H3K36me3 reader activity
GO:0140003.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H3 trimethylated at lysine 36." [PMID:15489290, PMID:16364921]

GO:0140004.name: histone H3Q5ser reader activity
GO:0140004.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H3 serotonylated at glutamine 5." [PMID:34144982]

GO:0140005.name: histone H4K20me2 reader activity
GO:0140005.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H4 dimethylated at lysine 20." [PMID:22150589]

GO:0140006.name: histone H3 reader activity
GO:0140006.def: "A histone reader that specifically binds either to an unmodified histone H3 or a form modified by a post-translational modification on a specific residue. The most common PTMs on histones are methylation, acetylation and phosphorylation." [PMID:11498575, PMID:25688442, PMID:31082667, PMID:34726351]

GO:0140007.name: KICSTOR complex
GO:0140007.def: "A protein complex that regulates the TORC1 signaling pathway in response to nutrients. The KICSTOR complex is composed of KPTN, ITFG2, C12orf66 and SZT2." [PMID:28199306]

GO:0140008.name: histone H4 reader activity
GO:0140008.def: "A histone reader that specifically binds either to an unmodified histone H4 or a form modified by a post-translational modification on a specific residue. The most common PTMs on histones are methylation, acetylation and phosphorylation." [PMID:11498575, PMID:25688442, PMID:31082667, PMID:34726351]

GO:0140009.name: L-aspartate import across plasma membrane
GO:0140009.def: "The directed movement of L-aspartate from outside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the cytosol." [GO_REF:0000069, PMID:7914198]

GO:0140010.name: D-aspartate transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0140010.def: "Enables the transfer of D-aspartate from one side of a membrane to the other." [GO_REF:0000070, PMID:7914198]

GO:0140011.name: histone H4K12ac reader activity
GO:0140011.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H4 acetylated at lysine 12." [PMID:14731392]

GO:0140012.name: histone H4K5ac reader activity
GO:0140012.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H4 acetylated at lysine 5." [PMID:18406326, PMID:20709061]

GO:0140013.name: meiotic nuclear division
GO:0140013.def: "One of the two nuclear divisions that occur as part of the meiotic cell cycle." [PMID:9334324]

GO:0140014.name: mitotic nuclear division
GO:0140014.def: "A mitotic cell cycle process comprising the steps by which the nucleus of a eukaryotic cell divides; the process involves condensation of chromosomal DNA into a highly compacted form. Canonically, mitosis produces two daughter nuclei whose chromosome complement is identical to that of the mother cell." [ISBN:0198547684]

GO:0140015.name: histone H3K14ac reader activity
GO:0140015.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H3 acetylated at lysine 14." [PMID:30110338]

GO:0140017.name: histone H3K18cr reader activity
GO:0140017.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H3 crotonylated at lysine 18." [PMID:27105114]

GO:0140018.name: regulation of cytoplasmic translational fidelity
GO:0140018.def: "Any process that modulates the ability of the cytoplasmic translational apparatus to interpret the genetic code." [PMID:22768388]

GO:0140019.name: histone H3K9cr reader activity
GO:0140019.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H3 crotonylated at lysine 9." [PMID:27105114]

GO:0140020.name: DNA methyltransferase complex
GO:0140020.def: "A protein complex that possesses DNA methyltransferase activity." [PMID:20939822, PMID:24947342]

GO:0140021.name: mitochondrial ADP transmembrane transport
GO:0140021.def: "The process in which ADP is transported across a mitochondrial membrane, into or out of the mitochondrion." [PMID:2541251]

GO:0140022.name: cnida
GO:0140022.def: "A giant secretory organelle that comprises a bulb-shape capsule containing a coiled hollow tubule structure attached to it. A cnida defines the phylum Cnidaria." [Wikipedia:Cnida#Structure_and_function]

GO:0140023.name: tRNA adenosine deamination to inosine
GO:0140023.def: "The removal of an amine group from an adenosine to produce inosine within a tRNA molecule." [PMID:27974624]

GO:0140024.name: plus-end-directed endosome transport along mitotic spindle midzone microtubule
GO:0140024.def: "The directed movement of an endosome towards the plus end of a microtubule, mediated by motor proteins. This process begins with the attachment of an endosome to a microtubule, and ends when the endosome reaches its final destination." [PMID:24803650, PMID:25706234]

GO:0140025.name: contractile vacuole tethering involved in discharge
GO:0140025.def: "The initial, indirect interaction between a contractile vacuole membrane and a site of discharge in the plasma membrane. This interaction is mediated by tethering factors (or complexes), which interact with both membranes. Interaction can occur via direct binding to membrane phospholipids or membrane proteins, or via binding to vesicle coat proteins. This process is distinct from and prior to docking and fusion." [PMID:22323285]

GO:0140026.name: contractile vacuole dissociation from plasma membrane
GO:0140026.def: "The dissociation of the contractile vacuole after discharge, from the plasma membrane. This interaction is mediated by detethering factors that initiate the process of tubulation and fragmentation of the empty contractile vacuole bladder, which is then reincorporated into the CV network." [PMID:22323285]

GO:0140027.name: contractile vacuole localization
GO:0140027.def: "The directed movement of the contractile vacuole to a specific location." [PMID:19687255]

GO:0140028.name: pore formation during contractile vacuole discharge
GO:0140028.def: "The formation of a transient pore in the plasma membrane and the attached contractile vacuolar membrane, to release water from the cell. This process does not involve fusion of the two membranes." [PMID:22323285, Wikipedia:Exocytosis]

GO:0140029.name: exocytic process
GO:0140029.def: "The cellular processes that contribute to exocytosis." [Wikipedia:Exocytosis]

GO:0140030.name: modification-dependent protein binding
GO:0140030.def: "Binding to a protein upon post-translation modification of the target protein." [PMID:26060076]

GO:0140031.name: phosphorylation-dependent protein binding
GO:0140031.def: "Binding to a protein upon phosphorylation of the target protein." [PMID:26060076]

GO:0140032.name: glycosylation-dependent protein binding
GO:0140032.def: "Binding to a protein upon glycosylation of the target protein." [PMID:26060076]

GO:0140033.name: acetylation-dependent protein binding
GO:0140033.def: "Binding to a protein upon acetylation of the target protein." [PMID:26060076]

GO:0140034.name: methylation-dependent protein binding
GO:0140034.def: "Binding to a protein upon methylation of the target protein." [PMID:26060076]

GO:0140035.name: ubiquitin-like protein reader activity
GO:0140035.def: "A molecular adaptor that recognizes and binds a target protein containing a ubiquitin-like modification and that brings the target protein into contact with another protein to allow those proteins to function in a coordinated way." [PMID:26060076]

GO:0140036.name: ubiquitin-modified protein reader activity
GO:0140036.def: "A molecular adaptor recognizes and binds a target protein containing a ubiquitination modification and brings the target protein into contact with another protein to allow those proteins to function in a coordinated way." [PMID:26060076]

GO:0140037.name: SUMO-modified protein reader activity
GO:0140037.def: "A molecular adaptor that recognizes and binds a target protein containing a SUMO modification and that brings the target protein into contact with another protein to allow those proteins to function in a coordinated way." [PMID:26060076]

GO:0140038.name: histone H3K27cr reader activity
GO:0140038.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H3 crotonylated at lysine 27." [PMID:27105114]

GO:0140039.name: cell-cell adhesion in response to extracellular stimulus
GO:0140039.def: "The attachment of one cell to another cell via adhesion molecules as a result of an extracellular stimulus." [PMID:14996911]

GO:0140040.name: mitochondrial polycistronic RNA processing
GO:0140040.def: "The conversion of polycistronic RNA transcribed from a mitochondrial genome into mono- or bi-cistronic RNAs." [PMID:20211597]

GO:0140041.name: cellular detoxification of methylglyoxal
GO:0140041.def: "Any process carried out at the cellular level that reduces or removes the toxicity of methylglyoxal. These may include chemical modification or transport of methylglyoxal away from sensitive areas and to compartments or complexes whose purpose is sequestration of the toxic substance." [PMID:15042280]

GO:0140042.name: lipid droplet formation
GO:0140042.def: "A process that results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts of a lipid droplet." [PMID:28011631]

GO:0140043.name: lipid droplet localization to prospore membrane leading edge
GO:0140043.def: "Any process in which a lipid droplet is transported to, or maintained to the prospore membrane leading edge." [PMID:28011631]

GO:0140044.name: histone H3K18ac reader activity
GO:0140044.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H3 acetylated at lysine 18." [PMID:30110338]

GO:0140046.name: histone H4K16ac reader activity
GO:0140046.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H4 acetylated at lysine 16." [PMID:16085498]

GO:0140047.name: specialized extracellular matrix
GO:0140047.def: "Species or cell-type specific extracellular matrices that are different from the two main types of extracellular matrices: the interstitial ECM and the basement membrane ECM in metazoa." [PMID:28955324, PMID:33605520]

GO:0140048.name: manganese ion export across plasma membrane
GO:0140048.def: "The directed movement of manganese ions from inside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the extracellular region." [PMID:25319704]

GO:0140049.name: regulation of endocardial cushion to mesenchymal transition
GO:0140049.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of endocardial cushion to mesenchymal transition." [GOC:BHF, GOC:BHF_miRNA, GOC:rph, PMID:21778427]

GO:0140050.name: negative regulation of endocardial cushion to mesenchymal transition
GO:0140050.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of endocardial cushion to mesenchymal transition." [GOC:BHF, GOC:BHF_miRNA, GOC:rph, PMID:21778427]

GO:0140051.name: positive regulation of endocardial cushion to mesenchymal transition
GO:0140051.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of endocardial cushion to mesenchymal transition." [GOC:BHF, GOC:BHF_miRNA, GOC:rph, PMID:21778427]

GO:0140052.name: cellular response to oxidised low-density lipoprotein particle stimulus
GO:0140052.def: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of an oxidized lipoprotein particle stimulus." [GOC:aruk, GOC:BHF, PMID:20037584, PMID:27607416]

GO:0140053.name: mitochondrial gene expression
GO:0140053.def: "The process in which a mitochondrial gene's sequence is converted into a mature gene product or products (proteins or RNA). This includes the production of an RNA transcript as well as any processing to produce a mature RNA product or an mRNA or circRNA (for protein-coding genes) and the translation of that mRNA or circRNA into protein. Protein maturation is included when required to form an active form of a product from an inactive precursor form." [PMID:27058308]

GO:0140054.name: histone H2A reader activity
GO:0140054.def: "A histone reader that specifically binds either to an unmodified histone H2A or a form modified by a post-translational modification on a specific residue. The most common PTMs on histones are methylation, acetylation and phosphorylation." [PMID:11498575, PMID:25688442, PMID:31082667, PMID:34726351]

GO:0140055.name: histone H4K8ac reader activity
GO:0140055.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H4 acetylated at lysine 8." [PMID:17996705]

GO:0140056.name: organelle localization by membrane tethering
GO:0140056.def: "The process by which an organelle membrane interacts with another membrane via molecular tethers that physically bridge the two membranes and attach them to each other." [PMID:27875684]

GO:0140057.name: vacuole-mitochondria membrane tethering
GO:0140057.def: "The attachment of a mitochondrial membrane to a vacuolar membrane via molecular tethers that physically bridge their respective membranes and attach them to each other. The tethering may facilitate exchange of metabolites between the organelles." [PMID:27875684]

GO:0140058.name: neuron projection arborization
GO:0140058.def: "The process in which the anatomical structures of a neuron projection are generated and organized into branches. A neuron projection is any process extending from a neural cell, such as axons or dendrites." [GOC:aruk, GOC:bc, PMID:17114044, PMID:23270857, PMID:23764288]

GO:0140059.name: dendrite arborization
GO:0140059.def: "The process in which the anatomical structures of a dendritic tree are generated and organized into dendritic branches." [GOC:aruk, GOC:bc, PMID:23270857]

GO:0140060.name: axon arborization
GO:0140060.def: "The process in which the terminal anatomical structures of an axon are generated and organized into branches of specialised projections, or boutons. An axon is the long process of a neuron that conducts nerve impulses, usually away from the cell body to the terminal branches." [GOC:aruk, GOC:bc, PMID:23764288]

GO:0140063.name: unmodified histone reader activity
GO:0140063.def: "A histone reader that specifically binds either to an unmodified histone." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140064.name: peptide crotonyltransferase activity
GO:0140064.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: crotonyl-CoA + lysine in peptide = CoA + N-crotonyl-lysine-peptide." [PMID:25818647]

GO:0140065.name: peptide butyryltransferase activity
GO:0140065.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: butyryl-CoA + lysine in peptide = CoA + N-butyryl-lysine-peptide." [PMID:27105113]

GO:0140066.name: peptidyl-lysine crotonylation
GO:0140066.def: "The crotonylation of a lysine residue in a protein. Crotonyl is the univalent radical CH3-CH=CH-CO- derived from crotonic acid." [PMID:25818647, Wikipedia:crotonyl]

GO:0140067.name: peptidyl-lysine butyrylation
GO:0140067.def: "The butyrylation of a lysine residue in a protein. Butyryl is the univalent radical C3H7COO- derived from butyric acid." [PMID:27105113, Wikipedia:butyryl]

GO:0140068.name: histone crotonyltransferase activity
GO:0140068.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: crotonyl-CoA + histone = CoA + crotonyl-histone." [PMID:25818647]

GO:0140069.name: histone butyryltransferase activity
GO:0140069.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: butyryl-CoA + histone = CoA + butyryl-histone." [PMID:27105113]

GO:0140070.name: hydrogen peroxide channel activity
GO:0140070.def: "Enables the energy-independent facilitated diffusion of hydrogen peroxide through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel." [PMID:23541115, PMID:27256569]

GO:0140071.name: histone H2B reader activity
GO:0140071.def: "A histone reader that specifically binds either to an unmodified histone H2B or a form modified by a post-translational modification on a specific residue. The most common PTMs on histones are methylation, acetylation and phosphorylation." [PMID:11498575, PMID:25688442, PMID:31082667, PMID:34726351]

GO:0140072.name: histone H3K9ac reader activity
GO:0140072.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H3 acetylated at lysine 9." [PMID:26067602]

GO:0140073.name: bioadhesive activity
GO:0140073.def: "A structural molecule ativity that mediates an organism's attachment to an environmental substrate via stable, non-selective binding by a protein to an external surface. Examples includes proteins used by insects to anchor pupae to surfaces." [PMID:39370426]

GO:0140074.name: cardiac endothelial to mesenchymal transition
GO:0140074.def: "A transition where a cardiac endothelial cell loses apical/basolateral polarity, severs intercellular adhesive junctions, degrades basement membrane components and becomes a migratory mesenchymal cell. Endocardial cells (specialized endothelial cells that line the heart) undergo EndMT, and give rise to mesenchymal cells necessary for proper heart development. EndMT, specifically generates valve progenitor cells that give rise to the mitral and tricuspid valves. EndMT also contributes to endocardial cushion formation, as well as to generation of cardiac fibroblasts and smooth muscle cells, but not cardiac myocytes." [GOC:BHF, GOC:nc, PMID:16162442, PMID:26053665]

GO:0140075.name: regulation of lipoprotein transport
GO:0140075.def: "Any process that controls lipoprotein transport." [GOC:BHF, GOC:BHF_miRNA, GOC:RPH, PMID:26501192]

GO:0140076.name: negative regulation of lipoprotein transport
GO:0140076.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of lipoprotein transport." [GOC:BHF, GOC:BHF_miRNA, GOC:RPH, PMID:26501192]

GO:0140077.name: positive regulation of lipoprotein transport
GO:0140077.def: "Any process that activates or increases the rate or extent of lipoprotein transport." [GOC:BHF, GOC:BHF_miRNA, GOC:RPH, PMID:26501192]

GO:0140078.name: class I DNA-(apurinic or apyrimidinic site) endonuclease activity
GO:0140078.def: "Catalysis of the cleavage of an AP site 3' of the baseless site by a beta-lyase mechanism, leaving an unsaturated aldehyde, termed a 3'-(4-hydroxy-5-phospho-2-pentenal) residue, and a 5'-phosphate." [PMID:1698278, RHEA:66592]

GO:0140081.name: glycosylated region protein binding
GO:0140081.def: "Binding to a glycosylated region of a protein." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140082.name: SUMO-ubiquitin ligase activity
GO:0140082.def: "Isoenergetic transfer of SUMO from one protein to an existing ubiquitin chain via the reaction X-ubiquitin + Y-ubiquitin = Y-ubiquitin-ubiquitin + X, where both the X-ubiquitin and Y-ubiquitin-ubiquitin linkages are thioester bonds between the C-terminal glycine of ubiquitin and a sulfhydryl side group of a cysteine residue." [PMID:28552615]

GO:0140083.name: ATP-dependent protein-DNA unloader activity
GO:0140083.def: "Facilitating the removal of a protein or protein complex from a DNA molecule driven by ATP hydrolysis. This can be achieved for example by introducing non-canonical DNA structures or generating torque to directly inhibit a protein-DNA binding interaction." [PMID:28552615]

GO:0140084.name: sexual macrocyst formation
GO:0140084.def: "The fusion of haploid amoebae cells with matching mating types to form a larger cell, which ingests additional amoebae and forms a cellulose wall. The resulting macrocyst undergoes recombination and meiosis followed by release of haploid amoebae. An example of this process can be found in Dictyostelium discoideum." [PMID:16592095, PMID:20089169]

GO:0140085.name: L-amino-acid N-acetyltransferase activity
GO:0140085.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + a L-amino acid = CoA + an N-acetyl-L-amino-acid. In some cases acetyl phosphate can be used as a donor." [GOC:pg, RHEA:83863]

GO:0140086.name: basement membrane/interstitial matrix interface
GO:0140086.def: "The structure located at the interface of the basement membrane and interstitial extracellular matrix and anchoring the two types of ECM to one another." [PMID:19945621, PMID:26377767, PMID:7767545, PMID:9334230]

GO:0140087.name: acetaldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
GO:0140087.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: acetaldehyde + NAD+ + H2O = acetate + NADH + 2 H+." [PMID:9473035, RHEA:25294]

GO:0140088.name: acetaldehyde dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
GO:0140088.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: acetaldehyde + NADP+ + H2O = acetate + NADPH + 2 H+." [PMID:15659684, PMID:9473035, RHEA:25298]

GO:0140089.name: protein storage
GO:0140089.def: "The accumulation and maintenance in cells of proteins. Protein reserves can be accumulated during early developmental stages for mobilization and utilization at later stages of development." [PMID:37922900]

GO:0140090.name: membrane curvature sensor activity
GO:0140090.def: "Preferential binding of proteins on curved membranes. The binding to curved membranes by insertion (aka wedging) to curved membranes is mediated by both the hydrophobic and hydrophilic faces of the helix of membrane curvature sensing (MCS) proteins." [PMID:25898166]

GO:0140091.name: mBAF complex
GO:0140091.def: "A muscle cell-specific SWI/SNF-type complex that contains eight to fourteen proteins, including both conserved (core) and nonconserved components; contains the ATPase product of either the SMARCA4/BAF190A/BRG1 gene, the mammalian ortholog of the yeast SNF2 gene, or the SMARCA2/BAF190B/BRM gene, the mammalian ortholog of the Drosophila brm (brahma) gene, or an ortholog of either of these genes, and the muscle-specific product of the DPF3/BAF45C gene or an ortholog thereof." [GO:bhm, PMID:11175787, PMID:12620226, PMID:15525990, PMID:8804307, PMID:8895581]

GO:0140092.name: bBAF complex
GO:0140092.def: "A brain-specific SWI/SNF-type complex that contains eight or nine proteins, including both conserved (core) and nonconserved components; contains the ATPase product of either the SMARCA4/BAF190A/BRG1 gene, the mammalian ortholog of the yeast SNF2 gene, or the SMARCA2/BAF190B/BRM gene, the mammalian ortholog of the Drosophila brm (brahma) gene, or an ortholog of either of these genes. Compared to the neuron-specific nBAF complex (GO:0071565) it does not contain DPF1, DPF3 or SMARCC1 or their orthologs. May contain PB1/BAF180." [GOC:bhm, PMID:12368262, PMID:12620226, PMID:15525990, PMID:17640523, PMID:17920018, PMID:8804307, PMID:8895581]

GO:0140093.name: esBAF complex
GO:0140093.def: "An embryonic stem cell-specific SWI/SNF-type complex that contains eight or nine proteins, including both conserved (core) and nonconserved components; contains the ATPase product of either the SMARCA4/BAF190A/BRG1 gene, the mammalian ortholog of the yeast SNF2 gene, or an ortholog thereof. Compared to many other BAF complexes never contains ACTL6B/BAF53B, ARID1B/BAF250B, SMARCA2/BRM, SMARCC2/BAF170 or SMARCD3/BAF60C but contains PHF10/BAF45A, DPF2/BAF45D and possibly one of BCL7A/B/C." [GOC:bhm, PMID:19279218, PMID:19279220, PMID:2620226, PMID:8804307, PMID:8895581]

GO:0140094.name: structural constituent of cytoplasmic lattice
GO:0140094.def: "The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of cytoplasmic lattice of the the mammalian ooplasm." [PMID:37922900]

GO:0140095.name: cytoplasmic lattice
GO:0140095.def: "Fibrous structures of the mammalian ooplasm that store ribosomes and maternal proteins in insoluble form to prevent their degradation, activation and nuclear transfer." [PMID:37922900, PMID:38955588]

GO:0140096.name: catalytic activity, acting on a protein
GO:0140096.def: "Catalytic activity that acts to modify a protein." [GOC:molecular_function_refactoring, GOC:pdt]

GO:0140097.name: catalytic activity, acting on DNA
GO:0140097.def: "Catalytic activity that acts to modify DNA." [GOC:molecular_function_refactoring, GOC:pdt]

GO:0140098.name: catalytic activity, acting on RNA
GO:0140098.def: "Catalytic activity that acts to modify RNA." [GOC:molecular_function_refactoring, GOC:pdt]

GO:0140099.name: venom-mediated suppression of fibrinolysis
GO:0140099.def: "A process in which an organism inhibits or disrupts fibrinolysis in another organism via the action of a venom. Fibrinolysis is the solubilization of fibrin in the bloodstream. Anti-fibrinolytic proteins reduce bleeding at the bite or sting site of the prey." [PMID:19236611, PMID:22359676, PMID:27208884, PMID:35716829]

GO:0140100.name: lytic exotransglycosylase activity
GO:0140100.def: "Catalysis of the exolytic cleavage of the (1->4)-beta-glycosidic linkage between N-acetylmuramic acid (MurNAc) and N-acetylglucosamine (GlcNAc) residues in peptidoglycan, from either the reducing or the non-reducing ends of the peptidoglycan chains, with concomitant formation of a 1,6-anhydrobond in the MurNAc residue." [EC:4.2.2.n1]

GO:0140101.name: catalytic activity, acting on a tRNA
GO:0140101.def: "Catalytic activity that acts to modify a tRNA." [GOC:molecular_function_refactoring, GOC:pdt]

GO:0140102.name: catalytic activity, acting on a rRNA
GO:0140102.def: "Catalytic activity that acts to modify a ribosomal RNA." [GOC:molecular_function_refactoring, GOC:pdt]

GO:0140103.name: catalytic activity, acting on a glycoprotein
GO:0140103.def: "Catalysis of a biochemical reaction in which one of the substrates is a glycoprotein." [GOC:molecular_function_refactoring, GOC:pdt]

GO:0140104.name: molecular carrier activity
GO:0140104.def: "Directly binding to a specific ion or molecule and delivering it either to an acceptor molecule or to a specific location." [GOC:molecular_function_refactoring, GOC:pdt]

GO:0140105.name: interleukin-10-mediated signaling pathway
GO:0140105.def: "The series of molecular signals initiated by interleukin-10 binding to its receptor on the surface of a target cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription." [PMID:11244051]

GO:0140106.name: hematophagy
GO:0140106.def: "A feeding behavior that involves the ingestion of blood. Hematophagous animals have mouth parts and chemical agents for penetrating vascular structures in the skin of hosts. To overcome natural hemostasis, vasoconstriction, inflammation, and pain sensation in the host, hematophagous animals pre-inject chemical substances with anesthetic and/or anticoagulant properties." [Wikipedia:Hematophagy]

GO:0140107.name: high-affinity potassium ion transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0140107.def: "Enables the transfer of potassium ions from one side of a membrane to the other. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations." [PMID:10629185]

GO:0140108.name: high-affinity D-glucose transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0140108.def: "Enables the transfer of D-glucose from one side of a membrane to the other. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations." [PMID:25411338]

GO:0140109.name: histone H3K4me1 reader activity
GO:0140109.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H3 monomethylated at lysine 4." [PMID:18840606, PMID:29255264]

GO:0140110.name: transcription regulator activity
GO:0140110.def: "A molecular function that controls the rate, timing and/or magnitude of gene transcription. The function of transcriptional regulators is to modulate gene expression at the transcription step so that they are expressed in the right cell at the right time and in the right amount throughout the life of the cell and the organism. Genes are transcriptional units, and include bacterial operons." [GOC:pg, GOC:txnOH-2018, Wikipedia:Transcription_factor]

GO:0140111.name: [choline trimethylamine-lyase]-activating enzyme activity
GO:0140111.def: "Catalyzes the activation of choline trimethylamine-lyase by generation of an organic free radical on a glycine residue via a homolytic cleavage of S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAM)." [PMID:24854437]

GO:0140112.name: extracellular vesicle biogenesis
GO:0140112.def: "The assembly and secretion a set of components to form an extracellular vesicule, a membrane-bounded vesicle that is released into the extracellular region. Extracellular vesicles include exosomes, microvesicles and apoptotic bodies, based on the mechanism by which they are released from cells and differentiated based on their size and content." [PMID:28736435]

GO:0140113.name: extracellular microvesicle biogenesis
GO:0140113.def: "The assembly and secretion of a set of components to form an extracellular microvesicule, a membrane-bounded vesicle that ranges in size 100 nm to 1 micron in size) and exits the cell by budding." [PMID:28736435]

GO:0140114.name: cellular detoxification of fluoride
GO:0140114.def: "Any process carried out at the cellular level that reduces or removes the toxicity of a fluoride. These may include chemical modification or transport of fluoride away from sensitive areas and to compartments or complexes whose purpose is sequestration of the toxic substance." [GOC:vw]

GO:0140115.name: export across plasma membrane
GO:0140115.def: "The directed movement of some substance from inside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the extracellular region." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140116.name: fluoride export across plasma membrane
GO:0140116.def: "The directed movement of fluoride ions from inside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the extracellular region." [GOC:vw, PMID:27327046]

GO:0140117.name: histone H4K20me1 reader activity
GO:0140117.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H4 monomethylated at lysine 20." [PMID:19494831]

GO:0140118.name: histone H3K23ac reader activity
GO:0140118.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H3 acetylated at lysine 23." [PMID:21164480]

GO:0140119.name: histone H3K27ac reader activity
GO:0140119.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H3 acetylated at lysine 27." [PMID:25417107]

GO:0140120.name: histone H2AK15ub reader activity
GO:0140120.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H2A ubiquitinated at lysine 15." [PMID:23760478]

GO:0140121.name: Lewy body formation
GO:0140121.def: "The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a Lewy body." [PMID:15158159]

GO:0140122.name: regulation of Lewy body formation
GO:0140122.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of Lewy body formation." [GOC:sl]

GO:0140123.name: negative regulation of Lewy body formation
GO:0140123.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of Lewy body formation." [GOC:sl]

GO:0140124.name: positive regulation of Lewy body formation
GO:0140124.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of Lewy body formation." [GOC:sl]

GO:0140125.name: thiamine import across plasma membrane
GO:0140125.def: "The directed movement of thiamine from outside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the cytosol." [GOC:vw]

GO:0140126.name: histone H2AK15ac reader activity
GO:0140126.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H2A acetylated at lysine 15." [PMID:27153538]

GO:0140127.name: histone H3R8me2 reader activity
GO:0140127.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H3 dimethylate at arginine 8. The methylation can be symmetrical or asymmetrical." [PMID:24589551]

GO:0140128.name: histone H1 reader activity
GO:0140128.def: "A histone reader that specifically binds either to an unmodified histone H1 or a form modified by a post-translational modification on a specific residue. The most common PTMs on histones are methylation, acetylation and phosphorylation." [PMID:17540172]

GO:0140129.name: histone H3K56ac reader activity
GO:0140129.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H3 acetylated at lysine 56." [PMID:23798425]

GO:0140130.name: histone H2AK5ac reader activity
GO:0140130.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H2A acetylated at lysine 5." [PMID:18469222]

GO:0140131.name: positive regulation of lymphocyte chemotaxis
GO:0140131.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of lymphocyte chemotaxis." [PMID:19255442]

GO:0140132.name: iron-sulfur cluster chaperone activity
GO:0140132.def: "Binding to an iron-sulfur cluster and delivering it to an acceptor molecule." [PMID:22966982, PMID:29051382]

GO:0140134.name: venom-mediated perturbation of blood circulation
GO:0140134.def: "A process in which an organism alters or subverts the circulation of blood in another organism via the action of a venom." [PMID:31370142]

GO:0140135.name: mechanosensitive monoatomic cation channel activity
GO:0140135.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of a monoatomic cation by a channel that opens in response to a mechanical stress." [GOC:ha, PMID:22343900]

GO:0140136.name: venom-mediated perturbation of nervous system process
GO:0140136.def: "A process in which an organism alters or subverts a nervous system process in another organism via the action of a venom." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140137.name: venom-mediated perturbation of muscle system process
GO:0140137.def: "A process in which an organism alters or subverts a muscular process in another organism via the action of a venom." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140138.name: venom-mediated disruption of anatomical structure in another organism
GO:0140138.def: "A process by which an organism effects a change that impairs the structure or function of an anatomical structure in another organism via the action of a venom. Venoms are injected into the prey by a bite or a sting." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140139.name: solid phase of basement membrane
GO:0140139.def: "The solid compartment of the basement membrane ECM, including a specific subset of basement membrane collagens and basement membrane glycoproteins like laminins or nidogens." [PMID:33972551]

GO:0140140.name: mitochondrial guanine nucleotide transmembrane transport
GO:0140140.def: "The process in which a guanine nucleotide is transported across a mitochondrial membrane, into or out of the mitochondrion." [GOC:vw, PMID:14998997]

GO:0140141.name: mitochondrial potassium ion transmembrane transport
GO:0140141.def: "The process in which a potassium ion is transported across a mitochondrial membrane, into or out of the mitochondrion." [GOC:vw, PMID:20197279]

GO:0140142.name: nucleocytoplasmic carrier activity
GO:0140142.def: "Binding to and carrying a cargo between the nucleus and the cytoplasm by moving along with the cargo. The cargo can be either a RNA or a protein." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140143.name: collagenous component of basement membrane
GO:0140143.def: "Collagenous component of basement membrane ECMs, including collagen IV and other types of collagen specifically expressed in basement membrane." [PMID:21123617, PMID:21421915, PMID:28040522, PMID:28324731, PMID:31387942, PMID:39223427]

GO:0140144.name: non-collagenous component of basement membrane
GO:0140144.def: "The non-collagenous compartment of the solid phase in basement membrane ECM, including glycoproteins like laminins or nidogens." [PMID:21421915, PMID:28324731]

GO:0140145.name: copper ion export from vacuole
GO:0140145.def: "The directed movement of copper ions out of the vacuole across the vacuolar membrane." [GOC:vw, PMID:12244050]

GO:0140146.name: calcium ion import into vacuole
GO:0140146.def: "The directed movement of calcium cations into the vacuole across the vacuolar membrane." [GOC:vw, PMID:8628289]

GO:0140147.name: zinc ion export from vacuole
GO:0140147.def: "The directed movement of zinc ions from inside the vacuole across the vacuolar membrane and into the cytosol." [GOC:vw, PMC:PMC203372]

GO:0140148.name: gel phase of basement membrane
GO:0140148.def: "Gel formed of proteglycans filling the basement membrane ECM space." [PMID:21421915, PMID:28324731]

GO:0140149.name: non-collagenous component of interstitial matrix
GO:0140149.def: "The non-collagenous component of interstitial extracellular matrices, including glycoprotein like fibronectin and elastin." [PMID:21123617, PMID:25701227, PMID:33605520, PMID:39223427]

GO:0140150.name: gel phase of interstitial matrix
GO:0140150.def: "Hydrogel filling the interstitial extracellular matrix space. Composed of proteoglycans such as hyaluronan and lectin-binding proteoglycans, SPOCK proteoglycans and small leucin-rich proteoglycan (SLRP)." [PMID:21123617, PMID:25701227, PMID:33605520, PMID:39223427]

GO:0140151.name: solid phase of interstitial matrix
GO:0140151.def: "The solid compartment of the interstitial matrix, including interstitial collagens such as fibrillar and fibril-associated collagens and non-collagenous glycoproteins like fibronectin and elastin." [PMID:3284468, PMID:34807416]

GO:0140152.name: collagenous component of interstitial matrix
GO:0140152.def: "Main components of the interstitial matrix solid phase, including fibrillar and fibril-associated collagens." [PMID:12064927, PMID:17550969, PMID:21421911, PMID:28101870, PMID:39223427]

GO:0140153.name: FACIT collagen complex
GO:0140153.def: "A supramolecular complex formed by fibril-associated collagens with interrupted triple helices (FACIT) that associate with collagen fibrils and forms a link on large, banded fibrils." [PMID:1882421, PMID:21421911]

GO:0140154.name: chicken-wire-like collagen network
GO:0140154.def: "Network-forming collagens can either form a chicken-wire-like network or a hexagonal network. Collagen type IV forms a chicken-wire-like structure and is found in the basement membrane." [PMID:21421911, PMID:21421915, PMID:31387942]

GO:0140155.name: hexagonal collagen network of basement membrane
GO:0140155.def: "Supramolecular structure formed by trimers of collagen VIII and found in the basement membrane." [PMID:21421911, PMID:2376131, PMID:3047147, PMID:31387942]

GO:0140156.name: multiplexin collagen trimer
GO:0140156.def: "Collagen that contains multiple triple-helix domains with interruptions." [PMID:21421911, PMID:27746220, PMID:31479735, PMID:33543021]

GO:0140157.name: ammonium import across plasma membrane
GO:0140157.def: "The directed movement of an ammonium ion from outside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the cytosol." [GOC:vw, PMID:16999738]

GO:0140158.name: von-Willerbrand-factor-A-domain-rich collagen trimer
GO:0140158.def: "A family of collagens containing multiple von Willebrand factor A (vWA) domains." [PMID:21421911]

GO:0140159.name: borate export across plasma membrane
GO:0140159.def: "The directed movement of borate from inside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the extracellular region." [GOC:vw, PMID:17459946]

GO:0140161.name: monocarboxylate:sodium symporter activity
GO:0140161.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: monocarboxylate(out) + Na+(out) = monocarboxylate(in) + Na+(in)." [GOC:ln, PMID:15322102]

GO:0140162.name: venom-mediated vasodilation by activation of bradykinin receptor signaling pathway
GO:0140162.def: "A process in which an organism initiates, promotes, or enhances vasodilation via the action of a venom that activates bradykinin-dependent signaling, concomittantly reducing blood pressure in the bitten/stung organism. This can take place via several mechanisms that affect endogenous bradykinin: either increasing its release by kallikrein-like proteases, increasing bradykinin action by potentiation, or inhibiting bradykinin degradation." [PMID:31370142]

GO:0140163.name: venom-mediated suppression of bradykinin-dependent vasodilation
GO:0140163.def: "A process in which an organism inhibits or disrupts vasodilation via the action of a venom that suppresses bradykinin-dependent signaling." [PMID:21889567, PMID:31370142]

GO:0140164.name: Golgi transport complex binding
GO:0140164.def: "Binding to a Golgi transport complex, a multisubunit tethering complex of the CATCHR family." [GOC:ha, PMID:28100664]

GO:0140165.name: venom-mediated vasodilation by activation of nitric oxide-cGMP-mediated signaling
GO:0140165.def: "A process in which an organism initiates, promotes, or enhances vasodilation via the action of a venom that activates nitric oxide-cGMP-mediated signaling, concomittantly reducing blood pressure in the bitten/stung organism." [PMID:10512636]

GO:0140166.name: venom-mediated vasodilation via suppression of angiotensin maturation
GO:0140166.def: "A process in which an organism initiates, promotes, or enhances vasodilation via the action of a venom that prevents angiotensin maturation, concomittantly reducing blood pressure in the bitten/stung organism." [PMID:31370142]

GO:0140167.name: histone locus body assembly
GO:0140167.def: "The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a histone locus body." [PMID:21576393, PMID:32401666]

GO:0140168.name: nuclear ribonucleoprotein granule
GO:0140168.def: "A ribonucleoprotein granule located in the nucleus." [PMID:32475683, PMID:35355287, PMID:37890457]

GO:0140169.name: 3-alpha-hydroxysteroid 3-dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
GO:0140169.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 3alpha-hydroxysteroid + NAD(P)+ = a 3-oxosteroid + NAD(P)H + H+." [EC:1.1.1.357]

GO:0140170.name: D-lactate dehydrogenase (FAD) activity
GO:0140170.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-lactate + FAD + H+ = FADH2 + pyruvate." [RHEA:82479]

GO:0140171.name: L-lactate dehydrogenase activity
GO:0140171.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-lactate + A = AH(2) + pyruvate." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140172.name: histone H2AS121phos reader activity
GO:0140172.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H2A phosphorylated at serine 121." [PMID:20679485]

GO:0140173.name: histone H2AS128phos reader activity
GO:0140173.def: "A histone reader that recognizes a histone H2A phosphorylated at serine 128." [PMID:20679485]

GO:0140174.name: (2R)-2-hydroxycarboxylate dehydrogenase activity
GO:0140174.def: "Catalysis of the activity: a (2R)-2-hydroxycarboxylate + FAD + H+ = a 2-oxocarboxylate + FADH2." [PMID:37863926, RHEA:82511]

GO:0140175.name: (2R)-2-hydroxyacid dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
GO:0140175.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a (2R)-2-hydroxycarboxylate + NAD+ = a 2-oxocarboxylate + NADH + H+." [RHEA:35643]

GO:0140176.name: positive regulation of pyruvate decarboxylation to acetyl-CoA
GO:0140176.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of acetyl-CoA from pyruvate. In most organisms, this pathway links glycolysis to the TCA cycle, by a series of three reactions carried out by a multisubunit complex called the 'pyruvate dehydrogenase complex', even though pyruvate dehydrogenase activity describes only one of those reactions." [PMID:15855260]

GO:0140177.name: membrane-membrane adaptor activity
GO:0140177.def: "The binding activity of a molecule that brings together two membranes, either via membrane lipid binding or by interacting with a membrane protein, to establish or maintain the localization of the protein, protein complex or organelle." [GOC:curator]

GO:0140178.name: lumenal side of cis-Golgi network membrane
GO:0140178.def: "The membrane leaflet of the cis-Golgi network directly contacts the Golgi lumen and may be involved in glycosylation, cargo sorting, or interactions with resident Golgi proteins." [PMID:1747103, PMID:29802621, PMID:34080016]

GO:0140179.name: cytoplasmic side of cis-Golgi network membrane
GO:0140179.def: "The leaflet of the membrane bilayer of the cis-Golgi network faces the cytoplasm and is where interactions with cytosolic proteins occur, including those for vesicle tethering, fusion, and Golgi-associated trafficking activities." [PMID:1747103, PMID:23913272, PMID:34080016, PMID:34597626]

GO:0140315.name: iron ion sequestering activity
GO:0140315.def: "Binding to an iron ion to prevent it from interacting with other partners or to inhibit its localization to the area of the cell or complex where it is active." [PMID:27780864]

GO:0140317.name: export across cell outer membrane
GO:0140317.def: "The directed movement of a substance across the outer membrane in cells with two membranes." [PMID:15968039]

GO:0140318.name: protein transporter activity
GO:0140318.def: "Directly binding to a specific protein and delivering it to a specific cellular location." [PMID:18706423]

GO:0140319.name: receptor decoy activity
GO:0140319.def: "Binding and sequestering a specific receptor ligand to prevent it from binding to its regular receptor." [Wikipedia:Decoy_receptors]

GO:0140320.name: PAMP receptor decoy activity
GO:0140320.def: "Binding and sequestering PAMP ligands in order to prevent them from binding and activating to the host PAMP receptor. Usually this activity is encoded by a symbiont or a pathogen to prevent activation of the host innate immune response." [PMID:20724636]

GO:0140321.name: symbiont-mediated suppression of host autophagy
GO:0140321.def: "A process in which a symbiont inhibits or disrupts the normal execution of autophagy in the host cell. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140325.name: negative regulation of protein localization to medial cortex
GO:0140325.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of protein localization to the medial cortex." [PMID:30853434]

GO:0140326.name: ATPase-coupled intramembrane lipid transporter activity
GO:0140326.def: "Catalysis of the movement of lipids from one membrane leaflet to the other, driven by ATP hydrolysis. This includes flippases and floppases." [PMID:16828084]

GO:0140327.name: flippase activity
GO:0140327.def: "Catalysis of the movement of lipids from the exoplasmic to the cytosolic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP." [PMID:20043909, PMID:25284293, Wikipedia:Flippase]

GO:0140328.name: floppase activity
GO:0140328.def: "Catalysis of the movement of a lipid from the cytosolic to the exoplasmic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP." [PMID:20043909, PMID:25284293, Wikipedia:Flippase]

GO:0140329.name: lysophospholipid translocation
GO:0140329.def: "The movement of a lysophospholipid molecule from one leaflet of a membrane bilayer to the opposite leaflet." [PMID:15661733]

GO:0140330.name: xenobiotic detoxification by transmembrane export across the cell outer membrane
GO:0140330.def: "A process that reduces or removes the toxicity of a xenobiotic by exporting it outside the cell through the outer membrane." [PMID:11948170]

GO:0140331.name: aminophospholipid translocation
GO:0140331.def: "The movement of an aminophospholipid molecule from one leaflet of a membrane bilayer to the opposite leaflet." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140332.name: lipopolysaccharide transfer activity
GO:0140332.def: "Removes a lipopolysaccharide (LPS) from the outer leaflet of a donor membrane, transports it through the aqueous phase while protected in a hydrophobic pocket, and brings it to the outer leaflet of an acceptor membrane." [PMID:24639492]

GO:0140333.name: glycerophospholipid flippase activity
GO:0140333.def: "Catalysis of the movement of a glycerophospholipid from the exoplasmic to the cytosolic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP." [PMID:26212235]

GO:0140334.name: lipopolysaccharide localization to cell outer membrane
GO:0140334.def: "A process in which a lipopolysaccharide is transported to the cell outer membrane." [PMID:24639492]

GO:0140337.name: diacylglyceride transfer activity
GO:0140337.def: "Directly binding to diacylglyceride and delivering it either to an acceptor molecule or to a specific location." [PMID:9132017]

GO:0140338.name: sphingomyelin transfer activity
GO:0140338.def: "Removes a sphingomyelin from the outer leaflet of a donor membrane, transports it through the aqueous phase while protected in a hydrophobic pocket, and brings it to the outer leaflet of an acceptor membrane." [PMID:9132017]

GO:0140339.name: phosphatidylglycerol transfer activity
