GO:0140339.def: "Directly binding to phosphatidylglycerol and delivering it either to an acceptor molecule or to a specific location." [PMID:9132017]

GO:0140340.name: cerebroside transfer activity
GO:0140340.def: "Directly binding to a cerebroside and delivering it either to an acceptor molecule or to a specific location." [PMID:9132017]

GO:0140341.name: phosphatidylethanolamine floppase activity
GO:0140341.def: "Catalysis of the movement of phosphatidylethanolamine from the cytosolic to the exoplasmic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP." [PMID:10029989]

GO:0140343.name: phosphatidylserine transfer activity
GO:0140343.def: "Removes phosphatidylserine from the outer leaflet of a donor membrane, transports it through the aqueous phase while protected in a hydrophobic pocket, and brings it to the outer leaflet of an acceptor membrane." [PMID:26206935]

GO:0140344.name: triglyceride transfer activity
GO:0140344.def: "Directly binding to a triglyceride and delivering it either to an acceptor molecule or to a specific location." [PMID:23475612]

GO:0140345.name: phosphatidylcholine flippase activity
GO:0140345.def: "Catalysis of the movement of phosphatidylcholine from the exoplasmic to the cytosolic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP." [PMID:11870854]

GO:0140346.name: phosphatidylserine flippase activity
GO:0140346.def: "Catalysis of the movement of phosphatidylserine from the exoplasmic to the cytosolic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP." [PMID:11870854]

GO:0140347.name: N-retinylidene-phosphatidylethanolamine flippase activity
GO:0140347.def: "Catalysis of the movement of N-retinylidene-N-retinylphosphatidylethanolamine from the exoplasmic to the cytosolic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP." [PMID:10412977]

GO:0140348.name: lysophosphatidylcholine flippase activity
GO:0140348.def: "Catalysis of the movement of lysophosphatidylcholine from the exoplasmic to the cytosolic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP." [PMID:26945070]

GO:0140351.name: glycosylceramide flippase activity
GO:0140351.def: "Catalysis of the movement of glycosylceramide from the exoplasmic to the cytosolic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP. Glycosylceramides are ceramides containing a functional group derived from a sugar." [PMID:30530492]

GO:0140352.name: export from cell
GO:0140352.def: "The directed movement of some substance from a cell, into the extracellular region. This may occur via transport across the plasma membrane or via exocytosis." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140353.name: lipid export from cell
GO:0140353.def: "The directed movement of a lipid from a cell, into the extracellular region." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140354.name: lipid import into cell
GO:0140354.def: "The directed movement of a lipid from outside of a cell into a cell. This may occur via transport across the plasma membrane or via endocytosis." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140355.name: cargo receptor ligand activity
GO:0140355.def: "The activity of a gene product that interacts with a cargo receptor and initiates endocytosis." [PMID:15797858]

GO:0140357.name: heme export from vacuole to cytoplasm
GO:0140357.def: "The directed movement of heme from inside the vacuole across the vacuolar membrane and into the cytosol." [PMID:28193844]

GO:0140358.name: P-type transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0140358.def: "Primary active transporter that auto-phosphorylates (hence P) at a key conserved aspartate residue, generating a conformational change that allows transport of the substrate. Hydrolysis of the phosphorylated Asp residue, catalyzed by the actuator (A) domain, results in another state with occluded substrates. Upon dissociation of Mg2+ and Pi, the enzyme reverts to the initial state, in which the counter-transported substrate is released into the cytosol." [PMID:18075584, PMID:25918123]

GO:0140359.name: ABC-type transporter activity
GO:0140359.def: "Primary active transporter characterized by two nucleotide-binding domains and two transmembrane domains. Uses the energy generated from ATP hydrolysis to drive the transport of a substance across a membrane." [PMID:26517899]

GO:0140360.name: cyclic-GMP-AMP transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0140360.def: "Enables the transfer of cyclic-GMP-AMP from one side of a membrane to the other." [PMID:31126740]

GO:0140361.name: cyclic-GMP-AMP transmembrane import across plasma membrane
GO:0140361.def: "The directed movement of cyclic-GMP-AMP from outside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the cytosol." [PMID:31126740]

GO:0140363.name: TIS granule
GO:0140363.def: "A ribonucleoprotein granule located in the cytoplasm that is formed by the RNA-binding protein TIS11B and RNA molecules, enriched in membrane protein-encoding mRNAs with multiple AU-rich elements. TIS granules are reticular meshworks intertwined with the endoplasmic reticulum (ER)." [PMID:30449617, PMID:30479375, Wikipedia:TIGER_domain]

GO:0140364.name: GW body
GO:0140364.def: "A ribonucleoprotein granule located in the cytoplasm and the nucleus. GW-bodies minimally contain the Argonaute2 (Ago2) and TNRC6B proteins, together with specific target RNAs." [PMID:16418578, PMID:26930655, PMID:29576456]

GO:0140365.name: RNP body
GO:0140365.def: "A ribonucleoprotein granule located in the cytoplasm of bacteria, minimally containing the RNase E protein and RNA molecules. Bacterial RNP-bodies are similar to eukaryotic P-bodies and stress granules." [PMID:30197298]

GO:0140366.name: galectin lattice
GO:0140366.def: "A non-stoichiometric protein complex formed by several galectins crosslinking glycosylated ligands to form a dynamic lattice. The galectin lattice modulates receptor kinase signaling and the functionality of membrane receptors, by regulating the diffusion, compartmentalization and endocytosis of plasma membrane glycoproteins and glycolipids." [PMID:19021578, PMID:26092931, PMID:28893908, PMID:30951647]

GO:0140367.name: antibacterial innate immune response
GO:0140367.def: "An defense response against a bacteria mediated through an innate immune response. An innate immune response is mediated by germline encoded components that directly recognize components of potential pathogens." [PMID:16177355, PMID:23006328]

GO:0140368.name: decoy receptor complex
GO:0140368.def: "A receptor complex that recognizes, binds and sequesters a specific receptor ligand to prevent it from binding to its regular receptor. May be soluble or membrane bound." [GOC:bhm, PMID:30621730, PMID:9168977]

GO:0140374.name: antiviral innate immune response
GO:0140374.def: "A defense response against viruses mediated through an innate immune response. An innate immune response is mediated by germline encoded components that directly recognize components of potential pathogens." [PMID:31006531]

GO:0140375.name: immune receptor activity
GO:0140375.def: "Receiving a signal and transmitting it in a cell to initiate an immune response." [PMID:31415752, Wikipedia:Immune_receptor]

GO:0140376.name: innate immune receptor activity
GO:0140376.def: "Receiving a signal and transmitting it in a cell to initiate an innate immune response." [PMID:28921463, PMID:31415752]

GO:0140380.name: psilocybin biosynthetic process
GO:0140380.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of psilocybin, a psychotropic tryptamine-derived natural product." [PMID:28763571]

GO:0140381.name: 4-hydroxytryptamine 4-phosphate methyltransferase activity
GO:0140381.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAM) + 4-hydroxytryptamine 4-phosphate (norbaeocystin) = 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + psilocybin." [PMID:28763571]

GO:0140382.name: tryptamine 4-monooxygenase activity
GO:0140382.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: tryptamine + reduced acceptor + O2 = 4-hydroxytryptamine + acceptor + H2O." [PMID:28763571]

GO:0140383.name: 4-hydroxytryptamine kinase activity
GO:0140383.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxytryptamine + ATP = 4-hydoxytryptamine 4-phosphate + ADP + H+." [PMID:28763571]

GO:0140384.name: metacyclogenesis
GO:0140384.def: "The morphological, biochemical and genetic changes that induce the differentiation of non-pathogenic parasites into pathogenic metacyclic parasites in the Trypanosomatidae species. The pathogenic parasites are known as metacyclic trypomastigotes in Trypanosoma and metacyclic promastigotes in Leishmania." [PMID:12152483, PMID:21514274, PMID:2659372, PMID:29091711, PMID:29409544]

GO:0140393.name: norsolorinic acid ketoreductase activity
GO:0140393.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (1'S)-averantin + NADP+ = norsolorinic acid + NADPH." [PMID:10584035, PMID:8368836, RHEA:35447]

GO:0140394.name: ABC-type azole transporter activity
GO:0140394.def: "Enables the transfer of azoles, heterocyclic compound found in many biologically important substances, from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + azole(in) = ADP + phosphate + azole(out)." [PMID:31501141, RHEA:33503]

GO:0140395.name: averantin hydroxylase activity
GO:0140395.def: "Catalyzes the reaction: (1'S)-averantin + [reduced NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = (1'S,5'S)-5'-hydroxyaverantin + [oxidized NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + H2O. Involved in aflatoxin biosynthesis." [EC:1.14.14.116, PMID:8368836]

GO:0140397.name: versiconal hemiacetal acetate esterase activity
GO:0140397.def: "Catalyzes the reactions: versiconal hemiacetal acetate + H2O = versiconal + acetate, as well as versiconol acetate + H2O = versiconol + acetate." [EC:3.1.1.94, PMID:15006741, PMID:15932995, PMID:8368837]

GO:0140398.name: versicolorin B desaturase activity
GO:0140398.def: "Catalyzes the reaction: versicolorin B + NADPH + O2 = versicolorin A + NADP+ + 2 H2O. Uses heme-thiolate as a co-factor. Involved in the synthesis of aflatoxins in the fungus Aspergillus parasiticus." [PMID:15006741, PMID:8368837]

GO:0140399.name: aflatoxin B synthase activity
GO:0140399.def: "Catalyzes the reaction: 8-O-methylsterigmatocystin + 2 [reduced NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + 2 O2 = aflatoxin B + 2 [oxidized NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + H2O + methanol + CO2. Produces both aflatoxin B(1) and aflatoxin B(2)." [EC:1.14.14.117]

GO:0140403.name: effector-mediated suppression of host innate immune response
GO:0140403.def: "A process mediated by a molecule secreted by a symbiont that results in the suppression of a host innate immune response. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:21467214, PMID:30584105]

GO:0140404.name: effector-mediated perturbation of host innate immune response by symbiont
GO:0140404.def: "A process mediated by a molecule secreted by a symbiont that results in the modulation (either activation or suppression) of a host innate immune response. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:21467214]

GO:0140405.name: spindle pole body-led chromosome movement during mitotic interphase
GO:0140405.def: "A microtubule-based process in which chromosomes migrate as a result of rapid spindle pole body (SPB) and centrosome oscillations during mitotic interphase." [PMID:31483748]

GO:0140406.name: L-alanine export across the plasma membrane
GO:0140406.def: "The directed movement of L-alanine from inside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the extracellular region." [PMID:26073055, PMID:31591285]

GO:0140407.name: L-alanine:proton antiporter activity
GO:0140407.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: H+(out) + L-alanine(in) = H+(in) + L-alanine(out)." [PMID:26073055, PMID:31591285]

GO:0140408.name: regulation of mRNA alternative polyadenylation
GO:0140408.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of mRNA alternative polyadenylation." [PMID:29507755]

GO:0140409.name: positive regulation of mRNA alternative polyadenylation
GO:0140409.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of mRNA alternative polyadenylation." [PMID:29507755]

GO:0140410.name: monoatomic cation:bicarbonate symporter activity
GO:0140410.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: monoatomic cation(out) + HCO3-(out) = monoatomic cation(in) + HCO3-(in)." [PMID:27166256]

GO:0140412.name: zinc:bicarbonate symporter activity
GO:0140412.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: zinc(out) + HCO3-(out) = zinc(in) + HCO3-(in)." [PMID:27166256]

GO:0140413.name: zinc:bicarbonate:selenite symporter activity
GO:0140413.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: zinc(out) + HCO3-(out) + HO3Se-(out) = zinc(in) + HCO3-(in) + HO3Se-(out)." [PMID:27166256]

GO:0140414.name: phosphopantetheine-dependent carrier activity
GO:0140414.def: "Binding a substrate via a thioester at the terminal thiol of a covalentely linked phosphopantetheine prosthetic group and mediating protein-protein interactions with cognate enzymes for processing or offloading of the thiol-bound substrate." [PMID:17502372]

GO:0140415.name: effector-mediated perturbation of host defenses by symbiont
GO:0140415.def: "A process mediated by a molecule secreted by a symbiont that results in the modulation (either activation or suppression) of a defense response. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:30610168]

GO:0140416.name: transcription regulator inhibitor activity
GO:0140416.def: "A molecular function regulator that inhibits the activity of a transcription regulator via direct binding and/or post-translational modification." [PMID:10652346]

GO:0140417.name: intracellularly ATP-gated calcium channel activity
GO:0140417.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of a calcium ion from intracellular stores by a channel that opens when a ATP has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts." [PMID:22736763]

GO:0140418.name: effector-mediated perturbation of host process by symbiont
GO:0140418.def: "A process mediated by a molecule secreted by a symbiont that results in the modulation (either activation or suppression) of a host structure or process. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:21467214]

GO:0140420.name: heme import into cell
GO:0140420.def: "The directed movement of a heme from outside of a cell into a cell. This may occur via transport across the plasma membrane or via endocytosis." [PMID:28193844]

GO:0140421.name: endocytic heme import into cell
GO:0140421.def: "The directed movement into cell of externally available heme by receptor-mediated endocytosis." [PMID:28193844]

GO:0140423.name: effector-mediated suppression of host pattern-triggered immunity signaling
GO:0140423.def: "A process mediated by a molecule secreted by a symbiont that results in the suppression of a pattern-triggered immunity PTI signaling pathway. PTI signaling pathways are found in plants." [PMID:30584105]

GO:0140425.name: galactose import across plasma membrane
GO:0140425.def: "The directed movement of galactose from outside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the cytosol." [PMID:21621292, PMID:23254763]

GO:0140426.name: pathogen-associated molecular pattern receptor signaling pathway
GO:0140426.def: "The series of molecular signals initiated by a ligand binding of a pattern recognition receptor (PRR) to activate a plant innate immune response. PAMP-triggered immunity PRRs bind pathogen-associated molecular pattern (PAMPs), structures conserved among microbial species." [PMID:25744358]

GO:0140429.name: positive regulation of mitotic sister chromatid biorientation
GO:0140429.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of mitotic sister chromatid biorientation, the mitotic cell cycle process in which sister chromatids establish stable, end-on attachments to the plus ends of microtubules emanating from opposite spindle poles, oriented such that separation can proceed." [GOC:mtg_cell_cycle, GOC:vw, PMID:15525536, PMID:20739936, PMID:21306900]

GO:0140430.name: positive regulation of chromosome passenger complex localization to kinetochore
GO:0140430.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of a chromosome passenger complex localization to kinetochore." [PMID:20739936]

GO:0140431.name: DNA-(abasic site) binding
GO:0140431.def: "Binding to a DNA site that has neither a purine nor a pyrimidine base. Apurinic sites can form spontaneously or when DNA glycosylase removes a damaged base." [PMID:23245849]

GO:0140432.name: 5'-hydroxyl dinucleotide hydrolase activity
GO:0140432.def: "Catalysis of the hydrolysis of phosphodiester bonds in 5'OH-RNA according to the reaction 5'OH-NpN-RNA + H20 = 5'OH-NpN + 5'P-RNA, where NpN represents a dinucleotide." [PMID:31777937]

GO:0140433.name: regulation of protein localization to meiotic spindle pole body
GO:0140433.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of protein localization to a meiotic spindle pole body." [PMID:22438582]

GO:0140434.name: positive regulation of protein localization to meiotic spindle pole body
GO:0140434.def: "Any process that increases the frequency, rate or extent of protein localization to a meiotic spindle pole body." [PMID:22438582]

GO:0140435.name: negative regulation of protein localization to meiotic spindle pole body
GO:0140435.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of protein localization to a meiotic spindle pole body." [PMID:22438582]

GO:0140438.name: protein stearoylation
GO:0140438.def: "The covalent attachment of a stearoyl group to an amino acid in a protein." [PMID:26214738]

GO:0140439.name: protein-cysteine S-stearoyltransferase activity
GO:0140439.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of a stearoyl (systematic name, octadecanoyl) group to a sulfur atom on the cysteine of a protein molecule, in the reaction: octadecanoyl-CoA + L-cysteinyl-[protein] = CoA + S-octadecanoyl-L-cysteinyl-[protein]." [PMID:12681491, PMID:22247542, PMID:22968831, RHEA:59740]

GO:0140440.name: protein-cysteine S-oleoyltransferase activity
GO:0140440.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of an oleoyl (systematic name, (9Z)-octadecenoyl) group to a sulfur atom on the cysteine of a protein molecule, in the reaction: (9Z)-octadecenoyl-CoA + L-cysteinyl-[protein] = CoA + S-(9Z-octadecenoyl)-L-cysteinyl-[protein]." [PMID:22247542, RHEA:59744]

GO:0140441.name: protein-cysteine S-arachidonoyltransferase activity
GO:0140441.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of an arachidonoyl (systematic name, (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatetraenoyl) group to a sulfur atom on the cysteine of a protein molecule, in the reaction: in the reaction: (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatetraenoyl-CoA + L-cysteinyl-[protein] = CoA + S-(5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z-eicosatetraenoyl)-L-cysteinyl-[protein]." [PMID:12681491, PMID:22247542, PMID:22968831, RHEA:59748]

GO:0140442.name: peroxide sensor activity
GO:0140442.def: "Binding to hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) and eliciting a change in the protein's activity in response to the intracellular level of that small molecule." [PMID:20919928]

GO:0140443.name: mitochondrion-plasma membrane adaptor activity
GO:0140443.def: "The binding activity of a molecule that brings together a mitochondrion and a plasma membrane either via membrane lipid binding or by interacting with a mitochondrial outer membrane protein, to establish or maintain the localization of the mitochondrion." [PMID:31582398]

GO:0140444.name: cytoskeleton-nuclear membrane anchor activity
GO:0140444.def: "The binding activity of a molecule that brings together a cytoskeletal protein or protein complex and a nuclear membrane lipid or membrane-associated protein, in order to maintain the localization of the cytoskeleton at a specific location of the nuclear membrane." [PMID:16237665]

GO:0140445.name: chromosome, telomeric repeat region
GO:0140445.def: "A complex of DNA and protein that seals the end of a chromosome. The telomeric repeat DNA consists of simple tandemly repeated sequences specific for each species. Typically one strand is G-rich and the other C-rich. The G-rich strand forms a 3'-terminal overhang, the length of which varies with species. The single strand overhang is bound by a variety of proteins, including telomere capping proteins that bind to the single-stranded DNA and seal the telomeric loop." [PMID:11352055, PMID:30208292]

GO:0140446.name: fumigermin biosynthetic process
GO:0140446.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of fumigermin, an alpha-pyrone secondary metabolite found in some species of fungi such as Aspergillus fumigatus." [PMID:32083553]

GO:0140447.name: cytokine precursor processing
GO:0140447.def: "The cleavage of a peptide bond in a precursor form of a cytokine, resulting in the mature (active) form of the cytokine." [PMID:29247995]

GO:0140448.name: signaling receptor ligand precursor processing
GO:0140448.def: "The cleavage of a peptide bond in a precursor form of a signaling receptor ligand, resulting in the mature (active) form of the ligand." [PMID:29247995]

GO:0140449.name: centromere-nuclear envelope anchor activity
GO:0140449.def: "The binding activity of a molecule that brings together the centromeric region of a chromosome and the inner nuclear membrane by interacting with both the centromere/kinetochore complex and the nuclear membrane, in order to establish and maintain the centromere/kinetochore location." [PMID:31635174]

GO:0140450.name: protein targeting to Golgi apparatus
GO:0140450.def: "The process of targeting specific proteins to the Golgi apparatus. Usually requires an organelle-specific protein sequence motif or a protein modification (for example a palmitoylation)." [PMID:18817523]

GO:0140451.name: counting factor complex
GO:0140451.def: "A secreted multiprotein complex composed of 4 proteins, regulating group size during aggregation in cooperative development. An example of this complex is found in Dictyostelium discoideum." [PMID:10444594, PMID:12117815, PMID:12912898, PMID:16963635, PMID:18426773]

GO:0140453.name: protein aggregate center
GO:0140453.def: "Reversible aggregate of misfolded proteins and chaperones formed to shield thermosensitive proteins from degradation until conditions allow disaggregation and refolding." [PMID:32075773]

GO:0140454.name: protein aggregate center assembly
GO:0140454.def: "The reversible aggregation of misfolded proteins and chaperones, formed to shield thermosensitive proteins from degradation until conditions allow disaggregation and refolding." [PMID:32075773]

GO:0140455.name: cytoplasm protein quality control
GO:0140455.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of misfolded proteins in the cytoplasm, which are either targeted to cytoplasmic proteasomes for degradation or protected by chaperones to shield thermosensitive proteins from degradation until conditions allow disaggregation and refolding." [PMID:32075773]

GO:0140456.name: initial meiotic spindle pole body separation
GO:0140456.def: "The release of duplicated meiotic spindle pole bodies (SPBs)." [PMID:31532702]

GO:0140457.name: protein demethylase activity
GO:0140457.def: "Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from a protein." [PMID:24498420, PMID:28360925]

GO:0140459.name: response to Gram-positive bacterium
GO:0140459.def: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a stimulus from a Gram-positive bacterium." [PMID:23664307]

GO:0140460.name: response to Gram-negative bacterium
GO:0140460.def: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a stimulus from a Gram-negative bacterium." [PMID:23664307]

GO:0140462.name: pericentric heterochromatin organization
GO:0140462.def: "The organization of chromatin into heterochromatin at the pericentric region of a chromosome." [PMID:26744419]

GO:0140463.name: chromatin-protein adaptor activity
GO:0140463.def: "An adaptor activity that brings together a protein and a region of the chromatin, such as a nucleosome, to establish or maintain the chromatin localization of the protein, or the complex to which it belongs." [PMID:32277274]

GO:0140464.name: subnuclear spatial organization of silent mating-type cassette heterochromatin
GO:0140464.def: "The localization of silent mating-type cassette heterochromatin at a specific location in the nucleus." [PMID:26744419]

GO:0140466.name: iron-sulfur cluster export from the mitochondrion
GO:0140466.def: "The directed movement of iron sulfur clusters from inside the mitochondrion into the cytosol by crossing the inner mitochondrial membrane." [PMID:31040179]

GO:0140467.name: integrated stress response signaling
GO:0140467.def: "The series of molecular signals generated in response to diverse stress stimuli required to restore cellular homeostasis. The core event in this pathway is the phosphorylation of eIF2 alpha by one of four members of the eIF2a kinase family (EIF2AK1/HRI, EIF2AK2/PKR, EIF2AK3/PERK and EIF2AK4/GCN2), which leads to a decrease in global protein synthesis and the induction of selected genes, including the transcription factor ATF4, that together promote cellular recovery." [PMID:27629041]

GO:0140468.name: HRI-mediated signaling
GO:0140468.def: "A series of reactions in which a signal is passed on to downstream proteins within the cell via HRI (also known as EIF2AK1), an intracellular protein kinase that is activated by stress signals, such as heme deficiency, oxidative stress, osmotic shock, mitochondrial dysfunction and heat shock." [PMID:27629041]

GO:0140469.name: GCN2-mediated signaling
GO:0140469.def: "A series of reactions in which a signal is passed on to downstream proteins within the cell via GCN2 (also known as EIF2AK4), an intracellular protein kinase that is activated by stress signals, such as amino acid starvation." [PMID:27629041]

GO:0140471.name: positive regulation of transepithelial migration of symbiont in host
GO:0140471.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of transepithelial migration of symbiont in host." [PMID:29113016]

GO:0140472.name: cell cortex of non-growing cell tip
GO:0140472.def: "The region directly beneath the plasma membrane at the cell tip at which no growth takes place." [PMID:17895368]

GO:0140473.name: telomere-nuclear envelope anchor activity
GO:0140473.def: "The binding activity of a molecule that brings together the telomeric region of a chromosome and the inner nuclear membrane by interacting with both the telomere and the nuclear membrane, in order to establish and maintain the telomeric location." [PMID:31635174]

GO:0140474.name: mitochondrion-endoplasmic reticulum membrane tether activity
GO:0140474.def: "The binding activity of a molecule that brings together a mitochondrion and an ER membrane either via membrane lipid binding or by interacting with a mitochondrial outer membrane protein, to establish or maintain the localization of the mitochondrion." [PMID:19556461, PMID:27875684]

GO:0140475.name: spindle pole body anchor activity
GO:0140475.def: "The binding activity of a protein that brings together the spindle pole body and one or more other molecules, permitting them to function in a coordinated way." [PMID:19942852]

GO:0140479.name: ergothioneine biosynthesis from histidine via hercynylcysteine sulfoxide synthase
GO:0140479.def: "A biosynthetic process that results in the formation of ergothioneine from histidine via a set of steps including the hercynylcysteine sulfoxide synthase reaction, which converts N-alpha,N-alpha,N-alpha-trimethyl-L-histidine directly to hercynylcysteine sulfoxide." [PMID:22209968, PMID:24828577]

GO:0140480.name: mitotic spindle pole body insertion into the nuclear envelope
GO:0140480.def: "A process in which the duplicated mitotic spindle pole body is inserted into a fenestra which opens in the nuclear envelope in early mitosis, and is subsequently tethered to the membrane." [PMID:19487457, PMID:24529240]

GO:0140481.name: ABC-type iron-sulfur cluster transporter activity
GO:0140481.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O + iron-sulfur cluster(in) = ADP + phosphate + iron-sulfur cluster(out)." [PMID:31040179]

GO:0140482.name: iron sensor activity
GO:0140482.def: "Binding to and responding, e.g. by conformational change, to changes in the cellular level of iron." [PMID:11956219, PMID:25806539]

GO:0140483.name: kinetochore adaptor activity
GO:0140483.def: "The binding activity of a protein that brings the kinetochore and another molecule into contact, permitting those molecules to function in a coordinated way." [PMID:22521786]

GO:0140484.name: 5-aminolevulinic acid import across plasma membrane
GO:0140484.def: "The directed movement of 5-aminolevulinic acid from outside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the cytosol." [PMID:31989647]

GO:0140485.name: 5-aminolevulinic acid transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0140485.def: "Enables the transfer of 5-aminolevulinic acid from one side of a membrane to the other." [PMID:31989647]

GO:0140486.name: zinc ion sequestering activity
GO:0140486.def: "Binding to a zinc ion to prevent it from interacting with other partners or to inhibit its localization to the area of the cell or complex where it is active." [PMID:12050156]

GO:0140487.name: metal ion sequestering activity
GO:0140487.def: "Binding to a metal ion to prevent it from interacting with other partners or to inhibit its localization to the area of the cell or complex where it is active." [PMID:12050156]

GO:0140488.name: heme receptor activity
GO:0140488.def: "Binding specifically to heme to deliver it to a transport vesicle." [PMID:28193844, PMID:32185489]

GO:0140489.name: molecular template activity
GO:0140489.def: "The action of a molecule that provides a shape or a sequence mimicking or complementary to the final product, providing template for copying the original molecule's shape or sequence." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140490.name: microtubule nucleator activity
GO:0140490.def: "The action of a molecule that provides a shape mimicking the end of a microtubule to seed the formation of a new microtubule via self-assembly." [PMID:20631709, PMID:21993292]

GO:0140492.name: metal-dependent deubiquitinase activity
GO:0140492.def: "An metal-dependent isopeptidase activity that cleaves ubiquitin from a target protein to which it is conjugated." [PMID:19489724]

GO:0140493.name: very long-chain fatty acid beta-oxidation
GO:0140493.def: "A fatty acid beta-oxidation pathway acting on a very long-chain fatty acid. A very long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing more than 22 carbons. The partway stars with the conversion of an acyl-CoA to a trans-2-enoyl-CoA, catalyzed by acyl-CoA oxidase; the electrons removed by oxidation pass directly to oxygen and produce hydrogen peroxide, which is cleaved by peroxisomal catalases. Fatty acid beta-oxidation begins with the addition of coenzyme A to a fatty acid, and ends when only two or three carbons remain (as acetyl-CoA or propionyl-CoA respectively)." [GOC:ha, PMID:17028011, PMID:32169171]

GO:0140494.name: migrasome
GO:0140494.def: "A vesicular organelle that forms on retraction fibers behind migrating cells and mediates the release of cytoplasmic contents during cell migration." [PMID:25342562, PMID:31371827]

GO:0140495.name: migracytosis
GO:0140495.def: "A cell migration-dependent mechanism for releasing cellular contents." [PMID:25342562]

GO:0140497.name: mannan polymerase II complex
GO:0140497.def: "A complex with alpha-(1->6)-mannosyltransferase activity, located in the cis Golgi membrane; adds mannan to N-linked glycans on proteins as part of the elongation of alpha 1,6-linked Man backbone. In S. cerevisiae, contains Mnn9p, Anp1p, Mnn10p, Mnn11p, and Hoc1p." [PMID:9430634]

GO:0140498.name: mannan polymerase I complex
GO:0140498.def: "A complex with alpha-(1->6)-mannosyltransferase activity, located in the cis Golgi membrane; adds mannan to N-linked glycans on proteins as part of the priming and elongation of alpha 1,6-linked Man backbone. In S. cerevisiae, contains Mnn9p and Van1p." [PMID:9430634]

GO:0140499.name: negative regulation of mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint signaling
GO:0140499.def: "Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of negative regulation of mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint signaling." [PMID:28017606]

GO:0140500.name: regulation of reticulophagy
GO:0140500.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of reticulophagy." [PMID:32735772]

GO:0140501.name: positive regulation of reticulophagy
GO:0140501.def: "Any process that increases the frequency, rate or extent of reticulophagy." [PMID:32735772]

GO:0140502.name: effector-mediated suppression of host salicylic acid-mediated innate immune signaling
GO:0140502.def: "A process mediated by a molecule secreted by a symbiont that results in the suppression of host salicylic acid-mediated innate immune signaling." [PMID:25438793, PMID:30651637]

GO:0140504.name: microlipophagy
GO:0140504.def: "Degradation of a lipid droplet by microautophagy." [PMID:25070953, PMID:28394250, PMID:28838958, PMID:29293450, PMID:29601311]

GO:0140505.name: regulation of microlipophagy
GO:0140505.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of microlipophagy, the microautophagy-mediated direct internalization of lipid droplets into a lysosome-like vacuole during nutrient depletion." [PMID:28394250, PMID:29601311]

GO:0140506.name: endoplasmic reticulum-autophagosome adaptor activity
GO:0140506.def: "The binding activity of a molecule that brings together an ER membrane and an autophagosome during reticulophagy." [PMID:32735772]

GO:0140507.name: granzyme-mediated programmed cell death signaling pathway
GO:0140507.def: "The series of molecular signals induced by granzymes which triggers the cell death of a cell. The pathway starts with reception of a granzyme signal, and ends when the execution phase of cell death is triggered. Granzymes are serine proteases that are secreted by cytotoxic T cells and natural killer cells to induce cell death in target cells." [PMID:32299851]

GO:0140509.name: epithelium-like organization
GO:0140509.def: "The organization of a polarized cell layer during morphogenesis in protozoa; an example is found during culmination in D. discoideum, involving alpha and beta catenins." [PMID:21393547, PMID:22902739]

GO:0140510.name: mitotic nuclear bridge
GO:0140510.def: "A narrow constricted region of the nucleus that forms around the anaphase spindle during closed mitosis, and connects the main portions of the newly forming daughter nuclei." [PMID:32848252]

GO:0140511.name: mitotic nuclear bridge stalk
GO:0140511.def: "Either of the regions of a mitotic nuclear bridge proximal to the main portion of each daughter nucleus. The nuclear envelope in the stalk regions is depleted of nuclear pore complexes." [PMID:32848252]

GO:0140512.name: mitotic nuclear bridge midzone
GO:0140512.def: "The central region of a mitotic nuclear bridge, distal to the main portions of the daughter nuclei." [PMID:32848252]

GO:0140513.name: nuclear protein-containing complex
GO:0140513.def: "A stable assembly of two or more macromolecules, i.e. proteins, nucleic acids, carbohydrates or lipids, in which at least one component is a protein and the constituent parts function together in the nucleus." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140515.name: mitotic nuclear bridge organization
GO:0140515.def: "A mitotic cell cycle process which results in the assembly, arrangement, or disassembly of the mitotic nuclear bridge during closed mitosis." [PMID:32848252]

GO:0140516.name: mitotic nuclear pore complex disassembly
GO:0140516.def: "The mitotic cell cycle process in which the controlled breakdown of the nuclear pores occurs during open or closed mitosis." [PMID:32848252]

GO:0140517.name: protein-RNA adaptor activity
GO:0140517.def: "The binding activity of a protein that brings together another protein and an RNA, permitting those molecules to function in a coordinated way." [PMID:24470144]

GO:0140522.name: fusogenic activity
GO:0140522.def: "The activity of joining two lipid bilayers to form a single membrane." [PMID:10332732, PMID:11493675, PMID:12600315, PMID:32100701, PMID:32641474]

GO:0140523.name: GTPase-dependent fusogenic activity
GO:0140523.def: "A GTPase activity that mediates the joining of two lipid bilayers to form a single membrane." [PMID:29663589]

GO:0140525.name: antipodal site
GO:0140525.def: "The pole of the kinetoplast associated with kinetoplast DNA replication. The antipodal sites flank the kinetoplast DNA disk and are positioned approximately 180 degrees apart. In Trypanosoma brucei and Crithidia fasciculata, minicircles are attached at antipodal sites and they contain enzymes that catalyse some of the later reactions in minicircle replication." [PMID:12455998, PMID:17462016, PMID:8045928]

GO:0140526.name: double membrane vesicle viral factory assembly
GO:0140526.def: "A process that results in the assembly of a cytoplasmic viral factory consisting of a double-membrane bound vesicle." [PMID:32555292]

GO:0140527.name: reciprocal homologous recombination
GO:0140527.def: "A DNA recombination process that results in the bidirectional exchange of genetic material between highly homologous DNA molecules." [PMID:17846636]

GO:0140528.name: bilobe structure assembly
GO:0140528.def: "The assembly and organization of a bilobe structure, a cytoskeletal structure in some kinetoplastid species linking the structures of the ciliary pocket collar and the flagellum attachment zone (aka cilium attachment zone)." [PMID:18443217, PMID:32675283]

GO:0140529.name: CMG complex assembly
GO:0140529.def: "The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form the CMG complex, a protein complex that contains the GINS complex, Cdc45p, and the heterohexameric MCM complex, and that is involved in unwinding DNA during replication. The process begins when additional proteins (e.g. Cdc45 and Sld3) join the loaded, inactive double MCM hexamer at replication origins, and ends when Mcm10 triggers the separation of the Mcm2-7 double hexamers, forming two active CMG complexes." [PMID:22718908, PMID:28501329]

GO:0140530.name: MCM complex loading
GO:0140530.def: "The protein localization process in which two MCM complexes become associated with chromatin at replication origins. MCM loading begins when origin-bound ORC and Cdc6 (Cdc18 in fission yeast) recruit one MCM2-7/Cdt1 complex to the origin, includes formation of a succession of intermediate complexes and ATP hydrolysis-dependent Mcm2-7 ring closure, and ends when two MCM hexamers fully encircle DNA, and are oriented head-to-head. The double hexamer is inactive for DNA unwinding. MCM loading takes place during G1 phase, and precedes CMG complex assembly." [PMID:23603117, PMID:28191893, PMID:28191894, PMID:28501329]

GO:0140533.name: symbiont-mediated suppression of host RNAi-mediated antiviral immune response
GO:0140533.def: "A process by which a symbiont inhibits or disrupts the host's RNAi-mediated antiviral immune response. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:17693253]

GO:0140534.name: endoplasmic reticulum protein-containing complex
GO:0140534.def: "A protein complex that is part of an endoplasmic reticulum." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140537.name: transcription regulator activator activity
GO:0140537.def: "A molecular function regulator that increases the activity of a transcription regulator via direct binding and/or post-translational modification." [PMID:9597751]

GO:0140538.name: negative regulation of conjugation with zygote
GO:0140538.def: "A process that prevents a zygote from fusing an additional cell." [PMID:30089908]

GO:0140539.name: regulation of melanotic encapsulation of foreign target
GO:0140539.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of melanotic encapsulation of foreign target." [PMID:15749104, PMID:18457993]

GO:0140540.name: negative regulation melanotic encapsulation of foreign target
GO:0140540.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of melanotic encapsulation of foreign target." [PMID:15749104, PMID:18457993]

GO:0140541.name: piRNA transcription
GO:0140541.def: "The cellular synthesis of Piwi-interacting RNA piRNAs, a class of 24- to 30-nucleotide RNA derived from repeat or complex DNA sequence elements and processed by a Dicer-independent mechanism." [PMID:28847004]

GO:0140542.name: regulation of piRNA transcription
GO:0140542.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the synthesis of a piRNA." [PMID:28847004]

GO:0140543.name: positive regulation of piRNA transcription
GO:0140543.def: "Any process that increases the frequency, rate or extent of the synthesis of piRNA." [PMID:28847004]

GO:0140544.name: septin collar organization
GO:0140544.def: "A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of cytoskeletal structures comprising the septin collar." [PMID:21736496, PMID:32386534]

GO:0140545.name: ATP-dependent protein disaggregase activity
GO:0140545.def: "An ATP-dependent molecular chaperone activity that mediates the solubilization of ordered protein aggregates." [PMID:26312418]

GO:0140546.name: defense response to symbiont
GO:0140546.def: "Reactions triggered in response to the presence of a symbiont that act to protect or prevent damage to the host." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140547.name: acquisition of seed longevity
GO:0140547.def: "The acquisition of seed longevity is the ordered series of events during seed development, that prevent embryo deterioration and ROS damage and thus contribute to seed viability over time or in response to adverse environmental conditions. These events include protective (e.g. production of glassy cytoplasm ) and repair (e.g. oxidative stress responses) processes." [PMID:26637538]

GO:0140549.name: spore inner membrane
GO:0140549.def: "The membrane surrounding the spore core (endospore core) that separates it from its external environment." [PMID:23202530]

GO:0140550.name: phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate sensor activity
GO:0140550.def: "Binding to and responding, e.g. by conformational change, to changes in the cellular level of phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate." [PMID:33172987]

GO:0140552.name: TEAD-YAP complex
GO:0140552.def: "A transcription factor complex that is composed of the one DNA binding protein of the TEAD family and the transcriptional coactivator YAP." [GOC:mah, PMID:11358867]

GO:0140560.name: xylosyl alpha-1,3-xylosyltransferase activity
GO:0140560.def: "Catalyzes the reaction: UDP-alpha-D-xylose + [protein with EGF-like domain]-3-O-(alpha-D-xylosyl-(1->3)-beta-D-glucosyl)-L-serine = UDP + [protein with EGF-like domain]-3-O-(alpha-D-xylosyl-(1->3)-alpha-D-xylosyl-(1->3)-beta-D-glucosyl)-L-serine. The enzyme, found in animals and insects, is involved in the biosynthesis of the alpha-D-xylosyl-(1->3)-alpha-D-xylosyl-(1->3)- beta-D-glucosyl trisaccharide on epidermal growth factor-like (EGF- like) domains." [PMID:22117070, PMID:8982869, RHEA:22820]

GO:0140561.name: EGF-domain serine glucosyltransferase activity
GO:0140561.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-alpha-D-glucose + [protein with EGF-like domain]-L-serine = UDP + [protein with EGF-like domain]-3-O-(beta-D-glucosyl)-L-serine." [RHEA:58116]

GO:0140562.name: EGF-domain serine xylosyltransferase activity
GO:0140562.def: "Catalyses the reaction: UDP-alpha-D-xylose + [protein with EGF-like domain]-L-serine = UDP + [protein with EGF-like domain]-3-O-(beta-D-xylosyl)-L-serine." [RHEA:62016]

GO:0140563.name: UDP-D-xylose:beta-D-glucoside alpha-1,3-D-xylosyltransferase activity
GO:0140563.def: "Catalyzes the reaction: UDP-alpha-D-xylose + [protein with EGF-like domain]-3-O-(beta-D-glucosyl)-L-serine = UDP + [protein with EGF-like domain]-3-O-(alpha-D-xylosyl-(1->3)-beta-D-glucosyl)-L-serine." [EC:2.4.2.42, PMID:30127001, RHEA:56064]

GO:0140566.name: histone reader activity
GO:0140566.def: "A chromatin adaptor activity that brings together a protein and a specific form of histone, either modified by a post-translational modification, or the unmodified form. Histone readers have roles in many processes, including in centromere function or in modulating the accessibility of cis-regulatory regions to the transcription machinery." [PMID:11498575, PMID:25688442, PMID:31082667, PMID:34726351]

GO:0140567.name: membrane protein dislocase activity
GO:0140567.def: "The activity of removing a protein from a membrane, by binding to a transmembrane helical fragment of a tail-anchored protein and releasing it from the the hydrophobic region of one or both lipid bilayers. The reaction is driven by ATP hydrolysis." [PMID:24821790, PMID:28712723, PMID:32973005]

GO:0140568.name: extraction of mislocalized protein from membrane
GO:0140568.def: "The removal of a mislocalized protein from a cellular membrane." [PMID:24821790, PMID:28712723, PMID:32973005]

GO:0140569.name: extraction of mislocalized protein from ER membrane
GO:0140569.def: "The removal of a mislocalized protein from the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) membrane." [PMID:32973005]

GO:0140570.name: extraction of mislocalized protein from mitochondrial outer membrane
GO:0140570.def: "The removal of a mislocalized protein from the mitochondrial outer membrane." [PMID:32973005]

GO:0140571.name: transmembrane ascorbate ferrireductase activity
GO:0140571.def: "Oxidation of Fe(3+) to Fe(2+) on the outer side of a membrane coupled to the reduction of L-ascorbate to monodehydro-L-ascorbate radical on the inner side of a membrane. Electrons get transferred across the membrane during the reaction." [PMID:16911521, PMID:24449903, RHEA:30403]

GO:0140572.name: vacuole fission
GO:0140572.def: "The division of a vacuole within a cell to form two or more separate vacuoles." [PMID:19643199]

GO:0140573.name: histone H3-containing nucleosome
GO:0140573.def: "A complex comprised of DNA wound around a multisubunit core and associated proteins containing the histone H3, which forms the primary packing unit of DNA into higher order structures." [PMID:33155135]

GO:0140575.name: transmembrane monodehydroascorbate reductase activity
GO:0140575.def: "Oxidation of monodehydroascorbate outside of a membrane coupled to the reduction of L-ascorbate to monodehydro-L-ascorbate radical on the inner side of a membrane. Electrons get transferred across the membrane during the reaction." [PMID:1623014, RHEA:66524]

GO:0140576.name: ascorbate homeostasis
GO:0140576.def: "Any process involved in the maintenance of an internal steady state of ascorbate at the level of a cell." [PMID:1623014, PMID:17068337, PMID:32547589]

GO:0140580.name: mitochondrion autophagosome adaptor activity
GO:0140580.def: "The binding activity of a molecule that brings together a mitochondrial membrane and an autophagosome during mitophagy." [PMID:33138913]

GO:0140581.name: P-type monovalent copper transporter activity
GO:0140581.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + Cu+(in) = ADP + phosphate + Cu+(out)." [RHEA:25792]

GO:0140582.name: adenylate cyclase-activating G protein-coupled cAMP receptor signaling pathway
GO:0140582.def: "An adenylate cyclase-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway initiated by extracellular cAMP binding to its receptor on the surface of the target cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process." [PMID:9578623]

GO:0140584.name: chromatin extrusion motor activity
GO:0140584.def: "A DNA translocase activity that folds chromosomal DNA and catalytically extends the newly formed loop, driven by ATP hydrolysis." [PMID:23074191, PMID:26499245, PMID:27210764]

GO:0140585.name: promoter-enhancer loop anchoring activity
GO:0140585.def: "Bridging together two cis-regulatory elements, colloquially referred to as promoters and/or enhancers, holding two loop anchors together to maintain a chromatin loop." [PMID:32213323]

GO:0140586.name: promoter-terminator loop anchoring activity
GO:0140586.def: "Bridging together a cis-regulatory element and a terminator DNA sequences on the chromatin, holding two loop anchors together, maintaining a chromatin loop." [PMID:19933151]

GO:0140587.name: chromatin loop anchoring activity
GO:0140587.def: "Bridging together two DNA loop anchors together, maintaining a chromatin loop." [PMID:32213323]

GO:0140588.name: chromatin looping
GO:0140588.def: "A chromatin organization process that starts with the loading of an extrusion motor (by an SMC family complex) onto the chromatin, followed by chromatin extrusion that stops at loop anchoring sites on the chromosome." [PMID:32213323]

GO:0140590.name: effector-mediated suppression of host defense response
GO:0140590.def: "A process mediated by a molecule secreted by a symbiont that results in the suppression of a defense response. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:28082413]

GO:0140591.name: nuclear envelope budding
GO:0140591.def: "The process by which large macromolecular complexes are budded through the inner nuclear membrane, into the perinuclear space, thus acquiring a membrane envelope. The enveloped particle fuses with the outer nuclear membrane and is released into the cytoplasm." [PMID:27236823, PMID:32503943]

GO:0140592.name: histone H3R8 methyltransferase activity
GO:0140592.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + (histone H3)-arginine (position 8) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + (histone H3-N-methyl-arginine (position 8). This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the arginine residue at position 8 of histone H3." [PMID:20708585, PMID:31533925]

GO:0140593.name: host apoplast
GO:0140593.def: "The apoplast region surrounding a host plant cell. Plants may be described as having two major compartments: the living symplast and the non-living apoplast. The apoplast is external to the plasma membrane and includes cell walls, intercellular spaces and the lumen of dead structures such as xylem vessels. Water and solutes pass freely through it. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:28082413]

GO:0140594.name: xyloglucan-specific endo-beta-1,4-glucanase inhibitor activity
GO:0140594.def: "Stops, prevents or reduces the activity of xyloglucan-specific endo-beta-1,4-glucanase." [PMID:28082413]

GO:0140595.name: MIM complex
GO:0140595.def: "A protein complex located in the mitochondrial outer membrane that functions as an insertase, mediating the insertion of alpha-helical proteins from the cytosol into the outer membrane. Client proteins are usually single- and multi-span proteins that include components of the TOM complex." [GOC:vw]

GO:0140596.name: TOM complex
GO:0140596.def: "A large mitochondrial outer membrane translocase complex that mediates transport of proteins into mitochondrial compartments. TOM transports beta-barrel precursors across the outer membrane and the sorting and assembly machinery (SAM complex) inserts them into the target membrane." [PMID:33035511]

GO:0140597.name: protein carrier chaperone
GO:0140597.def: "Binding to and carrying a protein between two different cellular components by moving along with the target protein." [PMID:7628437]

GO:0140598.name: lipoprotein carrier activity
GO:0140598.def: "Binding to and carrying a lipoprotein between two different cellular locations by moving along with the target lipoprotein." [PMID:7628437]

GO:0140599.name: mitotic nuclear bridge midzone membrane domain
GO:0140599.def: "A nuclear membrane part at the midzone of the mitotic nuclear bridge. The midzone forms a bulge that is enriched in nuclear pores that lack baskets." [PMID:25963819, PMID:32502403]

GO:0140602.name: nucleolar peripheral inclusion body
GO:0140602.def: "Inclusion bodies located at the nucleolar periphery where several nuclear factors are reversibly aggregated and sequestered during acute heat stress or starvation." [PMID:33176152, PMID:37128864]

GO:0140604.name: mycofactocin biosynthetic process
GO:0140604.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of the coenzyme mycofactocin, a variably glycosylated small molecule electron pair carrier derived from the C-terminal valine-tyrosine dipeptide of the ribosomally translated precursor peptide MftA." [PMID:21223593, PMID:27312813, PMID:30183269, PMID:30778644, PMID:31381312, PMID:33014324]

GO:0140605.name: proton motive force-driven motor activity
GO:0140605.def: "A motor activity driven by an electrochemical proton gradient (proton-motive force). PMF-driven motors are used by bacterial flagella." [PMID:18216858]

GO:0140608.name: cysteine-type endopeptidase activator activity
GO:0140608.def: "Binds to and increases the activity of a cysteine-type endopeptidase." [PMID:32558991]

GO:0140609.name: phycocyanobilin biosynthetic process
GO:0140609.def: "The chemical reactions or pathway resulting in the formation of phycocyanobilin, which involves the oxidative cleavage of heme by a heme oxygenase (HO) to form biliverdin IX alpha. Biliverdin IX alpha is subsequently converted to phycocyanobilin by a ferredoxin-dependent oxidoreductase (PCYA)." [PMID:23345435]

GO:0140610.name: RNA sequestering activity
GO:0140610.def: "Binding to a specific RNA molecule to prevent it from interacting with other partners or to inhibit its localization to the area of the cell or complex where it is active." [PMID:23334420, PMID:29084823]

GO:0140612.name: DNA damage sensor activity
GO:0140612.def: "A molecule that recognises toxic DNA structures, for example, double-strand breaks or collapsed replication forks, and initiates a signaling response." [PMID:31995034]

GO:0140613.name: P-type manganese transporter activity
GO:0140613.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + Mn2+(in) = ADP + H+ + Mn2+(out) + phosphate." [PMID:11134055, PMID:15590060, PMID:15831496, PMID:21187401, RHEA:66820]

GO:0140614.name: 1,8-dihydroxynaphthalene-melanin biosynthetic process
GO:0140614.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of dihydroxy naphthalene (DHN)-melanin." [PMID:12788746, PMID:23998343]

GO:0140615.name: ATP-dependent citrate lyase complex
GO:0140615.def: "A protein complex that catalyzes the cleavage of citrate into oxaloacetate and acetyl-CoA." [PMID:12376641]

GO:0140616.name: iodotyrosine deiodinase activity
GO:0140616.def: "Catalyzes the reaction: 2 iodide + L-tyrosine + 2 NADP+ = 3,5-diiodo-L-tyrosine + H+ + 2 NADPH. Note that this activity has only been demonstrated in the direction of 3-deiodination. 3-bromo-L-tyrosine and 3-chloro-L-tyrosine can also be used as substrates." [PMID:15289438, PMID:18434651, PMID:25395621, PMID:27643701, RHEA:32479]

GO:0140618.name: ferric-chelate reductase (NADH) activity
GO:0140618.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 2 Fe3+-siderophore + NAD+ + H+ -> 2 Fe2+-siderophore + NADH." [RHEA:15061]

GO:0140619.name: DNA strand exchange activator activity
GO:0140619.def: "Binds to and increases a DNA strand exchange activity." [PMID:33493431]

GO:0140620.name: DNA strand exchange inhibitor activity
GO:0140620.def: "Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces a DNA strand exchange activity." [PMID:33493431]

GO:0140621.name: type I pilus
GO:0140621.def: "A short filamentous structure on the surface of a bacterial cell distinguished from other pili by their D-mannose-sensitive agglutinatination of erythrocytes. In E. coli, type I pili consist of a short tip fibrillum made up of the adhesin protein (FimH) and two minor subunits (FimG and FimF) that is joined to the pilus rod, a homopolymer of ~1000 FimA subunits." [PMID:28496159, PMID:29345620]

GO:0140622.name: ER-to-endosome phospholipid transfer complex
GO:0140622.def: "Lipid transfer complex that is responsible for the non-vesicular transport of phospholipids, such as phosphatidylserine, from the endoplasmic reticulum to the endosome. It resides in the endosomal (acceptor) membrane and binds to specific lipids on the donor membrane at the ER-endosome contact site." [GOC:lnp, PMID:20016005, PMID:24366873]

GO:0140623.name: type I pilus assembly
GO:0140623.def: "The assembly from its constituent parts of a type I pilus." [PMID:1679330]

GO:0140624.name: EGAD pathway
GO:0140624.def: "The protein catabolic pathway which selectively extracts ER-resident membrane proteins exported to the Golgi and endosomes for degradation by cytosolic proteasomes. It begins with phosphorylation of the ER-resident membrane protein, which triggers export of the protein from the ER to the Golgi and endosomes, followed by polyubiquitination by the Dsc E3 ubiquitin ligase complex and extraction of the ubiquitinated target, and ends with proteasomal degradation." [PMID:31368600]

GO:0140625.name: opioid growth factor receptor activity
GO:0140625.def: "Combining with the opioid growth factor (OGF, met-enkephalin) and transmitting the signal across the nuclear membrane. Met-enkephalin is an endogenous opioid peptide that binds to opioid and opioid growth factor receptors, regulating tissue growth in a variety of cellular processes." [PMID:11890982]

GO:0140626.name: opioid growth factor receptor signaling pathway
GO:0140626.def: "The series of molecular signals generated as a consequence of an opioid growth factor receptor binding to its physiological ligand, opioid growth factor (OGF, met-enkephalin). The OGF-OGFr complex leads to the increase in the synthesis of the selective cyclin-dependent kinase (CDK) inhibitor proteins, p12 (POLD4) and p16 (CDKN2A)." [PMID:19675283, PMID:19923357]

GO:0140627.name: ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process via the C-end degron rule pathway
GO:0140627.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of a protein or peptide covalently tagged with ubiquitin, via the DesCEND (destruction via C-end degron) pathway. In the DesCEND pathway, C-terminal residues (C-end degrons) in substrates are recognized by Cul2-RING and Cul4-RING E3 ligases, whereupon the substrates are linked to ubiquitin and then delivered to the proteasome for degradation. C-end degrons can be present in full-length proteins, truncated proteins or proteolytically cleaved forms." [PMID:29775578, PMID:29779948]

GO:0140628.name: outward rectifier potassium channel inhibitor activity
GO:0140628.def: "Binds to and stops, prevents, or reduces the activity of an outwardly rectifying potassium channel." [PMID:28108814]

GO:0140629.name: small conductance calcium-activated potassium channel inhibitor activity
GO:0140629.def: "Binds to and stops, prevents, or reduces the activity of a small conductance calcium-activated potassium channel." [PMID:20562108]

GO:0140630.name: all-trans-phytoene synthase activity
GO:0140630.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 2 geranylgeranyl diphosphate -> all-trans-phytoene + 2 diphosphate." [PMID:12641468, PMID:7896759]

GO:0140631.name: aldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) inhibitor activity
GO:0140631.def: "Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of aldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+)." [PMID:33495566]

GO:0140632.name: canonical inflammasome complex assembly
GO:0140632.def: "The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form an inflammasome complex." [PMID:33420028, PMID:33420033, PMID:33542150]

GO:0140633.name: CARD8 inflammasome complex assembly
GO:0140633.def: "The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a CARD8 inflammasome complex." [PMID:33420028, PMID:33420033, PMID:33542150]

GO:0140634.name: CARD8 inflammasome complex
GO:0140634.def: "An inflammasome complex that consists of CARD8 and CASP1." [PMID:33420028, PMID:33420033, PMID:33542150]

GO:0140635.name: neutrophil dispersal
GO:0140635.def: "The movement of a neutrophil away from the site of wound or infection following its initial migration to the site." [PMID:31727891]

GO:0140636.name: copper import into the mitochondrion
GO:0140636.def: "The process in which copper is transported from the cytosol into the mitochondrial matrix." [PMID:32979421]

GO:0140638.name: small ribosomal subunit processing complex
GO:0140638.def: "A small heterodimeric protein complex that is required during early maturation of nascent 40S ribosomal subunits. The complex has endonuclease activity, it interacts with the small ribosomal subunit pre-rRNA and cleave it it to produce the mature 18S (or small ribosomal subunit) rRNA. In S. cerevisiae it is composed of Rcl1p and Bms1p." [GOC:lnp, PMID:21849504, PMID:25064857]

GO:0140639.name: positive regulation of pyroptotic inflammatory response
GO:0140639.def: "Any process that increases the frequency, rate or extent of a pyroptotic inflammatory response." [PMID:24626226]

GO:0140640.name: catalytic activity, acting on a nucleic acid
GO:0140640.def: "Catalytic activity that acts to modify a nucleic acid." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140641.name: mitotic spindle formation (spindle phase two)
GO:0140641.def: "The spindle organization process in which the spindle is maintained at a constant length during mitotic metaphase." [PMID:32723864]

GO:0140642.name: meiotic spindle formation (spindle phase two)
GO:0140642.def: "The spindle organization process in which the spindle is maintained at a constant length during meiotic metaphase." [PMID:32723864]

GO:0140643.name: hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA reductase (NADH) activity
GO:0140643.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-mevalonate + CoA + 2 NAD+ = 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA + 2 NADH." [PMID:29224355, RHEA:14833]

GO:0140644.name: neutrophil extracellular trap
GO:0140644.def: "Extracellular microbicidal structure composed of nuclear chromatin, histones and granular antimicrobial proteins. Histones and several neutrophil granule proteins associated with the DNA framework damage entrapped microorganisms." [PMID:31172493]

GO:0140645.name: neutrophil extracellular trap formation
GO:0140645.def: "The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a neutrophil extracellular trap, a network of extracellular fibers primarily composed of DNA from neutrophils, which bind and neutralizes pathogens." [PMID:28267716]

GO:0140646.name: negative regulation of pre-B cell receptor expression
GO:0140646.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of the process leading up to expression of the pre-B cell receptor on the surface of pre-B cells." [PMID:22949502]

GO:0140647.name: P450-containing electron transport chain
GO:0140647.def: "A electron transport chain in which one or more electron carriers operate to transfer electrons from donors to a cytochrome P450 protein or domain. Electron carriers operating in this chain include FAD-containing flavoproteins or domains, FMN domains, ferredoxins and cytochrome b5. The reduced cytochrome P450 functions as the terminal oxidase and participates in a wide range of biochemical pathways." [PMID:16042601]

GO:0140648.name: positive regulation of cell cycle switching, mitotic to meiotic cell cycle
GO:0140648.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of mitotic to meiotic cell cycle switching, the process in which a cell switches cell cycle mode from mitotic to meiotic division." [PMID:22375066]

GO:0140649.name: symbiont-mediated cell-to-cell migration by invasive hypha
GO:0140649.def: "The directional movement of a hyphal filament from one host cell to another. This process involves the clearance of plant-derived plasmodesmal occlusion materials, cytoskeleton based constriction of invasive hypha to traverse plasmodesmata. Septins and F-actin are reorganized into an hourglass shape at the point of maximum hyphal constriction." [PMID:29567712]

GO:0140650.name: radial glia-guided pyramidal neuron migration
GO:0140650.def: "The radial migration of a pyramidal neuron along radial glial cells." [PMID:3760547]

GO:0140651.name: futile creatine cycle
GO:0140651.def: "The phosphorylation and dephosphorylation of creatine in a futile cycle, which dissipates the high energy charge of phosphocreatine as heat without performing any mechanical or chemical work. The futile creatine cycle takes place in thermogenic fat cells and is part of adaptive thermogenesis." [PMID:33597756, PMID:33981039]

GO:0140652.name: pyripyropene A biosynthetic process
GO:0140652.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of pyripyropene A." [GOC:ach, PMID:21224862, PMID:26019565]

GO:0140654.name: tryprostatin A biosynthetic process
GO:0140654.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of tryprostatin A." [GOC:ach, PMID:19226505]

GO:0140656.name: endodeoxyribonuclease activator activity
GO:0140656.def: "Binds to and increases the activity of an endodeoxyribonuclease." [PMID:33836577]

GO:0140657.name: ATP-dependent activity
GO:0140657.def: "A molecular function characterized by the coupling of ATP hydrolysis to other steps of a reaction mechanism to make the reaction energetically favorable, for example to catalyze a reaction or drive transport against a concentration gradient." [PMID:24878343, PMID:25750732, PMID:32933017, PMID:33818025, PMID:33873056, PMID:33988324]

GO:0140658.name: ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler activity
GO:0140658.def: "An activity, driven by ATP hydrolysis, that modulates the contacts between histones and DNA, resulting in a change in chromosome architecture within the nucleosomal array, leading to chromatin remodeling." [PMID:14729263, PMID:19165147, PMID:21862382, PMID:30867599, PMID:34313222]

GO:0140659.name: cytoskeletal motor regulator activity
GO:0140659.def: "Binds to and modulates the activity of a motor protein." [PMID:23142046, PMID:33221250]

GO:0140660.name: cytoskeletal motor activator activity
GO:0140660.def: "Binds to and increases the activity of a motor protein." [PMID:33221250]

GO:0140661.name: cytoskeletal motor inhibitor activity
GO:0140661.def: "Binds to and stops, prevents, or reduces the activity of a motor protein." [PMID:23142046]

GO:0140662.name: ATP-dependent protein folding chaperone
GO:0140662.def: "Binding to a protein or a protein-containing complex to assist the protein folding process, driven by ATP hydrolysis." [PMID:27365453]

GO:0140663.name: ATP-dependent FeS chaperone activity
GO:0140663.def: "Binding to and delivering metal ions to a target protein, driven by ATP hydrolysis." [PMID:16843540]

GO:0140664.name: ATP-dependent DNA damage sensor activity
GO:0140664.def: "A molecule that recognises toxic DNA structures, and initiates a signaling response, driven by ATP hydrolysis." [PMID:33302090, PMID:33510387]

GO:0140665.name: ATP-dependent H3-H4 histone complex chaperone activity
GO:0140665.def: "A histone chaperone that carries a H3-H4 histone complex, driven by ATP hydrolysis." [PMID:31848341, PMID:33658433]

GO:0140666.name: annealing activity
GO:0140666.def: "An activity that facilitates the formation of a complementary double-stranded polynucleotide molecule." [PMID:22888405]

GO:0140667.name: regulation of oxytocin production
GO:0140667.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate, or extent of production of oxytocin." [PMID:25096581]

GO:0140668.name: positive regulation of oxytocin production
GO:0140668.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of production of oxytocin." [PMID:25096581]

GO:0140669.name: negative regulation of oxytocin production
GO:0140669.def: "Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the rate of production of oxytocin." [PMID:25096581]

GO:0140670.name: cohesin unloader activity
GO:0140670.def: "Facilitating a conformational change to unload a cohesin complex from sister chromatids." [PMID:26687354]

GO:0140671.name: ADA complex
GO:0140671.def: "A chromatin remodeling complex that regulates transcription via acetylation primarily of nucleosomal histones H3 and H2B. In budding yeast shares the histone acetylation (HAT) module of ADA2-GCN5-NGG1-SGF29 with the related SAGA complex." [GOC:bhm, PMID:21734642, PMID:28966424]

GO:0140672.name: ATAC complex
GO:0140672.def: "A chromatin remodeling complex that regulates transcription via acetylation primarily of nucleosomal histones H3 and possibly H4. Shares the histone acetylation (HAT) module of GCN5/PCAF-ADA2-ADA3-SGF29 (or orthologs) with the related SAGA complex (GO:0000124). Contains HAT subunits GCN5 or PCAF in a mutually exclusive manner. In addition to the HAT module contains DR1/NC2B, KAT14, MBIP, WDR5, YEATS2 and ZZZ3 or orthologs. Also regulates the activity of non-histone targets and orchestrates mitotic progression by regulating Cyclin A degradation through acetylation." [GOC:bhm, PMID:19936620, PMID:20562830, PMID:28966424]

GO:0140673.name: transcription elongation-coupled chromatin remodeling
GO:0140673.def: "A chromatin remodeling process that reestablishes the chromatin structure following the passage of RNA polymerase II during transcription elongation, thus preventing cryptic transcription initiation." [PMID:22922743, PMID:28053344]

GO:0140674.name: ATP-dependent histone chaperone activity
GO:0140674.def: "Binding to and carrying a histone or a histone complex to unload or deposit it as a nucleosome, driven by ATP hydrolysis." [PMID:26459557]

GO:0140676.name: oscillatory cAMP signaling
GO:0140676.def: "Fluctuation in the extracellular cAMP levels due to the alternate activation of adenylate cyclase, which produces cAMP, and phosphodiesterase, which degrades it. Occurs in Dictyostelium during early sorocarp development. Oscillation in signaling result is directional chemotaxis of cells towards the center of the aggregate." [PMID:18657484]

GO:0140677.name: molecular function activator activity
GO:0140677.def: "A molecular function regulator that activates or increases the activity of its target via non-covalent binding that does not result in covalent modification to the target." [GOC:curators]

GO:0140678.name: molecular function inhibitor activity
GO:0140678.def: "A molecular function regulator that inhibits or decreases the activity of its target via non-covalent binding that does not result in covalent modification to the target." [GOC:curators]

GO:0140679.name: ABC-type sodium transporter activity
GO:0140679.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + Na(in) = ADP + phosphate + Na(out)." [PMID:9106203]

GO:0140680.name: histone H3K36me/H3K36me2 demethylase activity
GO:0140680.def: "Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from a di- or a monomethyl-lysine residue at position 36 of the histone H3 protein. This is a dioxygenase reaction that is dependent on Fe(II) and 2-oxoglutarate." [PMID:20531378]

GO:0140681.name: histone H3K36me2/H3K36me3 demethylase activity
GO:0140681.def: "Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from a tri- or a dimethyl-lysine residue at position 36 of the histone H3 protein. This is a dioxygenase reaction that is dependent on Fe(II) and 2-oxoglutarate." [PMID:21914792]

GO:0140682.name: FAD-dependent H3K4me/H3K4me3 demethylase activity
GO:0140682.def: "Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from a di- or a monomethyl-lysine residue at position 4 of the histone H3 protein. This is a flavin adenine dinucleotide (FAD)-dependent amine oxidation reaction." [PMID:22473470]

GO:0140683.name: histone H3K9me/H3K9me2 demethylase activity
GO:0140683.def: "Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from a di or a monomethyl-lysine residue at position 9 of the histone H3 protein. This is a dioxygenase reaction that is dependent on Fe(II) and 2-oxoglutarate." [PMID:16603238]

GO:0140684.name: histone H3K9me2/H3K9me3 demethylase activity
GO:0140684.def: "Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from a tri or a dimethyl-lysine residue at position 9 of the histone H3 protein. This is a dioxygenase reaction that is dependent on Fe(II) and 2-oxoglutarate." [PMID:20208542, PMID:20531378]

GO:0140685.name: FAD-dependent histone H3K9me/H3K9me2 demethylase activity
GO:0140685.def: "Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from a di- or a monomethyl-lysine residue at position 9 of the histone H3 protein. This is a flavin adenine dinucleotide (FAD)-dependent amine oxidation reaction." [PMID:22473470]

GO:0140690.name: dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (NAD+) complex
GO:0140690.def: "A heteromultimeric complex capable of dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (NAD+); in E. coli, composed of PreA and PreT." [PMID:21169495, PMID:34097066]

GO:0140691.name: RNA folding chaperone
GO:0140691.def: "Binding to an RNA or an RNA-containing complex to assist the folding process." [PMID:31165735]

GO:0140692.name: very long-chain fatty acid omega-hydroxylase activity
GO:0140692.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: an omega-methyl-very-long-chain fatty acid + O2 + reduced [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] = an omega-hydroxy-very-long-chain fatty acid + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase]. A very long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing more than 22 carbons." [PMID:16547005, RHEA:67952]

GO:0140693.name: molecular condensate scaffold activity
GO:0140693.def: "Binding and bringing together two or more macromolecules in contact, permitting those molecules to organize as a molecular condensate." [PMID:28225081]

GO:0140694.name: membraneless organelle assembly
GO:0140694.def: "The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a non-membrane-bounded organelle." [PMID:28225081]

GO:0140696.name: (S)-2-hydroxyglutarate dehydrogenase activity
GO:0140696.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-2-hydroxyglutarate + a quinone = 2-oxoglutarate + a quinol." [PMID:30498244, RHEA:58664]

GO:0140698.name: attachment of telomeric heterochromatin to nuclear envelope
GO:0140698.def: "The process in which physical connections are formed between sub-telomeric heterochromatin and the nuclear envelope facilitating bouquet formation." [PMID:31635174]

GO:0140699.name: cyclic GMP-AMP synthase activity
GO:0140699.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + GTP = 2 diphosphate + cyclic GMP-AMP." [PMID:23258413]

GO:0140700.name: 3',2'-cyclic GMP-AMP synthase activity
GO:0140700.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + GTP = 2 diphosphate + cyclic G-P(3'-5')A-P(2'-5') (cyclic 3',2' GAMP)." [PMID:34261127]

GO:0140701.name: 3',3'-cyclic GMP-AMP synthase activity
GO:0140701.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + GTP = 2 diphosphate + cyclic G-P(3'-5')A-P(3'-5') (cyclic 3',3' GAMP)." [PMID:30787435, RHEA:35647]

GO:0140703.name: 3',3'-cyclic GMP-AMP binding
GO:0140703.def: "Binding to 3',3' cyclic GMP-AMP (cGAMP) nucleotide, a cyclic purine dinucleotide that consists of AMP and GMP units cyclized via 3',5' and 3',5' linkages." [PMID:30787435]

GO:0140704.name: 3',2'-cyclic GMP-AMP binding
GO:0140704.def: "Binding to 3',2' cyclic GMP-AMP (cGAMP) nucleotide, a cyclic purine dinucleotide that consists of AMP and GMP units cyclized via 3',5' and 2',5' linkages." [PMID:34261127]

GO:0140706.name: protein-containing complex localization to centriolar satellite
GO:0140706.def: "A protein-containing complex localization by which the complex is transported to, or maintained in, the centriolar satellite." [PMID:27979967]

GO:0140707.name: chromatin-nuclear membrane anchor activity
GO:0140707.def: "Binding to chromatin and the nuclear inner membrane, in order to establish and maintain the heterochromatin location and organization, or to enable equal segregation of the nuclear membrane during mitosis." [PMID:24184107, PMID:31048766]

GO:0140708.name: CAT tailing
GO:0140708.def: "The C-terminal elongation of 60S-anchored stalled nascent polypeptide chains with untemplated alanine and threonine tails (CAT tails). CAT tails participate in the recognition of stalled nascent chains by the ribosome quality control system." [PMID:25554787, PMID:32934225]

GO:0140709.name: Frizzled Nuclear Import pathway
GO:0140709.def: "A type of non-canonical Wnt signaling in which Wnt binding to its receptor on the surface a the target cell results in internalization and cleavage of the frizzled receptor to yield a C-terminal fragment that is imported into the nucleus. The frizzled C-terminal fragment is incorporated into large ribonucleoprotein particles and stimulates their egress via nuclear budding." [PMID:22510459, PMID:22579286]

GO:0140710.name: regulation of Frizzled Nuclear Import pathway
GO:0140710.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of a Frizzled Nuclear Import pathway." [PMID:22510459, PMID:22579286]

GO:0140711.name: positive regulation of Frizzled Nuclear Import pathway
GO:0140711.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of a Frizzled Nuclear Import pathway." [PMID:22510459, PMID:22579286]

GO:0140712.name: negative regulation of Frizzled Nuclear Import pathway
GO:0140712.def: "Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of a Frizzled Nuclear Import pathway." [PMID:22510459, PMID:22579286]

GO:0140713.name: histone chaperone activity
GO:0140713.def: "Binding to and carrying a histone or a histone complex to unload or deposit it as a nucleosome. The histone can be newly synthesized or result from nucleosome disassembly (either spontaneously, or by a histone chaperone)." [PMID:26459557]

GO:0140714.name: large ribosomal subunit pre-assembly complex
GO:0140714.def: "A protein complex that assists early maturation of nascent 60S ribosomal subunits. The complex interacts with the large ribosomal subunit rRNA via one of the components (Urb2 in S. cerevisiae) and requires a RNA helicase (Dbp6 in S. cerevisiae)." [GOC:lnp, PMID:17145778, PMID:9528757]

GO:0140715.name: serine-tRNA ligase complex
GO:0140715.def: "A heterodimeric enzyme complex that catalyzes the ligation of serine to tRNA(Ser), forming L-seryl-tRNA(Ser)." [PMID:30943413]

GO:0140717.name: entry into host through the stromata
GO:0140717.def: "Entry of a symbiont into host plant tissue via the stromata, microscopic pores in the epidermis of the aerial parts of terrestrial plants. These pores are essential for photosynthesis, as they allow CO2 to diffuse into the plant. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:16959560, PMID:17419713, PMID:29307013]

GO:0140718.name: facultative heterochromatin formation
GO:0140718.def: "The compaction of chromatin into a conformation that is refractory to transcription but that can be converted to euchromatin and allow transcription in specific contexts. These can be temporal (e.g., developmental states or specific cell-cycle stages), spatial (e.g., nuclear localization changes from the center to the periphery or vice versa due to exogenous factors/signals), or parental/heritable (e.g., monoallelic gene expression). In metazoa, this involves the methylation of histone H3K27." [PMID:17936700]

GO:0140719.name: constitutive heterochromatin formation
GO:0140719.def: "The compaction of chromatin into heterochromatin, a conformation that is refractory to transcription.
