Constitutive heterochromatin cannot be converted back to euchromatin, the transcriptionally-active conformation. In metazoa, this involves the methylation of histone H3K9." [PMID:17936700]

GO:0140720.name: subtelomeric heterochromatin
GO:0140720.def: "Heterochromatin that is located adjacent to the telomere, and characterized by methylated H3 histone at lysine 9 (H3K9me2/H3K9me3)." [PMID:34576871]

GO:0140721.name: nuclease inhibitor activity
GO:0140721.def: "Binds to and modulates the activity of a nuclease." [PMID:28785032, PMID:29554913, PMID:30046034]

GO:0140722.name: mycophenolic acid biosynthetic process
GO:0140722.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of mycophenolic acid (MPA). MPA is the first isolated antibiotic natural product in the world obtained from a culture of Penicillium brevicompactum in 1893." [PMID:21398490, PMID:26751579, PMID:31209052]

GO:0140723.name: patulin biosynthetic process
GO:0140723.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of patulin, an acetate-derived tetraketide mycotoxin produced by several fungal species that shows antimicrobial properties against several bacteria." [PMID:25120234, PMID:30680886]

GO:0140724.name: positive regulation of patulin biosynthetic process
GO:0140724.def: "Any process that increases the rate, frequency or extent of the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of patulin." [PMID:25625822]

GO:0140725.name: detoxification of free heme
GO:0140725.def: "Any process that reduces or removes the toxicity of free heme. These include transport of heme away from sensitive areas and to compartments or complexes whose purpose is sequestration of heme." [PMID:26741528, PMID:32983129]

GO:0140727.name: siRNA-mediated pericentric heterochromatin formation
GO:0140727.def: "The formation of pericentric heterochromatin by a process mediated by a small interfering RNA (siRNA)." [PMID:15289661]

GO:0140728.name: GC-box binding
GO:0140728.def: "Binding to a GC-box, a DNA motif with the consensus sequence GGGCGG that is located upstream of the start point of eukaryotic transcription units. The GC-box may occur in multiple copies or in either orientation relative to the transcription start site." [PMID:14701757]

GO:0140729.name: self-resistance to endogenously produced metabolite
GO:0140729.def: "A process that reduces or removes the toxicity of an endogenously produced substance. Mechanisms of resistance to endogenously produced compounds include modification the compound, export, sequestration, or mutations in the target enzyme." [PMID:21923907, PMID:29763292]

GO:0140730.name: amphiregulin production
GO:0140730.def: "The appearance of amphiregulin due to biosynthesis or secretion following a cellular stimulus, resulting in an increase in its intracellular or extracellular levels. Amphiregulin (AREG) is a ligand of the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR), a widely expressed transmembrane tyrosine kinase. AREG is synthesized as a membrane-anchored precursor protein that can engage in juxtacrine signaling on adjacent cells. Alternatively, after proteolytic processing by cell membrane proteases, mainly TACE/ADAM17, AREG is secreted and behaves as an autocrine or paracrine factor." [PMID:24463227]

GO:0140731.name: regulation of amphiregulin production
GO:0140731.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate, or extent of production of amphiregulin." [PMID:24463227]

GO:0140732.name: positive regulation of amphiregulin production
GO:0140732.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of production of amphiregulin." [PMID:24463227]

GO:0140733.name: tRNA ligase activator activity
GO:0140733.def: "Binds to and increases the activity of a tRNA ligase." [PMID:30943413]

GO:0140734.name: ammonium excretion
GO:0140734.def: "The elimination of ammonium ions from an excretory cell." [PMID:25740900]

GO:0140735.name: lovastatin biosynthetic process
GO:0140735.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of lovastatin (also known as mevinolin, mevacor or monacolin K), a hypolipidemic inhibitor of (3S)-hydroxymethylglutaryl-coenzyme A (HMG-CoA) reductase (HMGR)." [PMID:10334994, PMID:10381407]

GO:0140736.name: positive regulation of lovastatin biosynthetic process
GO:0140736.def: "Any process that increases the rate, frequency or extent of the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of lovastin." [PMID:10334994, PMID:19781329]

GO:0140737.name: encapsulin nanocompartment
GO:0140737.def: "Intracellular non-membrane bound organelle, consisting of proteinaceous polyhedral shells that encapsulate enzymes, protecting the contents from their surrounding milieu and/or the milieu from reactants in their interior. The self-assembling, 25-42 nm nanocompartment shell, unlike larger bacterial microcompartments, is made of only one protein, and has only a few proteins inside. Shells about vary from about 25-42 nm in diameter. The shell protein has an HK97-like fold and probably evolved from a viral protein. Artificial encapsulin nanocompartments can be expressed and filled with cargo proteins for biotechnological uses. They are found in many bacterial and a few archaeal phyla." [PMID:32918485]

GO:0140738.name: NLRP6 inflammasome complex
GO:0140738.def: "An inflammasome complex that consists of NLRP6, PYCARD/ASC and caspase-1 or caspase-4/caspase-11." [PMID:30674671, PMID:34678144]

GO:0140739.name: NLRP6 inflammasome complex assembly
GO:0140739.def: "The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a NLRP6 inflammasome complex." [PMID:30674671, PMID:34678144]

GO:0140740.name: ADP-riboxanase activity
GO:0140740.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-arginyl-[protein] + NAD+ = ADP-riboxanated L-argininyl-[protein] + H+ + NH4(+) + nicotinamide." [PMID:34671164, RHEA:69500]

GO:0140741.name: tRNA-uracil-4 sulfurtransferase activity
GO:0140741.def: "Catalyzes the reaction: ATP + [ThiI sulfur-carrier protein]-S-sulfanyl-L-cysteine + uracil in tRNA + 2 reduced ferredoxin [iron-sulfur] cluster = AMP + diphosphate + 4-thiouracil in tRNA + [ThiI sulfur-carrier protein]-L-cysteine + 2 oxidized ferredoxin [iron-sulfur] cluster." [PMID:27791189, PMID:5541999, RHEA:24176]

GO:0140742.name: lncRNA transcription
GO:0140742.def: "The transcription of lncRNAs, non-coding RNAs over 200 nucleotides in length, from a DNA template." [PMID:33767452, PMID:33913806]

GO:0140743.name: regulation of lncRNA transcription
GO:0140743.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the synthesis of a lncRNA." [PMID:33767452, PMID:33913806]

GO:0140744.name: negative regulation of lncRNA transcription
GO:0140744.def: "Any process that decreases the frequency, rate or extent of the synthesis of a lncRNA." [PMID:33767452, PMID:33913806]

GO:0140745.name: siRNA transcription
GO:0140745.def: "The transcription of a small interfering RNA from an RNA template." [PMID:23001036]

GO:0140746.name: siRNA catabolic process
GO:0140746.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of small interfering RNA transcripts (siRNAs)." [PMID:25928405]

GO:0140748.name: positive regulation of regulation of ascospore wall (1->3)-beta-D-glucan biosynthetic process
GO:0140748.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of ascospore wall (1->3)-beta-D-glucan biosynthetic process." [PMID:19189958]

GO:0140749.name: phlorizin hydrolase activity
GO:0140749.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: phlorizin + H2O = beta-D-glucose + phloretin." [PMID:9762914, RHEA:69639]

GO:0140750.name: nucleosome array spacer activity
GO:0140750.def: "A histone octamer slider activity that spaces nucleosomes along chromosomal DNA. This activity is involved in assembling chromatin in uniform nucleosome arrays to regulate transcription by RNA polymerases I, II, and III, as well as DNA replication, recombination and repair." [PMID:11683384, PMID:16468993]

GO:0140751.name: histone octamer slider activity
GO:0140751.def: "A chromatin remodeler activity that slides core histone octamers along chromosomal DNA." [PMID:10466730]

GO:0140752.name: branched 1,3-beta-D-glucan synthase activity
GO:0140752.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + [(1->3)-beta-D-glucosyl](n) = UDP + a branched [(1->3)-beta-D-glucosyl](n+1)." [PMID:34959732]

GO:0140753.name: linear 1,3-beta-D-glucan synthase activity
GO:0140753.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + [(1->3)-beta-D-glucosyl](n) = UDP + a linear [(1->3)-beta-D-glucosyl](n+1)." [PMID:34959732]

GO:0140754.name: reorganization of cellular membranes to establish viral sites of replication
GO:0140754.def: "A process in intracellular membranes are reorganized by viral proteins that perturb membrane integrity and can cause an extensive rearrangement of cellular membranes, forming membranous webs, which are thought to be the site of replication or certain viruses, for example the HPV virus." [PMID:19376974]

GO:0140755.name: reorganization of host cellular membranes to establish sites of replication
GO:0140755.def: "A process in which a virus triggers host intracellular membranes to be reorganized, forming membranous webs, which are thought to be the site of replication or certain viruses, for example the HPV virus." [PMID:34699787, PMID:4372566]

GO:0140756.name: structural constituent of proteasome
GO:0140756.def: "The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of the proteasome." [PMID:10500111, PMID:28525752, PMID:28583440, PMID:29652515]

GO:0140757.name: cysteine-type deNEDDylase activity
GO:0140757.def: "An thiol-dependent isopeptidase activity that cleaves NEDD8 from a target protein to which it is conjugated." [PMID:25628956]

GO:0140758.name: metal-dependent deNEDDylase activity
GO:0140758.def: "An metal-dependent isopeptidase activity that cleaves NEDD8 from a target protein to which it is conjugated." [PMID:25628956]

GO:0140759.name: histone H3K56 methyltransferase activity
GO:0140759.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + histone H3 L-lysine (position 56) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + histone H3 N6-methyl-L-lysine (position 56). This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the lysine residue at position 56 of the histone H3 protein." [PMID:23451023, PMID:28743002]

GO:0140760.name: histone H3K56me2/H3K56me3 demethylase activity
GO:0140760.def: "Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from a tri or a dimethyl-lysine residue at position 56 of the histone H3 protein." [PMID:23451023, PMID:28743002]

GO:0140761.name: calmodulin-activated 3',5'-cyclic-AMP phosphodiesterase activity
GO:0140761.def: "Catalysis of the reactions: nucleoside 3',5'-cyclic AMP + H2O = AMP + H+; this activity is activated by binding to calcium-bound calmodulin." [PMID:15901640]

GO:0140762.name: glucose dehydrogenase (FAD, quinone) activity
GO:0140762.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a quinone + D-glucose = a quinol + D-glucono-1,5-lactone." [RHEA:47372]

GO:0140763.name: programmed DNA elimination by elimination of internal DNA segments
GO:0140763.def: "A programmed DNA elimination mechanism in which specific sequences, namely, internal eliminated sequences (IES) and breakage eliminated sequences (BES) are removed from the genome. This process is known to occur in ciliates." [PMID:18708581]

GO:0140764.name: small RNA binding translational repressor activity
GO:0140764.def: "A translational repressor activity that binds to a single-stranded small regulatory RNA (either a miRNA or a siRNA) to guide it to its target mRNA." [PMID:27184117, PMID:34117606]

GO:0140765.name: histone H3K56 deacetylase activity, NAD-dependent
GO:0140765.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: histone H3 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 56) + NAD+ + H2O = histone H3 L-lysine (position 56) + 2''-O-acetyl-ADP-D-ribose + nicotinamide. This reaction transfers an acetyl group attached to a lysine residue in H3K56 to NAD, producing nicotinamide." [PMID:23911928, PMID:30374165]

GO:0140766.name: siRNA-mediated post-transcriptional gene silencing
GO:0140766.def: "A post-transcriptional gene silencing pathway in which small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) elicit silencing of specific target genes. siRNAs are 21-23 nucleotide RNA duplexes that are fully complementary to their target mRNA. siRNAs can be exported and act in other cells, including in germline cells. Once incorporated into a RNA-induced silencing complex (RISC), siRNAs can downregulate gene expression by either of two posttranscriptional mechanisms: endonucleolytic cleavage of the mRNA or mRNA translational repression. siRNAs are present in lower animals and plants, but not found in mammals; whereas miRNAs are present in all the animals and in plants." [PMID:26372022]

GO:0140767.name: enzyme-substrate adaptor activity
GO:0140767.def: "An adaptor that brings together an enzyme and its substrate. Adaptors recruit the substrate to its enzyme, thus contributing to substrate selection and specificity." [PMID:16250895, PMID:34358446]

GO:0140768.name: protein ADP-ribosyltransferase-substrate adaptor activity
GO:0140768.def: "An enzyme-substrate adaptor that bings together a protein ADP-ribosyl transferase and its substrate." [PMID:32028527]

GO:0140769.name: ACP-dependent peptidyl-lysine N6-myristoyltransferase activity
GO:0140769.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl-[protein] + tetradecanoyl-[ACP] = H+ + holo-[ACP] + N(6)-tetradecanoyl-L-lysyl-[protein]." [PMID:32461253, RHEA:70611]

GO:0140770.name: CoA-dependent peptidyl-lysine N6-myristoyltransferase activity
GO:0140770.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl-[protein] + tetradecanoyl-CoA = CoA + H+ + N(6)-tetradecanoyl-L-lysyl-[protein]." [PMID:1402651, RHEA:59752]

GO:0140771.name: ACP-dependent peptidyl-lysine N6-palmitoyltransferase activity
GO:0140771.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: hexadecanoyl-[ACP] + L-lysyl-[protein] = H+ + holo-[ACP] + N(6)-hexadecanoyl-L-lysyl-[protein]." [PMID:32461253, RHEA:70615]

GO:0140772.name: CoA-dependent peptidyl-lysine N6-palmitoyltransferase activity
GO:0140772.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl-[protein] + hexadecanoyl-CoA = CoA + H+ + N(6)-hexadecanoyl-L-lysyl-[protein]." [PMID:30061757]

GO:0140773.name: NAD-dependent protein demyristoylase activity
GO:0140773.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: N6-tetradecanoyl-L-lysyl-[protein] + NAD+ + H2O = tetradecanoyl-ADP-D-ribose + L-lysyl-[protein] + nicotinamide." [PMID:23552949, RHEA:70567]

GO:0140774.name: NAD-dependent protein depalmitoylase activity
GO:0140774.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: N6-octadecanoyl-L-lysyl-[protein] + NAD+ + H2O = octadecanoyl-ADP-D-ribose + L-lysyl-[protein] + nicotinamide." [PMID:23552949, RHEA:70563]

GO:0140775.name: actin filament debranching activity
GO:0140775.def: "Binding to an actin filament and promoting the dissociation of an actin filament branch." [PMID:20362448]

GO:0140776.name: protein-containing complex destabilizing activity
GO:0140776.def: "A molecular function that involves direct binding to one of the subunits of a protein-containing complex and promoting the dissociation of one or many subunits. This often happens by changing the conformation of the protein being bound, which decreases its affinity for the rest of the complex." [PMID:23727094, PMID:29779865, PMID:34836783]

GO:0140777.name: protein-containing complex stabilizing activity
GO:0140777.def: "A molecular function that involves direct binding to one of the subunits of a protein-containing complex, thus preventing an interaction with a factor that would promote dissociation of the complex." [PMID:34040253]

GO:0140778.name: microtubule stabilizing activity
GO:0140778.def: "A protein-containing complex stabilizing activity that prevents dissociation of microtubules." [PMID:34970964]

GO:0140779.name: XCL1 production
GO:0140779.def: "The appearance of XCL1 due to biosynthesis or secretion following a cellular stimulus, resulting in an increase in its intracellular or extracellular levels." [PMID:7973732]

GO:0140781.name: ilicicolin H biosynthetic process
GO:0140781.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of ilicicolin H, a 4-hydroxy-2-pyridone alkaloid that has potent and broad antifungal activities by inhibiting the mitochondrial respiration chain." [PMID:30905148, PMID:31216742, PMID:34947016]

GO:0140782.name: novofumigatonin biosynthetic process
GO:0140782.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of novofumigatonin, a heavily oxygenated meroterpenoid containing a unique orthoester moiety." [PMID:29968715]

GO:0140783.name: (M)-viriditoxin biosynthetic process
GO:0140783.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of (M)-viriditoxin, a fungal secondary metabolite with antibacterial activity." [PMID:31045362, PMID:31304040]

GO:0140784.name: metal ion sensor activity
GO:0140784.def: "Binding to and responding, e.g. by conformational change, to changes in the cellular level of a metal ion." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140785.name: amino acid sensor activity
GO:0140785.def: "Binding to and responding, e.g. by conformational change, to changes in the cellular level of an amino acid." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140786.name: glutamine sensor activity
GO:0140786.def: "Binding to and responding, e.g. by conformational change, to changes in the cellular level of glutamine." [PMID:34535752]

GO:0140787.name: phosphate ion uniporter activity
GO:0140787.def: "Catalysis of the active transport of a phosphate ion across a membrane by a mechanism involving conformational change, where energy for active transport is derived from membrane potential if the solute is charged." [PMID:29642010]

GO:0140788.name: L-glutamate uniporter activity
GO:0140788.def: "Catalysis of the active transport of a L-glutamate across a membrane by a mechanism involving conformational change, where energy for active transport is derived from membrane potential if the solute is charged." [PMID:27133463, PMID:29642010]

GO:0140789.name: histone phosphatase activity
GO:0140789.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a phosphorylated histone + H2O = a protein + phosphate." [PMID:19351884]

GO:0140791.name: histone H2AXS139 phosphatase activity
GO:0140791.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: histone H2AX serine phosphate (position 139) + H2O = histone H2AX serine (position 139) + phosphate." [PMID:18614045]

GO:0140793.name: histone H2AXY142 phosphatase activity
GO:0140793.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: histone H2AX tyrosine phosphate (position 142) + H2O = histone H2AX tyrosine (position 142) + phosphate." [PMID:19234442, PMID:19351884]

GO:0140794.name: histone arginine deiminase activity
GO:0140794.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + histone 3 L-arginyl = histone 3 L-citrullyl + NH4+, resulting in histone citrullination." [PMID:15339660]

GO:0140795.name: histone H3R2 arginine deiminase activity
GO:0140795.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + histone H3 L-arginyl (position 2)= histone H3 L-citrullyl (position 2) + NH4+, resulting in histone H3 citrullination at position 2." [PMID:15339660]

GO:0140796.name: histone H3R8 arginine deiminase activity
GO:0140796.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + histone H3 L-arginyl (position 8)= histone H3 L-citrullyl (position 8) + NH4+, resulting in histone H3 citrullination at position 8." [PMID:15339660]

GO:0140797.name: histone H3R17 arginine deiminase activity
GO:0140797.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + histone H3 L-arginyl (position 17)= histone H3 L-citrullyl (position 17) + NH4+, resulting in histone H3 citrullination at position 17." [PMID:15339660]

GO:0140798.name: histone H3R26 arginine deiminase activity
GO:0140798.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + histone H3 L-arginyl (position 26)= histone H3 L-citrullyl (position 26) + NH4+, resulting in histone H3 citrullination at position 26." [PMID:15339660]

GO:0140799.name: glycine:proton antiporter activity
GO:0140799.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: glycine(out) + H+(in) = glycine(in) + H+(out)." [PMID:16701208, PMID:26912364]

GO:0140800.name: gamma-aminobutyric acid:proton antiporter activity
GO:0140800.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: 4-aminobutanoate(out) + H+(in) = 4-aminobutanoate(in) + H+(out)." [PMID:16701208, PMID:26912364, PMID:27601664]

GO:0140801.name: histone H2AXY142 kinase activity
GO:0140801.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: histone H2AX-tyrosine (position 142) + ATP = (histone H2AX-phosphotyrosine (position 142) + ADP. This reaction is the addition of a phosphate group to the serine residue at position 142 of histone variant H2AX." [PMID:19092802]

GO:0140802.name: NAD+-protein-C-terminal glycine ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
GO:0140802.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: [protein]-C-terminal glycine + NAD+ = [protein]-C-terminal O-(ADP-D-ribosyl)-glycine + nicotinamide." [PMID:28525742, RHEA:58268]

GO:0140803.name: NAD+-protein-cysteine ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
GO:0140803.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-cysteinyl-[protein] + NAD+ = H+ + nicotinamide + S-(ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-cysteinyl-[protein]." [PMID:25043379, RHEA:56612]

GO:0140804.name: NAD+-protein-lysine ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
GO:0140804.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl-[protein] + NAD+ = H+ + N(6)-(ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-lysyl-[protein] + nicotinamide." [PMID:25043379, RHEA:58220]

GO:0140805.name: NAD+-protein-serine ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
GO:0140805.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-seryl-[protein] + NAD+ = H+ + nicotinamide + O-(ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-seryl-[protein]." [PMID:32028527, PMID:33186521, RHEA:58232]

GO:0140806.name: NAD+-protein-aspartate ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
GO:0140806.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartyl-[protein] + NAD+ = 4-O-(ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-aspartyl-[protein] + nicotinamide." [PMID:19764761, PMID:25043379, RHEA:54424]

GO:0140807.name: NAD+-protein-glutamate ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
GO:0140807.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamyl-[protein] + NAD+ = 5-O-(ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-glutamyl-[protein] + nicotinamide." [PMID:19764761, PMID:25043379, RHEA:58224]

GO:0140808.name: NAD+-protein-tyrosine ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
GO:0140808.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-tyrosyl-[protein] + NAD+ = H+ + nicotinamide + O-(ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-tyrosyl-[protein]." [PMID:29954836, PMID:30257210, RHEA:58236]

GO:0140809.name: histone H4R3 arginine deiminase activity
GO:0140809.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + histone H4 L-arginyl (position 3)= histone H4 L-citrullyl (position 3) + NH4+, resulting in histone H4 citrullination at position 3." [PMID:16567635]

GO:0140810.name: histone H1R54 arginine deiminase activity
GO:0140810.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + histone H1 L-arginyl (position 54)= histone H1 L-citrullyl (position 54) + NH4+, resulting in histone H1 citrullination at position 54." [PMID:24463520]

GO:0140811.name: histone H2AR3 arginine deiminase activity
GO:0140811.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + histone 2A L-arginyl (position 3)= histone 2A L-citrullyl (position 3) + NH4+, resulting in histone H2A citrullination at position 3." [PMID:15823041]

GO:0140812.name: orotate:monoatomic anion antiporter activity
GO:0140812.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: orotate(out) + anion (in) = orotate (in) + anion (out)." [PMID:21350910, PMID:35144162]

GO:0140813.name: urate:monoatomic anion antiporter activity
GO:0140813.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: urate(out) + anion (in) = urate (in) + anion (out)." [PMID:12024214, PMID:18411268]

GO:0140814.name: glycine betaine:sodium:chloride symporter activity
GO:0140814.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: glycine betaine(out) + Na+(out) + Cl-(out)= glycine betaine(in) + Na+(in) + Cl-(in)." [PMID:10358010]

GO:0140815.name: NAD+-protein-histidine ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
GO:0140815.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-histidyl-[protein] + NAD+ = H+ + Nt-(ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-histidyl-[protein] + nicotinamide." [PMID:35393539, RHEA:72071]

GO:0140816.name: NAD+-histone H2BS6 serine ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
GO:0140816.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of ADP-ribose groups to the serine-6 or an equivalent residue of the N-terminal tail of histone H2B." [PMID:34874266]

GO:0140817.name: NAD+-histone H3S10 serine ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
GO:0140817.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of ADP-ribose groups to the serine-10 or an equivalent residue of the N-terminal tail of histone H3." [PMID:34874266]

GO:0140818.name: mRNA 5'-triphosphate monophosphatase activity
GO:0140818.def: "A 5'-end triphospho-[mRNA] + H2O = a 5'-end diphospho-[mRNA] + H+ + phosphate." [PMID:9473487]

GO:0140819.name: UDP-beta-L-arabinofuranose transporter activity
GO:0140819.def: "Enables the transfer of UDP-beta-L-arabinofuranose from one side of a membrane to the other." [PMID:28373556]

GO:0140820.name: cytosol to Golgi apparatus transport
GO:0140820.def: "The directed movement of substances from the cytosol into the Golgi apparatus of a cell." [PMID:28373556]

GO:0140821.name: UDP-beta-L-arabinofuranose import into Golgi lumen
GO:0140821.def: "The directed movement of UDP-beta-L-arabinofuranose from the cytosol to the Golgi apparatus of a cell." [PMID:28373556]

GO:0140822.name: NAD+-histone H2BE35 glutamate ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
GO:0140822.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of ADP-ribose groups to the glutamate-35 residue of the N-terminal tail of histone H2B (or an equivalent residue)." [PMID:32822587]

GO:0140844.name: NAD+-histone H2BE2 glutamate ADP-ribosyltransferase activity

GO:0140845.name: regulation of promoter clearance from RNA polymerase II promoter

GO:0140849.name: ATP-dependent H2AZ histone chaperone activity
GO:0140849.def: "A histone chaperone that mediates the exchange of histone H2A-H2B dimer and histone H2AZ-H2B dimers in a nucleosome, driven by ATP hydrolysis. Some chaperones insert H2AZ-H2B dimers and remove H2A-H2B, while others do the opposite." [PMID:21241891, PMID:23580526, PMID:30309918]

GO:0140850.name: histone H2B C-terminal K residue ubiquitin ligase activity

GO:0140851.name: histone H3K14 ubiquitin ligase activity

GO:0140854.name: interleukin-19-mediated signaling pathway
GO:0140854.def: "The series of molecular signals initiated by interleukin-19 binding to its receptor on the surface of a target cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription." [PMID:34052656]

GO:0140855.name: histone H3S57 kinase activity

GO:0140856.name: histone H2AK13 ubiquitin ligase activity

GO:0140858.name: histone H2AK15 ubiquitin ligase activity

GO:0140859.name: pterocarpan synthase activity

GO:0140860.name: (3R)-2'-hydroxyisoflavanone reductase (NADP+) activity

GO:0140861.name: DNA repair-dependent chromatin remodeling

GO:0140866.name: interleukin-20-mediated signaling pathway
GO:0140866.def: "The series of molecular signals initiated by interleukin-20 binding to its receptor on the surface of a target cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription." [PMID:34755534]

GO:0140867.name: NAD+-histone H2BE18 glutamate ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
GO:0140867.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of ADP-ribose groups to the glutamate-18 residue of histone H2B (or an equivalent residue)." [PMID:28252050]

GO:0140869.name: miRNA inhibitor activity via base-pairing
GO:0140869.def: "Stops, prevents or reduces the activity of miRNA-mediated gene silencing activity by base-pairing with a target miRNA. An example of this activity is mediated by long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs)." [PMID:34454184]

GO:0140872.name: viridicatumtoxin biosynthetic process

GO:0140873.name: paxilline biosynthetic process

GO:0140874.name: paraherquonin biosynthetic process
GO:0140874.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of paraherquonin, a meroterpenoid with a unique, highly congested hexacyclic molecular architecture." [PMID:27602587]

GO:0140875.name: PR-toxin biosynthetic process
GO:0140875.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of PR-toxin, a bicyclic sesquiterpene belonging to the eremophilane class and acting as a mycotoxin." [PMID:24239699, PMID:27921136]

GO:0140876.name: andrastin A biosynthetic process
GO:0140876.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of andrastin A, a meroterpenoid that exhibits inhibitory activity against ras farnesyltransferase, suggesting that it could have promising antitumor activity." [DOI:10.1016/j.tet.2013.07.029]

GO:0140877.name: mevastatin biosynthetic process
GO:0140877.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of mevastatin , also known as compactin or ML-236B, and which acts as a potent competitive inhibitor of HMG-CoA reductase." [PMID:12172803, PMID:12242508]

GO:0140878.name: griseofulvin biosynthetic process

GO:0140879.name: conidiogenone biosynthetic process

GO:0140882.name: zinc export across plasma membrane

GO:0140883.name: symbiont-mediated activation of host reticulophagy

GO:0140884.name: symbiont-mediated suppression of host type II interferon-mediated signaling pathway

GO:0140885.name: symbiont-mediated suppression of host type III interferon-mediated signaling pathway

GO:0140886.name: symbiont-mediated suppression of host interferon-mediated signaling pathway
GO:0140886.def: "Any process in which a virus stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of interferon-mediated signaling in the host organism." [PMID:31266861, PMID:33097660, PMID:34305858]

GO:0140887.name: positive regulation of nucleosome disassembly
GO:0140887.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of the controlled breakdown of nucleosomes, the beadlike structural units of eukaryotic chromatin composed of histones and DNA." [PMID:34471130, PMID:35308047]

GO:0140888.name: interferon-mediated signaling pathway
GO:0140888.def: "The series of molecular signals initiated by type II interferon binding to its receptor on the surface of a target cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription. Type II interferon is also known as interferon-gamma." [GOC:add, GOC:dph, GOC:signaling, PMID:32464097]

GO:0140889.name: DNA replication-dependent chromatin disassembly
GO:0140889.def: "The disruption of nucleosomes during DNA replication to allow the replication machinery to access the DNA." [PMID:34471130, PMID:35308047]

GO:0140890.name: H1 histone chaperone activity

GO:0140891.name: tRNA-derived regulatory ncRNA processing

GO:0140892.name: sodium,bicarbonate:chloride antiporter activity

GO:0140894.name: endolysosomal toll-like receptor signaling pathway

GO:0140895.name: cell surface toll-like receptor signaling pathway
GO:0140895.def: "The series of molecular signals initiated by a ligand binding to a cell surface pattern recognition receptor (PRR) of the toll-like family." [GOC:add, GOC:ar, ISBN:0781735149, PMID:15199967]

GO:0140896.name: cGAS/STING signaling pathway
GO:0140896.def: "The series of molecular signals initiated by the binding of a double-stranded DNA or RNA from another organism to cytosolic cyclic GMP-AMP (cGAMP) synthase (cGAS) that activates innate immune responses through production of the second messenger cGAMP, which activates the adaptor STING." [PMID:27648547, PMID:34261127, PMID:34261128]

GO:0140897.name: mechanoreceptor activity

GO:0140898.name: CENP-A eviction from euchromatin

This includes the production of an RNA transcript as well as any processing to produce a mature RNA product or an mRNA or circRNA (for protein-coding genes) and the translation of that mRNA or circRNA into protein. Protein maturation is included when required to form an active form of a product from an inactive precursor form." [PMID:28377785]

GO:0140900.name: chloride:bicarbonate antiporter activity
GO:0140900.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: chloride(in) + HCO3-(out) = chloride(out) + HCO3-(in)." [PMID:10428871, PMID:16606687, RHEA:72203]

GO:0140901.name: L-asparagine:sodium symporter activity

GO:0140902.name: L-glutamine:sodium symporter activity

GO:0140904.name: cytoophidium organization

GO:0140905.name: haloperoxidase activity

GO:0140914.name: zinc ion import into secretory vesicle

GO:0140915.name: zinc ion import into zymogen granule

GO:0140916.name: zinc ion import into lysosome

GO:0140917.name: zinc ion import into mitochondrion

GO:0140919.name: thermomorphogenesis

GO:0140920.name: regulation of thermomorphogenesis
GO:0140920.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of thermomorphogenesis." [PMID:27250752]

GO:0140921.name: negative regulation of thermomorphogenesis
GO:0140921.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of thermomorphogenesis." [PMID:27250752]

GO:0140922.name: positive regulation of thermomorphogenesis
GO:0140922.def: "Any process that increases the rate, frequency or extent of thermomorphogenesis." [PMID:27250752]

GO:0140923.name: magnetosome assembly
GO:0140923.def: "The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a magnetosome. Magnetosomes are specialized organelles for magnetic navigation that comprise membrane-enveloped, nano-sized crystals of a magnetic iron mineral; they are formed by a diverse group of magnetotactic bacteria (MTB)." [PMID:19575557, PMID:34723168]

GO:0140924.name: L-kynurenine transmembrane transport
GO:0140924.def: "The directed movement of L-kynurenine across a membrane." [PMID:35245456]

GO:0140925.name: L-phenylalanine import across plasma membrane
GO:0140925.def: "The directed movement of L-phenylalanine from outside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the cytosol." [PMID:11069779]

GO:0140926.name: L-kynurenine transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0140926.def: "Enables the transfer of L-kynurenine from one side of a membrane to the other." [PMID:35245456]

GO:0140927.name: cyclic-di-GMP transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0140927.def: "Enables the transfer of cyclic-di-GMP from one side of a membrane to the other." [PMID:34965418]

GO:0140928.name: inhibition of non-skeletal tissue mineralization
GO:0140928.def: "A homeostatic process involved in the maintenance of non-mineral tissue, by preventing mineralization of non-skeletal tissue." [PMID:21490328, PMID:30030150]

GO:0140929.name: mannose:sodium symporter activity
GO:0140929.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: D-mannose(out) + Na+(out) = D-mannose(in) + Na+(in)." [PMID:22212718, PMID:23451068, PMID:24573086]

GO:0140930.name: fructose:sodium symporter activity
GO:0140930.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: D-fructose(out) + Na+(out) = D-fructose(in) + Na+(in)." [PMID:22212718, PMID:23451068]

GO:0140931.name: neutral L-amino acid:sodium:chloride symporter activity
GO:0140931.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: neutral L-amino acid(out) + Na+(out) + Cl-(out) = neutral L-amino acid(in) + Na+(in)+ Cl-(in)." [PMID:19478081]

GO:0140932.name: 5'-(N(7)-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-[mRNA] diphosphatase activity
GO:0140932.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 5'-end (N2,N2,N7-trimethyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-ribonucleoside in mRNA + H2O = a 5'-end diphospho-ribonucleoside in mRNA + 2 H+ + N7-methyl-GMP. Can also use (N7-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-ribonucleoside in mRNA as a substrate." [PMID:24742626, PMID:32723815]

GO:0140933.name: 5'-(N(7)-methylguanosine 5'-triphospho)-[mRNA] hydrolase activity
GO:0140933.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 5'-end (N7-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-ribonucleoside in mRNA + H2O = a 5'-end phospho-ribonucleoside in mRNA + N7-methyl-GDP + H+." [PMID:18820299, PMID:29483298]

GO:0140934.name: histone deubiquitinase activity
GO:0140934.def: "A deubiquitinase that cleaves ubiquitin from a histone protein to which it is conjugated." [PMID:18206972, PMID:18226187]

GO:0140935.name: histone H2B conserved C-terminal lysine deubiquitinase activity
GO:0140935.def: "A histone deubiquitinase that cleaves ubiquitin from the conserved C-terminal lysine residue of a histone H2B protein to which it is conjugated. The conserved lysine residue is K119 in fission yeast, K123 in budding yeast, and K120 in mammals." [PMID:15657442]

GO:0140936.name: histone H2B deubiquitinase activity
GO:0140936.def: "A histone deubiquitinase that cleaves ubiquitin from a histone H2B protein to which it is conjugated." [PMID:18206972, PMID:29352077]

GO:0140937.name: histone H4K12 deacetylase activity, hydrolytic mechanism
GO:0140937.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: histone H4 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 12) + H2O = histone H4 L-lysine (position 12) + acetate. This reaction represents the removal of an acetyl group from lysine at position 12 of the histone H4 protein." [GOC:vw, PMID:15293224]

GO:0140938.name: histone H3 methyltransferase activity
GO:0140938.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + a histone H3 = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + a methylated histone H3. Histone methylation generally occurs on either an arginine or a lysine residue." [PMID:28450737]

GO:0140939.name: histone H4 methyltransferase activity
GO:0140939.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + a histone H4 = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + a methylated histone H4. Histone methylation generally occurs on either an arginine or a lysine residue." [PMID:28450737]

GO:0140940.name: histone H2A methyltransferase activity
GO:0140940.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + a histone H2 = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + a methylated histone H2A. Histone methylation generally occurs on either an arginine or a lysine residue." [PMID:28450737]

GO:0140941.name: histone H4K20me methyltransferase activity
GO:0140941.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-methyl-L-lysyl(20)-[histone H4] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N(6),N(6)-dimethyl-L-lysyl(20)-[histone H4] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the monomethylated lysine residue at position 20 of histone H4, producing H4K20me2." [RHEA:60348]

GO:0140942.name: histone H3K9 dimethyltransferase activity
GO:0140942.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl9-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N6,N6-dimethyl-L-lysyl9-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of two methyl groups to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 9 of histone H3, producing histone H3K9me2." [RHEA:64444]

GO:0140943.name: histone H4K20 trimethyltransferase activity
GO:0140943.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl(20)-[histone H4] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3 H+ + N(6),N(6),N(6)-trimethyl-L-lysyl(20)-[histone H4] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the addition of three methyl groups to the lysine residue at position 20 of the histone H4 protein, producing histone H4K20me3." [RHEA:64456]

GO:0140944.name: histone H4K20 monomethyltransferase activity
GO:0140944.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl20-[histone H4] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N6-methyl-L-lysyl20-[histone H4] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 20 of histone H4, producing histone H4K20me." [RHEA:60344]

GO:0140945.name: histone H3K4 monomethyltransferase activity
GO:0140945.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl4-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N6-methyl-L-lysyl4-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the addition of a single methyl group to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 4 of histone H3, producing histone H3K4me." [RHEA:60264]

GO:0140946.name: histone H3K4 dimethyltransferase activity
GO:0140946.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl4-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N6,N6-dimethyl-L-lysyl4-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of two methyl groups to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 4 of histone H3, producing histone H3K4me2." [RHEA:64448]

GO:0140947.name: histone H3K9me2 methyltransferase activity
GO:0140947.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: N6,N6-dimethyl-L-lysyl9-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N6,N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysyl9-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the addition of a single methyl group to the dimethylated lysine residue at position 9 of histone H3, producing histone H3K9me3." [RHEA:60288]

GO:0140948.name: histone H3K9 monomethyltransferase activity
GO:0140948.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl9-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N6-methyl-L-lysyl9-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 9 of histone H3, producing histone H3K9me." [RHEA:60280]

GO:0140949.name: histone H3K9 trimethyltransferase activity
GO:0140949.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl9-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3 H+ + N6,N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysyl9-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of three methyl groups to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 9 of histone H3, producing histone H3K9me3." [RHEA:60276]

GO:0140950.name: histone H2A deubiquitinase activity
GO:0140950.def: "A histone deubiquitinase that cleaves ubiquitin from a histone H2A protein to which it is conjugated." [PMID:18226187, PMID:20436459]

GO:0140951.name: histone H3K27 trimethyltransferase activity
GO:0140951.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl27-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3 H+ + N6,N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysyl27-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of three methyl groups to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 27 of histone H3, producing histone H3K27me3." [RHEA:60292]

GO:0140952.name: histone H3K27 dimethyltransferase activity
GO:0140952.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl27-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N6,N6-dimethyl-L-lysyl27-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of two methyl groups to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 27 of histone H3, producing histone H3K27me2." [RHEA:64452]

GO:0140953.name: histone H3K27 monomethyltransferase activity
GO:0140953.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl27-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N6-methyl-L-lysyl27-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the addition of a single methyl group to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 27 of histone H3, producing histone H3K27me." [RHEA:60296]

GO:0140954.name: histone H3K36 dimethyltransferase activity
GO:0140954.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl36-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N6,N6-dimethyl-L-lysyl36-[histone H3] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of two methyl groups to the lysine residue at position 36 of histone H3, producing histone H3K36me2." [RHEA:60308]

GO:0140955.name: histone H3K36 trimethyltransferase activity
GO:0140955.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl36-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3 H+ + N6,N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysyl36-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of three methyl groups to the lysine residue at position 36 of histone H3, producing histone H3K36me3." [RHEA:60324]

GO:0140956.name: histone H3K79 trimethyltransferase activity
GO:0140956.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl79-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3 H+ + N6,N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysyl79-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of up to three methyl group to the lysine residue at position 79 of the histone H3 protein, producing H3K79me3." [PMID:15371351, RHEA:60328]

GO:0140958.name: target-directed miRNA degradation
GO:0140958.def: "The process in which a miRNA is targeted for degradation by a non-coding RNA or mRNA. The binding of an RNA to a target miRNA within a RISC complex results in either ubiquitin-mediated degradation of AGO protein or the displacement of the 3' end of the miRNA, exposing it to nucleases." [PMID:33184237, PMID:36150386]

GO:0140961.name: cellular detoxification of metal ion
GO:0140961.def: "Any process carried out at the cellular level that reduces or removes the toxicity of a metal ion." [PMID:26729300, PMID:33046888, PMID:34442707]

GO:0140962.name: multicellular organismal-level chemical homeostasis
GO:0140962.def: "A homeostatic process involved in the maintenance of a steady state level of a chemical within extracellular body fluids, such as blood, xylem or phloem, of a multicellular organism. This is distinct from maintenance of cellular homeostasis, which occurs within a cell." [GOC:curators]

GO:0140964.name: intracellular auxin homeostasis
GO:0140964.def: "A homeostatic process involved in the maintenance of a steady state level of auxin within a cell." [PMID:19506555, PMID:22314799]

GO:0140965.name: secondary piRNA processing
GO:0140965.def: "A process leading to the generation of a functional secondary piRNA, involving a self-perpetuating piRNA loop, often called the ping-pong cycle, in which piRNAs are amplified by pairing with complementary transcripts (for example the transposable element mRNA target). In Drosophila, the processing involves the piwi proteins aubergine and Argonaute 3 and in mice, the piwi proteins Piwil2 and Piwil4." [PMID:29281264, PMID:32895365]

GO:0140966.name: piRNA-mediated heterochromatin formation
GO:0140966.def: "The formation of heterochromatin into a heterochromatin domain, enriched in histone H3 methylated on lysine 9 (H3K9me), by a process mediated by a Piwi-associated RNA (piRNA)." [PMID:23329111]

GO:0140967.name: manganese import into cell
GO:0140967.def: "The directed movement of mangnanese ions from outside of a cell into a cell." [PMID:22773749]

GO:0140968.name: polyspecific organic cation:proton antiporter activity
GO:0140968.def: "Enables the transfer of various organic cations in exchange for a proton, according to the reaction: H+(out) + organic cation(in) = H+(in) + organic cation(out). The transported substrates are usually toxic molecules, drugs and xenobiotics." [PMID:17047166, PMID:17509534]

GO:0140969.name: determination of lung left/right asymmetry
GO:0140969.def: "Determination of the asymmetric location of the lungs with respect to the left and right halves of the organism." [GOC:BHFL, GOC:rl, PMID:19944405, PMID:20007846, PMID:21131974]

GO:0140970.name: AIM2 inflammasome complex assembly
GO:0140970.def: "The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form the AIM2 inflammasome complex." [PMID:33467177]

GO:0140971.name: regulation of AIM2 inflammasome complex assembly
GO:0140971.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of AIM2 inflammasome complex assembly." [PMID:33467177]

GO:0140972.name: negative regulation of AIM2 inflammasome complex assembly
GO:0140972.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of AIM2 inflammasome complex assembly." [PMID:33467177]

GO:0140973.name: positive regulation of AIM2 inflammasome complex assembly
GO:0140973.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of AIM2 inflammasome complex assembly." [PMID:33467177]

GO:0140974.name: cellular detoxification of sulfide
GO:0140974.def: "Any process carried out at the cellular level that reduces or removes the toxicity of a sulfide. These may include chemical modification or transport of sulfide away from sensitive areas and to compartments or complexes whose purpose is sequestration of the toxic substance." [PMID:20077566, PMID:25747485]

GO:0140975.name: disruption of cellular anatomical structure in another organism
GO:0140975.def: "The disruption of a cellular component of another organism, leading to damage or temporary subversion of that structure. In some cases this can cause malfunctioning of the cells and death of the target organism." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140976.name: host defense response against symbiont-mediated perturbation of plasma membrane integrity
GO:0140976.def: "The cellular processes and signaling pathways by which a cell responds to disruption of the integrity of its plasma membrane by another organism. Some toxins produced by other organisms can form pores in membranes, or affect the membrane permeability." [PMID:17234446, PMID:21518219]

GO:0140977.name: cellular detoxification of acetone
GO:0140977.def: "Any process carried out at the cellular level that reduces or removes the toxicity of acetone. These may include chemical modification, for example to methylglyoxal." [PMID:22314896, PMID:26958851]

GO:0140978.name: mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit binding
GO:0140978.def: "Binding to a mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit." [PMID:28892042]

GO:0140979.name: intracellular nucleotide homeostasis
GO:0140979.def: "A homeostatic process involved in the maintenance of a steady state level of nucleotides within a cell." [PMID:23416111, PMID:34880500]

GO:0140980.name: intracellular nucleoside homeostasis
GO:0140980.def: "A homeostatic process involved in the maintenance of a steady state level of nucleosides within a cell." [PMID:23416111, PMID:34880500]

GO:0140981.name: medium-chain fatty acid omega-hydroxylase activity
GO:0140981.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: an omega-methyl-medium-chain fatty acid + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = an omega-hydroxy-medium-chain fatty acid + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase]. A medium-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 6 to 12 carbons." [RHEA:75279]

GO:0140982.name: detoxification of aluminum ion
GO:0140982.def: "Any process that reduce or remove the toxicity of aluminum ions. These can include transport of the aluminum away from sensitive areas, sequesteration, or chemical modification to an inert form." [PMID:10845450, PMID:23888867, PMID:9576769]

GO:0140983.name: calcium:manganese antiporter activity
GO:0140983.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: Ca2+(in) + Mn2+(out) = Ca2+(out) + Mn2+(in)." [PMID:30755481]

GO:0140984.name: histone H4K12 methyltransferase activity
GO:0140984.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + histone H4 L-lysine (position 12) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + histone H4 N6-methyl-L-lysine (position 12). This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the lysine residue at position 12 of the histone H4 protein." [PMID:12086618]

GO:0140985.name: G protein-coupled chemorepellent receptor activity
GO:0140985.def: "Combining with a chemorepellent and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein; promotes the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G-protein complex." [PMID:30462573]

GO:0140986.name: G protein-coupled chemorepellent receptor signaling pathway
GO:0140986.def: "A G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway initiated by a chemorepellent binding to its receptor on the surface of a target cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. cytoskeleton reorganization." [PMID:30462573]

GO:0140987.name: ATP:phosphate antiporter activity
GO:0140987.def: "Enables the transfer of ATP from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP(out) + phosphate(in) = ATP(in) + phosphate(out)." [PMID:15123600]

GO:0140988.name: ADP:phosphate antiporter activity
GO:0140988.def: "Enables the transfer of ADP from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ADP(out) + phosphate(in) = ADP(in) + phosphate(out)." [PMID:15123600]

GO:0140989.name: 7-deoxyloganate 7-hydroxylase activity
GO:0140989.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 7-deoxyloganate + O2 + reduced [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] = H+ + H2O + loganate + oxidized [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase]." [PMID:24710322, RHEA:57576]

GO:0140990.name: primary piRNA processing
GO:0140990.def: "The process involved in converting precursor piRNAs into non-overlapping, contiguous primary piRNAs (approximately 24-30-nt piRNAs with a preference for a 5' uridine (U) via the endonucleolytic activity of cytosolic PIWI. This may include pre-piRNA maturation of 3' ends by trimming and 2'-O-methylation." [PMID:22907665, PMID:26166577, PMID:34469728]

GO:0140991.name: piRNA-mediated gene silencing by mRNA destabilization
GO:0140991.def: "A cytoplasmic post-transcriptional gene silencing pathway in which piRNAs direct the cleavage of target mRNAs. The target mRNA, often transcribed from a transposable element, is destabilized by the activity of a PIWI class endonuclease within the piRNA-induced silencing complex. This may also be accompanied by mRNA deadenylation and decapping." [PMID:29281264, PMID:33419460]

GO:0140993.name: histone modifying activity
GO:0140993.def: "A catalytic activity that acts on a histone protein. Reversible histone modifications contribute to regulation of gene expression." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140994.name: RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat modifying activity
GO:0140994.def: "A catalytic activity that acts on the RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat (consensus YSPTSPS). Reversible modifications cof the RNA polymerase II CTD repeats contribute to regulation of RNA polymerase activity." [GOC:pg]

GO:0140995.name: histone H2A kinase activity
GO:0140995.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group to a histone H2A." [PMID:25303536]

GO:0140996.name: histone H3 kinase activity
GO:0140996.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group to a histone H3." [PMID:25303536]

GO:0140997.name: histone H4 kinase activity
GO:0140997.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group to a histone H4." [PMID:25303536]

GO:0140998.name: histone H2B kinase activity
GO:0140998.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group to a histone H2B." [PMID:25303536]

GO:0140999.name: histone H3K4 trimethyltransferase activity
GO:0140999.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl4-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysyl4-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of three methyl groups to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 4 of histone H3, producing histone H3K4me3." [PMID:18375658, RHEA:60260]

GO:0141000.name: histone H4K91 ubiquitin ligase activity
GO:0141000.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of a ubiquitin molecule to histone 4 at the lysine-91 residue." [PMID:19818714]

GO:0141002.name: histone H4K16 propionyltransferase activity
GO:0141002.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: histone H4 L-lysine (position 16) + propionyl-CoA = CoA + H+ + histone H3 N6-propionyl-L-lysyl (position 16)." [PMID:17267393, PMID:29321206, PMID:31794431]

GO:0141003.name: histone H2AX kinase activity
GO:0141003.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group to a histone variant H2AX." [GOC:bf]

GO:0141005.name: transposable element silencing by heterochromatin formation
GO:0141005.def: "A transposable element silencing mechanism involving heterochromatin assembly. Heterochromatin is a chromatin conformation that is refractory to transcription." [PMID:25247314, PMID:28951459, PMID:32823517]

GO:0141006.name: transposable element silencing by piRNA-mediated heterochromatin formation
GO:0141006.def: "A transposable element silencing mechanism in which a Piwi-associated RNA (piRNA) triggers heterochromatin assembly. Heterochromatin is a chromatin conformation that is refractory to transcription." [PMID:32381626, PMID:32674113]

GO:0141007.name: transposable element silencing by siRNA-mediated heterochromatin formation
GO:0141007.def: "A transposable element silencing mechanism in which a siRNA triggers heterochromatin assembly. Heterochromatin is a chromatin conformation that is refractory to transcription." [PMID:36570931]

GO:0141008.name: transposable element silencing by mRNA destabilization
GO:0141008.def: "A transposable element silencing mechanism in which mRNAs transcribed from transposons are targeted for degradation." [GOC:curators]

GO:0141009.name: transposable element silencing by piRNA-mediated mRNA destabilization
GO:0141009.def: "A transposable element silencing mechanism in which mRNAs transcribed from transposons are targeted for degradation by a Piwi-associated RNA (piRNA)." [PMID:22121019]

GO:0141010.name: transposable element silencing by siRNA-mediated DNA methylation
GO:0141010.def: "A transposable element silencing mechanism mediated by RNA-directed DNA methylation. RNA-directed DNA methylation is a gene silencing process in which small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) guide DNA methylation to the siRNA-generating genomic loci and other loci that are homologous to the siRNAs for de novo DNA methylation. This results in a heterochromatin assembly, a chromatin conformation that is refractory to transcription." [PMID:28633017, PMID:32381626, PMID:32719317, PMID:36570931]

GO:0141011.name: transposable element silencing by siRNA-mediated mRNA destabilization
GO:0141011.def: "A transposable element silencing mechanism in which mRNAs transcribed from transposons are targeted for degradation by a siRNA." [PMID:36570931]

GO:0141013.name: purine nucleotide import into lysosome
GO:0141013.def: "The directed import of purine nucleotide from the cytosol, across the lysosomal membrane, into the lysosome." [PMID:18375752, PMID:23876310]

GO:0141014.name: ribosome hibernation
GO:0141014.def: "A cellular process that results in the silencing of ribosomes in quiescent cells. Quiescence takes place when cells encounter unfavorable conditions and cease to grow in bacteria and yeast. It also takes place in some specialized cells in higher eukaryotes, such as eggs. Ribosomes in a hibernation state are kept silent via association with proteins with inhibitory and protective functions." [PMID:28468753, PMID:30177741, PMID:36653451]

GO:0141016.name: G/T mismatch-specific thymine-DNA glycosylase activity
GO:0141016.def: "Hydrolyzes mismatched double-stranded DNA and polynucleotides, releasing free thymine and leaving an apyrimidinic (AP) site." [EC:3.2.2.29, PMID:12711670]

GO:0141017.name: effector-mediated induction of cell cycle reactivation in host
GO:0141017.def: "A symbiont process in which a molecule secreted by the symbiont reactivates the host cell cycle, resulting in DNA synthesis and host cell division, and contributing to vegetative tumor formation." [PMID:25888589]

GO:0141018.name: adhesion of symbiont to host via host extracellular matrix
GO:0141018.def: "The attachment of a symbiont to its host by binding to a component of the host extracellular matrix. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:15228540, PMID:21270401, PMID:23586629]

GO:0141023.name: symbiont-mediated disruption of host cell-cell adhesion
GO:0141023.def: "A process in which a symbiont alters or subverts host cell adhesion ito its extracellular matrix. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [GOC:curators]

GO:0141024.name: adhesion of symbiont to host cell surface via host membrane carbohydrate
GO:0141024.def: "The attachment of a symbiont to its host by binding to a carbohydrate on the host cell surface. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:15210807, PMID:19527885, PMID:30736336]

GO:0141025.name: adhesion of symbiont to host cell surface via host glycoprotein
GO:0141025.def: "The attachment of a symbiont to its host by binding to a glycoprotein on the host cell surface. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:12010488, PMID:15487949, PMID:17630833, PMID:29184850]

GO:0141026.name: adhesion of symbiont to host cell surface via host membrane cholesterol
GO:0141026.def: "The attachment of a symbiont to its host by binding to cholesterol on the host cell surface. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:17557817, PMID:23239883]

GO:0141027.name: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host actin cytoskeleton
GO:0141027.def: "The process in which an organism effects a change that impairs the structure or function of the host actin cytoskeleton. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:20688909]

GO:0141028.name: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host microtubule cytoskeleton
GO:0141028.def: "The process in which an organism effects a change that impairs the structure or function of the host microtubule cytoskeleton. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:21692747, PMID:26220855]

GO:0141029.name: symbiont-mediated disruption of host focal adhesion
GO:0141029.def: "A process in which a symbiont alters or subverts focal adhesion in its host. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:19489119, PMID:24573681, PMID:24905543]

GO:0141030.name: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host actin cytoskeleton via filamentous actin depolymerization
GO:0141030.def: "The process in which an organism effects a change that impairs the structure or function of the host actin cytoskeleton by depolymerizing the host filamentous actin. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:11889090, PMID:28800062]

GO:0141031.name: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host actin cytoskeleton via actin crosslinking
GO:0141031.def: "The process in which an organism effects a change that impairs the structure or function of the host actin cytoskeleton by actin crosslinking the host actin filaments. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:14512630, PMID:22814176]

GO:0141032.name: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host actin cytoskeleton via actin filament reorganization
GO:0141032.def: "The process in which an organism effects a change that impairs the structure or function of the host actin cytoskeleton by reorganizing the actin filaments, in a way that keeps the total filementous actin remains approximately constant. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:22212282, PMID:31130928]

GO:0141033.name: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host actin cytoskeleton via actin polymerization
GO:0141033.def: "The process in which an organism effects a change that impairs the structure or function of the host actin cytoskeleton by polymerizing the host filamentous actin. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:18331467, PMID:25293534]

GO:0141034.name: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host actin cytoskeleton via inhibition of actin polymerization
GO:0141034.def: "The process in which an organism effects a change that disrupts the host actin cytoskeleton by inhibiting host actin from polymerizing. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:23409096, PMID:24253566, PMID:30297616]

GO:0141035.name: CTP-dependent diacylglycerol kinase activity
GO:0141035.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol + CTP = a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate + CDP + H+." [RHEA:25948]

GO:0141038.name: phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase activator activity
GO:0141038.def: "Binds to and increases the activity of a phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K)." [PMID:31686003]

GO:0141039.name: phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase inhibitor activity
GO:0141039.def: "Binds to and decreases the activity of a phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K)." [PMID:31686003]

GO:0141040.name: very-long-chain 3-oxoacyl-CoA reductase activity
GO:0141040.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a very-long-chain (3R)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA + NADP+ = a very-long-chain 3-oxoacyl-CoA + H+ + NADPH. This reaction is the second (reduction) step of the four-step fatty acid elongation cycle in the endoplasmic reticulum that extends fatty acids of C-16 or longer with an additional 2-C unit." [PMID:16564093, PMID:19763486, RHEA:48680]

GO:0141042.name: symbiont-mediated cAMP intoxication of host cell
GO:0141042.def: "The production by a symbiont of high levels of cyclic AMP in a host cell, impairing host cellular functions in multiple ways, including ATP depletion, interference with host intracellular signaling, cytoskeletal defects and apoptosis-related cell death. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:16390441, PMID:19516256, PMID:27731909, PMID:33013916]

GO:0141043.name: symbiont-mediated evasion of host innate immune response
GO:0141043.def: "A process by which a symbiont avoids recognition by host's innate immune response by altering, concealing or destroying a conserved symbiont molecule recognized by the host. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:15014080, PMID:22131330, PMID:26502908, PMID:29101229]

GO:0141044.name: epigenetic programming in the endosperm
GO:0141044.def: "The global programming of epigenetic modifications following binucleate central cell fertilization. This involves DNA methylation at the silent allele. In the endosperm, maternal genomes are hypomethylated compared with the paternal genome." [PMID:10580004, PMID:16469697, PMID:16527743, PMID:18700816, PMID:28118754]

GO:0141046.name: Atg8-family conjugating enzyme activity
GO:0141046.def: "Isoenergetic transfer of an Atg8 family modifier from one protein to a phosphatidylethanolamine or phosphatidylserine on a membrane, via the reaction X-Atg8 + Y = Y-Atg8 + X." [PMID:11100732, PMID:17986448, PMID:18704115, PMID:28234446, PMID:33909989]

GO:0141047.name: molecular tag activity
GO:0141047.def: "A molecular function exhibited by a protein that is covalently attached (AKA tagged or conjugated) to another molecule (for example a protein or a lipid) where it acts as a marker, recognized by the cellular apparatus to target the tagged protein for some cellular process such as modification, sequestration, transport or degradation." [PMID:17632063]

GO:0141048.name: membrane tag activity
GO:0141048.def: "A molecular function exhibited by a protein that is covalently attached (AKA tagged or conjugated) to a lipid, where it acts as a marker for a membrane, recognized by the cellular apparatus to target the tagged protein for some cellular process such as autophagy." [PMID:17632063]

GO:0141049.name: protein-glutathione oxidoreductase (glutathione) activity
GO:0141049.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: glutathionylated protein (PSSG) + glutathione (GSH) = protein-thiol (PSH) + glutathione disulfide (GSSG). The reaction may proceed via a 'monothiol' or 'dithiol' mechanism." [PMID:23397885, PMID:33932870, PMID:36771108]

GO:0141050.name: histone H3K deacetylase activity
GO:0141050.def: "Removal of an acetyl group from a lysine residue in a histone H3." [GOC:pg, PMID:9893272]

GO:0141051.name: histone H4K deacetylase activity
GO:0141051.def: "Removal of an acetyl group from a lysine residue in a histone H4." [PMID:12590135]

GO:0141052.name: histone H3 demethylase activity
GO:0141052.def: "Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from a modified lysine residue of the histone H3 protein. This is a dioxygenase reaction that is dependent on Fe(II) and 2-oxoglutarate." [PMID:17947579]

GO:0141053.name: histone H2A ubiquitin ligase activity
GO:0141053.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of ubiquitin to a histone H2A substrate." [PMID:25303536]

GO:0141054.name: histone H2B ubiquitin ligase activity
GO:0141054.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of ubiquitin to a histone H2B substrate." [PMID:25303536]

GO:0141055.name: histone H3 ubiquitin ligase activity
GO:0141055.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of ubiquitin to a histone H3 substrate." [PMID:25303536]

GO:0141056.name: histone H4 ubiquitin ligase activity
GO:0141056.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of ubiquitin to a histone H4 substrate." [PMID:25303536]

GO:0141057.name: histone H3 arginine deiminase activity
GO:0141057.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + histone H3 L-arginyl = histone H3 L-citrullyl + NH4+, resulting in histone H3 citrullination." [PMID:25303536]

GO:0141058.name: histone H4 demethylase activity
GO:0141058.def: "Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from a modified lysine residue of the histone H4 protein. This is a dioxygenase reaction that is dependent on Fe(II) and 2-oxoglutarate." [PMID:17947579]

GO:0141059.name: symbiont-mediated disruption of host antimicrobial peptide activity
GO:0141059.def: "Any process in which a symbiont interferes with a host antimicrobial peptide, for example by cleavage or degradation." [PMID:16242332, PMID:19015361, PMID:21335044]

GO:0141060.name: disruption of anatomical structure in another organism
GO:0141060.def: "The disruption of an anatomical structure of another organism, leading to damage or temporary subversion of that structure." [GOC:pg]

GO:0141061.name: disruption of cell in another organism
GO:0141061.def: "The disruption of a cell of another organism, leading to damage or temporary subversion of that cell." [GOC:pg]

GO:0141063.name: epigenetic programming in the central cell
GO:0141063.def: "The establishment of epigenetic modifications (imprints) in a plant central cell, leading to an asymmetry between the two maternal alleles and the paternal allele, and differential expression of the corresponding alleles in the developing endosperm. This can happen through heterochromatin formation or differential chromatin loop formation." [PMID:28118754]

GO:0141064.name: zygotic genome activation
GO:0141064.def: "A process that contributes to the onset of de novo transcription from the zygotic genome as part of the maternal-to-zygote transition in gene expression. The zygote overcomes the silencing that has been established. The cause of this silencing could be due to several factors: chromatin modifications leading to repression, or lack of adequate transcription machinery." [PMID:19204068, PMID:20808952]

GO:0141065.name: maternal mRNA clearance
GO:0141065.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the clearance of maternal mRNA transcripts from the zygote as part of the maternal-to-zygote transition in gene expression." [PMID:19204068, PMID:32558204]

GO:0141066.name: symbiont-mediated disruption of host extracellular matrix
GO:0141066.def: "The process in which an organism effects a change that impairs the structure or function of the host extracellular matrix." [PMID:11982763, PMID:21115719, PMID:2404867, PMID:25865874]

GO:0141067.name: intracellular nitrogen homeostasis
GO:0141067.def: "A homeostatic process involved in the maintenance of a steady state level of nitrogen within a cell." [GOC:tb]

GO:0141068.name: autosome genomic imprinting
GO:0141068.def: "The establishment of epigenetic modifications (imprints) in autosomal (non-sexual) chromosomes during gametogenesis, and propagation of these imprints during the organism's life. Genomic imprinting leads to an asymmetry between the maternal and paternal alleles and differential expression of the corresponding alleles. This can happen through heterochromatin formation or differential chromatin loop formation." [PMID:31782494]

GO:0141069.name: receptor ligand inhibitor activity
GO:0141069.def: "Binds to and decreases the activity of the ligand of a signaling receptor." [PMID:12478285, PMID:1721860]

GO:0141070.name: symbiont-mediated suppression of host MAPK cascade
GO:0141070.def: "A process in which a symbiont interferes with, inhibits or disrupts a MAPK signal transduction pathway in its host organism. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:18005697]

GO:0141071.name: symbiont-mediated activation of host MAPK cascade
GO:0141071.def: "A process in which a symbiont subverts a MAPK signal transduction pathway in the host organism by initiating, promoting, or enhancing its activation. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:24043761, PMID:25675415, PMID:28166272]

GO:0141072.name: symbiont-mediated suppression of host tumor necrosis factor-mediated signaling pathway
GO:0141072.def: "A process in which a virus interferes with, inhibits or disrupts a tumor necrosis factor-mediated signal transduction in its host organism. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:11805081, PMID:24736233]

GO:0141073.name: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host opsonization
GO:0141073.def: "A process in which a symbiont alters or subverts opsonization by the host. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:18068388, PMID:18941224, PMID:2307127, PMID:28860090]

GO:0141074.name: symbiont-mediated suppression of host cGAS-STING signal transduction
GO:0141074.def: "A process in which a virus interferes with, inhibits or disrupt a cGAS/STING signal transduction in the host organism. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:26405230, PMID:27234299, PMID:29018427]

GO:0141079.name: symbiont-mediated activation of host inflammasome-mediated signal transduction
GO:0141079.def: "A process in which a symbiont subverts an inflammasome-mediated signal transduction pathway in the host organism by initiating, promoting, or enhancing its activation. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:25538194, PMID:28331908, PMID:30872531, PMID:34155776]

GO:0141080.name: symbiont-mediated activation of host interferon signaling pathway
GO:0141080.def: "A process in which a symbiont subverts an interferon-mediated signal transduction pathway in the host organism by initiating, promoting, or enhancing its activation." [PMID:26553469, PMID:29076073]

GO:0141081.name: symbiont-mediated suppression of host inflammasome-mediated signal transduction
GO:0141081.def: "A process in which a symbiont interferes with, inhibits or stops an inflammasome-mediated signal transduction pathway in the host organism by interfering with its normal execution. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:26687278, PMID:27214553, PMID:29061850, PMID:34324582, PMID:36227980]

GO:0141082.name: symbiont-mediated detoxification of host-generated reactive oxygen species
GO:0141082.def: "A process in which a symbiont interferes with, inhibits or disrupts the host reactive oxygen species (ROS)-mediated innate immune response by directly degrading host ROS. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:19684141, PMID:27825304, PMID:28288207]

GO:0141083.name: symbiont-mediated suppression of host reactive oxygen species generation
GO:0141083.def: "A process in which a symbiont interferes with, inhibits or disrupts the host signal transduction pathways leading to the production of reactive oxygen species as part of the host innate immune response. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction." [PMID:27473656, PMID:31375544]

GO:0141084.name: inflammasome-mediated signaling pathway
GO:0141084.def: "An intracellular signal transduction pathway that starts with a ligand binding to a pattern recognition receptor (PRR), assembly of the inflammasome complex, leading to the activation of CASP1 and inducing an inflammatory response. In some cases, inflammasome-mediated signal transduction can lead to programmed cell death, such as pyroptosis." [PMID:35883561]

GO:0141085.name: regulation of inflammasome-mediated signaling pathway
GO:0141085.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of an inflammasome-mediated signaling pathway." [PMID:33467177]

GO:0141086.name: negative regulation of inflammasome-mediated signaling pathway
GO:0141086.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of an inflammasome-mediated signaling pathway." [PMID:33467177]

GO:0141087.name: positive regulation of inflammasome-mediated signaling pathway
GO:0141087.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of an inflammasome-mediated signaling pathway." [PMID:33467177]

GO:0141089.name: glucose sensor activity
GO:0141089.def: "Binding to and responding, e.g. by conformational change, to changes in the cellular level of glucose." [PMID:17470517]

GO:0141090.name: protein serine pyrophosphorylase activity
GO:0141090.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: protein phospho-serine + inositol 5-triphosphate pentakisphosphate = protein diphospho-serine + inositol 5-diphosphate pentakisphosphate." [PMID:36603579, RHEA:64104]

GO:0141091.name: transforming growth factor beta receptor superfamily signaling pathway
GO:0141091.def: "The series of molecular signals initiated by an extracellular ligand binding to a member of the transforming growth factor receptor superfamily, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription." [PMID:22651914, PMID:28096268]

GO:0141092.name: positive regulation of nodal signaling pathway
GO:0141092.def: "Any process that increases the rate, frequency or extent of nodal signaling pathway." [PMID:17239842]

GO:0141093.name: 5-amino-6-(D-ribitylamino)uracil--L-tyrosine 4-hydroxyphenyl transferase activity
GO:0141093.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 5-amino-6-(D-ribitylamino)uracil + L-tyrosine + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2-iminoacetate + 5'-deoxyadenosine + 5-amino-5-(4-hydroxybenzyl)-6-(D-ribitylimino)-5,6-dihydrouracil + H+ + L-methionine." [PMID:11948155, PMID:23072415, PMID:25781338, RHEA:55200]

GO:0141094.name: DNA loop anchor binding
GO:0141094.def: "Binding to a DNA loop anchor, a region of chromosome that defines the ends of a DNA loop where two parts of same DNA strand are held in close physical proximity. For example, in animals, the anchors of DNA loops are convergently oriented CTCF binding sites during interphase." [PMID:25497547, PMID:26499245]

GO:0141096.name: ligand-modulated transcription repressor activity
GO:0141096.def: "A DNA-binding transcription repressor activity regulated by binding to a ligand and that inhibits the transcription of specific genes and gene sets." [PMID:21555518]

GO:0141097.name: ligand-modulated transcription activator activity
GO:0141097.def: "A DNA-binding transcription activator activity regulated by binding to a ligand and that activates the transcription of specific genes and gene sets." [GOC:pg]

GO:0141098.name: tRNA (cytidine(34)-2'-O)-methyltransferase activity
GO:0141098.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: cytidine(34) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2'-O-methylcytidine(34) in tRNA + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine." [PMID:31943105, RHEA:43084]

GO:0141100.name: tRNA (guanine(18)-2'-O)-methyltransferase activity
GO:0141100.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + guanosine 18 in tRNA= S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + 2'-O-methylguanosine 18 in tRNA + H+." [PMID:25404562]

GO:0141101.name: tRNA(Ser) (uridine(44)-2'-O-)-methyltransferase activity
