GO:0160006.name: Fc receptor-mediated immune complex endocytosis
GO:0160006.def: "An endocytosis process mediated by the Fc receptor for the purpose of delivery of antigen-bound immunoglobulin to an intracellular compartment where the antigen can be processed and loaded onto MHC molecules. This process selectively targets antigens for presentation by MHC class II or cross-presentation by MHC class I." [PMID:28389502, PMID:9143687, PMID:9463401]

GO:0160007.name: glutathione import into mitochondrion
GO:0160007.def: "The process in which glutathione is transported from the cytosol into the mitochondrial matrix." [PMID:34707288]

GO:0160008.name: protein decrotonylase activity
GO:0160008.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-(2E)-butenoyl-L-lysyl-[protein] = (2E)-2-butenoate + L-lysyl-[protein]." [PMID:28497810, PMID:30279482, PMID:34608293]

GO:0160009.name: histone decrotonylase activity
GO:0160009.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-(2E)-butenoyl-L-lysyl-[histone] = (2E)-2-butenoate + L-lysyl-[histone]." [PMID:28497810]

GO:0160011.name: NAD-dependent protein decrotonylase activity
GO:0160011.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-(2E)-butenoyl-L-lysyl-[protein] + NAD+ = 2''-O-(2E)-but-2-enoyl-ADP-D-ribose + L-lysyl-[protein] + nicotinamide." [PMID:28497810]

GO:0160012.name: histone decrotonylase activity, NAD-dependent
GO:0160012.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-(2E)-butenoyl-L-lysyl-[histone] + NAD+ = 2''-O-(2E)-but-2-enoyl-ADP-D-ribose + L-lysyl-[histone] + nicotinamide." [PMID:28497810]

GO:0160013.name: NAD-dependent protein de-2-hydroxyisobutyrylase activity
GO:0160013.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-(2-hydroxyisobutanoyl)-L-lysyl-[protein] + NAD+ = 2''-O-(2-hydroxyisobutanoyl)-ADP-D-ribose + L-lysyl-[protein] + nicotinamide." [PMID:31328167]

GO:0160014.name: exopher
GO:0160014.def: "An extracellular vesicle that is approximately four microns in diameter, released by budding out of cells into the extracellular space, and hypothesized to be a mechanism for disposal of unwanted cellular material including protein aggregates and damaged organelles." [PMID:28178240, PMID:33016946, PMID:33027673, PMID:33659873, PMID:34288362, PMID:34475208]

GO:0160015.name: platelet rolling
GO:0160015.def: "Transient adhesive interactions between platelets and endothelial cells lining blood vessels. Carbohydrates on circulating platelets bind selectins or other molecules on the vessel wall causing the platelets to slow down and roll along the inner surface of the vessel wall. During this rolling motion, transitory bonds are formed and broken between surface molecules of platelets and endothelium." [GOC:sl, PMID:29018081]

GO:0160016.name: CCACCA tRNA nucleotidyltransferase activity
GO:0160016.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a tRNA with a 3' CCA end + 2 CTP + ATP = a tRNA with a 3' CCACCA end + 3 diphosphate." [PMID:22076379, RHEA:76235]

GO:0160017.name: regulation of platelet rolling
GO:0160017.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of platelet rolling." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:sl]

GO:0160018.name: positive regulation of platelet rolling
GO:0160018.def: "Any process that increases the rate, frequency, or extent of platelet rolling." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:sl]

GO:0160019.name: negative regulation of platelet rolling
GO:0160019.def: "Any process that decreases the rate, frequency, or extent of platelet rolling." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:sl, PMID:15738422]

GO:0160020.name: positive regulation of ferroptosis
GO:0160020.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of ferroptosis." [PMID:32015325]

GO:0160021.name: maternal-to-zygotic transition of gene expression
GO:0160021.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of gene expression by which developmental control passes from the maternal genome to the zygotic genome." [PMID:19204068, PMID:32558204]

GO:0160022.name: apocrine secretion
GO:0160022.def: "The controlled release of a substance by a cell or a tissue by discharging a portion of the secreting cell when intracellular components are freed into a lumen through the shedding of whole pieces of the cytoplasm." [PMID:25960390]

GO:0160023.name: sneeze reflex
GO:0160023.def: "A reflex process that expels air forcibly from the mouth and nose in an explosive, spasmodic involuntary action resulting chiefly from irritation of the nasal mucous membrane." [https://www.thefreedictionary.com/sneeze, PMID:34133943]

GO:0160024.name: Leydig cell proliferation
GO:0160024.def: "The multiplication or reproduction of Leydig cells, resulting in the expansion of a cell population. Leydig cells are interstitial cells located adjacent to the seminiferous tubules in the testis which produce testosterone." [PMID:29632025]

GO:0160025.name: sensory perception of itch
GO:0160025.def: "A sensory perception which causes the desire or reflex to scratch." [PMID:26015312, PMID:29723501, PMID:30734045, Wikipedia:Itch]

GO:0160027.name: egg deposition
GO:0160027.def: "The multicellular organismal reproductive process that results in the movement of an egg from within an organism into the external environment." [PMID:18050396, PMID:31164023]

GO:0160028.name: negative regulation of pyroptotic inflammatory response
GO:0160028.def: "Any process that decreases the frequency, rate or extent of a pyroptotic inflammatory response." [PMID:34637033]

GO:0160029.name: kidney cortex tubule cell dedifferentiation
GO:0160029.def: "The process in which a kidney cortex tubule cell (specialized epithelial cell of the kidney) loses the structural or functional features that characterize it in the mature organism, or some other relatively stable phase of the organism's life history. Under certain conditions, these cells can revert back to the features of the stem cells that were their ancestors." [PMID:18987110, PMID:31847447]

GO:0160030.name: pollen intine formation
GO:0160030.def: "Formation of pollen intine, the inner layer of the pollen wall. The reticulate pollen wall pattern consists of two layers, exine and intine." [PMID:35498668]

GO:0160031.name: endoplasmic reticulum membrane biogenesis
GO:0160031.def: "The process in which an endoplasmic reticulum membrane is synthesized, aggregates, and bonds together." [PMID:19825355, PMID:24373967, PMID:34617598]

GO:0160032.name: Toll receptor ligand protein activation cascade
GO:0160032.def: "A protein activation cascade that generates the active Toll receptor ligand and consists of the cascade of enzymatic reactions initiated by extracellular recognition factors, leading to the cleavage of the inactive form of spatzle family of ligands." [PMID:23632253]

GO:0160033.name: regulation of Toll receptor ligand protein activation cascade
GO:0160033.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the Toll receptor ligand protein activation cascade." [PMID:23632253]

GO:0160034.name: positive regulation of Toll receptor ligand protein activation cascade
GO:0160034.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of Toll receptor ligand protein activation cascade." [PMID:23632253]

GO:0160035.name: negative regulation of Toll receptor ligand protein activation cascade
GO:0160035.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of Toll receptor ligand protein activation cascade." [PMID:23632253]

GO:0160036.name: positive regulation of postsynaptic density assembly
GO:0160036.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of postsynaptic density assembly." [PMID:17626212]

GO:0160037.name: negative regulation of postsynaptic density assembly
GO:0160037.def: "Any process that decreases the rate, frequency, or extent of postsynaptic density assembly." [PMID:17626212]

GO:0160038.name: somatic sensory system development
GO:0160038.def: "The process whose specific outcome is the progression of a somatic sensory system over time from its formation to the mature structure. Somatic sensory system is the sensory system for the sense of touch and pain." [PMID:25832476, PMID:31399790]

GO:0160039.name: serotonin-gated chloride channel activity
GO:0160039.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of a chloride ion by a channel that opens when the biogenic amine serotonin has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts. Serotonin (5-hydroxytryptamine) is a neurotransmitter and hormone found in vertebrates and invertebrates." [PMID:11100728]

GO:0160040.name: mitocytosis
GO:0160040.def: "A migrasome-mediated selective removal of damaged mitochondria process that maintains mitochondrion homeostasis in migrating cells." [PMID:34108688]

GO:0160041.name: neuropeptide activity
GO:0160041.def: "The receptor ligand activity of any polypeptide expressed in, and secreted from a neuron." [PMID:18806786, PMID:21922398]

GO:0160042.name: purine nucleotide uniporter activity
GO:0160042.def: "Catalysis of the active transport of purine nucleotides across a membrane by a mechanism involving conformational change, where energy for active transport is derived from membrane potential if the solute is charged." [PMID:18375752, PMID:27477609]

GO:0160043.name: catecholamine secretion, neurotransmission
GO:0160043.def: "The regulated release of catecholamine by a cell in which the catecholamine acts as a neurotransmitter." [PMID:10191060]

GO:0160044.name: sulfate:chloride antiporter activity
GO:0160044.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: chloride(in) + sulfate(out) = chloride(out) + sulfate(in)." [PMID:17442754]

GO:0160045.name: TMEM240-body
GO:0160045.def: "A multilamellar subcellular structure formed in the cytoplasm of developing neuron, composed of Tmem240 and Emd proteins." [PMID:32535204]

GO:0160046.name: oxalate:chloride antiporter activity
GO:0160046.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: chloride(out) + oxalate(in) = chloride(in) + oxalate(out)." [PMID:17442754]

GO:0160047.name: muramyl dipeptide kinase activity
GO:0160047.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + muramyl dipeptide = ADP + H+ + 6-O-phospho-muramyl dipeptide." [PMID:36002575]

GO:0160048.name: craniofacial suture closure
GO:0160048.def: "The process of fusing together the edges of a craniofacial suture." [PMID:33842480]

GO:0160049.name: negative regulation of cGAS/STING signaling pathway
GO:0160049.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of cGAS/STING signaling pathway." [PMID:29875158]

GO:0160050.name: xanthine binding
GO:0160050.def: "Binding to xanthine, a purine base." [PMID:32345632, PMID:34125892]

GO:0160051.name: Cyc8(Ssn6)-Tup1 general repressor complex
GO:0160051.def: "A corepressor complex containing the WD-repeat protein Tup1p (S. cerevisiae) and Tup11/Tup12 (fission yeast) and the TPR repeat protein Cyc8p (S. cerevisiae) ssn6 (fission yeast) that is recruited to target genes by DNA-bound repressor proteins preferentially at regions where histones are deacetylated by the Clr6 class I HDAC, and recruits the SWI/SNF and SAGA complexes to promoters." [GOC:vw, PMID:10871883, PMID:17101775, PMID:22156212]

GO:0160052.name: mitotic nuclear envelope segregation
GO:0160052.def: "The mitotic cell cycle process in which the nuclear envelope, including nuclear pores, is equally distributed to the two daughter cells during the mitotic cell cycle." [GOC:vw, PMID:24184107]

GO:0160053.name: serine-based site-specific recombinase activity
GO:0160053.def: "Catalysis of the formation of new phosphodiester bonds between a pair of short, unique DNA target sequences; occurs through a phosphoseryl intermediate in which the target sequence is first cleaved by the nucleophilic attack by a serine in the active site." [PMID:16756503, PMID:29316791]

GO:0160054.name: microfibril assembly
GO:0160054.def: "The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of microfibril." [PMID:32855533]

GO:0160055.name: glideosome
GO:0160055.def: "A protein complex composed of at least GAP45 (gliding-associated protein), GAP50 and myosin heavy and light chains. Anchored via GAP50 to the inner membrane complex of motile and invasive forms of apicomplexan parasites and regulates parasite gliding motility and invasion of host cells." [PMID:12139608, PMID:15123738, PMID:19577950]

GO:0160057.name: plant endodermal cell fate specification
GO:0160057.def: "The process in which a cell becomes capable of differentiating autonomously into a plant endodermal cell in an environment that is neutral with respect to the developmental pathway. Upon specification, the cell fate can be reversed." [PMID:26415082]

GO:0160058.name: plant endodermal cell differentiation
GO:0160058.def: "The process in which a relatively unspecialized cell acquires specialized features of a plant endodermal cell." [PMID:21735349]

GO:0160059.name: programmed cell death in response to retinoic acid
GO:0160059.def: "Cell death resulting from activation of endogenous cellular processes and occurring as a result of a retinoic acid." [PMID:17869331, PMID:9187263]

GO:0160060.name: sleep homeostasis
GO:0160060.def: "A homeostatic process in which the drive for sleep increases sleep propensity with prolonged wakefulness." [PMID:30509635]

GO:0160061.name: respiratory chemosensitivity
GO:0160061.def: "A homeostatic process by which the sensing of CO2 and/or H+ by the brain leads to appropriate altering in breathing to regulate blood gas and tissue pH." [PMID:26068853]

GO:0160062.name: cutin-based cuticle development
GO:0160062.def: "The process whose specific outcome is the progression of the cutin-based cuticle over time, from its formation to the mature structure. Cutin-based cuticle is an extracellular structure composed of a covalently linked macromolecular scaffold of cutin and a variety of organic solvent-soluble lipids that are collectively termed waxes. Such structures are found on the external face of polysaccharide cell walls in land plants." [PMID:23893170]

GO:0160063.name: multi-pass transmembrane protein insertion into ER membrane
GO:0160063.def: "A process of protein insertion of multi-pass membrane proteins into the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) membrane. Insertion of multi-pass membrane proteins is mediated by the multi-pass translocon complex and takes place following membrane insertion of the first few transmembrane segments of proteins by the SEC61 complex to promote insertion of subsequent transmembrane regions." [PMID:36261522, PMID:36261528]

GO:0160064.name: multi-pass translocon complex
GO:0160064.def: "A protein complex that mediates the insertion of multi-pass transmembrane proteins into endoplasmic reticulum (ER) membrane. Substrates enter via the lateral gate of the Sec61 translocon. The complex comprises the GEL subcomplex (composed of RAB5IF/OPTI and TMCO1), the BOS subcomplex (composed of NCLN/Nicalin, NOMO and TMEM147) and the PAT subcomplex (composed of WDR83OS/Asterix and CCDC47)." [PMID:36261522, PMID:36261528]

GO:0160065.name: SIN/MEN signaling complex
GO:0160065.def: "A protein complex associated with the mitotic spindle pole body during interphase and mitosis and comprises of the proteins of the septation initiation signaling network (SIN) of fission yeast or mitotic exit network (MEN) of budding yeast, organized by two scaffold/adaptor proteins." [PMID:21131906, PMID:22525225, PMID:22684255]

GO:0160066.name: interphase SIN signaling complex
GO:0160066.def: "A SIN signaling complex associated with the old mitotic spindle pole body during interphase and early M-phase and characterised by the presence active ubiquitin ligase (Dma1 in fission yeast) and GTPase activator (Spg1 in fission yeast) to inactivate SIN signaling." [PMID:21131906]

GO:0160067.name: new spindle pole body SIN signaling complex
GO:0160067.def: "A SIN signaling complex associated with the new mitotic spindle pole body during anaphase and characterized by the presence activated (GTP bound) GTPase (Spg1 in fission yeast) to activate SIN signaling." [PMID:21131906]

GO:0160068.name: negative regulation of pollen tube guidance
GO:0160068.def: "Any process that decreases the rate, frequency or extent of pollen tube guidance towards ovules. This is one mechanism to prevent polytuby, the simultaneous penetration of ovules by multiple pollen tubes." [PMID:33790463]

GO:0160069.name: surfactant secretion
GO:0160069.def: "The regulated release of surfactant by a cell or tissue." [PMID:19824815]

GO:0160070.name: intracellular borate homeostasis
GO:0160070.def: "A homeostatic process involved in the maintenance of a steady state level of tetrahydroxoborate within a cell." [PMID:15525507]

GO:0160071.name: prevention of polyspermy during double fertilization
GO:0160071.def: "The regulation of double fertilization forming a zygote and endosperm process that ensures that only a single sperm cell fertilizes one egg cell and another single sperm cell fertilizes one central cell." [PMID:27951463]

GO:0160072.name: ubiquitin ligase complex scaffold activity
GO:0160072.def: "The binding activity of a molecule that brings together an ubiquitin ligase and an ubiquitin ligase-substrate adaptor, permitting those molecules to function in a coordinated way." [PMID:27664236]

GO:0160073.name: Casparian strip assembly
GO:0160073.def: "The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a Casparian strip, a region of plant cell wall specialised to act as a seal to prevent back leakage of secreted material." [PMID:28104889]

GO:0160074.name: non-canonical inflammasome complex
GO:0160074.def: "An inflammasome complex containing CASP4, known as caspase-11 (Casp11) in mouse, which assembles upon cytosolic lipopolysaccharide-binding and directly activates Gasdermin-D (GSDMD)." [PMID:33187725]

GO:0160075.name: non-canonical inflammasome complex assembly
GO:0160075.def: "The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a non-canonical inflammasome complex." [PMID:27291964]

GO:0160076.name: negative regulation of non-canonical inflammasome complex assembly
GO:0160076.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of non-canonical inflammasome complex assembly." [PMID:22002608, PMID:26375259]

GO:0160077.name: lipid droplet fusion
GO:0160077.def: "The process by which a single lipid droplet is created from the fusion of two or more lipid droplets." [PMID:34508658, PMID:36477540]

GO:0160078.name: negative regulation of lipid droplet fusion
GO:0160078.def: "Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of lipid droplet fusion." [PMID:36477540]

GO:0160079.name: G protein-coupled glycine receptor activity
GO:0160079.def: "Combining with glycine and transmitting the signal across the membrane by changing the activity of intracellular G protein signaling." [PMID:36996198]

GO:0160080.name: ABC-type indole transporter activity
GO:0160080.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + indole(in) = ADP + phosphate + indole(out)." [PMID:37146609]

GO:0160081.name: iodide channel activity
GO:0160081.def: "Enables the energy-independent facilitated diffusion of iodide through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel." [PMID:34910516]

GO:0160082.name: hypoxia-inducible factor-proline dioxygenase activity
GO:0160082.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + L-prolyl-[hypoxia-inducible factor alpha subunit] + O2 = CO2 + succinate + trans-4-hydroxy-L-prolyl-[hypoxia-inducible factor alpha subunit]." [PMID:11595184, PMID:11598268]

GO:0160083.name: exhausted T cell differentiation
GO:0160083.def: "The process in which an activated T cell acquires specialized features of an exhausted T cell." [PMID:21739672, PMID:31570879]

GO:0160086.name: protein localization to polar microtubule
GO:0160086.def: "A process in which a protein is transported to, or maintained in, a location within a polar microtubule." [PMID:34080538]

GO:0160087.name: spermatid cytoplasm removal during spermiation of flagellated sperm
GO:0160087.def: "The process of removing the majority of the cytoplasm and organelles from a spermatid as it develops into a mature flagellated sperm cell." [PMID:21866274, PMID:23087837]

GO:0160089.name: internal N(7)-methylguanine-containing RNA reader activity
GO:0160089.def: "A protein adaptor that recognizes and binds an RNA molecule modified by N(7)-methylguanine (m7G), a modification present at internal sites of mRNAs and some non-coding RNAs." [PMID:37379838]

GO:0160090.name: internal mRNA (guanine-N7-)-methyltransferase activity
GO:0160090.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a guanosine in mRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = an N(7)-methylguanosine in mRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine." [PMID:31031084, PMID:37379838, RHEA:60508]

GO:0160091.name: spliceosome-depend formation of circular RNA
GO:0160091.def: "Formation of circular RNAs (circRNAs) by back-splicing circularization of pre-mRNAs in a spliceosome-dependent process." [PMID:25768908, PMID:28625552]

GO:0160092.name: hemozoin formation complex
GO:0160092.def: "A protein-containing complex involved in hemoglobin degradation and detoxification of heme in the food vacuole during the asexual blood stage of a Plasmodium. It is composed of at least falcipains FP2A and/or FP2B, plasmepsins PMII, PMIII/HAP and PMIV, heme detoxifying protein HDP and falcilysin FLN." [PMID:23471987]

GO:0160093.name: chordate pharynx development
GO:0160093.def: "The process whose specific outcome is the progression of cordate pharynx over time, from its formation to the mature structure." [PMID:23020903]

GO:0160094.name: nematode pharynx development
GO:0160094.def: "The process whose specific outcome is the progression of nematode pharynx over time, from its formation to the mature structure." [PMID:18050503]

GO:0160095.name: insect pharynx development
GO:0160095.def: "The process whose specific outcome is the progression of insect pharynx over time, from its formation to the mature structure." [PMID:10952900]

GO:0160096.name: nematode pharyngeal muscle development
GO:0160096.def: "The process whose specific outcome is the progression of the nematode pharyngeal muscle over time, from its formation to the mature structure." [GOC:go_curators]

GO:0160097.name: reverse gyrase activity
GO:0160097.def: "Catalysis of a DNA topological transformation by transiently cleaving one DNA strand at a time to allow passage of another strand; changes the linking number by +1 per catalytic cycle, is driven by ATP hydrolysis." [PMID:25013168]

GO:0160101.name: tRNA (guanine(10)-N2)-dimethyltransferase activity
GO:0160101.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine(10) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N(2)-dimethylguanosine(10) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine." [EC:2.1.1.213]

GO:0160102.name: tRNA (guanine(10)-N2)-methyltransferase activity
GO:0160102.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine(10) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N(2)-methylguanosine(10) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine." [EC:2.1.1.214]

GO:0160103.name: tRNA (guanine(26)-N2/guanine(27)-N2)-dimethyltransferase activity
GO:0160103.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine(26)/guanosine(27) in tRNA + 4 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 4 H+ + N(2)-dimethylguanosine(26)/N(2)-dimethylguanosine(27) in tRNA + 4 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine." [EC:2.1.1.215]

GO:0160104.name: tRNA (guanine(26)-N2)-dimethyltransferase activity
GO:0160104.def: "Catalysis of the reaction:guanosine(26) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N(2)-dimethylguanosine(26) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine." [EC:2.1.1.216]

GO:0160105.name: tRNA (adenine(22)-N1)-methyltransferase activity
GO:0160105.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine(22) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N(1)-methyladenosine(22) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine." [EC:2.1.1.217]

GO:0160106.name: tRNA (adenine(9)-N1)-methyltransferase activity
GO:0160106.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine(9) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N(1)-methyladenosine(9) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine." [EC:2.1.1.218]

GO:0160107.name: tRNA (adenine(58)-N1)-methyltransferase activity
GO:0160107.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine(58) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N(1)-methyladenosine(58) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine." [EC:2.1.1.220]

GO:0160108.name: animal gross anatomical part developmental process
GO:0160108.def: "Any developmental process whose specific outcome is the progression of a gross anatomical part of an animal from an initial immature state, to a later, more mature state." [GOC:pg]

GO:0160109.name: plant gross anatomical part developmental process
GO:0160109.def: "Any developmental process whose specific outcome is the progression of a gross anatomical part of a plant from an initial immature state, to a later, more mature state." [GOC:pg]

GO:0160110.name: axonemal microtubule doublet inner sheath
GO:0160110.def: "A structural network of microtubule inner proteins (MIPs) located inside the lumens of the A and B tubules of the axonemal microtuble doublet that helps stabilize the doublet microtubule." [GOC:krc, PMID:29430673, PMID:37295417]

GO:0160111.name: axonemal A tubule inner sheath
GO:0160111.def: "A structural network of microtubule inner proteins (MIPs) located inside the lumen of the A tubule of the axonemal microtubule doublet that helps stabilize the A tubule." [GOC:krc, PMID:29430673, PMID:37295417]

GO:0160112.name: axonemal B tubule inner sheath
GO:0160112.def: "A structural network of microtubule inner proteins (MIPs) located inside the lumen of the B tubule of the axonemal microtubule doublet that helps stabilize the B tubule." [GOC:krc, PMID:29430673, PMID:37295417]

GO:0160113.name: axonemal microtubule doublet inner junction
GO:0160113.def: "The structure which joins the B10 protofilament of the B tubule to the A1 protofilament of the A tubule within an axonemal microtubule doublet." [GOC:krc, PMID:29430673, PMID:37295417]

GO:0160114.name: axonemal microtubule doublet outer junction
GO:0160114.def: "The structure which joins the B1 protofilament of the B tubule to the A10 and A11 protofilaments of the A tubule within an axonemal microtubule doublet." [GOC:krc, PMID:29430673, PMID:37295417]

GO:0160115.name: axonemal microtubule doublet ribbon
GO:0160115.def: "The 3 protofilaments A11, A12, and A13 of the A tubule along with associated inner sheath microtuble inner proteins (MIPs), either in the lumen of the A tubule or of the B tubule, which stabilize these three filiments within the axonemal doublet microtubule. The ribbon protofilaments separate the lumens of the A and B tubules." [GOC:krc, PMID:1262413, PMID:29430673]

GO:0160117.name: tRNA (guanine(6)-N2)-methyltransferase activity
GO:0160117.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine(6) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N(2)-methylguanosine(6) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine." [EC:2.1.1.256, PMID:34669960]

GO:0160118.name: tRNA (guanine(7)-N2)-methyltransferase activity
GO:0160118.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine(7) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N(2)-methylguanosine(7) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine." [PMID:34669960]

GO:0160119.name: cuproptosis
GO:0160119.def: "A programmed cell death process that is induced by intracellular copper accumulation." [PMID:35298263, PMID:35354936]

GO:0160122.name: corneal epithelial cell differentiation
GO:0160122.def: "The process in which a relatively unspecialized cell acquires specialized features of an corneal epithelial cell, any of the cells making up an corneal epithelium." [PMID:32697979, PMID:33414365]

GO:0160123.name: structural constituent of nuclear lamina
GO:0160123.def: "The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of nuclear lamina." [PMID:2824113, PMID:31434876]

GO:0160124.name: guanyl nucleotide exchange factor activator activity
GO:0160124.def: "Binds to and increases the activity of a guanyl nucleotide exchange factor." [PMID:37463208]

GO:0160125.name: pH-gated sodium channel activity
GO:0160125.def: "A gated channel activity that enables the transmembrane transfer of a sodium ion by a channel that opens in response to a change in pH." [PMID:34767445]

GO:0160126.name: pH-gated calcium channel activity
GO:0160126.def: "A gated channel activity that enables the transmembrane transfer of a calcium ion by a channel that opens in response to a change in pH." [PMID:30930064, PMID:34767445]

GO:0160127.name: protein-RNA covalent cross-linking repair
GO:0160127.def: "A process that rescues stalled ribosomes by removing the covalent cross-link between RNA and a protein." [PMID:37951215, PMID:37951216]

GO:0160128.name: pH-gated monoatomic ion channel activity
GO:0160128.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of an inorganic ion by a channel that opens in response to a change in proton concentration (pH)." [PMID:17167423, PMID:29513651]

GO:0160129.name: protein-DNA covalent cross-linking activity
GO:0160129.def: "Catalysis of the cross-link between a protein and a DNA abasic site, forming a thiazolidine linkage between a DNA ring-opened abasic site and the alpha-amino and sulfhydryl substituents of cysteine residue of the protein." [PMID:30554877, PMID:31235913]

GO:0160130.name: mRNA cap methyltransferase RNMT:RAMAC complex
GO:0160130.def: "A protein complex that consists of RNA guanine-7 methyltransferase (RNMT) and RNA guanine-7 methyltransferase activating subunit (RAMAC) and is involved in mRNA cap methylation." [PMID:22099306]

GO:0160131.name: sperm migration through the uterotubal junction
GO:0160131.def: "The controlled self-propelled movement of a sperm cell from the uterus through the uterotubal junction (UTJ) into the oviduct, where interaction between the sperm and the UTJ acts as a major selective barrier for sperm, allowing only living, motile, uncapacitated, morphologically normal sperm with intact acrosomes to pass from the uterus into the oviduct." [GOC:krc, PMID:29353867, PMID:31131960, PMID:32712384, PMID:34057175]

GO:0160132.name: meisosome
GO:0160132.def: "A cell part that is composed of multifold plasma membrane of the epidermis where it is in direct contact with apical extracellular matrix. Meisosome, or multiple eisome is named because of its superficial similarity to yeast eisosome." [PMID:36913486]

GO:0160133.name: bicarbonate channel activity
GO:0160133.def: "Enables the energy-independent facilitated diffusion of bicarbonate through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel." [PMID:18400985]

GO:0160134.name: protein-RNA sequence-specific adaptor activity
GO:0160134.def: "A protein adaptor activity characterized by the capacity to selectively recognize and interact with RNA molecules in a sequence-specific manner. Entities possessing this activity typically exhibit discerning binding preferences for specific nucleotide sequences within RNA molecules, enabling the identification and engagement of distinct RNA motifs or structural elements. This function is integral to various biological processes, including RNA processing, transport, and regulatory mechanisms, contributing to the specificity and precision of cellular RNA-related activities." [PMID:14749727, PMID:17036044]

GO:0160135.name: phospholipase C-activating endothelin receptor signaling pathway
GO:0160135.def: "A phospholipase C-activating receptor G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway initiated by endothelin binding to its receptor on the surface of a target cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription." [PMID:35284927]

GO:0160136.name: 16S rRNA pseudouridine(516) synthase activity
GO:0160136.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(516) in 16S rRNA = pseudouridine(516) in 16S rRNA." [EC:5.4.99.19, RHEA:38867]

GO:0160137.name: 23S rRNA pseudouridine(2457) synthase activity
GO:0160137.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(2457) in 23S rRNA = pseudouridine(2457) in 23S rRNA." [EC:5.4.99.20, RHEA:38871]

GO:0160138.name: 23S rRNA pseudouridine(2604) synthase activity
GO:0160138.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(2604) in 23S rRNA = pseudouridine(2604) in 23S rRNA." [EC:5.4.99.21, RHEA:38875]

GO:0160139.name: 23S rRNA pseudouridine(2605) synthase activity
GO:0160139.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(2605) in 23S rRNA = pseudouridine(2605) in 23S rRNA." [EC:5.4.99.22, RHEA:42520]

GO:0160140.name: 23S rRNA pseudouridine(1911/1915/1917) synthase activity
GO:0160140.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(1911/1915/1917) in 23S rRNA = pseudouridine(1911/1915/1917) in 23S rRNA." [EC:5.4.99.23, RHEA:42524]

GO:0160141.name: 23S rRNA pseudouridine(955/2504/2580) synthase activity
GO:0160141.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(955/2504/2580) in 23S rRNA = pseudouridine(955/2504/2580) in 23S rRNA." [EC:5.4.99.24, RHEA:42528]

GO:0160142.name: 23S rRNA pseudouridine(746) synthase activity
GO:0160142.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(746) in 23S rRNA = pseudouridine(746) in 23S rRNA." [EC:5.4.99.29, RHEA:42548]

GO:0160143.name: 21S rRNA pseudouridine(2819) synthase activity
GO:0160143.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(2819) in 21S rRNA = pseudouridine(2819) in 21S rRNA." [EC:5.4.99.43, RHEA:42556]

GO:0160144.name: GDF15-GFRAL signaling pathway
GO:0160144.def: "The series of molecular signals initiated by GDF15 binding to GFRAL coreceptor, triggering RET autophosphorylation and activation, in response to stress." [PMID:30639358, PMID:31535977, PMID:33593916, PMID:37437602]

GO:0160145.name: negative regulation of GDF15-GFRAL signaling pathway
GO:0160145.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of GDF15-GFRAL signaling pathway." [PMID:35177851]

GO:0160147.name: tRNA pseudouridine(38-40) synthase activity
GO:0160147.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(38/39/40) in tRNA = pseudouridine(38/39/40) in tRNA." [EC:5.4.99.12]

GO:0160148.name: tRNA pseudouridine(55) synthase activity
GO:0160148.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(55) in tRNA = pseudouridine(55) in tRNA." [EC:5.4.99.25]

GO:0160149.name: tRNA pseudouridine(65) synthase activity
GO:0160149.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(65) in tRNA = pseudouridine(65) in tRNA." [EC:5.4.99.26]

GO:0160150.name: tRNA pseudouridine(13) synthase activity
GO:0160150.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(13) in tRNA = pseudouridine(13) in tRNA." [EC:5.4.99.27]

GO:0160151.name: tRNA pseudouridine(32) synthase activity
GO:0160151.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(32) in tRNA = pseudouridine(32) in tRNA." [EC:5.4.99.28]

GO:0160152.name: tRNA pseudouridine(31) synthase activity
GO:0160152.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(31) in tRNA = pseudouridine(31) in tRNA." [EC:5.4.99.42]

GO:0160153.name: mitochondrial tRNA pseudouridine(27/28) synthase activity
GO:0160153.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(27/28) in mitochondrial tRNA = pseudouridine(27/28) in mitochondrial tRNA." [EC:5.4.99.44]

GO:0160154.name: tRNA pseudouridine(38/39) synthase activity
GO:0160154.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(38/39) in tRNA = pseudouridine(38/39) in tRNA." [EC:5.4.99.45]

GO:0160155.name: crinophagy
GO:0160155.def: "The autophagic process which involves the direct fusion of abnormal, excess or obsolete secretory granules with lysosomes. This pathway is often associated with maintaining homeostasis in endocrine and exocrine cells." [PMID:29066608, PMID:35452619]

GO:0160156.name: secretory granule-lysosome fusion
GO:0160156.def: "The cellular process that results in the fusion of secretory granules with lysosomes to form crinosomes." [PMID:29066608, PMID:35452619]

GO:0160157.name: branched-chain alpha-ketoacid dehydrogenase complex
GO:0160157.def: "A multi-enzyme complex that catalyzes the oxidative decarboxylation of branched-chain alpha-ketoacids derived from L-leucine, L-isoleucine, and L-valine to branched-chain acyl-CoAs. The complex comprises multiple copies of three enzymes referred to as E1, E2 and E3: branched-chain alpha-ketoacid dehydrogenase (E1, a heterotetramer of two alpha and two beta subunits), dihydrolipoyl transacylase (E2), and dihydrolipoamide dehydrogenase (E3). Additional proteins may also be present." [PMID:10464218, PMID:10745006, PMID:3593587]

GO:0160159.name: positive regulation of N-acetylmuramic acid catabolic process
GO:0160159.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of N-acetylmuramic acid catabolic process." [PMID:18723630]

GO:0160160.name: positive regulation of nicotine catabolic process
GO:0160160.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of nicotine catabolic process." [PMID:15838033]

GO:0160161.name: positive regulation of propanediol catabolic process
GO:0160161.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of propanediol catabolic process." [PMID:7559322, PMID:9023178]

GO:0160162.name: CD27 signaling pathway
GO:0160162.def: "The series of molecular signals initiated by the binding of the cell surface receptor CD27 to its physiological ligand CD70, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription." [PMID:26359318, PMID:8387892]

GO:0160163.name: S-nitrosoglutathione reductase (NADPH) activity
GO:0160163.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + NADPH + S-nitrosoglutathione = NADP+ + S-(hydroxysulfenamide)glutathione." [RHEA:63500]

GO:0160164.name: negative regulation of chromatin looping
GO:0160164.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of chromatin looping." [PMID:34856126]

GO:0160165.name: CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell homeostasis
GO:0160165.def: "The process of regulating the proliferation and elimination of CD8-positive alpha-beta T cells such that the total number of CD8-positive alpha-beta T cells within a whole or part of an organism is stable over time in the absence of an outside stimulus." [PMID:30650357, PMID:33815406]

GO:0160166.name: 2-oxoadipate dehydrogenase activity
GO:0160166.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoadipate + H+ + N(6)-[(R)-lipoyl]-L-lysyl-[dihydrolipoyllysine-residue succinyltransferase] = CO2 + N(6)-[(R)-S(8)-glutaryldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[dihydrolipoyllysine-residue succinyltransferase]." [PMID:29191460, PMID:32695416, RHEA:69576]

GO:0160167.name: oxoadipate dehydrogenase complex
GO:0160167.def: "A multi-enzyme complex that catalyzes the oxidative decarboxylation of 2-oxoadipate to glutaryl-CoA, thereby acting in the final step of lysine and tryptophan catabolism in mitochondria. The complex comprises multiple copies of three enzymes referred to as E1, E2 and E3: 2-oxoadipate dehydrogenase (E1), dihydrolipoamide S-succinyltransferase (E2) and dihydrolipoamide dehydrogenase (E3)." [PMID:29191460, PMID:32695416]

GO:0160168.name: T=9 icosahedral viral capsid
GO:0160168.def: "The protein coat that surrounds the infective nucleic acid in some virus particles where the subunits (capsomeres) are arranged to form an icosahedron with T=9 symmetry. The T=9 capsid is composed of 12 pentameric and 80 hexameric capsomeres." [PMID:37138077]

GO:0160169.name: T=21/pseudo21 icosahedral capsid
GO:0160169.def: "The protein coat that surrounds the infective nucleic acid in some virus particles where the subunits (capsomeres) are arranged to form an icosahedron with T=21 or pseudo T=21 symmetry." [VZ:833]

GO:0160170.name: T=27/pseudo27 icosahedral capsid
GO:0160170.def: "The protein coat that surrounds the infective nucleic acid in some virus particles where the subunits (capsomeres) are arranged to form an icosahedron with T=27 or pseudo T=27 symmetry." [VZ:1556]

GO:0160171.name: T=28 icosahedral capsid
GO:0160171.def: "The protein coat that surrounds the infective nucleic acid in some virus particles where the subunits (capsomeres) are arranged to form an icosahedron with T=28 symmetry." [VZ:6057]

GO:0160172.name: T=31/pseudo31 icosahedral capsid
GO:0160172.def: "The protein coat that surrounds the infective nucleic acid in some virus particles where the subunits (capsomeres) are arranged to form an icosahedron with T=31 or pseudo T=31 symmetry." [VZ:7036]

GO:0160173.name: histamine transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0160173.def: "Enables the transfer of histamine from one side of a membrane to the other." [PMID:36288320]

GO:0160174.name: cortical rotation
GO:0160174.def: "A cellular developmental process by which the outer layer of the cell (the cortex) rotates relative to the inner cytoplasm." [PMID:22949618, PMID:25077289, PMID:37983969]

GO:0160175.name: somatic muscle attachment to chitin-based cuticle
GO:0160175.def: "The developmental process in which a somatic muscle attaches to the chitin-based cuticle. In insects, this may occur via a specialized epithelial cell adherence to the chitinous extracellular matrix and to muscle cells through their basement membrane." [PMID:35675426]

GO:0160176.name: magnesium ion transport from cytosol to endoplasmic reticulum
GO:0160176.def: "The directed movement of magnesium ion from cytosol to endoplasmic reticulum." [PMID:38513662]

GO:0160177.name: positive regulation of autophagosome-lysosome fusion
GO:0160177.def: "Any process that activates or increases the rate which autophagosomes fuse with a vacuole (yeast) or lysosome (e.g. mammals and insects)." [PMID:38360932]

GO:0160178.name: dipeptide uniporter activity
GO:0160178.def: "Catalysis of the transport of a dipeptide across a membrane; transport is independent of the movement of any other molecular species." [PMID:38507452]

GO:0160179.name: intestinal iron absorption
GO:0160179.def: "A process in which iron is taken up from the contents of the intestine." [PMID:16054062, PMID:17729393]

GO:0160181.name: piperine biosynthetic process
GO:0160181.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of piperine." [PMID:33435446, PMID:33833371]

GO:0160182.name: nitrate reductase (quinone) activity
GO:0160182.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a quinol + nitrate = a quinone + H2O + nitrite." [RHEA:56144]

GO:0160183.name: autophagosome-membrane adaptor activity
GO:0160183.def: "The binding activity of a molecule that brings together a target membrane and an autophagosome during autophagy." [PMID:30544615, PMID:36635405]

GO:0160184.name: paracellular transport
GO:0160184.def: "The directed movement of substance through the space in between adjacent cells, rather than through the cells themselves." [PMID:28452575, WIki:Paracellular_transport]

GO:0160185.name: phospholipase C activator activity
GO:0160185.def: "Binds to and increases the activity of the enzyme phospholipase C." [PMID:28130414]

GO:0160186.name: phospholipase C inhibitor activity
GO:0160186.def: "Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of the enzyme phospholipase C." [PMID:28130414]

GO:0160187.name: paracellular tight junction channel activity
GO:0160187.def: "Enables size- and charge-selective transport of solutes through a tight junction barrier paracellularly, across the epithelium." [PMID:30665499]

GO:0160189.name: peroxisomal-mitochondrial contact site
GO:0160189.def: "An organelle membrane contact site between peroxisomal membrane and mitochondrial outer membrane." [PMID:29684109, PMID:38669296]

GO:0160190.name: peroxisome-mitochondrion membrane tether activity
GO:0160190.def: "The binding activity of a molecule that brings together the peroxisome and the mitochondrial outer membrane, establishing the localization of the peroxisome close to the mitochondrion." [PMID:29720625, PMID:38669296]

GO:0160191.name: steroid 22S-hydroxylase activity
GO:0160191.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a C28-steroid + O2 + reduced NADPH--hemoprotein reductase = a (22S)-22-hydroxy C28-steroid + H+ + H2O + oxidized NADPH--hemoprotein reductase. Also catalyzes the C-22 hydroxylation of a variety of C27 and C29 steroids." [EC:1.14.14.178]

GO:0160192.name: autophagosome-dependent secretion
GO:0160192.def: "A process of exocytosis that uses the autophagy machinery to facilitate secretion of the cytosolic cargo such as leaderless cytosolic proteins which cannot enter the conventional secretory pathway operating via the endoplasmic reticulum and the Golgi apparatus." [PMID:25988755, PMID:38534758]

GO:0160193.name: L-lactate dehydrogenase inhibitor activity
GO:0160193.def: "Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of L-lactate dehydrogenase." [PMID:33406399]

GO:0160194.name: stereocilium bundle organization
GO:0160194.def: "A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of a sensory hair cell stereocilium bundle." [PMID:28266911, PMID:6978627]

GO:0160195.name: negative regulation of phospholipase C/protein kinase C signal transduction
GO:0160195.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of phospholipase C/protein kinase C signal transduction." [PMID:32033984]

GO:0160196.name: polyprenol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
GO:0160196.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a di-trans,poly-cis-polyprenol + NAD+ = a di-trans,poly-cis-polyprenal + NADH + H+." [PMID:38821050, RHEA:80719]

GO:0160197.name: dolichal reductase (NADPH) activity
GO:0160197.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a di-trans,poly-cis-dolichol + NADP+ = a di-trans,poly-cis-dolichal + NADPH + H+." [PMID:38821050, RHEA:80731]

GO:0160198.name: polyprenal reductase activity
GO:0160198.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ditrans,polycis-polyprenal+ H+ + NADPH = ditrans,polycis-dolichal+ NADP." [PMID:38821050, RHEA:80727]

GO:0160199.name: positive regulation of 7-methylguanosine mRNA capping
GO:0160199.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of 7-methylguanosine mRNA capping." [PMID:19328067]

GO:0160201.name: polaroplast
GO:0160201.def: "A membrane-bounded organelle found in a microsporidian spore,  that swells with water, and exerts pressure to rupture the polar cap and evert the polar tube through which the sporoplasm escapes to infect the host." [PMID:16005007, PMID:19673893, Wikipedia:polaroplast]

GO:0160202.name: polar tube anchoring disc
GO:0160202.def: "A structural component of the microsporidian spore's invasion apparatus that is located at the anterior end of the spore and serves to attach the polar tube to the inside of the spore wall." [PMID:16005007, PMID:19673893]

GO:0160203.name: mitochondrial disulfide relay system
GO:0160203.def: "A protein folding process that facilitates the import of a subset of soluble proteins into mitochondrial intermembrane space via disulfide bond formation." [PMID:32936885, PMID:37159021]

GO:0160204.name: mitochondrion-mitochondrion outer membrane tether activity
GO:0160204.def: "The binding activity of a molecule that brings together two mitochondrion membranes via membrane lipid binding or by interacting with a mitochondrial outer membrane protein, to establish or maintain the localization of the mitochondrion." [PMID:38843396]

GO:0160205.name: cysteine-dependent adenosine diphosphate thiazole synthase activity
GO:0160205.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: [ADP-thiazole synthase]-L-cysteine + glycine + NAD(+) = [ADP-thiazole synthase]-dehydroalanine + ADP-5-ethyl-4-methylthiazole-2-carboxylate + 2 H(+) + 3 H2O + nicotinamide." [RHEA:55708]

GO:0160206.name: tRNA (cytidine(32)/uridine(32)-2'-O)-methyltransferase activity
GO:0160206.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: cytidine(32)/uridine(32) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2'-O-methylcytidine(32)/2'-O-methyluridine(32) in tRNA + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine." [EC:2.1.1.200]

GO:0160207.name: positive regulation of androgen receptor signaling pathway
GO:0160207.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of androgen receptor signaling." [PMID:29057879]

GO:0160208.name: fibrous body-membranous organelle
GO:0160208.def: "A Golgi-derived organelle that forms in primary spermatocytes during spermatogenesis of some nematodes including C. elegans. This 'double organelle' consists of a fibrous body containing major sperm protein and a membranous organelle that envelops the developing fibrous body." [PMID:18050478, PMID:8004009]

GO:0160209.name: FMRP-CYFIP1 complex
GO:0160209.def: "A protein-containing complex that contains the fragile X mental retardation protein (FMRP) and cytoplasmic FMRP Interacting protein 1 (CYIFIP1), and is capable of inhibiting translation initiation by binding to the eIF4F complex." [PMID:18805096, PMID:28183735]

GO:0160210.name: L-serine O-succinyltransferase activity
GO:0160210.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: L-serine + succinyl-CoA = CoA + O-succinyl-L-serine." [PMID:28581482, RHEA:52820]

GO:0160211.name: apicoplast membrane
GO:0160211.def: "Any of the lipid bilayers that surround an apicoplast and form the apicoplast envelope." [PMID:20124342, PMID:38865262]

GO:0160212.name: glycine-gated cation channel activity
GO:0160212.def: "Enables the transmembrane transfer of a cation by a channel that opens when glycine is bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts on the extracellular side of the plasma membrane." [PMID:11823786]

GO:0160213.name: beta-arrestin-dependent dopamine receptor signaling pathway
GO:0160213.def: "A beta-arrestin-dependent signaling pathway initiated by a dopamine binding to its receptor on the surface of a target cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process." [PMID:21711983, PMID:25671228]

GO:0160214.name: endoplasmic reticulum-plasma membrane adaptor activity
GO:0160214.def: "The binding activity of a molecule that brings together a plasma membrane with an endoplasmic reticulum membrane, via membrane lipid binding, to establish membrane contact sites and mediate exchange and communication." [PMID:23041194, PMID:39239853]

GO:0160215.name: deacylase activity
GO:0160215.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: R-CO-X + H2O = R-COOH + HX, hydrolysis of an acyl group or groups from a substrate molecule." [PMID:2760018, PMID:29637793, PMID:38355760]

GO:0160216.name: protein lysine delactylase activity
GO:0160216.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-lactoyl-L-lysyl-[protein] = (S)-lactate + L-lysyl-[protein]." [PMID:35044827, RHEA:81387]

GO:0160217.name: negative regulation of transcription initiation-coupled chromatin remodeling
GO:0160217.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of transcription initiation-coupled chromatin remodeling." [PMID:33980486]

GO:0160218.name: negative regulation of pyruvate decarboxylation to acetyl-CoA
GO:0160218.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of acetyl-CoA from pyruvate. In most organisms, this pathway links glycolysis to the TCA cycle, by a series of three reactions carried out by a multisubunit complex called the 'pyruvate dehydrogenase complex', even though pyruvate dehydrogenase activity describes only one of those reactions." [PMID:26942675, PMID:36849569, PMID:37754565]

GO:0160219.name: cortical endoplasmic reticulum membrane
GO:0160219.def: "The lipid bilayer surrounding the cortical endoplasmic reticulum." [PMID:32735772]

GO:0160220.name: D-alanine-(R)-lactate ligase activity
GO:0160220.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-lactate + ATP + D-alanine = ADP + D-alanyl-(R)-lactate + phosphate." [RHEA:37347]

GO:0160221.name: Rho-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway
GO:0160221.def: "A G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway in which the signal is transmitted via the activation of Rho activity. Rho is a family of small (~21 kDa) signaling G proteins that include RhoA, Cdc42, and Rac1." [PMID:10836144, PMID:33849392]

GO:0160222.name: D-alanine-D-serine ligase activity
GO:0160222.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + D-alanine + D-serine = ADP + D-alanyl-D-serine + H+ + phosphate." [EC:6.3.2.35, RHEA:27706]

GO:0160223.name: pyrenoid tubule
GO:0160223.def: "A specialized membranous structure that extends from the photosynthetic thylakoid membrane into and transverses the matrix of a pyrenoid." [PMID:32428480]

GO:0160224.name: 3-demethoxyubiquinone 3-hydroxylase (NADH) activity
GO:0160224.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: a 5-methoxy-2-methyl-3-(all-trans-polyprenyl)benzoquinone + NADH + O2 = a 3-demethylubiquinone + NAD+ + H2O." [PMID:23445365, PMID:38425362, RHEA:81211]

GO:0160225.name: G-quadruplex unwinding activity
GO:0160225.def: "Unwinding G-quadruplex structures in nucleic acids. A G-quadruplex is a specialized structure formed in DNA/RNA when sequences rich in guanine (G) assemble into a unique four-stranded arrangement." [PMID:1324186, PMID:26883636, PMID:34113828]

GO:0160226.name: oligosaccharyltransferase complex A
GO:0160226.def: "An oligosaccharyltransferase complex that contains STT3A as the catalytic subunit." [PMID:31831667, PMID:39509507]

GO:0160227.name: oligosaccharyltransferase complex B

GO:0160243.name: histone H1 demethylase activity

GO:0160253.name: de novo tRNA queuosine(34) biosynthetic process

GO:0160256.name: L-lysine transmembrane import into the mitochondrion

GO:0160257.name: complement activation, GZMK pathway

GO:0170053.def: "Binds to and increases the activity of a nuclease." [PMID:24736845]

GO:0170054.name: ribonuclease activator activity
GO:0170054.def: "Binds to and increases the activity of a ribonuclease." [PMID:24736845]

GO:0170055.name: lipid transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0170055.def: "Enables the transfer of a lipid from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:curators]

GO:0170056.name: cholesterol 7-desaturase [NAD(P)H] activity
GO:0170056.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: cholesterol + H+ + NAD(P)H + O2 = 7-dehydrocholesterol + 2 H2O + NAD(P)+." [EC:1.14.19.21, PMID:21632547, PMID:31521708]

GO:0170057.name: RNA ligase (GTP) activity
GO:0170057.def: "Catalysis of the joining of an RNA with 3'-phosphate or 2',3'-cyclic-phosphate ends to an RNA with 5'-hydroxy ends according to either (i) a 3'-end 3'-phospho-ribonucleotide-RNA + a 5'-end dephospho-ribonucleoside-RNA + GTP = a ribonucleotidyl-ribonucleotide-RNA + diphosphate + GMP; or (ii) a 3'-end 2',3'-cyclophospho-ribonucleotide-RNA + a 5'-end dephospho-ribonucleoside-RNA + GTP + H2O = a ribonucleotidyl-ribonucleotide-RNA + diphosphate + GMP + H+." [EC:6.5.1.8, PMID:21311021]

GO:0170060.name: microtubule destabilizing activity
GO:0170060.def: "A protein-containing complex destabilizing activity that promotes microtubule catastrophe (transition from microtubule growth to microtubule shrinkage)." [PMID:29858272, PMID:36435910]

GO:0170061.name: nickel chaperone activity
GO:0170061.def: "Directly binding to and delivering nickel ions to a target protein." [PMID:32133383, PMID:34530332]

GO:0170062.name: nutrient storage
GO:0170062.def: "The accumulation and maintenance in cells or tissues of a nutrient, a substance that is used by an organism to survive, to grow, and to reproduce; such as proteins, vitamins, and minerals. Nutrient reserves can be accumulated for mobilization and utilization when needed." [GOC:ew]

GO:0170063.name: transmembrane transport from lysosomal lumen to cytosol
GO:0170063.def: "The directed movement of a solute from the lysosomal lumen across the lysosomal membrane and into the cytosol." [PMID:26631267]

GO:0170064.name: lysosome fission
GO:0170064.def: "The process by which lysosomes undergo budding and fission to maintain their steady-state number, shape, size, composition and function, and to accomplish regeneration." [PMID:31171420, PMID:38538795]

GO:0170066.name: negative regulation of polyamine biosynthetic process
GO:0170066.def: "Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of polyamine biosynthesis. Polyamine biosynthesis is the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of polyamines, any organic compound containing two or more amino groups." [PMID:9769097]

GO:0170067.name: L-arginine biosynthetic process via N-acetyl-L-citrulline
GO:0170067.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of arginine (2-amino-5-guanidinopentanoic acid) via the intermediate compound N-acetyl-L-citrulline." [PMID:16585758]

GO:0170068.name: geranylgeranyltransferase type III activity
GO:0170068.def: "Catalyzes the covalent addition of a geranylgeranyl group to a mono-farnesylated substrate via a thioether linkage to a cysteine residue located within a conserved C-terminal tandem cysteine motif (CCAIM or CCIIM) that is used in substrate recognition. Known substrates include mono-farnesylated Golgi SNARE proteins." [PMID:32128853, PMID:33035318, PMID:35628237, PMID:40049413]

GO:0170069.name: geranylgeranyltransferase-III complex
GO:0170069.def: "A protein-containing complex that catalyzes the transfer of a geranyl-geranyl group from geranylgeranyl pyrophosphate to a mono-farnsylated substrate. In humans, the complex is comprised of a prenyltransferase alpha subunit, PTAR1 and beta subunit, RabGGTB, while in budding yeast the prenyltransferase complex contains Ecm9p, the alpha subunit and Bet2p, the beta subunit." [PMID:32128853, PMID:33035318, PMID:35628237, PMID:40049413]

GO:0170070.name: negative regulation of mitochondrial transcription
GO:0170070.def: "Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of transcription occurring in the mitochondrion." [PMID:23300484]

GO:0180000.name: histone methyltransferase inhibitor activity
GO:0180000.def: "Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a histone methyltransferase." [PMID:30923826]

GO:0180001.name: cyclic-di-AMP binding
GO:0180001.def: "Binding to a cyclic di-AMP nucleotide." [PMID:32843560, PMID:36629470]

GO:0180002.name: renal zinc excretion
GO:0180002.def: "The elimination of zinc ions from peritubular capillaries (or surrounding hemolymph in invertebrates) into the renal tubules to be incorporated subsequently into the urine." [PMID:28196538]

GO:0180003.name: S-adenosyl-L-methionine:S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine antiporter activity
GO:0180003.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine(out) + S-adenosyl-L-methionine(in) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine(in) + S-adenosyl-L-methionine(out)." [PMID:14674884, PMID:34375635]

GO:0180004.name: RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat Y1 phosphatase activity
GO:0180004.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat--phospho-L-tyrosine (consensus YSPTSPS)(position 1) + H2O = RNA polymerase II large subunit + phosphate." [PMID:22622228]

GO:0180005.name: RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat T4 phosphatase activity
GO:0180005.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat--phospho-L-threonine (consensus YSPTSPS)(position 4) + H2O = RNA polymerase II large subunit + phosphate." [PMID:22622228]

GO:0180006.name: RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat S2 phosphatase activity
GO:0180006.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat--phospho-L-serine (consensus YSPTSPS)(position 2) + H2O = RNA polymerase II large subunit + phosphate." [PMID:22622228]

GO:0180007.name: RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat S5 phosphatase activity
GO:0180007.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat--phospho-L-serine (consensus YSPTSPS)(position 5) + H2O = RNA polymerase II large subunit + phosphate." [PMID:22622228]

GO:0180008.name: RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat S7 phosphatase activity
GO:0180008.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat--phospho-L-serine (consensus YSPTSPS)(position 7) + H2O = RNA polymerase II large subunit + phosphate." [PMID:22622228]

GO:0180009.name: broad specificity neutral L-amino acid:basic L-amino acid antiporter activity
GO:0180009.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: basic L-amino acid(in) + neutral L-amino acid(out) = basic L-amino acid(in) + neutral L-amino acid(out)." [PMID:23506863, PMID:8663357]

GO:0180010.name: co-transcriptional mRNA 3'-end processing, cleavage and polyadenylation pathway
GO:0180010.def: "Any process involved in transcription termination-coupled 3' processing of RNA polymerase II mRNA transcripts by the 3' end cleavage and addition of a poly(A) tail." [PMID:31499460]

GO:0180011.name: cytosolic mRNA polyadenylation
GO:0180011.def: "Any process by which dormant, translationally inactive mRNAs become activated, or mRNAs become stabilized, via the elongation of their poly(A) tails in the cytosol." [PMID:21536428]

GO:0180012.name: co-transcriptional RNA 3'-end processing, cleavage and polyadenylation pathway
GO:0180012.def: "Any process involved in transcription termination-coupled 3' processing of RNA polymerase II RNA transcripts by 3' end cleavage and addition of a poly(A) tail." [PMID:31499460]

GO:0180013.name: lysophosphatidylserine flippase activity
GO:0180013.def: "Catalysis of the movement of a lysophosphatidylserine from the exoplasmic to the cytosolic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP." [PMID:34645814]

GO:0180014.name: protein-tRNA adaptor activity
GO:0180014.def: "The binding activity of a protein that brings together another protein and a tRNA, permitting those molecules to function in a coordinated way." [PMID:31048492]

GO:0180015.name: nucleoside import across plasma membrane
GO:0180015.def: "The directed movement of nucleoside from outside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the cytosol." [PMID:21998139, PMID:30658162]

GO:0180016.name: SUMO ligase regulator activity
GO:0180016.def: "Binds to and modulates the activity of a SUMO ligase." [PMID:19363481, PMID:33446573]

GO:0180017.name: K11-linked deubiquitinase activity
GO:0180017.def: "Hydrolysis of a ubiquitin unit from a ubiquitinated protein linked via the Lys11 residue of ubiquitin." [PMID:26412298]

GO:0180018.name: cytoplasmic polyadenylation-dependent RNA catabolic process
GO:0180018.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways occurring in the cytoplasm and resulting in the breakdown of an RNA molecule, initiated by the enzymatic addition of a sequence of adenylyl residues (polyadenylation) at the 3' end the target rRNA truncated degradation intermediate." [PMID:20368444]

GO:0180019.name: Knl1/Spc105 complex
GO:0180019.def: "A kinetochore subcomplex that binds to centromeric chromatin and forms part of the outer kinetochore. It helps to recruit outer kinetochore subunits that will bind to microtubules. In humans and yeast respectively, it consists of KNL1/Spc105p and ZWINT/Kre28p." [PMID:27881301]

GO:0180020.name: membrane bending activity
GO:0180020.def: "The activity of bending or deforming a membrane. This activity can occur by multiple mechanisms including the insertion amphipathic domains into one or both leaflets." [PMID:19780639]

GO:0180021.name: U6 snRNA 2'-O-ribose methyltransferase activity
GO:0180021.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + U6 snRNA = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + U6 containing a 3'-terminal 2'-O-methylnucleotide + H+." [PMID:37403782, RHEA:63088]

GO:0180022.name: RQC-trigger complex
GO:0180022.def: "A ribosome disassembly complex which dissociates stalled ribsome subunits as part of the ribosome quality control pathway. RQT complex is composed of a RNA helicase-family protein yeast Rqt2 (human ASCC3), a ubiquitin-binding protein yeast Rqt3, (human ASCC2), and Rqt4 (human TRIP4). The human complex has an additional component protein ASCC1 and can act as a transcriptional coactivator by interacting with transcription factors such as NF-kappa B." [PMID:12077347, PMID:28757607, PMID:32099016]

GO:0180023.name: cytosolic large ribosomal subunit assembly
GO:0180023.def: "The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a cytosolic large ribosomal subunit." [PMID:30467428]

GO:0180024.name: membrane grommet activity
GO:0180024.def: "An activity in which a protein, or group of proteins, acts to restrict the size of a fenestration in a membrane or membrane system (i.e. restrict the diameter of a hole in a membrane). An example of this is the molecular function is performed by ESCRT-III proteins at the nuclear envelope of fission yeast during anaphase B." [PMID:37783794]

GO:0180025.name: cytosolic small ribosomal subunit assembly
GO:0180025.def: "The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a cytosolic small ribosomal subunit." [PMID:30467428]

GO:0180026.name: mitochondrial small ribosomal subunit assembly
GO:0180026.def: "The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a mitochondrial small ribosomal subunit." [PMID:30467428]

GO:0180027.name: inner nuclear membrane-associated protein degradation pathway
GO:0180027.def: "A protein quality control pathway that removes ubiquitinated proteins from the nuclear inner membrane before transferring them to the proteasome for degradation." [PMID:37694715]

GO:0180028.name: mitotic spindle pole body attachment site
GO:0180028.def: "A region of the nuclear envelope to which a spindle pole body (SPB) attaches; protein complexes embedded in the nuclear envelope mediate direct or indirect linkages between the microtubule cytoskeleton and the nuclear envelope." [PMID:37783794]

GO:0180029.name: phosphate ion export across plasma membrane
GO:0180029.def: "The directed movement of phosphate ions (Pi) from inside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the extracellular region." [PMID:37949217]

GO:0180030.name: inositol phosphate kinase activity
GO:0180030.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: inositol phosphate + ATP = inositol phosphate + ADP." [PMID:35536002]

GO:0180031.name: snoRNA 2,2,7-trimethylguanosine (TMG) capping
GO:0180031.def: "The sequence of enzymatic reactions by which a 2,2,7-trimethylguanosine cap structure is added to the 5' end of an snoRNA. The snoRNA capping includes the formation of 7-methyl-G caps found on all RNA polymerase II transcripts, followed by hypermethylation at the 2' position of the guanosine residue to convert a mono-methylated cap to a 2,2,7-trimethylguanosine cap structure. Note that the pol III transcribed snoRNAs are also TMG capped." [GOC:vw, PMID:15590684]

GO:0180032.name: histone H4K5 deacetylase activity, hydrolytic mechanism
GO:0180032.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: histone H4 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 5) + H2O = histone H4 L-lysine (position 5) + acetate. This reaction represents the removal of an acetyl group from lysine at position 5 of the histone H4 protein." [PMID:37459529]

GO:0180033.name: histone H4K8 deacetylase activity, hydrolytic mechanism
GO:0180033.def: "Catalysis of the reaction: histone H4 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 8) + H2O = histone H4 L-lysine (position 8) + acetate. This reaction represents the removal of an acetyl group from lysine at position 8 of the histone H4 protein." [PMID:37459529]

GO:0180034.name: co-transcriptional lncRNA 3' end processing, cleavage and polyadenylation pathway
GO:0180034.def: "Any process involved in transcription termination-coupled 3' processing of RNA polymerase II lncRNA transcripts by the 3' end cleavage and addition of a poly(A) tail." [PMID:31276588]

GO:0180035.name: lncRNA processing
GO:0180035.def: "Any process involved in the conversion of one or more primary lncRNA transcripts into one or more mature lncRNA molecules." [PMID:31276588]

GO:0180036.name: nuclear lncRNA surveillance
GO:0180036.def: "A process that identifies and degrades defective or aberrant lncRNAs within the nucleus." [GOC:vw]

GO:0180037.name: rapid tRNA decay
GO:0180037.def: "A cytoplasmic tRNA surveillance pathway that targets mature hypomodified tRNAs, catalyzed by 5'-3' exonucleases Xrn1 (S. cerevisiae/human) and Rat1 (S. cerevisiae) XRN2 human, and regulated by adenosine 3',5' bisphosphate (pAp)." [GOC:vw, PMID:35901126]

GO:0180038.name: cyclin L-CDK11 complex
GO:0180038.def: "A protein complex consisting of cyclin L and cyclin-dependent kinase 11 (CDK11). Cyclins are characterized by periodicity in protein abundance throughout the cell cycle. Cyclin-dependent kinases represent a family of serine/threonine protein kinases that become active upon binding to a cyclin regulatory partner." [PMID:23122962, PMID:32446654]

GO:0180039.name: regulation of pheromone response MAPK cascade
GO:0180039.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of a pheromone response MAPK cascade." [GOC:vw]

GO:0180040.name: negative regulation of pheromone response MAPK cascade
GO:0180040.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of a pheromone response MAPK cascade." [GOC:vw]

GO:0180041.name: dol-P-Man:GlcN-acyl-PI alpha-1,4-mannosyltransferase activity
GO:0180041.def: "Catalysis of the transfer of an alpha-D-mannosyl residue from dolichol-P-mannose to GlcN-acyl-PI, forming an alpha-(1->4)-D-mannosyl-GlcN linkage. This transfers the first mannose to the GPI precursor." [PMID:11226175, PMID:15635094]

GO:0180042.name: polyphosphate import into vacuole

GO:0180043.name: inositol pyrophosphate sensor activity
GO:0180043.def: "Binding to and responding, e.g. by conformational change, to changes in the cellular level of an inositol pyrophosphate." [PMID:37949217]

GO:0180044.name: borate channel activity
GO:0180044.def: "Enables the facilitated diffusion of borate (by an energy-independent process) involving passage through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel without evidence for a carrier-mediated mechanism." [PMID:21710975]

GO:0180045.name: type 1 mitophagy

GO:0180046.name: GPI anchored protein biosynthesis

GO:0180047.name: dolichol phosphate mannose biosynthetic process
GO:0180047.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of dolichol phosphate mannose." [PMID:18387370]

GO:0180048.name: phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate biosynthetic process
GO:0180048.def: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate." [PMID:39239853]

GO:0180049.name: Mrh5C translation activator complex
GO:0180049.def: "A protein complex capable of translation activator activity, and is involved in the activation of cox1 mRNA for translation. In fission yeast this complex consists of a scaffold (Sls1), a helicase (Mrh5), and PPR repeat proteins Prr4 and Mtf2." [PMID:34634819, PMID:38499152]

GO:0180050.name: protein-mitochondrial outer membrane tethering activity
GO:0180050.def: "The binding activity of a molecule that brings together a protein or protein complex and a mitochondrial outer membrane lipid or membrane-associated protein, in order to maintain the localization of the protein, or protein complex at a specific mitochondrial outer membrane location." [GOC:vw]

GO:0180051.name: translation factor activity
GO:0180051.def: "A molecular function required for translation of a mRNA into a protein functioning as part of initiation, elongation or termination of translation." [GOC:pg]

GO:0180052.name: mitochondrial translation initiation complex
GO:0180052.def: "A ribonucleoprotein complex comprising the mRNA bound fully assembled 55S mitoribosome with the tRNA-met positioned in the P-site of the mitochondrial small subunit to recognize the mRNA start codon." [GOC:vw, PMID:32522994]

GO:0180053.name: mitochondrial translation preinitiation complex
GO:0180053.def: "A ribonucleoprotein complex comprising of the 28S small mitoribosomal subunit (mt-SSU) and mitochondrial initiation factors (e.g. mtIF3 and mtIF2-GTP) and the initiator tRNA-Met and an mRNA binding. [GOC:vw, PMID:32522994]

GO:0180054.name: ribosome translocase activity

GO:0180055.name: response to metal ion starvation

GO:0180056.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: citrate(out) + 2-oxogluarate(in) = citrate(in) + 2-oxogluarat(out)." [PMID:20371607]

GO:0180060.def: "A process in which iron siderophores (low-molecular-weight, high-affinity iron-chelating compounds) are exported to scavenge iron and the iron-loaded siderophores imported back into the cell by transmembrane transport or endocytosis." [GOC:vw]

GO:0180061.name: native siderophore export across plasma membrane
GO:0180061.def: "The directed movement of siderophores, low molecular weight Fe(III)-chelating substances, from inside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the extracellular region." [GOC:vw]

GO:0180062.name: protein O-linked glycosylation via galactose
GO:0180062.def: "A glycoprotein biosynthetic process starting with the covalent linkage of galactose via a beta-glycosidic bond to the oxygen atom of the hydroxyl group of a hydroxyproline, a hydroxylysine, a serine or a threonine in a protein, which can be further elongated with the sequential addition of sugar units resulting in the formation of a protein O-linked glycan. [https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK579918/, PMID:17516569, PMID:30822656, PMID:33815452]

GO:0180063.name: protein O-linked glycosylation via arabinose

GO:1904091.name: non-ribosomal peptide synthetase activity
GO:1904091.def: "Catalysis of a multistep reaction that produce non-ribosomal peptides. The key chain-building reaction, a C-N bond-forming reaction, involves the generation of the characteristic peptide bond by nucleophilic attack of the amino group of an amino-acyl donor unit covalently bound to a downstream peptidyl carrier protein module (amino acyl-S-PCP) on the acyl group of an upstream electrophilic acyl- or peptidyl acyl-S-PCP chain, catalyzed by a condensation (C) domain. Supplementing these core chain-elongation domains are variable numbers of auxiliary domains that are responsible for modification of the growing polypeptide chain by a small set of iterated reactions including epimerization, N-methylation, and heterocyclization." GO:1905938.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of germ cell proliferation." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:15342467]

GO:1905939.name: regulation of gonad development
GO:1905939.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of gonad development." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:15342467]

GO:1905940.name: negative regulation of gonad development
GO:1905940.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of gonad development." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:15342467]

GO:1905941.name: positive regulation of gonad development
GO:1905941.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of gonad development." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:15342467]

GO:1905942.name: regulation of formation of growth cone in injured axon
GO:1905942.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of formation of growth cone in injured axon." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:19737525]

GO:1905943.name: negative regulation of formation of growth cone in injured axon
GO:1905943.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of formation of growth cone in injured axon." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:19737525]

GO:1905944.name: positive regulation of formation of growth cone in injured axon
GO:1905944.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of formation of growth cone in injured axon." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:19737525]

GO:1905945.name: regulation of response to calcium ion
GO:1905945.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of response to calcium ion." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:aruk, GOC:bc, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:11404397]

GO:1905946.name: negative regulation of response to calcium ion
GO:1905946.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of response to calcium ion." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:aruk, GOC:bc, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:11404397]

GO:1905947.name: positive regulation of response to calcium ion
GO:1905947.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of response to calcium ion." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:aruk, GOC:bc, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:11404397]

GO:1905948.name: ABC-type 3',5'-cyclic GMP transmembrane transporter activity
GO:1905948.def: "Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + 3',5'-cyclic GMP(in) = ADP + phosphate + 3',5'-cyclic GMP(out)." [GO_REF:0000070, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:18310115]

GO:1905949.name: negative regulation of calcium ion import across plasma membrane
GO:1905949.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of calcium ion import across plasma membrane." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:bhm, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:17640527]

GO:1905951.name: mitochondrion DNA recombination
GO:1905951.def: "Any DNA recombination that takes place in mitochondrion." [GO_REF:0000062, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:8087883]

GO:1905952.name: regulation of lipid localization
GO:1905952.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of lipid localization." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:17564681]

GO:1905953.name: negative regulation of lipid localization
GO:1905953.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of lipid localization." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:17564681]

GO:1905954.name: positive regulation of lipid localization
GO:1905954.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of lipid localization." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:17564681]

GO:1905955.name: negative regulation of endothelial tube morphogenesis
GO:1905955.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of endothelial tube morphogenesis." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:BHF, GOC:BHF_miRNA, GOC:rph, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:25961718]

GO:1905956.name: positive regulation of endothelial tube morphogenesis
GO:1905956.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of endothelial tube morphogenesis." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:BHF, GOC:BHF_miRNA, GOC:rph, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:25961718]

GO:1905957.name: regulation of cellular response to alcohol
GO:1905957.def: "Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of cellular response to alcohol." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:26434723]

GO:1905958.name: negative regulation of cellular response to alcohol
GO:1905958.def: "Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of cellular response to alcohol." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:26434723]

GO:1905959.name: positive regulation of cellular response to alcohol
GO:1905959.def: "Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of cellular response to alcohol." [GO_REF:0000058, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:26434723]

GO:1905960.name: response to differentiation-inducing factor 2
GO:1905960.def: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a 1-(3,5-dichloro-2,6-dihydroxy-4-methoxyphenyl)pentan-1-one stimulus." [GO_REF:0000071, GOC:rjd, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:19684855, PMID:3355503]

GO:1905961.name: protein-cysteine S-palmitoyltransferase complex
GO:1905961.def: "A protein complex which is capable of protein-cysteine S-palmitoyltransferase activity." [GO_REF:0000088, GOC:bhm, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:20851885]

GO:1905962.name: glutamatergic neuron differentiation
